verses.textZh: 亚当、塞特、以挪士、
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当、塞特、以挪士、

verses.textEnNiv: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
verses.textEnEsv: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
verses.textEnNkjv: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Adam were Seth, Enosh,
verses.textEnNasb: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
verses.textEn: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

verses.textZh: 该南、玛勒列、雅列、
verses.textZhCnvs: 该南、玛勒列、雅列、
verses.textZhCuv: 以挪士生该南；该南生玛勒列；玛勒列生雅列；
verses.textEnNiv: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
verses.textEnEsv: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
verses.textEnNkjv: Cainan, Mahalalel, Jared,
verses.textEnNlt: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
verses.textEnNasb: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
verses.textEn: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

verses.textZh: 以诺、玛土撒拉、拉麦、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以诺、玛土撒拉、拉麦、
verses.textZhCuv: 雅列生以诺；以诺生玛土撒拉；玛土撒拉生拉麦；
verses.textEnNiv: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
verses.textEnEsv: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
verses.textEnNkjv: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.textEnNlt: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.textEnNasb: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.textEn: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.

verses.textZh: 挪亚、挪亚生闪、含和雅弗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚、挪亚生闪、含和雅弗。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉麦生挪亚；挪亚生闪、含、雅弗。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
verses.textEnEsv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNlt: and Noah. The sons of Noah were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNasb: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEn: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth.

verses.textZh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEn: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.

verses.textZh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、低法、陀迦玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、低法、陀迦玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、低法 、陀迦玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

verses.textZh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施，基提人和多单人也是他的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施，基提人和多单人也是他的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单 。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshishah, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.textEn: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.

verses.textZh: 含的儿子是古实、埃及、弗和迦南。
verses.textZhCnvs: 含的儿子是古实、埃及、弗和迦南。
verses.textZhCuv: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.

verses.textZh: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛和撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴和底但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛和撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴和底但。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabtecha. The sons of Raama were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raama were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.textZh: 古实又生宁录；宁录是世上第一位英雄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实又生宁录；宁录是世上第一位英雄。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实生宁录；他为世上英雄之首。
verses.textEnNiv: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Cush fathered Nimrod. He was the first on earth to be a mighty man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Cush was also the ancestor of Nimrod, who was the first heroic warrior on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.
verses.textEn: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.

verses.textZh: 埃及生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.textZhCuv: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
verses.textEnEsv: Egypt fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.textEnNkjv: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.textEnNlt: Mizraim was the ancestor of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
verses.textEnNasb: Mizraim fathered the people of Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh,
verses.textEn: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

verses.textZh: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人和迦斐托人；从迦斐托而出的有非利士人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人和迦斐托人；从迦斐托而出的有非利士人。
verses.textZhCuv: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。
verses.textEnNiv: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.
verses.textEnEsv: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom the Philistines came), and Caphtorim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and the Caphtorim).
verses.textEnNlt: Pathrusites, Casluhites, and the Caphtorites, from whom the Philistines came.
verses.textEnNasb: Pathrus, and Casluh, from whom the Philistines came, and the Caphtorim.
verses.textEn: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

verses.textZh: 迦南生了长子西顿，又生赫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦南生了长子西顿，又生赫。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫
verses.textEnNiv: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
verses.textEnEsv: Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn and Heth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Canaan begot Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth;
verses.textEnNlt: Canaan’s oldest son was Sidon, the ancestor of the Sidonians. Canaan was also the ancestor of the Hittites,
verses.textEnNasb: Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.textEn: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

verses.textZh: 他的子孙还有：耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的子孙还有：耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.textZhCuv: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.textEnNiv: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
verses.textEnEsv: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.textEnNkjv: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
verses.textEnNlt: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
verses.textEnNasb: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.textEn: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

verses.textZh: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
verses.textZhCuv: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
verses.textEnNiv: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
verses.textEnEsv: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.textEnNkjv: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;
verses.textEnNlt: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
verses.textEnNasb: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.textEn: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

verses.textZh: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人和哈马人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人和哈马人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人，并哈马人。
verses.textEnNiv: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.
verses.textEnEsv: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
verses.textEnNkjv: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.textEnNlt: Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites.
verses.textEnNasb: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
verses.textEn: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.

verses.textZh: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰；亚兰的儿子是 、乌斯、户勒、基帖、米设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰；亚兰的儿子是 、乌斯、户勒、基帖、米设。
verses.textZhCuv: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰、乌斯、户勒、基帖、米设 。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram. And the sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The descendants of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.

verses.textZh: 亚法撒生沙拉，沙拉生希伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚法撒生沙拉，沙拉生希伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
verses.textEnNiv: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
verses.textEnEsv: Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arphaxad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
verses.textEnNlt: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah. Shelah was the father of Eber.
verses.textEnNasb: Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.
verses.textEn: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.

verses.textZh: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒，因为他在世的时候，世人就分散各地；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒，因为他在世的时候，世人就分散各地；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯生了两个儿子：一个名叫法勒 ，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
verses.textEnNiv: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.
verses.textEnEsv: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg (for in his days the earth was divided), and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEnNlt: Eber had two sons. The first was named Peleg (which means "division"), for during his lifetime the people of the world were divided into different language groups. His brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEnNasb: Two sons were born to Eber: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEn: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

verses.textZh: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
verses.textZhCuv: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
verses.textEnNiv: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnEsv: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnNlt: Joktan was the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnNasb: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEn: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.textZh: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
verses.textZhCuv: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、

verses.textEnEsv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.textEnNasb: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEn: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.textZh: 以巴录、亚比玛利、示巴、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以巴录、亚比玛利、示巴、
verses.textZhCuv: 以巴录、亚比玛利、示巴、
verses.textEnNiv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnEsv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnNlt: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnNasb: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEn: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.textZh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴。这些人都是约坍的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴。这些人都是约坍的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴。这都是约坍的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
verses.textEnEsv: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.textEnNlt: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were descendants of Joktan.
verses.textEnNasb: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.textEn: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

verses.textZh: 闪、亚法撒、沙拉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 闪、亚法撒、沙拉、
verses.textZhCuv: 闪生亚法撒；亚法撒生沙拉；
verses.textEnNiv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.textEnEsv: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah;
verses.textEnNkjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.textEnNlt: So this is the family line descended from Shem: Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.textEnNasb: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
verses.textEn: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

verses.textZh: 希伯、法勒、拉吴、
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯、法勒、拉吴、
verses.textZhCuv: 沙拉生希伯；希伯生法勒；法勒生拉吴；

verses.textEnNlt: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.textEnNasb: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.textEn: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰，亚伯兰就是亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰，亚伯兰就是亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拉生亚伯兰，亚伯兰就是亚伯拉罕。
verses.textEnNiv: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
verses.textEnEsv: Abram, that is, Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Abram, who is Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: and Abram, later known as Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: and Abram, that is Abraham.
verses.textEn: and Abram (that is, Abraham).

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子是以撒和以实玛利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕的儿子是以撒和以实玛利。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕的儿子是以撒、以实玛利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.textEn: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

verses.textZh: 以下是他们的后代：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，他其余的儿子是基达、押德别、米比衫、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是他们的后代：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，他其余的儿子是基达、押德别、米比衫、
verses.textZhCuv: 以实玛利的儿子记在下面：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，其次是基达、押德别、米比衫、
verses.textEnNiv: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnEsv: These are their genealogies: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnNkjv: These are their genealogies: The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnNlt: These are their genealogical records: The sons of Ishmael were Nebaioth (the oldest), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnNasb: These are their genealogies: the firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEn: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

verses.textZh: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、哈达、提玛、
verses.textZhCnvs: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、哈达、提玛、
verses.textZhCuv: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、哈达、提玛、
verses.textEnNiv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.textEnEsv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.textEnNkjv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.textEnNlt: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.textEnNasb: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.textEn: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

verses.textZh: 伊突、拿非施、基底玛；这些人都是以实玛利的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伊突、拿非施、基底玛；这些人都是以实玛利的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 伊突、拿非施、基底玛。这都是以实玛利的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
verses.textEnEsv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
verses.textEnNlt: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
verses.textEnNasb: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah; these were the sons of Ishmael.
verses.textEn: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的儿子，就是心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、书亚。约珊的儿子是示巴和底但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的儿子，就是心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、书亚。约珊的儿子是示巴和底但。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的儿子，就是心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、书亚。约珊的儿子是示巴、底但。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine, were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine, were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine, to whom she gave birth, were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEn: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.textZh: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大、以勒大。这些人都是基土拉的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大、以勒大。这些人都是基土拉的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大、以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the descendants of Keturah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒。以撒的儿子是以扫和以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕生以撒。以撒的儿子是以扫和以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的儿子是以扫和以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.
verses.textEn: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

verses.textZh: 以扫的儿子是以利法、流珥、耶乌施、雅兰和可拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫的儿子是以利法、流珥、耶乌施、雅兰和可拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫的儿子是以利法、流珥、耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

verses.textZh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯、亭纳和亚玛力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯、亭纳和亚玛力。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯、亭纳、亚玛力。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz; by Timna: Amalek.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, and of Timna, Amalek.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, and Amalek, who was born to Timna.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
verses.textEn: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz; by Timna: Amalek.

verses.textZh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛和米撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛和米撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

verses.textZh: 西珥的儿子是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、底顺、以察和底珊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西珥的儿子是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、底顺、以察和底珊。
verses.textZhCuv: 西珥的儿子是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、底顺、以察、底珊。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.

verses.textZh: 罗坍的儿子是何利、荷幔；罗坍的妹妹是亭纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗坍的儿子是何利、荷幔；罗坍的妹妹是亭纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗坍的儿子是何利、荷幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Homam; Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan’s sister was named Timna.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Homam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.textEn: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

verses.textZh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒、玛拿辖、以巴录、示非和阿南。祭便的儿子是亚雅和亚拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒、玛拿辖、以巴录、示非和阿南。祭便的儿子是亚雅和亚拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示非、阿南。祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Shobal were Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon were Ajah and Anah.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Shobal were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The descendants of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shobal were Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

verses.textZh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。底顺的儿子是哈默兰、伊是班、益兰和基兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。底顺的儿子是哈默兰、伊是班、益兰和基兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。底顺的儿子是哈默兰、伊是班、益兰、基兰。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Anah was Dishon. The sons of Dishon were Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Anah was Dishon. The descendants of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Anah was Dishon. And the sons of Dishon were Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.textEn: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

verses.textZh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、耶亚干。底珊的儿子是乌斯和亚兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、耶亚干。底珊的儿子是乌斯和亚兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan. The sons of Dishan : Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The descendants of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan. The sons of Dishan : Uz and Aran.

verses.textZh: 以色列人没有君王统治的时候，在以东地作王的有以下这些人：比珥的儿子比拉，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人没有君王统治的时候，在以东地作王的有以下这些人：比珥的儿子比拉，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以东地作王的记在下面：有比珥的儿子比拉，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the people of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, the name of his city being Dinhabah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites : Bela son of Beor, who ruled from his city of Dinhabah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king from the sons of Israel reigned. Bela was the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.textEn: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.

verses.textZh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: When Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约巴死了，来自提幔地的户珊接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约巴死了，来自提幔地的户珊接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押的田野击败了米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押的田野击败了米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.textZhCuv: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王。这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.textEnNiv: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.
verses.textEnEsv: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place, the name of his city being Avith.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
verses.textEnNlt: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Avith. He was the one who destroyed the Midianite army in the land of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: When Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the field of Moab, became king in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.textEn: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

verses.textZh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Hadad died, Samlah from the city of Masrekah became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 桑拉死了，来自幼发拉底河旁边的利河伯的扫罗接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 桑拉死了，来自幼发拉底河旁边的利河伯的扫罗接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-by-the-River reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Samlah died, Shaul from the city of Rehoboth-on-the-River became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: When Samlah died, Shaul of Rehoboth by the Euphrates River became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒．哈南接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒．哈南接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒‧哈南接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Shaul died, and Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Acbor became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 巴勒．哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的京城名叫巴伊；他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米．萨合的孙女、玛特列的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒．哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的京城名叫巴伊；他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米．萨合的孙女、玛特列的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒‧哈南死了，哈达接续他作王。他的京城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米‧萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
verses.textEnEsv: Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place, the name of his city being Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Baal-Hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.textEnNlt: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Pau. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab.
verses.textEnNasb: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad became king in his place; and the name of his city was Pai, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.textEn: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

verses.textZh: 哈达死了，以东人的族长有亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、

verses.textEnEsv: And Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were Chief Timnah, Chief Aliah, Chief Jetheth,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hadad died. The clan leaders of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hadad died. Now the tribal chiefs of Edom were chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
verses.textEn: Hadad also died. The chiefs of Edom were: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

verses.textZh: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、

verses.textEn: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

verses.textEn: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

verses.textZh: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长，这些人都是以东的族长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长，这些人都是以东的族长。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这都是以东人的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: Magdiel, and Iram; these are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: Magdiel, and Iram. These are the clan leaders of Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
verses.textEn: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的儿子是：流本、西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦、

verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

verses.textEn: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

verses.textZh: 但、约瑟、便雅悯、拿弗他利、迦得和亚设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但、约瑟、便雅悯、拿弗他利、迦得和亚设。
verses.textZhCuv: 但、约瑟、便雅悯、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。
verses.textEnNiv: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.textEnEsv: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.textEnNlt: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.textEnNasb: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.textEn: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

verses.textZh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南和示拉。这三人是迦南人书亚的女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥行耶和华看为恶的事，耶和华就使他死去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南和示拉。这三人是迦南人书亚的女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥行耶和华看为恶的事，耶和华就使他死去。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉，这三人是迦南人书亚女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就使他死了。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah; these three Bath-shua the Canaanite bore to him. Now Er, Judah’s firstborn, was evil in the sight of the Lord , and he put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by the daughter of Shua, the Canaanitess. Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; so He killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah had three sons from Bathshua, a Canaanite woman. Their names were Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord saw that the oldest son, Er, was a wicked man, so he killed him.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah; these three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanitess. But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was evil in the sight of the Lord, so He put him to death.
verses.textEn: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.

verses.textZh: 犹大的媳妇他玛，给犹大生了法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的媳妇他玛，给犹大生了法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的儿妇她玛给犹大生法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah’s daughter-in-law Tamar bore Perez and Zerah to Judah. He had five sons in all.
verses.textEnEsv: His daughter-in-law Tamar also bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.textEnNlt: Later Judah had twin sons from Tamar, his widowed daughter-in-law. Their names were Perez and Zerah. So Judah had five sons in all.
verses.textEnNasb: His daughter-in-law Tamar bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
verses.textEn: Judah’s daughter-in-law Tamar bore Perez and Zerah to Judah. He had five sons in all.

verses.textZh: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯仑和哈母勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯仑和哈母勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯仑、哈母勒。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEn: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

verses.textZh: 谢拉的儿子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各和大拉，共五人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谢拉的儿子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各和大拉，共五人。
verses.textZhCuv: 谢拉的儿子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉 ，共五人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol and Darda —five in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, five in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda —five in all.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
verses.textEn: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol and Darda —five in all.

verses.textZh: 迦米的儿子是亚干；这亚干偷取了当毁灭之物，连累了以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦米的儿子是亚干；这亚干偷取了当毁灭之物，连累了以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦米的儿子是亚干，这亚干在当灭的物上犯了罪，连累了以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Karmi: Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, who broke faith in the matter of the devoted thing;
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Carmi was Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Carmi (a descendant of Zimri) was Achan, who brought disaster on Israel by taking plunder that had been set apart for the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Carmi was Achar, the one who brought disaster on Israel by violating the ban.
verses.textEn: The son of Karmi: Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.

verses.textZh: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.textEnEsv: and Ethan’s son was Azariah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Ethan was Azariah.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Ethan was Azariah.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Ethan was Azariah.
verses.textEn: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

verses.textZh: 希斯仑所生的儿子是耶拉篾、兰和基路拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希斯仑所生的儿子是耶拉篾、兰和基路拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 希斯仑所生的儿子是耶拉篾、兰、基路拜。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons born to Hezron were: Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Hezron that were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Hezron were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.textEn: The sons born to Hezron were: Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.

verses.textZh: 兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺是犹大人的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺是犹大人的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺。拿顺作犹大人的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, prince of the sons of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ram begot Amminadab, and Amminadab begot Nahshon, leader of the children of Judah;
verses.textEnNlt: Ram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, leader of the sons of Judah;
verses.textEn: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 拿顺生撒门；撒门生波阿斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿顺生撒门；撒门生波阿斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿顺生撒门；撒门生波阿斯；
verses.textEnNiv: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,
verses.textEnEsv: Nahshon fathered Salmon, Salmon fathered Boaz,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz;
verses.textEnNlt: Nahshon was the father of Salmon. Salmon was the father of Boaz.
verses.textEnNasb: Nahshon fathered Salma, Salma fathered Boaz,
verses.textEn: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,

verses.textZh: 波阿斯生俄备得；俄备得生耶西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯生俄备得；俄备得生耶西。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；
verses.textEnNiv: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.
verses.textEnEsv: Boaz fathered Obed, Obed fathered Jesse.
verses.textEnNkjv: Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;
verses.textEnNlt: Boaz was the father of Obed. Obed was the father of Jesse.
verses.textEnNasb: Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse;
verses.textEn: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.

verses.textZh: 耶西生长子以利押、次子亚比拿达、三子示米亚、
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西生长子以利押、次子亚比拿达、三子示米亚、
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西生长子以利押，次子亚比拿达，三子示米亚 ，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,
verses.textEnEsv: Jesse fathered Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesse begot Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesse’s first son was Eliab, his second was Abinadab, his third was Shimea,
verses.textEnNasb: and Jesse fathered Eliab his firstborn, then Abinadab, the second, Shimea, the third,
verses.textEn: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,

verses.textZh: 四子拿坦业、五子代拉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 四子拿坦业、五子代拉、
verses.textZhCuv: 四子拿坦业，五子拉代，
verses.textEnNiv: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,
verses.textEnEsv: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.textEnNlt: his fourth was Nethanel, his fifth was Raddai,
verses.textEnNasb: Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,
verses.textEn: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,

verses.textZh: 六子阿鲜、七子大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六子阿鲜、七子大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 六子阿鲜，七子大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.
verses.textEnEsv: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh.
verses.textEnNlt: his sixth was Ozem, and his seventh was David.
verses.textEnNasb: Ozem, the sixth, and David, the seventh.
verses.textEn: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.

verses.textZh: 他们的姊妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛、约押和亚撒黑，共三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的姊妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛、约押和亚撒黑，共三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的姊妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛、约押、亚撒黑，共三人。
verses.textEnNiv: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.
verses.textEnEsv: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel—three.
verses.textEnNlt: Their sisters were named Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah had three sons named Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
verses.textEnNasb: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abshai, Joab, and Asahel.
verses.textEn: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.

verses.textZh: 亚比该生亚玛撒；亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该生亚玛撒；亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该生亚玛撒；亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。
verses.textEnNiv: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.textEnEsv: Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.textEnNlt: Abigail married a man named Jether, an Ishmaelite, and they had a son named Amasa.
verses.textEnNasb: Abigail gave birth to Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.textEn: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

verses.textZh: 希斯仑的儿子迦勒与妻子阿苏巴生了儿子，也和耶略生了儿子；她的儿子是耶设、朔罢和押墩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希斯仑的儿子迦勒与妻子阿苏巴生了儿子，也和耶略生了儿子；她的儿子是耶设、朔罢和押墩。
verses.textZhCuv: 希斯仑的儿子迦勒娶阿苏巴和耶略为妻，阿苏巴的儿子是耶设、朔罢、押墩。
verses.textEnNiv: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.
verses.textEnEsv: Caleb the son of Hezron fathered children by his wife Azubah, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Caleb the son of Hezron had children by Azubah, his wife, and by Jerioth. Now these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezron’s son Caleb had sons from his wife Azubah and from Jerioth. Her sons were named Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Caleb the son of Hezron had sons by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.textEn: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.

verses.textZh: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法他；以法他给他生了户珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法他；以法他给他生了户珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法她，生了户珥。
verses.textEnNiv: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
verses.textEnEsv: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Azubah died, Caleb took Ephrath as his wife, who bore him Hur.
verses.textEnNlt: After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrathah, and they had a son named Hur.
verses.textEnNasb: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
verses.textEn: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

verses.textZh: 户珥生乌利；乌利生比撒列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户珥生乌利；乌利生比撒列。
verses.textZhCuv: 户珥生乌利；乌利生比撒列。
verses.textEnNiv: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.
verses.textEnEsv: Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezalel.
verses.textEnNlt: Hur was the father of Uri. Uri was the father of Bezalel.
verses.textEnNasb: Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.textEn: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.

verses.textZh: 后来希斯仑在六十岁的时候，娶了基列的父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房，她就给他生了西割。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来希斯仑在六十岁的时候，娶了基列的父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房，她就给他生了西割。
verses.textZhCuv: 希斯仑正六十岁娶了基列父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房；玛吉的女儿生了西割；
verses.textEnNiv: Later, Hezron, when he was sixty years old, married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead. He made love to her, and she bore him Segub.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old, and she bore him Segub.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.textEnNlt: When Hezron was sixty years old, he married Gilead’s sister, the daughter of Makir. They had a son named Segub.
verses.textEnNasb: Later, Hezron had relations with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore to him Segub.
verses.textEn: Later, Hezron, when he was sixty years old, married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead. He made love to her, and she bore him Segub.

verses.textZh: 西割生睚珥；睚珥在基列地有二十三座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西割生睚珥；睚珥在基列地有二十三座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三个城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: And Segub fathered Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Segub begot Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: Segub was the father of Jair, who ruled twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: Segub fathered Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEn: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.

verses.textZh: 基述人和亚兰人却从他们那里夺取了睚珥的村镇，以及基纳和基纳的村庄，共六十座城。以上这些人都是基列的父亲玛吉的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基述人和亚兰人却从他们那里夺取了睚珥的村镇，以及基纳和基纳的村庄，共六十座城。以上这些人都是基列的父亲玛吉的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来基述人和亚兰人夺了睚珥的城邑，并基纳和其乡村，共六十个。这都是基列父亲玛吉之子的。
verses.textEnNiv: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements—sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: But Geshur and Aram took from them Havvoth-jair, Kenath, and its villages, sixty towns. All these were descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Geshur and Syria took from them the towns of Jair, with Kenath and its towns—sixty towns.) All these belongedto the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: (But Geshur and Aram captured the Towns of Jair and also took Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages.) All these were descendants of Makir, the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: But Geshur and Aram took the villages of Jair from them, with Kenath and its villages, sixty settlements. All of these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.textEn: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements—sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 希斯仑在迦勒．以法他死后，他的妻子亚比雅给他生了亚施户；亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希斯仑在迦勒．以法他死后，他的妻子亚比雅给他生了亚施户；亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 希斯仑在迦勒‧以法他死后，他的妻亚比雅给他生了亚施户；亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.textEnEsv: After the death of Hezron, Caleb went in to Ephrathah, the wife of Hezron his father, and she bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
verses.textEnNkjv: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Hezron’s wife Abijah bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after Hezron died in the town of Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah gave birth to a son named Ashhur (the father of Tekoa).
verses.textEnNasb: After the death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.textEn: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

verses.textZh: 希斯仑的长子耶拉篾的儿子是长子兰、布拿、阿连、阿鲜和亚希雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希斯仑的长子耶拉篾的儿子是长子兰、布拿、阿连、阿鲜和亚希雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 希斯仑的长子耶拉篾生长子兰，又生布拿、阿连、阿鲜、亚希雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron: Ram, his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram, the firstborn, and Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, were Ram (the firstborn), Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram the firstborn, then Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.

verses.textZh: 耶拉篾另有一个妻子，名叫亚他拉，是阿南的母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶拉篾另有一个妻子，名叫亚他拉，是阿南的母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亚她拉，是阿南的母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.textEnEsv: Jerahmeel also had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerahmeel had a second wife named Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
verses.textEnNasb: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.textEn: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

verses.textZh: 耶拉篾的长子兰的儿子是玛斯、雅悯和以结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶拉篾的长子兰的儿子是玛斯、雅悯和以结。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶拉篾长子兰的儿子是玛斯、雅悯、以结。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin and Eker.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin and Eker.

verses.textZh: 阿南的儿子是沙买和雅大；沙买的儿子是拿答和亚比述。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿南的儿子是沙买和雅大；沙买的儿子是拿答和亚比述。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿南的儿子是沙买、雅大。沙买的儿子是拿答、亚比述。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.textEn: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

verses.textZh: 亚比述的妻子名叫亚比孩；亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比述的妻子名叫亚比孩；亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比述的妻名叫亚比孩，亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。
verses.textEnNiv: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of Abishur’s wife was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Abishur and his wife Abihail were Ahban and Molid.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of Abishur’s wife was Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
verses.textEn: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.

verses.textZh: 拿答的儿子是西列和亚遍；西列死了，没有儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿答的儿子是西列和亚遍；西列死了，没有儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿答的儿子是西列、亚遍；西列死了没有儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; and Seled died childless.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim; Seled died without children.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim, and Seled died without sons.
verses.textEn: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.

verses.textZh: 亚遍的儿子是以示；以示的儿子是示珊；示珊的儿子是亚来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚遍的儿子是以示；以示的儿子是示珊；示珊的儿子是亚来。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚遍的儿子是以示；以示的儿子是示珊；示珊的儿子是亚来。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Appaim: Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan. Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Appaim was Ishi, the son of Ishi was Sheshan, and Sheshan’s son was Ahlai.
verses.textEnNlt: but Appaim had a son named Ishi. The son of Ishi was Sheshan. Sheshan had a descendant named Ahlai.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Appaim was Ishi. And the son of Ishi was Sheshan, and the son of Sheshan, Ahlai.
verses.textEn: The son of Appaim: Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan. Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.

verses.textZh: 沙买的兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖和约拿单；益帖死了，没有儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙买的兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖和约拿单；益帖死了，没有儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙买兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖、约拿单；益帖死了没有儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died childless.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai, were Jether and Jonathan; Jether died without children.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother, were Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai were Jether and Jonathan, and Jether died without sons.
verses.textEn: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

verses.textZh: 约拿单的儿子是比勒和撒萨。以上这些人都是耶拉篾的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单的儿子是比勒和撒萨。以上这些人都是耶拉篾的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单的儿子是比勒、撒萨。这都是耶拉篾的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnNlt: but Jonathan had two sons named Peleth and Zaza. These were all descendants of Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

verses.textZh: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿；示珊有一仆人，是埃及人，名叫耶哈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿；示珊有一仆人，是埃及人，名叫耶哈。
verses.textZhCuv: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿。示珊有一个仆人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。
verses.textEnNiv: Sheshan had no sons—only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters, but Sheshan had an Egyptian slave whose name was Jarha.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha.
verses.textEnNlt: Sheshan had no sons, though he did have daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. Sheshan also had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha.
verses.textEn: Sheshan had no sons—only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

verses.textZh: 示珊把女儿嫁给仆人耶哈作妻子，她给耶哈生了亚太。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示珊把女儿嫁给仆人耶哈作妻子，她给耶哈生了亚太。
verses.textZhCuv: 示珊将女儿给了仆人耶哈为妻，给他生了亚太。
verses.textEnNiv: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.
verses.textEnEsv: So Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to Jarha his slave, and she bore him Attai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife, and she bore him Attai.
verses.textEnNlt: Sheshan gave one of his daughters to be the wife of Jarha, and they had a son named Attai.
verses.textEnNasb: Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha in marriage, and she bore to him Attai.
verses.textEn: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.

verses.textZh: 亚太生拿单；拿单生撒拔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚太生拿单；拿单生撒拔。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚太生拿单；拿单生撒拔；
verses.textEnNiv: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan the father of Zabad,
verses.textEnEsv: Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad;
verses.textEnNlt: Attai was the father of Nathan. Nathan was the father of Zabad.
verses.textEnNasb: Attai fathered Nathan, Nathan fathered Zabad,
verses.textEn: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan the father of Zabad,

verses.textZh: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄备得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄备得。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄备得；
verses.textEnNiv: Zabad the father of Ephlal, Ephlal the father of Obed,
verses.textEnEsv: Zabad fathered Ephlal, and Ephlal fathered Obed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed;
verses.textEnNlt: Zabad was the father of Ephlal. Ephlal was the father of Obed.
verses.textEnNasb: Zabad fathered Ephlal, Ephlal fathered Obed,
verses.textEn: Zabad the father of Ephlal, Ephlal the father of Obed,

verses.textZh: 俄备得生耶户；耶户生亚撒利雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄备得生耶户；耶户生亚撒利雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 俄备得生耶户；耶户生亚撒利雅；
verses.textEnNiv: Obed the father of Jehu, Jehu the father of Azariah,
verses.textEnEsv: Obed fathered Jehu, and Jehu fathered Azariah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah;
verses.textEnNlt: Obed was the father of Jehu. Jehu was the father of Azariah.
verses.textEnNasb: Obed fathered Jehu, Jehu fathered Azariah,
verses.textEn: Obed the father of Jehu, Jehu the father of Azariah,

verses.textZh: 亚撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亚萨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亚萨。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亚萨；
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah the father of Helez, Helez the father of Eleasah,
verses.textEnEsv: Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Eleasah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah;
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah was the father of Helez. Helez was the father of Eleasah.
verses.textEnNasb: Azariah fathered Helez, Helez fathered Eleasah,
verses.textEn: Azariah the father of Helez, Helez the father of Eleasah,

verses.textZh: 以利亚萨生西斯买；西斯买生沙龙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚萨生西斯买；西斯买生沙龙。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚萨生西斯买；西斯买生沙龙；
verses.textEnNiv: Eleasah the father of Sismai, Sismai the father of Shallum,
verses.textEnEsv: Eleasah fathered Sismai, and Sismai fathered Shallum.
verses.textEnNkjv: Eleasah begot Sismai, and Sismai begot Shallum;
verses.textEnNlt: Eleasah was the father of Sismai. Sismai was the father of Shallum.
verses.textEnNasb: Eleasah fathered Sismai, Sismai fathered Shallum,
verses.textEn: Eleasah the father of Sismai, Sismai the father of Shallum,

verses.textZh: 沙龙生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙龙生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙龙生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Shallum the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.
verses.textEnEsv: Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
verses.textEnNlt: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah. Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
verses.textEnNasb: Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.textEn: Shallum the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.

verses.textZh: 耶拉篾的兄弟迦勒的子孙如下：他的长子是米沙，是西弗的父亲；他的儿子是玛利沙，是希伯仑的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶拉篾的兄弟迦勒的子孙如下：他的长子是米沙，是西弗的父亲；他的儿子是玛利沙，是希伯仑的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的长子米沙，是西弗之祖玛利沙的儿子，是希伯仑之祖。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mareshah his firstborn, who fathered Ziph. The son of Mareshah: Hebron.
verses.textEnNkjv: The descendants of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha, his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, included Mesha (the firstborn), who became the father of Ziph. Caleb’s descendants also included the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and his son was Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
verses.textEn: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.

verses.textEn: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem and Shema.

verses.textZh: 示玛生拉含，是约干的父亲；利肯生沙买。
