verses.textEnEsv: These were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon, four by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.textEnNkjv: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon—four by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons born to David in Jerusalem included Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. Their mother was Bathsheba, the daughter of Ammiel.
verses.textEnNasb: These were the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.textEn: and these were the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon. These four were by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.

verses.textZh: 还有益辖、以利沙玛、以利法列、
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有益辖、以利沙玛、以利法列、
verses.textZhCuv: 还有益辖、以利沙玛、以利法列、
verses.textEnNiv: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
verses.textEnEsv: then Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also there were Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
verses.textEnNlt: David also had nine other sons: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.textEnNasb: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
verses.textEn: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,

verses.textZh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textZhCuv: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textEnNiv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnEsv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNlt: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNasb: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEn: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.textZh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列等九人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列等九人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列，共九人。
verses.textEnNiv: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet—nine in all.
verses.textEnEsv: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet— nine inall.
verses.textEnNlt: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNasb: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.textEn: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet—nine in all.

verses.textZh: 他们都是大卫的儿子，此外还有他们的妹妹他玛，以及妃嫔所生的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都是大卫的儿子，此外还有他们的妹妹他玛，以及妃嫔所生的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是大卫的儿子，还有他们的妹子她玛，妃嫔的儿子不在其内。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
verses.textEnEsv: All these were David’s sons, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar was their sister.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thesewere all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the sons of David, not including his sons born to his concubines. Their sister was named Tamar.
verses.textEnNasb: All of these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.textEn: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的儿子是罗波安，罗波安的儿子是亚比雅，亚比雅的儿子是亚撒，亚撒的儿子是约沙法，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的儿子是罗波安，罗波安的儿子是亚比雅，亚比雅的儿子是亚撒，亚撒的儿子是约沙法，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的儿子是罗波安；罗波安的儿子是亚比雅；亚比雅的儿子是亚撒；亚撒的儿子是约沙法；
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Solomon was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam; Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Solomon were Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, then Abijah was his son, Asa, his son, Jehoshaphat, his son,
verses.textEn: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

verses.textZh: 约沙法的儿子是约兰，约兰的儿子是亚哈谢，亚哈谢的儿子是约阿施，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法的儿子是约兰，约兰的儿子是亚哈谢，亚哈谢的儿子是约阿施，
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是亚哈谢；亚哈谢的儿子是约阿施；
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash,
verses.textEnNasb: Joram, his son, Ahaziah, his son, Joash, his son,
verses.textEn: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

verses.textZh: 约阿施的儿子是亚玛谢，亚玛谢的儿子是亚撒利雅，亚撒利雅的儿子是约坦，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施的儿子是亚玛谢，亚玛谢的儿子是亚撒利雅，亚撒利雅的儿子是约坦，
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施的儿子是亚玛谢；亚玛谢的儿子是亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅的儿子是约坦；
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah, Uzziah, Jotham,
verses.textEnNasb: Amaziah, his son, Azariah, his son, Jotham, his son,
verses.textEn: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

verses.textZh: 约坦的儿子是亚哈斯，亚哈斯的儿子是希西家，希西家的儿子是玛拿西，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦的儿子是亚哈斯，亚哈斯的儿子是希西家，希西家的儿子是玛拿西，
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦的儿子是亚哈斯；亚哈斯的儿子是希西家；希西家的儿子是玛拿西；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh,
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaz, his son, Hezekiah, his son, Manasseh, his son,
verses.textEn: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的儿子是亚们，亚们的儿子是约西亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的儿子是亚们，亚们的儿子是约西亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的儿子是亚们；亚们的儿子是约西亚；
verses.textEnNiv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Amon, and Josiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Amon, his son, and Josiah, his son.
verses.textEn: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

verses.textZh: 约西亚的儿子是：长子约哈难、次子约雅敬、三子西底家、四子沙龙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚的儿子是：长子约哈难、次子约雅敬、三子西底家、四子沙龙。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚的长子是约哈难，次子是约雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Josiah were Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Josiah were Johanan (the oldest), Jehoiakim (the second), Zedekiah (the third), and Jehoahaz (the fourth).
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Josiah were Johanan, the firstborn, the second was Jehoiakim, the third, Zedekiah, and the fourth, Shallum.
verses.textEn: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬的儿子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬的儿子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬的儿子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
verses.textEnNiv: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son, and Zedekiah.
verses.textEnEsv: The descendants of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son;
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah his son and Zedekiah his son.
verses.textEnNlt: The successors of Jehoiakim were his son Jehoiachin and his brother Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jehoiakim were his son Jeconiah and his son Zedekiah.
verses.textEn: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son, and Zedekiah.

verses.textZh: 被掳的耶哥尼雅的儿子是撒拉铁、
verses.textZhCnvs: 被掳的耶哥尼雅的儿子是撒拉铁、
verses.textZhCuv: 耶哥尼雅被掳。他的儿子是撒拉铁、
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.textEnEsv: and the sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Jeconiah were Assir, Shealtiel his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Jehoiachin, who was taken prisoner by the Babylonians, were Shealtiel,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jeconiah, the prisoner, were his son Shealtiel
verses.textEn: The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive: Shealtiel his son,

verses.textZh: 玛基兰、毘大雅、示拿萨、耶加米、何沙玛和尼大比雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛基兰、毘大雅、示拿萨、耶加米、何沙玛和尼大比雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛基兰、毗大雅、示拿萨、耶加米、何沙玛、尼大比雅。
verses.textEnNiv: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
verses.textEnEsv: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah;
verses.textEnNkjv: and Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.textEnNasb: and Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.textEn: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.

verses.textZh: 毘大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯和示每；所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰和哈拿尼雅，还有他们的妹妹示罗密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 毘大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯和示每；所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰和哈拿尼雅，还有他们的妹妹示罗密。
verses.textZhCuv: 毗大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯、示每。所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰、哈拿尼雅，他们的妹子名叫示罗密。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam, Hananiah, Shelomith their sister,
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam and Hananiah. (Their sister was Shelomith.)
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.textEn: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.

verses.textZh: 又有哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙．希悉等五人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙．希悉等五人。
verses.textZhCuv: 米书兰的儿子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙‧希悉，共五人。
verses.textEnNiv: There were also five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.
verses.textEnEsv: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-Hesed—five inall.
verses.textEnNlt: His five other sons were Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
verses.textEnNasb: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.textEn: There were also five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.

verses.textZh: 哈拿尼雅的儿子是毘拉提和耶筛亚；还有利法雅的众子、亚珥难的众子、俄巴底亚的众子和示迦尼的众子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿尼雅的儿子是毘拉提和耶筛亚；还有利法雅的众子、亚珥难的众子、俄巴底亚的众子和示迦尼的众子。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿尼雅的儿子是毗拉提、耶筛亚。还有利法雅的众子，亚珥难的众子，俄巴底亚的众子，示迦尼的众子。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shekaniah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, his son Rephaiah, his son Arnan, his son Obadiah, his son Shecaniah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah. Jeshaiah’s son was Rephaiah. Rephaiah’s son was Arnan. Arnan’s son was Obadiah. Obadiah’s son was Shecaniah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shekaniah.

verses.textZh: 示迦尼的子孙如下：示迦尼的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是哈突、以甲、巴利亚、尼利雅、沙法共六人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示迦尼的子孙如下：示迦尼的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是哈突、以甲、巴利亚、尼利雅、沙法共六人。
verses.textZhCuv: 示迦尼的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是哈突、以甲、巴利亚、尼利雅、沙法，共六人。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Shekaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat—six in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Shechaniah was Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six inall.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons, Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six in all.
verses.textEnNasb: The descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah, and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Shekaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat—six in all.

verses.textZh: 尼利雅的儿子是以利约乃、希西家、亚斯利干共三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼利雅的儿子是以利约乃、希西家、亚斯利干共三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼利雅的儿子是以利约乃、希西家、亚斯利干，共三人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam—three in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three inall.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.textEn: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam—three in all.

verses.textZh: 以利约乃的儿子是何大雅、以利雅实、毘莱雅、阿谷、约哈难、第来雅、阿拿尼共七人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利约乃的儿子是何大雅、以利雅实、毘莱雅、阿谷、约哈难、第来雅、阿拿尼共七人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利约乃的儿子是何大雅、以利亚实、毗莱雅、阿谷、约哈难、第莱雅、阿拿尼，共七人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani—seven in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven inall.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.textEn: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani—seven in all.

verses.textZh: 犹大的儿子是法勒斯、希斯仑、迦米、户珥和朔巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的儿子是法勒斯、希斯仑、迦米、户珥和朔巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的儿子是法勒斯、希斯仑、迦米、户珥、朔巴。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur and Shobal.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur and Shobal.

verses.textZh: 朔巴的儿子利亚雅生雅哈；雅哈生亚户买和拉哈。以上这些都是琐拉人的家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朔巴的儿子利亚雅生雅哈；雅哈生亚户买和拉哈。以上这些都是琐拉人的家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 朔巴的儿子利亚雅生雅哈；雅哈生亚户买和拉哈。这是琐拉人的诸族。
verses.textEnNiv: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
verses.textEnEsv: Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.
verses.textEnNlt: Shobal’s son Reaiah was the father of Jahath. Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.
verses.textEnNasb: Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.
verses.textEn: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.

verses.textZh: 以坦的儿子 是：耶斯列、伊施玛、伊得巴；他们的妹妹名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以坦的儿子 是：耶斯列、伊施玛、伊得巴；他们的妹妹名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
verses.textZhCuv: 以坦之祖的儿子是耶斯列、伊施玛、伊得巴；他们的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi,
verses.textEnNkjv: These werethesonsof the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi;
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Etam were Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash, their sister Hazzelelponi,
verses.textEnNasb: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
verses.textEn: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.

verses.textZh: 基多的父亲是毘努伊勒；户沙的父亲是以谢珥；这些都是伯利恒的父亲以法他的长子户珥所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基多的父亲是毘努伊勒；户沙的父亲是以谢珥；这些都是伯利恒的父亲以法他的长子户珥所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。户沙之祖是以谢珥。这都是伯利恒之祖以法她的长子户珥所生的。
verses.textEnNiv: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: and Penuel fathered Gedor, and Ezer fathered Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer wasthe father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah the father of Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: Penuel (the father of Gedor), and Ezer (the father of Hushah). These were the descendants of Hur (the firstborn of Ephrathah), the ancestor of Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 提哥亚的父亲亚施户有两个妻子，就是希拉和拿拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 提哥亚的父亲亚施户有两个妻子，就是希拉和拿拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 提哥亚之祖亚施户有两个妻子：一名希拉，一名拿拉。
verses.textEnNiv: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.textEnEsv: Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah;
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.textEnNlt: Ashhur (the father of Tekoa) had two wives, named Helah and Naarah.
verses.textEnNasb: Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.textEn: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

verses.textZh: 拿拉给亚施户生了亚户撒、希弗、提米尼、哈辖斯他利；这些人都是拿拉的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿拉给亚施户生了亚户撒、希弗、提米尼、哈辖斯他利；这些人都是拿拉的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿拉给亚施户生亚户撒、希弗、提米尼、哈辖斯他利。这都是拿拉的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
verses.textEnEsv: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.textEnNlt: Naarah gave birth to Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.
verses.textEnNasb: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.textEn: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.

verses.textZh: 希拉的儿子是洗列、琐辖和伊提南。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希拉的儿子是洗列、琐辖和伊提南。
verses.textZhCuv: 希拉的儿子是洗列、琐辖、伊提南。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, and Ethnan;
verses.textEnNlt: Helah gave birth to Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,

verses.textZh: 哥斯生亚诺、琐比巴和哈仑的儿子亚哈黑的众家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥斯生亚诺、琐比巴和哈仑的儿子亚哈黑的众家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥斯生亚诺、琐比巴，并哈仑儿子亚哈黑的诸族。
verses.textEnNiv: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
verses.textEnEsv: Koz fathered Anub, Zobebah, and the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Koz begot Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.textEnNlt: and Koz, who became the ancestor of Anub, Zobebah, and all the families of Aharhel son of Harum.
verses.textEnNasb: Koz fathered Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
verses.textEn: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.

verses.textZh: 雅比斯在众兄弟中最受人尊重，他母亲给他起名叫雅比斯，意思说："我生产时十分痛苦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅比斯在众兄弟中最受人尊重，他母亲给他起名叫雅比斯，意思说："我生产时十分痛苦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅比斯比他众弟兄更尊贵，他母亲给他起名叫雅比斯，意思说：我生他甚是痛苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, "I gave birth to him in pain."
verses.textEnEsv: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain."
verses.textEnNlt: There was a man named Jabez who was more honorable than any of his brothers. His mother named him Jabez because his birth had been so painful.
verses.textEnNasb: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother named him Jabez, saying, "Because I gave birth to him in pain."
verses.textEn: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, "I gave birth to him in pain."

verses.textZh: 雅比斯呼求以色列的神说："深愿你大大地赐福给我，扩张我的境界，你的能力常与我同在，保护我免遭灾祸，不受痛苦。"神就应允了他所求的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅比斯呼求以色列的神说："深愿你大大地赐福给我，扩张我的境界，你的能力常与我同在，保护我免遭灾祸，不受痛苦。"神就应允了他所求的。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅比斯求告以色列的神说：「甚愿你赐福与我，扩张我的境界，常与我同在，保佑我不遭患难，不受艰苦。」神就应允他所求的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain." And God granted his request.
verses.textEnEsv: Jabez called upon the God of Israel, saying, "Oh that you would bless me and enlarge my border, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from harm so that it might not bring me pain!" And God granted what he asked.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel saying, "Oh, that You would bless me indeed, and enlarge my territory, that Your hand would be with me, and that You would keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!" So God granted him what he requested.
verses.textEnNlt: He was the one who prayed to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and expand my territory! Please be with me in all that I do, and keep me from all trouble and pain!" And God granted him his request.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, "Oh that You would greatly bless me and extend my border, and that Your hand might be with me, and that You would keep me from harm so that it would not hurt me!" And God brought about what he requested.
verses.textEn: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain." And God granted his request.

verses.textZh: 书哈的兄弟基绿生米黑；米黑是伊施屯的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 书哈的兄弟基绿生米黑；米黑是伊施屯的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 书哈的弟兄基绿生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。
verses.textEnNiv: Kelub, Shuhah’s brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.textEnEsv: Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, fathered Mehir, who fathered Eshton.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chelub the brother of Shuhah begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.textEnNlt: Kelub (the brother of Shuhah) was the father of Mehir. Mehir was the father of Eshton.
verses.textEnNasb: Chelub the brother of Shuhah fathered Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.textEn: Kelub, Shuhah’s brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

verses.textZh: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亚和珥拿辖的父亲提欣拿；这些都是利迦人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亚和珥拿辖的父亲提欣拿；这些都是利迦人。
verses.textZhCuv: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亚，并珥拿辖之祖提欣拿，这都是利迦人。
verses.textEnNiv: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Rekah.
verses.textEnEsv: Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Eshton begot Beth-Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-Nahash. These were the men of Rechah.
verses.textEnNlt: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash. These were the descendants of Recah.
verses.textEnNasb: Eshton fathered Beth-rapha and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
verses.textEn: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Rekah.

verses.textZh: 基纳斯的儿子是俄陀聂和西莱雅；俄陀聂的儿子是哈塔和悯挪太 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基纳斯的儿子是俄陀聂和西莱雅；俄陀聂的儿子是哈塔和悯挪太 。
verses.textZhCuv: 基纳斯的儿子是俄陀聂、西莱雅。俄陀聂的儿子是哈塔。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel were Hathath,
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel’s sons were Hathath and Meonothai.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel were Hathath and Meonothai.
verses.textEn: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.

verses.textZh: 悯挪太生俄弗拉。西莱雅生革．夏纳欣人的祖先约押；他们原是匠人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 悯挪太生俄弗拉。西莱雅生革．夏纳欣人的祖先约押；他们原是匠人。
verses.textZhCuv: 悯挪太生俄弗拉；西莱雅生革‧夏纳欣人之祖约押。他们都是匠人。
verses.textEnNiv: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were skilled workers.
verses.textEnEsv: Meonothai fathered Ophrah; and Seraiah fathered Joab, the father of Ge-harashim, so-called because they were craftsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Meonothai who begot Ophrah. Seraiah begot Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
verses.textEnNlt: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the founder of the Valley of Craftsmen, so called because they were craftsmen.
verses.textEnNasb: Meonothai fathered Ophrah, and Seraiah fathered Joab the father of Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen.
verses.textEn: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were skilled workers.

verses.textZh: 耶孚尼的儿子是迦勒；迦勒的儿子是以路、以拉和拿安；以拉的儿子是基纳斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶孚尼的儿子是迦勒；迦勒的儿子是以路、以拉和拿安；以拉的儿子是基纳斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶孚尼的儿子是迦勒；迦勒的儿子是以路、以拉、拿安。以拉的儿子是基纳斯。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah was Kenaz.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah was Kenaz.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son of Elah was Kenaz.
verses.textEn: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

verses.textZh: 耶哈利勒的儿子是西弗、西法、提利和亚撒列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶哈利勒的儿子是西弗、西法、提利和亚撒列。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶哈利勒的儿子是西弗、西法、提利、亚撒列。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

verses.textZh: 荷第雅的妻子、拿含的妹妹的儿子是迦米人基伊拉的父亲和玛迦人以实提摩的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 荷第雅的妻子、拿含的妹妹的儿子是迦米人基伊拉的父亲和玛迦人以实提摩的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，她所生的儿子是迦米人基伊拉和玛迦人以实提摩之祖。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. These are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married; and she conceived and bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives became the mother of Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah (the father of Eshtemoa).
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife conceived and gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.textZh: 示门的儿子是暗嫩、林拿、便．哈南和提伦。以示的儿子是梭黑和便．梭黑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示门的儿子是暗嫩、林拿、便．哈南和提伦。以示的儿子是梭黑和便．梭黑。
verses.textZhCuv: 示门的儿子是暗嫩、林拿、便‧哈南、提伦。 以示的儿子是梭黑与便‧梭黑。
verses.textEnNiv: (His wife from the tribe of Judah gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soko, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.
verses.textEnEsv: And his Judahite wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
verses.textEnNkjv: (His wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Sochoh, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) And these were the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
verses.textEnNlt: He married a woman from Judah, who became the mother of Jered (the father of Gedor), Heber (the father of Soco), and Jekuthiel (the father of Zanoah). Mered also married Bithia, a daughter of Pharaoh, and she bore him children.
verses.textEnNasb: (His Jewish wife gave birth to Jered, the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the sons of Bithia the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married.
verses.textEn: (His wife from the tribe of Judah gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soko, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.

verses.textZh: 犹大的儿子是示拉；示拉的儿子是利迦的父亲珥、玛利沙的父亲拉大，以及在伯亚实比织造细麻布的众家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的儿子是示拉；示拉的儿子是利迦的父亲珥、玛利沙的父亲拉大，以及在伯亚实比织造细麻布的众家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的儿子是示拉；示拉的儿子是利迦之祖珥，玛利沙之祖拉大，和属亚实比族织细麻布的各家。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maakathite.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.textEnNlt: Hodiah’s wife was the sister of Naham. One of her sons was the father of Keilah the Garmite, and another was the father of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.textEn: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maakathite.

verses.textZh: 还有约敬、哥西巴人、约阿施和萨拉，他们曾统治摩押地，又有雅叔比利恒。这都是古代的记载。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有约敬、哥西巴人、约阿施和萨拉，他们曾统治摩押地，又有雅叔比利恒。这都是古代的记载。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有约敬、哥西巴人、约阿施、萨拉，就是在摩押地掌权的，又有雅叔比利恒。这都是古时所记载的。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

verses.textZh: 以上这些有名字记录的人，在犹大王希西家的日子，前来攻击含族人的帐棚和那里所有的米乌尼人，把他们完全毁灭，直到今日，并且住在他们的地方，因为那里有草场，可以牧放他们的羊群。

verses.textZh: 在西缅人中有五百人往西珥山去，他们的首领是以示的儿子毘拉提、尼利雅、利法雅和乌薛。

verses.textEnNiv: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful and quiet. Some Hamites had lived there formerly.
verses.textEnEsv: where they found rich, good pasture, and the land was very broad, quiet, and peaceful, for the former inhabitants there belonged to Ham.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they found rich, good pasture, and the land was broad, quiet, and peaceful; for some Hamites formerly lived there.
verses.textEnNlt: They found lush pastures there, and the land was spacious, quiet, and peaceful. Some of Ham’s descendants had been living in that region.
verses.textEnNasb: They found pasture that was rich and good, and the land was spread out on both sides, and peaceful and undisturbed; for those who lived there previously were Hamites.
verses.textEn: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful and quiet. Some Hamites had lived there formerly.

verses.textEnNiv: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: These, registered by name, came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and destroyed their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and marked them for destruction to this day, and settled in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: These recorded by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and they attacked their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and utterly destroyed them, as it is to this day. So they dwelt in their place, because therewas pasture for their flocks there.
verses.textEnNlt: But during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah, these leaders of Simeon invaded the region and completely destroyed the homes of the descendants of Ham and of the Meunites. No trace of them remains today. They killed everyone who lived there and took the land for themselves, because they wanted its good pastureland for their flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: These people, recorded by name, came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and they attacked their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and utterly destroyed them to this day; and they lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.textEn: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.

verses.textEnNiv: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.
verses.textEnEsv: and they lived in Gilead, in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasturelands of Sharon to their limits.
verses.textEnNkjv: And theGadites dwelt in Gilead, in Bashan and in its villages, and in all the common-lands of Sharon within their borders.
verses.textEnNlt: The Gadites lived in the land of Gilead, in Bashan and its villages, and throughout all the pasturelands of Sharon.
verses.textEnNasb: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon, as far as their borders.
verses.textEn: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.

verses.textZh: 流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派的人，都是勇士；他们拿盾牌和刀剑，能拉弓射箭，又能出征善战的，共有四万四千七百六十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派的人，都是勇士；他们拿盾牌和刀剑，能拉弓射箭，又能出征善战的，共有四万四千七百六十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人在犹大王约坦并在以色列王耶罗波安年间，都载入家谱。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: All of these were recorded in genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these were registered by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: All of these were listed in the genealogical records during the days of King Jotham of Judah and King Jeroboam of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: All of these were enrolled in the genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.textEn: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们与夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人和挪答人作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们与夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人和挪答人作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀剑、拉弓射箭、出征善战的勇士共有四万四千七百六十名。
verses.textEnNiv: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service—able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.
verses.textEnEsv: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had valiant men who carried shield and sword, and drew the bow, expert in war, 44,760, able to go to war.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh had forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty valiant men, men able to bear shield and sword, to shoot with the bow, and skillful in war, who went to war.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 44,760 capable warriors in the armies of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. They were all skilled in combat and armed with shields, swords, and bows.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, consisting of valiant men, men who carried shield and sword and shot with a bow and were skillful in battle, totaled 44,760 who went to war.
verses.textEn: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service—able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.

verses.textZh: 他们得神的帮助对抗敌人，夏甲人和所有与夏甲人联盟的人，都交在他们手中，因为他们在作战的时候向神呼求；神应允了他们，因为他们倚靠他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们得神的帮助对抗敌人，夏甲人和所有与夏甲人联盟的人，都交在他们手中，因为他们在作战的时候向神呼求；神应允了他们，因为他们倚靠他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们与夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人、挪答人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.
verses.textEnEsv: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made war with the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.textEnNlt: They waged war against the Hagrites, the Jeturites, the Naphishites, and the Nodabites.
verses.textEnNasb: They made war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.textEn: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.

verses.textZh: 他们又掳掠了敌人的牲畜：骆驼五万、羊二十五万、驴二千，以及人口十万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又掳掠了敌人的牲畜：骆驼五万、羊二十五万、驴二千，以及人口十万。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们得了神的帮助，夏甲人和跟随夏甲的人都交在他们手中；因为他们在阵上呼求神，倚赖神，神就应允他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They were helped in fighting them, and God delivered the Hagrites and all their allies into their hands, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they prevailed over them, the Hagrites and all who were with them were given into their hands, for they cried out to God in the battle, and he granted their urgent plea because they trusted in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them, for they cried out to God in the battle. He heeded their prayer, because they put their trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They cried out to God during the battle, and he answered their prayer because they trusted in him. So the Hagrites and all their allies were defeated.
verses.textEnNasb: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites and all who were with them were handed over to them; for they cried out to God in the battle, and He answered their prayers because they trusted in Him.
verses.textEn: They were helped in fighting them, and God delivered the Hagrites and all their allies into their hands, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.

verses.textZh: 因为这场战争是出于神，所以敌人被杀的很多；他们就占领了敌人的地方，直到被掳的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这场战争是出于神，所以敌人被杀的很多；他们就占领了敌人的地方，直到被掳的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们掳掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有骆驼五万，羊二十五万，驴二千；又有人十万。
verses.textEnNiv: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,
verses.textEnEsv: They carried off their livestock: 50,000 of their camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 men alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took away their livestock—fifty thousand of their camels, two hundred and fifty thousand of their sheep, and two thousand of their donkeys—also one hundred thousand of their men;
verses.textEnNlt: The plunder taken from the Hagrites included 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep and goats, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 captives.
verses.textEnNasb: They took away their livestock: their fifty thousand camels, 250,000 sheep, and two thousand donkeys; and a hundred thousand people.
verses.textEn: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,

verses.textZh: 玛拿西半个支派的人住在那地，从巴珊直到巴力．黑门、示尼珥和黑门山，他们人数众多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西半个支派的人住在那地，从巴珊直到巴力．黑门、示尼珥和黑门山，他们人数众多。
verses.textZhCuv: 敌人被杀仆倒的甚多，因为这争战是出乎神。他们就住在敌人的地上，直到被掳的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: and many others fell slain, because the battle was God’s. And they occupied the land until the exile.
verses.textEnEsv: For many fell, because the war was of God. And they lived in their place until the exile.
verses.textEnNkjv: for many fell dead, because the war was God’s. And they dwelt in their place until the captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Many of the Hagrites were killed in the battle because God was fighting against them. The people of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh lived in their land until they were taken into exile.
verses.textEnNasb: For many fell mortally wounded, because the war was of God. And they settled in their place until the exile.
verses.textEn: and many others fell slain, because the battle was God’s. And they occupied the land until the exile.

verses.textZh: 以下这些人是他们各家族的族长：以弗、以示、以列、亚斯列、耶利米、何达威雅和雅叠；他们都是英勇的战士，著名的人物，也是各家族的族长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些人是他们各家族的族长：以弗、以示、以列、亚斯列、耶利米、何达威雅和雅叠；他们都是英勇的战士，著名的人物，也是各家族的族长。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西半支派的人住在那地。从巴珊延到巴力‧黑们、示尼珥与黑门山。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous; they settled in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir (Mount Hermon).
verses.textEnEsv: The members of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They were very numerous from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land. Their numbers increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir, or Mount Hermon.
verses.textEnNlt: The half-tribe of Manasseh was very large and spread through the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land; from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon they were numerous.
verses.textEn: The people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous; they settled in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir (Mount Hermon).

verses.textZh: 他们背弃了他们列祖的神，随从当地民族的神行邪淫；神曾从他们面前消灭了这些民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们背弃了他们列祖的神，随从当地民族的神行邪淫；神曾从他们面前消灭了这些民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的族长是以弗、以示、以列、亚斯列、耶利米、何达威雅、雅叠，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族长的。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty warriors, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the leaders of their clans: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. These men had a great reputation as mighty warriors and leaders of their clans.
verses.textEnNasb: These were the heads of their fathers’ households: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, valiant mighty men, famous men, heads of their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.

verses.textZh: 因此，以色列的神激动了亚述王普勒的心，就是亚述王提革拉．毘尼色的心，他就把流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博和哈拉，以及歌散河边，他们的后裔直到今日还在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，以色列的神激动了亚述王普勒的心，就是亚述王提革拉．毘尼色的心，他就把流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博和哈拉，以及歌散河边，他们的后裔直到今日还在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们得罪了他们列祖的神，随从那地之民的神行邪淫；这民就是神在他们面前所除灭的。
verses.textEnNiv: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
verses.textEnEsv: But they broke faith with the God of their fathers, and whored after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
verses.textEnNlt: But these tribes were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors. They worshiped the gods of the nations that God had destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: But they were untrue to the God of their fathers and prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
verses.textEn: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

verses.textZh: 故此，以色列的神激动亚述王普勒和亚述王提革拉‧毗列色的心，他们就把吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博、哈拉与歌散河边，直到今日还在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 故此，以色列的神激动亚述王普勒和亚述王提革拉‧毗列色的心，他们就把吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博、哈拉与歌散河边，直到今日还在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，以色列的神激动亚述王普勒和亚述王提革拉‧毗列色的心，他们就把吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博、哈拉与歌散河边，直到今日还在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, the spirit of Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and he took them into exile, namely, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river Gozan, to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He carried the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into captivity. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So the God of Israel caused King Pul of Assyria (also known as Tiglath-pileser) to invade the land and take away the people of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh as captives. The Assyrians exiled them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the Gozan River, where they remain to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul, king of Assyria, that is, the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he took them into exile, namely the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.
verses.textEn: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.

verses.textZh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖和米拉利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖和米拉利。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEn: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

verses.textZh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦和乌薛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦和乌薛。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Kohath included Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

verses.textZh: 暗兰的儿女是亚伦、摩西和米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒和以他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗兰的儿女是亚伦、摩西和米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒和以他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西，还有女儿米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNasb: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEn: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.textZh: 以利亚撒生非尼哈，非尼哈生亚比书，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚撒生非尼哈，非尼哈生亚比书，
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亚比书；
verses.textEnNiv: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,
verses.textEnEsv: Eleazar fathered Phinehas, Phinehas fathered Abishua,
verses.textEnNkjv: Eleazar begot Phinehas, and Phinehas begot Abishua;
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas. Phinehas was the father of Abishua.
verses.textEnNasb: Eleazar fathered Phinehas, Phinehas fathered Abishua,
verses.textEn: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,

verses.textZh: 亚比书生布基，布基生乌西，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比书生布基，布基生乌西，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比书生布基；布基生乌西；
verses.textEnNiv: Abishua the father of Bukki, Bukki the father of Uzzi,
verses.textEnEsv: Abishua fathered Bukki, Bukki fathered Uzzi,
verses.textEnNkjv: Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi;
verses.textEnNlt: Abishua was the father of Bukki. Bukki was the father of Uzzi.
verses.textEnNasb: Abishua fathered Bukki, Bukki fathered Uzzi,
verses.textEn: Abishua the father of Bukki, Bukki the father of Uzzi,

verses.textZh: 乌西生西拉希雅，西拉希雅生米拉约，
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西生西拉希雅，西拉希雅生米拉约，
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉约；
verses.textEnNiv: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,
verses.textEnEsv: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, Zerahiah fathered Meraioth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;
verses.textEnNlt: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth.
verses.textEnNasb: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, Zerahiah fathered Meraioth,
verses.textEn: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,

verses.textZh: 米拉约生亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅生亚希突，
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉约生亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅生亚希突，
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉约生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；
verses.textEnNiv: Meraioth the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
verses.textEnEsv: Meraioth fathered Amariah, Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.textEnNkjv: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
verses.textEnNlt: Meraioth was the father of Amariah. Amariah was the father of Ahitub.
verses.textEnNasb: Meraioth fathered Amariah, Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.textEn: Meraioth the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,

verses.textZh: 亚希突生撒督，撒督生亚希玛斯，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希突生撒督，撒督生亚希玛斯，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生亚希玛斯；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,
verses.textEnEsv: Ahitub fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz;
verses.textEnNlt: Ahitub was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahitub fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,
verses.textEn: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,

verses.textZh: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅，亚撒利雅生约哈难，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅，亚撒利雅生约哈难，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅生约哈难；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahimaaz the father of Azariah, Azariah the father of Johanan,
verses.textEnEsv: Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, Azariah fathered Johanan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan;
verses.textEnNlt: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah. Azariah was the father of Johanan.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, Azariah fathered Johanan,
verses.textEn: Ahimaaz the father of Azariah, Azariah the father of Johanan,

verses.textZh: 约哈难生亚撒利雅 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈难生亚撒利雅 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈难生亚撒利雅（这亚撒利雅在所罗门于耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的职分）；
verses.textEnNiv: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),
verses.textEnEsv: and Johanan fathered Azariah ( it was he who served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem).
verses.textEnNkjv: Johanan begot Azariah (it was he who ministered as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem);
verses.textEnNlt: Johanan was the father of Azariah, the high priest at the Temple built by Solomon in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Johanan fathered Azariah (it was he who served as the priest in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem),
verses.textEn: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),

verses.textZh: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅生亚希突，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅生亚希突，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
verses.textEnEsv: Azariah fathered Amariah, Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.textEnNkjv: Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah was the father of Amariah. Amariah was the father of Ahitub.
verses.textEnNasb: Azariah fathered Amariah, Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.textEn: Azariah the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,

verses.textZh: 亚希突生撒督，撒督生沙龙，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希突生撒督，撒督生沙龙，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生沙龙；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Shallum,
verses.textEnEsv: Ahitub fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Shallum,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum;
verses.textEnNlt: Ahitub was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Shallum.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahitub fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Shallum,
verses.textEn: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Shallum,

verses.textZh: 沙龙生希勒家，希勒家生亚撒利雅，
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙龙生希勒家，希勒家生亚撒利雅，
verses.textZhCuv: 沙龙生希勒家；希勒家生亚撒利雅；
verses.textEnNiv: Shallum the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah the father of Azariah,
verses.textEnEsv: Shallum fathered Hilkiah, Hilkiah fathered Azariah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Shallum begot Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begot Azariah;
verses.textEnNlt: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah was the father of Azariah.
verses.textEnNasb: Shallum fathered Hilkiah, Hilkiah fathered Azariah,
verses.textEn: Shallum the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah the father of Azariah,

verses.textZh: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅，西莱雅生约萨答；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅，西莱雅生约萨答；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅；西莱雅生约萨答。
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah the father of Jozadak.
verses.textEnEsv: Azariah fathered Seraiah, Seraiah fathered Jehozadak;
verses.textEnNkjv: Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak.
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah was the father of Seraiah. Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak,
verses.textEnNasb: Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak;
verses.textEn: Azariah the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah the father of Jozadak.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华藉尼布甲尼撒掳掠犹大人和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华藉尼布甲尼撒掳掠犹大人和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华藉尼布甲尼撒的手掳掠犹大和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: Jozadak was deported when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jehozadak went into exile when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehozadak went intocaptivity when the Lord carried Judah and Jerusalem into captivity by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNlt: who went into exile when the Lord sent the people of Judah and Jerusalem into captivity under Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehozadak went along when the Lord led Judah and Jerusalem into exile by Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEn: Jozadak was deported when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.textZh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖和米拉利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖和米拉利。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Levi were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEn: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

verses.textZh: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼和示每。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼和示每。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼、示每。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon included Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEn: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.

verses.textZh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦和乌薛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦和乌薛。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Kohath included Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示。以上这些是利未人各宗族的各家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示。以上这些是利未人各宗族的各家。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。这是按着利未人宗族分的各家。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. Now these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers:
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Merari included Mahli and Mushi. The following were the Levite clans, listed according to their ancestral descent:
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙如下：革顺的儿子是立尼，立尼的儿子是雅哈，雅哈的儿子是薪玛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的子孙如下：革顺的儿子是立尼，立尼的儿子是雅哈，雅哈的儿子是薪玛，
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是雅哈；雅哈的儿子是薪玛；
verses.textEnNiv: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Gershon were Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah,
verses.textEnNasb: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.textEn: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

verses.textZh: 薪玛的儿子是约亚，约亚的儿子是易多，易多的儿子是谢拉，谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 薪玛的儿子是约亚，约亚的儿子是易多，易多的儿子是谢拉，谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。
verses.textZhCuv: 薪玛的儿子是约亚；约亚的儿子是易多；易多的儿子是谢拉；谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。
verses.textEnNiv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son and Jeatherai his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.
verses.textEnNasb: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
verses.textEn: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son and Jeatherai his son.

verses.textZh: 哥辖的子孙如下：哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达，亚米拿达的儿子是可拉，可拉的儿子是亚惜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖的子孙如下：哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达，亚米拿达的儿子是可拉，可拉的儿子是亚惜，
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达；亚米拿达的儿子是可拉；可拉的儿子是亚惜；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Kohath were Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Kohath included Amminadab, Korah, Assir,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Kohath were Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEn: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

verses.textZh: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿，以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒，以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿，以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒，以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜；
verses.textEnNiv: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Elkanah, Abiasaph, Assir,
verses.textEnNasb: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.textEn: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

verses.textZh: 亚惜的儿子是他哈，他哈的儿子是乌列，乌列的儿子是乌西雅，乌西雅的儿子是少罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚惜的儿子是他哈，他哈的儿子是乌列，乌列的儿子是乌西雅，乌西雅的儿子是少罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚惜的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是乌列；乌列的儿子是乌西雅；乌西雅的儿子是少罗。
verses.textEnNiv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
verses.textEnNasb: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.textEn: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.

verses.textZh: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩，
verses.textZhCuv: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth,
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Elkanah included Amasai, Ahimoth,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,

verses.textZh: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿，以利加拿的儿子是琐菲，琐菲的儿子是拿哈，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿，以利加拿的儿子是琐菲，琐菲的儿子是拿哈，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是琐菲；琐菲的儿子是拿哈；
verses.textEnNiv: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah were Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath,
verses.textEnNasb: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah were Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.textEn: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

verses.textZh: 拿哈的儿子是以利押，以利押的儿子是耶罗罕，耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿，以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿哈的儿子是以利押，以利押的儿子是耶罗罕，耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿，以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿哈的儿子是以利押；以利押的儿子是耶罗罕；耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。
verses.textEnNiv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son and Samuel his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Eliab, Jeroham, Elkanah, and Samuel.
verses.textEnNasb: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
verses.textEn: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son and Samuel his son.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳的子孙如下：长子是约珥 ，次子是亚比亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳的子孙如下：长子是约珥 ，次子是亚比亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳的长子是约珥，次子是亚比亚。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and Abijah the second son.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn, the second Abijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Samuel were Joel the firstborn, and Abijah the second.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Samuel were Joel (the older) and Abijah (the second).
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Samuel were Joel, the firstborn, and Abijah, the second.
verses.textEn: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and Abijah the second son.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的子孙如下：米拉利的儿子是抹利，抹利的儿子是立尼，立尼的儿子是示每，示每的儿子是乌撒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的子孙如下：米拉利的儿子是抹利，抹利的儿子是立尼，立尼的儿子是示每，示每的儿子是乌撒，
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的儿子是抹利；抹利的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是示每；示每的儿子是乌撒；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Merari included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Merari were Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.textEn: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

verses.textZh: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚，示米亚的儿子是哈基雅，哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚，示米亚的儿子是哈基雅，哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚；示米亚的儿子是哈基雅；哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。
verses.textEnNiv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son and Asaiah his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
verses.textEn: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son and Asaiah his son.

verses.textZh: 自约柜安放妥当以后，大卫指派在耶和华殿里负责歌唱事奉的就是以下这些人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自约柜安放妥当以后，大卫指派在耶和华殿里负责歌唱事奉的就是以下这些人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约柜安设之后，大卫派人在耶和华殿中管理歌唱的事。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the Lord after the ark came to rest there.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the men whom David put in charge of the service of song in the house of the Lord after the ark rested there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the men whom David appointed over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after the ark came to rest.
verses.textEnNlt: David assigned the following men to lead the music at the house of the Lord after the Ark was placed there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the ones whom David appointed over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after the ark rested there.
verses.textEn: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the Lord after the ark came to rest there.

verses.textZh: 他们在会幕的帐棚前担任歌唱的工作，直到所罗门在耶路撒冷建造了耶和华的殿，他们按着班次执行自己的职务。

verses.textEnNiv: They ministered with music before the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, until Solomon built the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem. They performed their duties according to the regulations laid down for them.
verses.textEnEsv: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they performed their service according to their order.
verses.textEnNkjv: They were ministering with music before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they served in their office according to their order.

verses.textEnNasb: They were ministering in song in front of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting until Solomon’s building of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they served in their office according to their order.
verses.textEn: They ministered with music before the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, until Solomon built the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem. They performed their duties according to the regulations laid down for them.

verses.textZh: 亚伦和他的子孙，却在燔祭坛上和香坛上，献祭烧香，作至圣所里的各种工作，为以色列人赎罪，是完全照着神的仆人摩西所吩咐的。

verses.textEnNiv: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Aaron and his sons offered sacrifices on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: Only Aaron and his descendants served as priests. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and the altar of incense, and they performed all the other duties related to the Most Holy Place. They made atonement for Israel by doing everything that Moses, the servant of God, had commanded them.
verses.textEnNasb: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, in accordance with everything that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.textEn: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
