verses.textZhCuv: 亚比书的儿子是布基；布基的儿子是乌西；乌西的儿子是西拉希雅；
verses.textEnNiv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah,
verses.textEnNasb: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.textEn: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

verses.textZh: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约，米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突，
verses.textZhCnvs: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约，米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突，
verses.textZhCuv: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约；米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突；
verses.textEnNiv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub,
verses.textEnNasb: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.textEn: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

verses.textZh: 亚希突的儿子是撒督，撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希突的儿子是撒督，撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希突的儿子是撒督；撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。
verses.textEnNiv: Zadok his son and Ahimaaz his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
verses.textEnNasb: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
verses.textEn: Zadok his son and Ahimaaz his son.

verses.textZh: 以下是在他们境内，他们按着营房居住的地方：哥辖族中亚伦的子孙抽中了签，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是在他们境内，他们按着营房居住的地方：哥辖族中亚伦的子孙抽中了签，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的住处按着境内的营寨，记在下面：哥辖族亚伦的子孙先拈阄得地，
verses.textEnNiv: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):
verses.textEnEsv: These are their dwelling places according to their settlements within their borders: to the sons of Aaron of the clans of Kohathites, for theirs was the first lot,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their settlements in their territory, for they were given by lot to the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathites:
verses.textEnNlt: This is a record of the towns and territory assigned by means of sacred lots to the descendants of Aaron, who were from the clan of Kohath.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are their settlements according to their camps within their borders. To the sons of Aaron of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
verses.textEn: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):

verses.textZh: 以色列人就把犹大地的希伯仑和希伯仑四周的草场，给了他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就把犹大地的希伯仑和希伯仑四周的草场，给了他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 在犹大地中得了希伯仑和四围的郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: They gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, with its surrounding common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: This territory included Hebron and its surrounding pasturelands in Judah,
verses.textEnNasb: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah and its pasture lands around it;
verses.textEn: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 但这城的郊野和属于这城的村庄，他们却给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这城的郊野和属于这城的村庄，他们却给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是属城的田地和村庄都为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒所得。
verses.textEnNiv: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
verses.textEnEsv: but the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.textEnNlt: but the fields and outlying areas belonging to the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
verses.textEnNasb: but they gave the fields of the city and its settlements to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.textEn: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

verses.textZh: 以色列人把避难城希伯仑给了亚伦的子孙，还有立拿和属于立拿的草场，雅提珥、以实提莫和属于以实提莫的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把避难城希伯仑给了亚伦的子孙，还有立拿和属于立拿的草场，雅提珥、以实提莫和属于以实提莫的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的子孙得了逃城希伯仑，又得了立拿与其郊野，雅提珥、以实提莫与其郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnEsv: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah with its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave oneof the cities of refuge, Hebron; also Libnah with its common-lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: So the descendants of Aaron were given the following towns, each with its pasturelands: Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnNasb: To the sons of Aaron they gave the following cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah together with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,

verses.textZh: 希仑和属于希仑的草场，底璧和属于底璧的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希仑和属于希仑的草场，底璧和属于底璧的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 希仑与其郊野，底璧与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: Hilen, Debir,
verses.textEnEsv: Hilen with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hilen with its common-lands, Debir with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: Holon, Debir,
verses.textEnNasb: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: Hilen, Debir,

verses.textZh: 亚珊和属于亚珊的草场，伯．示麦和属于伯．示麦的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚珊和属于亚珊的草场，伯．示麦和属于伯．示麦的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚珊与其郊野，伯‧示麦与其郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: Ashan with its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasturelands;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ashan with its common-lands, and Beth Shemesh with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh.
verses.textEnNasb: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands;
verses.textEn: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 又从便雅悯支派中，把迦巴和属于迦巴的草场，阿勒篾和属于阿勒篾的草场，亚拿突和属于亚拿突的草场，分给亚伦的子孙。他们各族所得的城共十三座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从便雅悯支派中，把迦巴和属于迦巴的草场，阿勒篾和属于阿勒篾的草场，亚拿突和属于亚拿突的草场，分给亚伦的子孙。他们各族所得的城共十三座。
verses.textZhCuv: 在便雅悯支派的地中，得了迦巴与其郊野，阿勒篾与其郊野，亚拿突与其郊野。他们诸家所得的城共十三座。
verses.textEnNiv: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. The total number of towns distributed among the Kohathite clans came to thirteen.
verses.textEnEsv: and from the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon, Geba with its pasturelands, Alemeth with its pasturelands, and Anathoth with its pasturelands. All their cities throughout their clans were thirteen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its common-lands, Alemeth with its common-lands, and Anathoth with its common-lands. All their cities among their families were thirteen.
verses.textEnNlt: And from the territory of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, each with its pasturelands. So thirteen towns were given to the descendants of Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: and from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. Their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities in all.
verses.textEn: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. The total number of towns distributed among the Kohathite clans came to thirteen.

verses.textZh: 哥辖其余家族的子孙从玛拿西半个支派中，抽签分得十座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖其余家族的子孙从玛拿西半个支派中，抽签分得十座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖族其余的人又拈阄，在玛拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: To the rest of the Kohathites were given by lot out of the clan of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: To the rest of the family of the tribe of the Kohathites theygave by lot ten cities from half the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten towns from the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh by means of sacred lots.
verses.textEnNasb: Then to the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, from the family of the tribe, from the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.textEn: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙，按着他们的家族，从以萨迦支派、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派和巴珊地的玛拿西支派中，分得十三座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的子孙，按着他们的家族，从以萨迦支派、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派和巴珊地的玛拿西支派中，分得十三座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺族按着宗族，在以萨迦支派的地中，亚设支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊内玛拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: To the Gershomites according to their clans were allotted thirteen cities out of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And to the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, theygave thirteen cities from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon received by sacred lots thirteen towns from the territories of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and from the Bashan area of Manasseh, east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNasb: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, were given from the tribe of Issachar, the tribe of Asher, the tribe of Naphtali, and the tribe of Manasseh, thirteen cities in Bashan.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的子孙，按着他们的家族，从流本支派、迦得支派和西布伦支派中，抽签分得十二座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的子孙，按着他们的家族，从流本支派、迦得支派和西布伦支派中，抽签分得十二座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利族按着宗族拈阄，在吕便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布伦支派的地中，得了十二座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: To the Merarites according to their clans were allotted twelve cities out of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
verses.textEnNkjv: To the sons of Merari, throughout their families, theygave twelve cities from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Merari received by sacred lots twelve towns from the territories of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
verses.textEnNasb: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 以色列人把这些城和属于这些城的草场，都分给利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把这些城和属于这些城的草场，都分给利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人将这些城与其郊野给了利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people of Israel gave the Levites the cities with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel gave these cities with their common-lands to the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel assigned all these towns and pasturelands to the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel gave the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 他们又从犹大支派、西缅支派和便雅悯支派中，抽签把以上这些有名字记录的城给了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又从犹大支派、西缅支派和便雅悯支派中，抽签把以上这些有名字记录的城给了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这以上录名的城，在犹大、西缅、便雅悯三支派的地中，以色列人拈阄给了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.
verses.textEnEsv: They gave by lot out of the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin these cities that are mentioned by name.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave by lot from the tribe of the children of Judah, from the tribe of the children of Simeon, and from the tribe of the children of Benjamin these cities which are called by their names.
verses.textEnNlt: The towns in the territories of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin, mentioned above, were assigned to them by means of sacred lots.
verses.textEnNasb: They gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah, the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
verses.textEn: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.

verses.textZh: 哥辖子孙的家族中，有些也从以法莲支派中分得他们境内的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖子孙的家族中，有些也从以法莲支派中分得他们境内的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖族中有几家在以法莲支派的地中也得了城邑，
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the clans of the sons of Kohath had cities of their territory out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now some of the families of the sons of Kohath weregiven cities as their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Kohath were given the following towns from the territory of Ephraim, each with its pasturelands:
verses.textEnNasb: Now some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又把避难城，在以法莲山地的示剑和属于示剑的草场，给了他们，还有基色和属于基色的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又把避难城，在以法莲山地的示剑和属于示剑的草场，给了他们，还有基色和属于基色的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 在以法莲山地得了逃城示剑与其郊野，又得了基色与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,
verses.textEnEsv: They were given the cities of refuge: Shechem with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave them oneof the cities of refuge, Shechem with its common-lands, in the mountains of Ephraim, also Gezer with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: Shechem (a city of refuge in the hill country of Ephraim), Gezer,
verses.textEnNasb: They gave to them the following cities of refuge: Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, Gezer with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,

verses.textZh: 约缅和属于约缅的草场，伯．和仑和属伯．和仑的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约缅和属于约缅的草场，伯．和仑和属伯．和仑的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 约缅与其郊野，伯‧和仑与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,
verses.textEnEsv: Jokmeam with its pasturelands, Beth-horon with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jokmeam with its common-lands, Beth Horon with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: Jokmeam, Beth-horon,
verses.textEnNasb: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth-horon with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,

verses.textZh: 亚雅仑和属于亚雅仑的草场，迦特．临门和属于迦特．临门的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚雅仑和属于亚雅仑的草场，迦特．临门和属于迦特．临门的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚雅仑与其郊野，迦特‧临门与其郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: Aijalon with its pasturelands, Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Aijalon with its common-lands, and Gath Rimmon with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon.
verses.textEnNasb: Aijalon with its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands;
verses.textEn: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半个支派中，把亚乃和属于亚乃的草场，比连和属于比连的草场，给了哥辖其余的家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又从玛拿西半个支派中，把亚乃和属于亚乃的草场，比连和属于比连的草场，给了哥辖其余的家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖族其余的人在玛拿西半支派的地中得了亚乃与其郊野，比连与其郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
verses.textEnEsv: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasturelands, and Bileam with its pasturelands, for the rest of the clans of the Kohathites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its common-lands and Bileam with its common-lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
verses.textEnNlt: The remaining descendants of Kohath were assigned the towns of Aner and Bileam from the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: and from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its pasture lands and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
verses.textEn: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

verses.textZh: 又从玛拿西半个支派的家族中，把巴珊的哥兰和属于哥兰的草场，亚斯他录和属于亚斯他录的草场，给了革顺的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从玛拿西半个支派的家族中，把巴珊的哥兰和属于哥兰的草场，亚斯他录和属于亚斯他录的草场，给了革顺的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺族在玛拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥兰与其郊野，亚斯他录与其郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: The Gershonites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they received Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands;
verses.textEnEsv: To the Gershomites were given out of the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands and Ashtaroth with its pasturelands;
verses.textEnNkjv: From the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh the sons of Gershon weregiven Golan in Bashan with its common-lands and Ashtaroth with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon received the towns of Golan (in Bashan) and Ashtaroth from the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: To the sons of Gershom were given, from the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
verses.textEn: The Gershonites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they received Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands;

verses.textZh: 又从以萨迦支派中，给了他们基低斯和属于基低斯的草场，大比拉和属于大比拉的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从以萨迦支派中，给了他们基低斯和属于基低斯的草场，大比拉和属于大比拉的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 又在以萨迦支派的地中得了基低斯与其郊野，大比拉与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Issachar they received Kedesh, Daberath,
verses.textEnEsv: and out of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasturelands, Daberath with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its common-lands, Daberath with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: From the territory of Issachar, they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
verses.textEnNasb: and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Issachar they received Kedesh, Daberath,

verses.textZh: 拉末和属于拉末的草场，亚年和属于亚年的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉末和属于拉末的草场，亚年和属于亚年的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉末与其郊野，亚年与其郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: Ramoth and Anem, together with their pasturelands;
verses.textEnEsv: Ramoth with its pasturelands, and Anem with its pasturelands;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ramoth with its common-lands, and Anem with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Ramoth, and Anem, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;
verses.textEn: Ramoth and Anem, together with their pasturelands;

verses.textZh: 又从亚设支派中给了他们玛沙和属于玛沙的草场，押顿和属于押顿的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从亚设支派中给了他们玛沙和属于玛沙的草场，押顿和属于押顿的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 在亚设支派的地中得了玛沙与其郊野，押顿与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Asher they received Mashal, Abdon,
verses.textEnEsv: out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasturelands, Abdon with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its common-lands, Abdon with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: From the territory of Asher, they received Mashal, Abdon,
verses.textEnNasb: and from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Asher they received Mashal, Abdon,

verses.textZh: 户割和属于户割的草场，利合和属于利合的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户割和属于户割的草场，利合和属于利合的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 户割与其郊野，利合与其郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: Hukok and Rehob, together with their pasturelands;
verses.textEnEsv: Hukok with its pasturelands, and Rehob with its pasturelands;
verses.textEnNkjv: Hukok with its common-lands, and Rehob with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Hukok, and Rehob, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;
verses.textEn: Hukok and Rehob, together with their pasturelands;

verses.textZh: 又从拿弗他利支派中，把加利利的基低斯和属于基低斯的草场，哈们和属于哈们的草场，基列亭和属于基列亭的草场，给了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从拿弗他利支派中，把加利利的基低斯和属于基低斯的草场，哈们和属于哈们的草场，基列亭和属于基列亭的草场，给了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯与其郊野，哈们与其郊野，基列亭与其郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: and from the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: and out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, Hammon with its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its common-lands, Hammon with its common-lands, and Kirjathaim with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: From the territory of Naphtali, they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.
verses.textEn: and from the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 又从西布伦支派中，把临摩挪和属于临摩挪的草场，他泊和属于他泊的草场，给了米拉利其余的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从西布伦支派中，把临摩挪和属于临摩挪的草场，他泊和属于他泊的草场，给了米拉利其余的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有米拉利族的人在西布伦支派的地中得了临摩挪与其郊野，他泊与其郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they received Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands;
verses.textEnEsv: To the rest of the Merarites were allotted out of the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono with its pasturelands, Tabor with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: From the tribe of Zebulun the rest of the children of Merari weregiven Rimmon with its common-lands and Tabor with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: The remaining descendants of Merari received the towns of Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmon, and Tabor from the territory of Zebulun, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono with its pasture lands, Tabor with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they received Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands;

verses.textZh: 又在约旦河那边，耶利哥对面，就是约旦河东岸，从流本支派中，给了他们在旷野的比悉和属于比悉的草场，雅哈撒和属于雅哈撒的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在约旦河那边，耶利哥对面，就是约旦河东岸，从流本支派中，给了他们在旷野的比悉和属于比悉的草场，雅哈撒和属于雅哈撒的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 又在耶利哥的约旦河东，在吕便支派的地中得了旷野的比悉与其郊野，雅哈撒与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan east of Jericho they received Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
verses.textEnEsv: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasturelands, Jahzah with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the other side of the Jordan, across from Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, theyweregiven from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its common-lands, Jahzah with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: From the territory of Reuben, east of the Jordan River opposite Jericho, they received Bezer (a desert town), Jahaz,
verses.textEnNasb: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan east of Jericho they received Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,

verses.textZh: 基底莫和属于基底莫的草场，米法押和属于米法押的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基底莫和属于基底莫的草场，米法押和属于米法押的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 基底莫与其郊野，米法押与其郊野；
verses.textEnNiv: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands;
verses.textEnEsv: Kedemoth with its pasturelands, and Mephaath with its pasturelands;
verses.textEnNkjv: Kedemoth with its common-lands, and Mephaath with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
verses.textEn: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands;

verses.textZh: 又从迦得支派中，给了他们基列的拉末和属于拉末的草场，玛哈念和属于玛哈念的草场，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从迦得支派中，给了他们基列的拉末和属于拉末的草场，玛哈念和属于玛哈念的草场，
verses.textZhCuv: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末与其郊野，玛哈念与其郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: and from the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
verses.textEnEsv: and out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands, Mahanaim with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its common-lands, Mahanaim with its common-lands,
verses.textEnNlt: And from the territory of Gad, they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
verses.textEnNasb: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: and from the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,

verses.textZh: 希实本和属于希实本的草场，雅谢和属于雅谢的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希实本和属于希实本的草场，雅谢和属于雅谢的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 希实本与其郊野，雅谢与其郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Jazer with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heshbon with its common-lands, and Jazer with its common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Heshbon, and Jazer, each with its pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
verses.textEn: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述和伸仑，共四人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述和伸仑，共四人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述 、伸仑，共四人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron—four in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four inall.
verses.textEnNlt: The four sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Issachar were four: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
verses.textEn: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron—four in all.

verses.textZh: 陀拉的儿子是乌西、利法雅、耶勒、雅买、易伯散和示母利，都是陀拉家族的族长，是他们那世代英勇的战士；到了大卫的日子，他们的人数共有二万二千六百名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 陀拉的儿子是乌西、利法雅、耶勒、雅买、易伯散和示母利，都是陀拉家族的族长，是他们那世代英勇的战士；到了大卫的日子，他们的人数共有二万二千六百名。
verses.textZhCuv: 陀拉的儿子是乌西、利法雅、耶勒、雅买、易伯散、示母利，都是陀拉的族长，是大能的勇士。到大卫年间，他们的人数共有二万二千六百名。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam and Samuel—heads of their families. During the reign of David, the descendants of Tola listed as fighting men in their genealogy numbered 22,600.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, namely of Tola, mighty warriors of their generations, their number in the days of David being 22,600.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house. Thesons of Tola were mighty men of valor in their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel. Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. At the time of King David, the total number of mighty warriors listed in the records of these clans was 22,600.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Samuel, heads of their fathers’ households. The sons of Tola were valiant warriors in their generations. Their number in the days of David was 22,600.
verses.textEn: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam and Samuel—heads of their families. During the reign of David, the descendants of Tola listed as fighting men in their genealogy numbered 22,600.

verses.textZh: 乌西的儿子是伊斯拉希，伊斯拉希的儿子是米迦勒、俄巴底亚，约珥和伊示雅，共五人，都是各家族的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西的儿子是伊斯拉希，伊斯拉希的儿子是米迦勒、俄巴底亚，约珥和伊示雅，共五人，都是各家族的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西的儿子是伊斯拉希；伊斯拉希的儿子是米迦勒、俄巴底亚、约珥、伊示雅，共五人，都是族长。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Ishiah. All five of them were chiefs.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, all five of them were chief men.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Uzzi was Izrahiah, and the sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Ishiah. All five of them were chief men.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Uzzi was Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. These five became the leaders of clans.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Uzzi was Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah; all five of them were chief men.
verses.textEn: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Ishiah. All five of them were chiefs.

verses.textZh: 此外，与他们在一起的，按着谱系和家族，还有能作战的军队三万六千人，因为他们的妻子和儿子很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，与他们在一起的，按着谱系和家族，还有能作战的军队三万六千人，因为他们的妻子和儿子很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所率领的，按着宗族出战的军队，共有三万六千人，因为他们的妻和子众多。
verses.textEnNiv: According to their family genealogy, they had 36,000 men ready for battle, for they had many wives and children.
verses.textEnEsv: And along with them, by their generations, according to their fathers’ houses, were units of the army for war, 36,000, for they had many wives and sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with them, by their generations, according to their fathers’ houses, were thirty-six thousand troops ready for war; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.textEnNlt: All of them had many wives and many sons, so the total number of men available for military service among their descendants was 36,000.
verses.textEnNasb: And with them by their generations according to their fathers’ households were thirty-six thousand troops of the army for war; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.textEn: According to their family genealogy, they had 36,000 men ready for battle, for they had many wives and children.

verses.textZh: 他们的兄弟在以萨迦各族中，都是英勇的战士，按着家谱登记的，共有八万七千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的兄弟在以萨迦各族中，都是英勇的战士，按着家谱登记的，共有八万七千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的族弟兄在以萨迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按着家谱计算共有八万七千人。
verses.textEnNiv: The relatives who were fighting men belonging to all the clans of Issachar, as listed in their genealogy, were 87,000 in all.
verses.textEnEsv: Their kinsmen belonging to all the clans of Issachar were in all 87,000 mighty warriors, enrolled by genealogy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now their brethren among all the families of Issachar were mighty men of valor, listed by their genealogies, eighty-seven thousand in all.
verses.textEnNlt: The total number of mighty warriors from all the clans of the tribe of Issachar was 87,000. All of them were listed in their genealogical records.
verses.textEnNasb: Their relatives among all the families of Issachar were valiant warriors, registered by genealogy, eighty-seven thousand in all.
verses.textEn: The relatives who were fighting men belonging to all the clans of Issachar, as listed in their genealogy, were 87,000 in all.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结和耶叠，共三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结和耶叠，共三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结、耶叠，共三人。
verses.textEnNiv: Three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker and Jediael.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thesons of Benjamin were Bela, Becher, and Jediael—three inall.
verses.textEnNlt: Three of Benjamin’s sons were Bela, Beker, and Jediael.
verses.textEnNasb: Benjamin had three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
verses.textEn: Three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker and Jediael.

verses.textZh: 比拉的儿子是以斯本、乌西、乌薛、耶利摩和以利，共五人，都是各家族的首领，是英勇的战士，按着家谱登记的，共有二万二千零三十四人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拉的儿子是以斯本、乌西、乌薛、耶利摩和以利，共五人，都是各家族的首领，是英勇的战士，按着家谱登记的，共有二万二千零三十四人。
verses.textZhCuv: 比拉的儿子是以斯本、乌西、乌薛、耶利摩、以利，共五人，都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万二千零三十四人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth and Iri, heads of families—five in all. Their genealogical record listed 22,034 fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five, heads of fathers’ houses, mighty warriors. And their enrollment by genealogies was 22,034.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Bela were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri—five inall. They were heads of their fathers’ houses, and they were listed by their genealogies, twenty-two thousand and thirty-four mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: The five sons of Bela were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. The total number of mighty warriors from these clans was 22,034, as listed in their genealogical records.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Bela were five: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were heads of fathers’ households, valiant warriors, 22,034 registered by genealogy.
verses.textEn: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth and Iri, heads of families—five in all. Their genealogical record listed 22,034 fighting men.

verses.textZh: 比结的儿子是细米拉、约阿施、以利以谢、以利约乃、暗利、耶利摩、亚比雅、亚拿突和亚拉篾，这都是比结的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 比结的儿子是细米拉、约阿施、以利以谢、以利约乃、暗利、耶利摩、亚比雅、亚拿突和亚拉篾，这都是比结的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 比结的儿子是细米拉、约阿施、以利以谢、以利约乃、暗利、耶利摩、亚比雅、亚拿突、亚拉篾。这都是比结的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Becher were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these are the sons of Becher.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Beker were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Becher were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.textEn: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.

verses.textZh: 他们都是各家族的首领，是英勇的战士，按着家谱登记的，共有二万零二百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都是各家族的首领，是英勇的战士，按着家谱登记的，共有二万零二百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万零二百人。
verses.textEnNiv: Their genealogical record listed the heads of families and 20,200 fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: And their enrollment by genealogies, according to their generations, as heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty warriors, was 20,200.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were recorded by genealogy according to their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, twenty thousand two hundred mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. The total number of mighty warriors and leaders from these clans was 20,200, as listed in their genealogical records.
verses.textEnNasb: They were registered by genealogy according to their generations, heads of their fathers’ households, 20,200 valiant warriors.
verses.textEn: Their genealogical record listed the heads of families and 20,200 fighting men.

verses.textZh: 耶叠的儿子是比勒罕；比勒罕的儿子是耶乌斯、便雅悯、以忽、基拿拿、细坦、他施和亚希沙哈；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶叠的儿子是比勒罕；比勒罕的儿子是耶乌斯、便雅悯、以忽、基拿拿、细坦、他施和亚希沙哈；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶叠的儿子是比勒罕；比勒罕的儿子是耶乌施、便雅悯、以忽、基拿拿、细坦、他施、亚希沙哈。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish and Ahishahar.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Jediael was Bilhan, and the sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Jediael was Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Jediael was Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.textEn: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish and Ahishahar.

verses.textZh: 这都是耶叠的儿子，是各家族的首领，是英勇的战士，能上阵作战的，共有一万七千二百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是耶叠的儿子，是各家族的首领，是英勇的战士，能上阵作战的，共有一万七千二百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是耶叠的儿子，都是族长，是大能的勇士；他们的子孙能上阵打仗的，共有一万七千二百人。
verses.textEnNiv: All these sons of Jediael were heads of families. There were 17,200 fighting men ready to go out to war.
verses.textEnEsv: All these were the sons of Jediael according to the heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty warriors, 17,200, able to go to war.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their fathers’ houses; therewere seventeen thousand two hundred mighty men of valor fit to go out for war and battle.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of them was the leader of an ancestral clan. From these clans the total number of mighty warriors ready for war was 17,200.
verses.textEnNasb: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, 17,200 valiant warriors who were ready to go out with the army to war.
verses.textEn: All these sons of Jediael were heads of families. There were 17,200 fighting men ready to go out to war.

verses.textZh: 还有以珥的儿子书品和户品，以及亚黑的儿子户伸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有以珥的儿子书品和户品，以及亚黑的儿子户伸。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有以珥的儿子书品、户品，并亚黑的儿子户伸。
verses.textEnNiv: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir, and the Hushites the descendants of Aher.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir, Hushim the son of Aher.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir, and Hushim was the son of Aher.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Ir were Shuppim and Huppim. Hushim was the son of Aher.
verses.textEnNasb: Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir; Hushim was the son of Aher.
verses.textEn: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir, and the Hushites the descendants of Aher.

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龙；都是辟拉的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龙；都是辟拉的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龙。这都是辟拉的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem —the descendants of Bilhah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shallum, the descendants of Bilhah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Naphtali were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem. They were all descendants of Jacob’s concubine Bilhah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Naphtali were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem —the descendants of Bilhah.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的儿子是亚斯列，是他亚兰籍的妾所生的；她又生了基列的父亲玛吉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的儿子是亚斯列，是他亚兰籍的妾所生的；她又生了基列的父亲玛吉。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的儿子亚斯列是他妾亚兰人所生的，又生了基列之父玛吉。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel was his descendant through his Aramean concubine. She gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his Aramean concubine bore; she bore Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: The descendants of Manasseh: his Syrian concubine bore him Machir the father of Gilead, the father of Asriel.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Manasseh through his Aramean concubine included Asriel. She also bore Makir, the father of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Manasseh were Asriel, to whom his Aramean concubine gave birth; she also gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel was his descendant through his Aramean concubine. She gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 玛吉娶了妻子，是户品和书品的妹妹，名叫玛迦。玛拿西的次子名叫西罗非哈；西罗非哈只有几个女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛吉娶了妻子，是户品和书品的妹妹，名叫玛迦。玛拿西的次子名叫西罗非哈；西罗非哈只有几个女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛吉娶的妻是户品、书品的妹子，名叫玛迦。玛拿西的次子名叫西罗非哈；西罗非哈但有几个女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Makir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. His sister’s name was Maakah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim. The name of his sister was Maacah. And the name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Machir took as his wife thesister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose name was Maachah. The name of Gilead’s grandson was Zelophehad, but Zelophehad begot only daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: Makir found wives for Huppim and Shuppim. Makir had a sister named Maacah. One of his descendants was Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Machir took a wife from Huppim and Shuppim, whose name was Maacah. And the name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.textEn: Makir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. His sister’s name was Maakah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.

verses.textZh: 玛吉的妻子玛迦生了一个儿子，她就给他起名叫毘利施；毘利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的儿子是乌兰和利金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛吉的妻子玛迦生了一个儿子，她就给他起名叫毘利施；毘利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的儿子是乌兰和利金。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛吉的妻玛迦生了一个儿子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的儿子是乌兰和利金。
verses.textEnNiv: Makir’s wife Maakah gave birth to a son and named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.textEnEsv: And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.textEnNlt: Makir’s wife, Maacah, gave birth to a son whom she named Peresh. His brother’s name was Sheresh. The sons of Peresh were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.textEnNasb: Maacah the wife of Machir gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh; the name of his brother was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.textEn: Makir’s wife Maakah gave birth to a son and named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

verses.textZh: 乌兰的儿子是比但。这都是基列的子孙；基列是玛吉的儿子，玛吉是玛拿西的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌兰的儿子是比但。这都是基列的子孙；基列是玛吉的儿子，玛吉是玛拿西的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌兰的儿子是比但。这都是基列的子孙。基列是玛吉的儿子，玛吉是玛拿西的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, son of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Ulam was Bedan.) These were the descendants of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Ulam was Bedan. All these were considered Gileadites, descendants of Makir son of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Ulam was Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.textEn: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 基列的妹妹哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亚比以谢和玛拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列的妹妹哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亚比以谢和玛拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亚比以谢、玛拉。（
verses.textEnNiv: His sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer and Mahlah.
verses.textEnEsv: And his sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.textEnNkjv: His sister Hammoleketh bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.textEnNlt: Makir’s sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.textEnNasb: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.textEn: His sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer and Mahlah.

verses.textZh: 示米大的儿子是亚现、示剑、利克希和阿尼安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示米大的儿子是亚现、示剑、利克希和阿尼安。
verses.textZhCuv: 示米大的儿子是亚现、示剑、利克希、阿尼安。）
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shemida were: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi and Aniam.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shemida were: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi and Aniam.

verses.textZh: 以法莲的儿子是书提拉，书提拉的儿子是比列，比列的儿子是他哈，他哈的儿子是以拉大，以拉大的儿子是他哈，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲的儿子是书提拉，书提拉的儿子是比列，比列的儿子是他哈，他哈的儿子是以拉大，以拉大的儿子是他哈，
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲的儿子是书提拉；书提拉的儿子是比列；比列的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是以拉大；以拉大的儿子是他哈；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ephraim were Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eladah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ephraim were Shuthelah, Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ephraim were Shuthelah and Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.textEn: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

verses.textZh: 他哈的儿子是撒拔，撒拔的儿子是书提拉。以谢和以列因为下去夺取迦特人的牲畜，被当地出生的迦特人杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他哈的儿子是撒拔，撒拔的儿子是书提拉。以谢和以列因为下去夺取迦特人的牲畜，被当地出生的迦特人杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他哈的儿子是撒拔；撒拔的儿子是书提拉。以法莲又生以谢、以列；这二人因为下去夺取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the native-born men of Gath, when they went down to seize their livestock.
verses.textEnEsv: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to raid their livestock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. The men of Gath who were born in that land killed them because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.textEnNlt: Zabad, Shuthelah, Ezer, and Elead. These two were killed trying to steal livestock from the local farmers near Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take their livestock.
verses.textEn: Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the native-born men of Gath, when they went down to seize their livestock.

verses.textZh: 他们的父亲以法莲为他们悲哀多日，他的兄弟都来安慰他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的父亲以法莲为他们悲哀多日，他的兄弟都来安慰他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的父亲以法莲为他们悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都来安慰他。
verses.textEnNiv: Their father Ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.textEnNlt: Their father, Ephraim, mourned for them a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
verses.textEnNasb: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
verses.textEn: Their father Ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.

verses.textZh: 以法莲与妻子同房，他的妻子就怀孕，生了一个儿子；以法莲就给他起名叫比利亚，因为他的家遭遇祸患。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲与妻子同房，他的妻子就怀孕，生了一个儿子；以法莲就给他起名叫比利亚，因为他的家遭遇祸患。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲与妻同房，他妻就怀孕生了一子，以法莲因为家里遭祸，就给这儿子起名叫比利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he made love to his wife again, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because there had been misfortune in his family.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ephraim went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son. And he called his name Beriah, because disaster had befallen his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived and bore a son; and he called his name Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Ephraim slept with his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. Ephraim named him Beriah because of the tragedy his family had suffered.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went in to his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son, and he named him Beriah, because misfortune had come upon his house.
verses.textEn: Then he made love to his wife again, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because there had been misfortune in his family.

verses.textZh: 他的女儿是舍伊拉，就是建造上伯．和仑、下伯．和仑和乌羡．舍伊拉的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的女儿是舍伊拉，就是建造上伯．和仑、下伯．和仑和乌羡．舍伊拉的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的女儿名叫舍伊拉，就是建筑上伯‧和仑、下伯‧和仑与乌羡‧舍伊拉的。
verses.textEnNiv: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon as well as Uzzen Sheerah.
verses.textEnEsv: His daughter was Sheerah, who built both Lower and Upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now his daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon and Uzzen Sheerah;
verses.textEnNlt: He had a daughter named Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower and Upper Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.textEnNasb: His daughter was Sheerah, who built lower and upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.textEn: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon as well as Uzzen Sheerah.

verses.textZh: 比利亚的儿子是利法和利悉；利悉的儿子是他拉，他拉的儿子是他罕，
verses.textZhCnvs: 比利亚的儿子是利法和利悉；利悉的儿子是他拉，他拉的儿子是他罕，
verses.textZhCuv: 比利阿的儿子是利法和利悉。利悉的儿子是他拉；他拉的儿子是他罕；
verses.textEnNiv: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.textEnEsv: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: and Rephah was his son, aswell as Resheph, and Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ephraim included Rephah, Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
verses.textEnNasb: Rephah was his son along with Resheph, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.textEn: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

verses.textZh: 他罕的儿子是拉但，拉但的儿子是亚米忽，亚米忽的儿子是以利沙玛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他罕的儿子是拉但，拉但的儿子是亚米忽，亚米忽的儿子是以利沙玛，
verses.textZhCuv: 他罕的儿子是拉但；拉但的儿子是亚米忽；亚米忽的儿子是以利沙玛；

verses.textEnEsv: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.textEnNlt: Nun, and Joshua.

verses.textEn: Nun his son and Joshua his son.

verses.textZh: 以法莲人的地业和居住的地方，是伯特利和属于伯特利的村庄，东边有拿兰，西边有基色和属于基色的村庄；示剑和属于示剑的村庄，直到迦萨和属于迦萨的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲人的地业和居住的地方，是伯特利和属于伯特利的村庄，东边有拿兰，西边有基色和属于基色的村庄；示剑和属于示剑的村庄，直到迦萨和属于迦萨的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲人的地业和住处是伯特利与其村庄；东边拿兰，西边基色与其村庄；示剑与其村庄，直到迦萨与其村庄；
verses.textEnNiv: Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages all the way to Ayyah and its villages.
verses.textEnEsv: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and to the east Naaran, and to the west Gezer and its towns, Shechem and its towns, and Ayyah and its towns;
verses.textEnNkjv: Now their possessions and dwelling places were Bethel and its towns: to the east Naaran, to the west Gezer and its towns, and Shechem and its towns, as far as Ayyah and its towns;
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ephraim lived in the territory that included Bethel and its surrounding towns to the south, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its surrounding villages to the north as far as Ayyah and its towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Their possessions and dwelling places were Bethel with its towns, and to the east, Naaran, and to the west, Gezer with its towns, and Shechem with its towns, as far as Ayyah with its towns,
verses.textEn: Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages all the way to Ayyah and its villages.

verses.textZh: 靠近玛拿西支派边界的还有：伯．善和属于伯．善的村庄；他纳和属于他纳的村庄；米吉多和属于米吉多的村庄；多珥和属于多珥的村庄。以色列的儿子约瑟的子孙就住在这些地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 靠近玛拿西支派边界的还有：伯．善和属于伯．善的村庄；他纳和属于他纳的村庄；米吉多和属于米吉多的村庄；多珥和属于多珥的村庄。以色列的儿子约瑟的子孙就住在这些地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有靠近玛拿西人的境界，伯‧善与其村庄；他纳与其村庄；米吉多与其村庄；多珥与其村庄。以色列儿子约瑟的子孙住在这些地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
verses.textEnEsv: also in possession of the Manassites, Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the sons of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh were Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph, the son of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Along the border of Manasseh were the towns of Beth-shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and their surrounding villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
verses.textEnNasb: and along the borders of the sons of Manasseh, Beth-shean with its towns, Taanach with its towns, Megiddo with its towns, and Dor with its towns. In these regions lived the sons of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.textEn: Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.

verses.textZh: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦和比利亚，还有他们的妹妹西拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦和比利亚，还有他们的妹妹西拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦、比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.

verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah was their sister.
verses.textEn: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah.

verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malkiel (the father of Birzaith).
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.textEn: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

verses.textZhCnvs: 希别生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦和他们的妹妹书雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 希别生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦，和他们的妹子书雅。

verses.textEnNkjv: And Heber begot Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Heber were Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham. They had a sister named Shua.
verses.textEnNasb: Heber fathered Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and their sister Shua.
verses.textEn: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer and Hotham and of their sister Shua.

verses.textZh: 雅弗勒的儿子是巴萨、宾哈和亚施法；这些人是雅弗勒的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅弗勒的儿子是巴萨、宾哈和亚施法；这些人是雅弗勒的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅弗勒的儿子是巴萨、宾哈、亚施法。这都是雅弗勒的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Japhlet: Pasak, Bimhal and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were the children of Japhlet.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were the sons of Japhlet.
verses.textEn: The sons of Japhlet: Pasak, Bimhal and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.

verses.textZh: 朔默的儿子是亚希、罗迦、耶户巴和亚兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朔默的儿子是亚希、罗迦、耶户巴和亚兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 朔默的儿子是亚希、罗迦、耶户巴、亚兰。

verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shemer his brother: Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Shemer were Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Shomer were Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shemer were Ahi and Rohgah, and Jehubbah and Aram.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shomer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah and Aram.

verses.textZh: 朔默的兄弟希连的儿子是琐法、音那、示利斯和亚抹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朔默的兄弟希连的儿子是琐法、音那、示利斯和亚抹。
verses.textZhCuv: 朔默兄弟希连的儿子是琐法、音那、示利斯、亚抹。

verses.textEnNasb: The sons of his brother Helem were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.textEn: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh and Amal.

verses.textZhCnvs: 益帖的儿子是耶孚尼、毘斯巴和亚拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 益帖的儿子是耶孚尼、毗斯巴、亚拉。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah and Ara.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

verses.textZhCnvs: 乌拉的儿子是亚拉、汉尼业和利写。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌拉的儿子是亚拉、汉尼业、利写。

verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Haniel, and Rizia.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel and Rizia.

verses.textZh: 这都是亚设的子孙，是他们各家族的首领，是杰出英勇的战士，是领袖中的首领；按着家谱登记的数目，能上阵作战的共有二万六千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是亚设的子孙，是他们各家族的首领，是杰出英勇的战士，是领袖中的首领；按着家谱登记的数目，能上阵作战的共有二万六千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是亚设的子孙，都是族长，是精壮大能的勇士，也是首领中的头目，按着家谱计算，他们的子孙能出战的共有二万六千人。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were descendants of Asher—heads of families, choice men, brave warriors and outstanding leaders. The number of men ready for battle, as listed in their genealogy, was 26,000.
verses.textEnEsv: All of these were men of Asher, heads of fathers’ houses, approved, mighty warriors, chiefs of the princes. Their number enrolled by genealogies, for service in war, was 26,000 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their fathers’ houses, choice men, mighty men of valor, chief leaders. And they were recorded by genealogies among the army fit for battle; their number was twenty-six thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of these descendants of Asher was the head of an ancestral clan. They were all select men—mighty warriors and outstanding leaders. The total number of men available for military service was 26,000, as listed in their genealogical records.
verses.textEnNasb: All these were the sons of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice, valiant mighty men, and heads of the leaders. And the number of them registered by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.textEn: All these were descendants of Asher—heads of families, choice men, brave warriors and outstanding leaders. The number of men ready for battle, as listed in their genealogy, was 26,000.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯生了长子比拉、次子亚实别、三子亚哈拉、

verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯的长子比拉，次子亚实别，三子亚哈拉，

verses.textEnNasb: And Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
verses.textEn: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second son, Aharah the third,

verses.textZhCuv: 比拉的儿子是亚大、基拉、亚比忽、

verses.textEn: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

verses.textZhCnvs: 基拉、示孚汛、户兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 基拉、示孚汛、户兰。

verses.textZh: 以下这些人是以忽的子孙，他们是迦巴居民各家族的首领，曾被掳到玛拿辖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些人是以忽的子孙，他们是迦巴居民各家族的首领，曾被掳到玛拿辖。
verses.textZhCuv: 以忽的儿子作迦巴居民的族长，被掳到玛拿辖；
verses.textEnNiv: These were the descendants of Ehud, who were heads of families of those living in Geba and were deported to Manahath:
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Ehud (they were heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they were carried into exile to Manahath):
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the sons of Ehud, who were the heads of the fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and who forced them to move to Manahath:
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Ehud, leaders of the clans living at Geba, were exiled to Manahath.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, and they took them into exile to Manahath,
verses.textEn: These were the descendants of Ehud, who were heads of families of those living in Geba and were deported to Manahath:

verses.textZh: 以忽的儿子是乃幔、亚希亚和基拉；基拉使他们被掳；他生了乌撒和亚希忽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以忽的儿子是乃幔、亚希亚和基拉；基拉使他们被掳；他生了乌撒和亚希忽。
verses.textZhCuv: 以忽的儿子乃幔、亚希亚、基拉也被掳去。基拉生乌撒、亚希忽。
verses.textEnNiv: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who deported them and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.textEnEsv: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, that is, Heglam, who fathered Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera who forced them to move. He begot Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.textEnNlt: Ehud’s sons were Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. Gera, who led them into exile, was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.textEnNasb: namely, Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera—he exiled them; and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.textEn: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who deported them and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.textZhCnvs: 沙哈连遣走户伸和巴拉两位妻子以后，就在摩押地生了儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙哈连休他二妻户伸和巴拉之后，在摩押地生了儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Sons were born to Shaharaim in Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shaharaim fathered sons in the country of Moab after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Shaharaim had children in the country of Moab, after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.
verses.textEnNlt: After Shaharaim divorced his wives Hushim and Baara, he had children in the land of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: Shaharaim fathered children in the country of Moab after he had sent his wives Hushim and Baara away.
verses.textEn: Sons were born to Shaharaim in Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.

verses.textZhCuv: 他的妻户伸给他生的儿子有亚比突、以利巴力。

verses.textEnNasb: By Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.textEn: By Hushim he had Abitub and Elpaal.

verses.textZh: 以利巴力的儿子是希伯、米珊和沙麦。沙麦建造了阿挪和罗德二城，以及属于这二城的村庄。

verses.textEn: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its surrounding villages),

verses.textZh: 还有比利亚和示玛，他们二人是亚雅仑居民各家族的首领，曾把迦特的居民赶走。

verses.textZhCuv: 又有比利亚和示玛是亚雅仑居民的族长，是驱逐迦特人的。
verses.textEnNiv: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of families of those living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

verses.textEnNkjv: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of their fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.textEnNlt: Beriah, and Shema. They were the leaders of the clans living in Aijalon, and they drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put the inhabitants of Gath to flight;
verses.textEn: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of families of those living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人照着家谱都是他们家族的首领，是住在耶路撒冷的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人照着家谱都是他们家族的首领，是住在耶路撒冷的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人都是著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were heads of families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the heads of fathers’ houses, according to their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were heads of the fathers’ houses by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the leaders of the ancestral clans; they were listed in their genealogical records, and they all lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: These were heads of the fathers’ households according to their generations, chief men who lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: All these were heads of families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 住在基遍的有基遍的父亲耶利，他的妻子名叫玛迦。

verses.textZhCuv: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；

verses.textEnNkjv: Now the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, dwelt at Gibeon.

verses.textEnNasb: Now, Jeiel, the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon, and his wife’s name was Maacah;
verses.textEn: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,

verses.textEnNasb: Mikloth fathered Shimeah. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem opposite their other relatives.
verses.textEn: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达；耶何阿达生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威和心利；心利生摩撒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达；耶何阿达生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威和心利；心利生摩撒；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达；耶何阿达生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz was the father of Jadah. Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.textEn: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.

verses.textZh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是拉法，拉法的儿子是以利亚萨，以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是拉法，拉法的儿子是以利亚萨，以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是拉法；拉法的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.textEnNiv: Moza was the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Moza fathered Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moza begot Binea, Raphah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Moza was the father of Binea. Binea was the father of Rephaiah. Rephaiah was the father of Eleasah. Eleasah was the father of Azel.
verses.textEnNasb: Moza fathered Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah, his son, and Azel, his son.
verses.textEn: Moza was the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.

verses.textZh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅和哈难；这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅和哈难；这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnEsv: Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Azel had six sons whose names were these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnNlt: Azel had six sons: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnNasb: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEn: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

verses.textZh: 亚悉的兄弟以设的众子是：长子乌兰、次子耶乌施、三子以利法列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚悉的兄弟以设的众子是：长子乌兰、次子耶乌施、三子以利法列。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚悉兄弟以设的长子是乌兰，次子耶乌施，三子是以利法列。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second son and Eliphelet the third.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.textEnNlt: Azel’s brother Eshek had three sons: the first was Ulam, the second was Jeush, and the third was Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of his brother Eshek were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.textEn: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second son and Eliphelet the third.

verses.textZh: 乌兰的儿子都是英勇的战士，是弓箭手；他们有很多子孙，共有一百五十名，都是便雅悯支派的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌兰的儿子都是英勇的战士，是弓箭手；他们有很多子孙，共有一百五十名，都是便雅悯支派的。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌兰的儿子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他们有许多的子孙，共一百五十名，都是便雅悯人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ulam were brave warriors who could handle the bow. They had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ulam were men who were mighty warriors, bowmen, having many sons and grandsons, 150. All these were Benjaminites.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor—archers. They had many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty inall. These were all sons of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: Ulam’s sons were all mighty warriors and expert archers. They had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were descendants of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ulam were valiant mighty men, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons, 150 of them. All these were among the sons of Benjamin.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ulam were brave warriors who could handle the bow. They had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 全体以色列人都照着家谱登记，都写在"以色列诸王记"上；犹大人因为悖逆，就被掳到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体以色列人都照着家谱登记，都写在"以色列诸王记"上；犹大人因为悖逆，就被掳到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人都按家谱计算，写在以色列诸王记上。犹大人因犯罪就被掳到巴比伦。
verses.textEnNiv: All Israel was listed in the genealogies recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. They were taken captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: So all Israel was recorded in genealogies, and these are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was taken into exile in Babylon because of their breach of faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all Israel was recorded by genealogies, and indeed, they were inscribed in the book of the kings of Israel. But Judah was carried away captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
verses.textEnNlt: So all Israel was listed in the genealogical records in The Book of the Kings of Israel. The people of Judah were exiled to Babylon because they were unfaithful to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So all Israel was enrolled in genealogies; and behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was taken into exile to Babylon for their infidelity.
verses.textEn: All Israel was listed in the genealogies recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. They were taken captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.

verses.textZh: 那些最先回来，住在自己的地业、自己的城中的，有以色列人、祭司、利未人和作殿役的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些最先回来，住在自己的地业、自己的城中的，有以色列人、祭司、利未人和作殿役的。
verses.textZhCuv: 先从巴比伦回来，住在自己地业城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提宁的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the first to resettle on their own property in their own towns were some Israelites, priests, Levites and temple servants.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the first to dwell again in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the first inhabitants who dwelt in their possessions in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and the Nethinim.
verses.textEnNlt: The first of the exiles to return to their property in their former towns were priests, Levites, Temple servants, and other Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the first inhabitants who lived on their own property in their cities were people of Israel, including the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
verses.textEn: Now the first to resettle on their own property in their own towns were some Israelites, priests, Levites and temple servants.

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷居住的，有犹大支派、便雅悯支派、以法莲支派和玛拿西支派的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷居住的，有犹大支派、便雅悯支派、以法莲支派和玛拿西支派的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在耶路撒冷的有犹大人、便雅悯人、以法莲人、玛拿西人。
verses.textEnNiv: Those from Judah, from Benjamin, and from Ephraim and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem were:
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the people of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in Jerusalem the children of Judah dwelt, and some of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the people from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh came and settled in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the sons of Judah, some of the sons of Benjamin, and some of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem:
verses.textEn: Those from Judah, from Benjamin, and from Ephraim and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem were:

verses.textZh: 犹大的儿子法勒斯的子孙中，有乌太；乌太是亚米忽的儿子，亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子，音利是巴尼的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的儿子法勒斯的子孙中，有乌太；乌太是亚米忽的儿子，亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子，音利是巴尼的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大儿子法勒斯的子孙中有乌太。乌太是亚米忽的儿子；亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子；音利是巴尼的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Uthai the son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, from the sons of Perez the son of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the descendants of Perez, the son of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: One family that returned was that of Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, from the sons of Perez the son of Judah.
verses.textEn: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.

verses.textZh: 示罗的子孙中，有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示罗的子孙中，有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。
verses.textZhCuv: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。
verses.textEnNiv: Of the Shelanites : Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.textEnEsv: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Others returned from the Shilonite clan, including Asaiah (the oldest) and his sons.
verses.textEnNasb: From the Shilonites were Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.textEn: Of the Shelanites : Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

verses.textZh: 谢拉的子孙中，有耶乌利和他们的亲族，共六百九十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谢拉的子孙中，有耶乌利和他们的亲族，共六百九十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 谢拉的子孙中有耶乌利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。
verses.textEnNiv: Of the Zerahites: Jeuel. The people from Judah numbered 690.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their kinsmen, 690.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren—six hundred and ninety.
verses.textEnNlt: From the Zerahite clan, Jeuel returned with his relatives. In all, 690 families from the tribe of Judah returned.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Zerah were Jeuel and their relatives, 690 of them.
verses.textEn: Of the Zerahites: Jeuel. The people from Judah numbered 690.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯的子孙中，有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路；
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯的子孙中，有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路；
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人中有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路，
verses.textEnNiv: Of the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Benjaminites: Sallu the son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Benjamin came Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah;
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Benjamin were Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
verses.textEn: Of the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

verses.textZh: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，以及伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，以及伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，
verses.textEnNiv: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Mikri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.
verses.textEnEsv: Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, Elah the son of Uzzi, son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ibneiah the son of Jeroham; Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.textEnNlt: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, son of Micri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah.
verses.textEnNasb: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.textEn: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Mikri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.

verses.textZh: 还有他们的众亲族；按着他们的家谱登记，共有九百五十六人。以上这些人都是他们各家族的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有他们的众亲族；按着他们的家谱登记，共有九百五十六人。以上这些人都是他们各家族的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 和他们的族弟兄，按着家谱计算共有九百五十六名。这些人都是他们的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: The people from Benjamin, as listed in their genealogy, numbered 956. All these men were heads of their families.
verses.textEnEsv: and their kinsmen according to their generations, 956. All these were heads of fathers’ houses according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and their brethren, according to their generations—nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were heads of a father’s house in their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: These men were all leaders of clans, and they were listed in their genealogical records. In all, 956 families from the tribe of Benjamin returned.
verses.textEnNasb: and their relatives according to their generations, 956. All these men were heads of fathers’ households according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEn: The people from Benjamin, as listed in their genealogy, numbered 956. All these men were heads of their families.

verses.textZh: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
verses.textEnNiv: Of the priests: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
verses.textEnNlt: Among the priests who returned were Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jakin,
verses.textEnNasb: From the priests were Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
verses.textEn: Of the priests: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;

verses.textZh: 还有管理神的殿的希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅；希勒家是米书兰的儿子，米书兰是撒督的儿子，撒督是米拉约的儿子，米拉约是亚希突的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有管理神的殿的希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅；希勒家是米书兰的儿子，米书兰是撒督的儿子，撒督是米拉约的儿子，米拉约是亚希突的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有管理神殿希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅。希勒家是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是撒督的儿子；撒督是米拉约的儿子；米拉约是亚希突的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God;
verses.textEnEsv: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the chief officer of the house of God;
verses.textEnNkjv: Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the officer over the house of God;
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub. Azariah was the chief officer of the house of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief officer of the house of God;
verses.textEn: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God;

verses.textZh: 又有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，以及亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子，雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子，米书兰是米实利密的儿子，米实利密是音麦的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，以及亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子，雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子，米书兰是米实利密的儿子，米实利密是音麦的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，又有亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子；雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是米实利密的儿子；米实利密是音麦的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer.
verses.textEnEsv: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer;
