verses.textEnNkjv: Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.textEnNlt: Other returning priests were Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah, and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer.
verses.textEnNasb: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.textEn: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer.

verses.textZh: 以及他们的众亲族，他们家族的首领，共有一千七百六十人，都是有才干，很会作神殿里工作的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及他们的众亲族，他们家族的首领，共有一千七百六十人，都是有才干，很会作神殿里工作的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们和众弟兄都是族长，共有一千七百六十人，是善于做神殿使用之工的。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests, who were heads of families, numbered 1,760. They were able men, responsible for ministering in the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: besides their kinsmen, heads of their fathers’ houses, 1,760, mighty men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and their brethren, heads of their fathers’ houses—one thousand seven hundred and sixty. Theywere very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: In all, 1,760 priests returned. They were heads of clans and very able men. They were responsible for ministering at the house of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and their relatives, heads of their fathers’ households, 1,760 competent men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.textEn: The priests, who were heads of families, numbered 1,760. They were able men, responsible for ministering in the house of God.

verses.textZh: 利未支派米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅；
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未支派米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅；
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅。
verses.textEnNiv: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a Merarite;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites who returned were Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;
verses.textEnNasb: Of the Levites, there were Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.textEn: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a Merarite;

verses.textZh: 又有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，和亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，和亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅；
verses.textZhCuv: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，并亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅，
verses.textEnNiv: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zikri, the son of Asaph;
verses.textEnEsv: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah the son of Mica, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;
verses.textEnNkjv: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.textEnNlt: Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zicri, son of Asaph;
verses.textEnNasb: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal; and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
verses.textEn: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zikri, the son of Asaph;

verses.textZh: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底；还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家；他们都住在尼陀法人的村落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底；还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家；他们都住在尼陀法人的村落。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底，还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家。他们都住在尼陀法人的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.textEnEsv: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.textEnNlt: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the area of Netophah.
verses.textEnNasb: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the settlements of the Netophathites.
verses.textEn: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

verses.textZh: 守门的有沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔和他们的众亲族；沙龙是他们的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守门的有沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔和他们的众亲族；沙龙是他们的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 守门的是沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔，和他们的弟兄；沙龙为长。
verses.textEnNiv: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman and their fellow Levites, Shallum their chief
verses.textEnEsv: The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their kinsmen (Shallum was the chief);
verses.textEnNkjv: And the gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brethren. Shallum was the chief.
verses.textEnNlt: The gatekeepers who returned were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was the chief gatekeeper.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives (Shallum the chief
verses.textEn: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman and their fellow Levites, Shallum their chief

verses.textZh: 直到现在，他们仍是看守东面的王门；他们曾经作过利未营的守门人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到现在，他们仍是看守东面的王门；他们曾经作过利未营的守门人。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前这些人看守朝东的王门，如今是利未营中守门的。
verses.textEnNiv: being stationed at the King’s Gate on the east, up to the present time. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the camp of the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: until then they were in the king’s gate on the east side as the gatekeepers of the camps of the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until then theyhadbeen gatekeepers for the camps of the children of Levi at the King’s Gate on the east.
verses.textEnNlt: Prior to this time, they were responsible for the King’s Gate on the east side. These men served as gatekeepers for the camps of the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: being stationed until now at the king’s gate to the east). These were the gatekeepers for the camp of the sons of Levi.
verses.textEn: being stationed at the King’s Gate on the east, up to the present time. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the camp of the Levites.

verses.textZh: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，以及他的众亲族可拉人，担任事务的工作，看守会幕的门；他们的祖先曾经管理耶和华的营幕，看守营门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，以及他的众亲族可拉人，担任事务的工作，看守会幕的门；他们的祖先曾经管理耶和华的营幕，看守营门。
verses.textZhCuv: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，并守会幕的门。他们的祖宗曾管理耶和华的营盘，又把守营门。
verses.textEnNiv: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his fellow gatekeepers from his family (the Korahites) were responsible for guarding the thresholds of the tent just as their ancestors had been responsible for guarding the entrance to the dwelling of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Shallum the son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his kinsmen of his fathers’ house, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent, as their fathers had been in charge of the camp of the Lord , keepers of the entrance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, from his father’s house, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, gatekeepers of the tabernacle. Their fathers had been keepers of the entrance to the camp of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Shallum was the son of Kore, a descendant of Abiasaph, from the clan of Korah. He and his relatives, the Korahites, were responsible for guarding the entrance to the sanctuary, just as their ancestors had guarded the Tabernacle in the camp of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives of his father’s house, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, doorkeepers of the tent; and their fathers had been in charge of the camp of the Lord, keepers of the entrance.
verses.textEn: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his fellow gatekeepers from his family (the Korahites) were responsible for guarding the thresholds of the tent just as their ancestors had been responsible for guarding the entrance to the dwelling of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，曾经作过他们的领袖，耶和华也与他同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，曾经作过他们的领袖，耶和华也与他同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈管理他们，耶和华也与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar was the official in charge of the gatekeepers, and the Lord was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the chief officer over them in time past; the Lord was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar had been the officer over them in time past; the Lordwas with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers in earlier times, and the Lord had been with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was supervisor over them previously, and the Lord was with him.
verses.textEn: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar was the official in charge of the gatekeepers, and the Lord was with him.

verses.textZh: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅，是看守会幕大门的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅，是看守会幕大门的。
verses.textZhCuv: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅是看守会幕之门的。
verses.textEnNiv: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was keeper of the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: And later Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was responsible for guarding the entrance to the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 这些被选看守殿门的人，共有二百一十二人；他们在自己的村庄里按着家谱登记；他们是大卫和撒母耳先见指派承担这职任的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些被选看守殿门的人，共有二百一十二人；他们在自己的村庄里按着家谱登记；他们是大卫和撒母耳先见指派承担这职任的。
verses.textZhCuv: 被选守门的人共有二百一十二名。他们在自己的村庄，按着家谱计算，是大卫和先见撒母耳所派当这紧要职任的。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. The gatekeepers had been assigned to their positions of trust by David and Samuel the seer.
verses.textEnEsv: All these, who were chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds, were 212. They were enrolled by genealogies in their villages. David and Samuel the seer established them in their office of trust.
verses.textEnNkjv: All those chosen as gatekeepers were two hundred and twelve. They were recorded by their genealogy, in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their trusted office.
verses.textEnNlt: In all, there were 212 gatekeepers in those days, and they were listed according to the genealogies in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed their ancestors because they were reliable men.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who were chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds were 212 in all. They were registered by genealogy in their settlements, those whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their official capacity.
verses.textEn: Altogether, those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. The gatekeepers had been assigned to their positions of trust by David and Samuel the seer.

verses.textZh: 他们和他们的子孙，按着班次，看守耶和华的殿门，就是会幕的门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们和他们的子孙，按着班次，看守耶和华的殿门，就是会幕的门。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们和他们的子孙按着班次看守耶和华殿的门，就是会幕的门。
verses.textEnNiv: They and their descendants were in charge of guarding the gates of the house of the Lord —the house called the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: So they and their sons were in charge of the gates of the house of the Lord , that is, the house of the tent, as guards.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they and their children were in charge of the gates of the house of the Lord, the house of the tabernacle, by assignment.
verses.textEnNlt: These gatekeepers and their descendants, by their divisions, were responsible for guarding the entrance to the house of the Lord when that house was a tent.
verses.textEnNasb: So they and their sons were in charge of the gates of the house of the Lord, the house of the tent, in their divisions of service.
verses.textEn: They and their descendants were in charge of guarding the gates of the house of the Lord —the house called the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 在东西南北四方，都有看守的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在东西南北四方，都有看守的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在东西南北，四方都有守门的。
verses.textEnNiv: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north and south.
verses.textEnEsv: The gatekeepers were on the four sides, east, west, north, and south.
verses.textEnNkjv: The gatekeepers were assigned to the four directions: the east, west, north, and south.
verses.textEnNlt: The gatekeepers were stationed on all four sides—east, west, north, and south.
verses.textEnNasb: The gatekeepers were on the four sides, to the east, west, north, and south.
verses.textEn: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north and south.

verses.textZh: 他们的亲族，就是住在他们村庄里的，每七天就要来和他们换班。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的亲族，就是住在他们村庄里的，每七天就要来和他们换班。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的族弟兄住在村庄，每七日来与他们换班。
verses.textEnNiv: Their fellow Levites in their villages had to come from time to time and share their duties for seven-day periods.
verses.textEnEsv: And their kinsmen who were in their villages were obligated to come in every seven days, in turn, to be with these,
verses.textEnNkjv: And their brethren in their villages had to come with them from time to time for seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: Their relatives in the villages came regularly to share their duties for seven-day periods.
verses.textEnNasb: Their relatives in their settlements were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them;
verses.textEn: Their fellow Levites in their villages had to come from time to time and share their duties for seven-day periods.

verses.textZh: 四个殿门的守卫长都是利未人，受托看守神的殿的房间和库房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个殿门的守卫长都是利未人，受托看守神的殿的房间和库房。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四个门领都是利未人，各有紧要的职任，看守神殿的仓库。
verses.textEnNiv: But the four principal gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the responsibility for the rooms and treasuries in the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted to be over the chambers and the treasures of the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in this trusted office were four chief gatekeepers; they were Levites. And they had charge over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The four chief gatekeepers, all Levites, were trusted officials, for they were responsible for the rooms and treasuries at the house of God.
verses.textEnNasb: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, served in an official capacity, and were in charge of the chambers and in charge of the treasuries in the house of God.
verses.textEn: But the four principal gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the responsibility for the rooms and treasuries in the house of God.

verses.textZh: 他们在神的殿的四周住宿，因为他们承担看守的责任，并且每天早晨要负责开门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在神的殿的四周住宿，因为他们承担看守的责任，并且每天早晨要负责开门。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们住在神殿的四围，是因委托他们守殿，要每日早晨开门。
verses.textEnNiv: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they had to guard it; and they had charge of the key for opening it each morning.
verses.textEnEsv: And they lodged around the house of God, for on them lay the duty of watching, and they had charge of opening it every morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they lodged all around the house of God because they had the responsibility, and they were in charge of opening it every morning.
verses.textEnNlt: They would spend the night around the house of God, since it was their duty to guard it and to open the gates every morning.
verses.textEnNasb: They spent the night around the house of God, because the watch was committed to them; and they were in charge of opening it morning by morning.
verses.textEn: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they had to guard it; and they had charge of the key for opening it each morning.

verses.textZh: 利未人中有管理器皿的使用的；他们按着数目拿出去，也要按着数目拿进来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人中有管理器皿的使用的；他们按着数目拿出去，也要按着数目拿进来。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着数目拿出拿入；
verses.textEnNiv: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in the temple service; they counted them when they were brought in and when they were taken out.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of them had charge of the utensils of service, for they were required to count them when they were brought in and taken out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now some of them were in charge of the serving vessels, for they brought them in and took them out by count.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the gatekeepers were assigned to care for the various articles used in worship. They checked them in and out to avoid any loss.
verses.textEnNasb: Now some of them were in charge of the utensils of the service, for they counted them when they brought them in and when they took them out.
verses.textEn: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in the temple service; they counted them when they were brought in and when they were taken out.

verses.textZh: 他们当中又有人受托管理器具，和管理圣所的一切器具，以及细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当中又有人受托管理器具，和管理圣所的一切器具，以及细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人管理器具和圣所的器皿，并细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。
verses.textEnNiv: Others were assigned to take care of the furnishings and all the other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the special flour and wine, and the olive oil, incense and spices.
verses.textEnEsv: Others of them were appointed over the furniture and over all the holy utensils, also over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the incense, and the spices.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some of them were appointed over the furnishings and over all the implements of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the incense and the spices.
verses.textEnNlt: Others were responsible for the furnishings, the items in the sanctuary, and the supplies, such as choice flour, wine, olive oil, frankincense, and spices.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture and over all the utensils of the sanctuary, and over the finely milled flour, the wine, the olive oil, the frankincense, and the balsam oil.
verses.textEn: Others were assigned to take care of the furnishings and all the other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the special flour and wine, and the olive oil, incense and spices.

verses.textZh: 祭司的子孙中，有人用香料配制成香膏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司的子孙中，有人用香料配制成香膏。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。
verses.textEnNiv: But some of the priests took care of mixing the spices.
verses.textEnEsv: Others, of the sons of the priests, prepared the mixing of the spices,
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.textEnNlt: But it was the priests who blended the spices.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the balsam oil.
verses.textEn: But some of the priests took care of mixing the spices.

verses.textZh: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他的职责是管理在煎盘烤饼的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他的职责是管理在煎盘烤饼的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他紧要的职任是管理盘中烤的物。
verses.textEnNiv: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with the responsibility for baking the offering bread.
verses.textEnEsv: and Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with making the flat cakes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mattithiah of the Levites, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the trusted office over the things that were baked in the pans.
verses.textEnNlt: Mattithiah, a Levite and the oldest son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread used in the offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the responsibility for the baking of cakes in pans.
verses.textEn: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with the responsibility for baking the offering bread.

verses.textZh: 他们的亲族哥辖的子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日要预备摆设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的亲族哥辖的子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日要预备摆设。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们族弟兄哥辖子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日预备摆列。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Kohathites, their fellow Levites, were in charge of preparing for every Sabbath the bread set out on the table.
verses.textEnEsv: Also some of their kinsmen of the Kohathites had charge of the showbread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of their brethren of the sons of the Kohathites were in charge of preparing the showbread for every Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: And some members of the clan of Kohath were in charge of preparing the bread to be set on the table each Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of their relatives of the sons of the Kohathites were in charge of the showbread to prepare it every Sabbath.
verses.textEn: Some of the Kohathites, their fellow Levites, were in charge of preparing for every Sabbath the bread set out on the table.

verses.textZh: 这些是歌唱的人，是利未各家族的首领，住在殿院的房间里，不作别的事，日夜只顾自己的事工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些是歌唱的人，是利未各家族的首领，住在殿院的房间里，不作别的事，日夜只顾自己的事工。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌唱的有利未人的族长，住在属殿的房屋，昼夜供职，不做别样的工。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who were musicians, heads of Levite families, stayed in the rooms of the temple and were exempt from other duties because they were responsible for the work day and night.
verses.textEnEsv: Now these, the singers, the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites, were in the chambers of the temple free from other service, for they were on duty day and night.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the singers, heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites, wholodged in the chambers, andwere free fromotherduties; for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.textEnNlt: The musicians, all prominent Levites, lived at the Temple. They were exempt from other responsibilities since they were on duty at all hours.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the chambers of the temple free of other duties; for they were engaged in their work day and night.
verses.textEn: Those who were musicians, heads of Levite families, stayed in the rooms of the temple and were exempt from other duties because they were responsible for the work day and night.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人都是利未各家族的首领，按他们的家谱都是首领；这些人都住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人都是利未各家族的首领，按他们的家谱都是首领；这些人都住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上都是利未人著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: These were heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites, according to their generations, leaders. These lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: These heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites were heads throughout their generations. They dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: All these men lived in Jerusalem. They were the heads of Levite families and were listed as prominent leaders in their genealogical records.
verses.textEnNasb: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites according to their generations, chief men who lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 住在基遍的有基遍的父亲耶利，他的妻子名叫玛迦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在基遍的有基遍的父亲耶利，他的妻子名叫玛迦。
verses.textZhCuv: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；
verses.textEnNiv: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,
verses.textEnEsv: In Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife was Maacah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, dwelt at Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeiel (the father of Gibeon) lived in the town of Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah,
verses.textEnNasb: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon, and his wife’s name was Maacah,
verses.textEn: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,

verses.textZh: 他的长子是亚伯顿，其余的是苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的长子是亚伯顿，其余的是苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
verses.textZhCuv: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
verses.textEnNiv: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.textEnEsv: and his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.textEnNkjv: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.textEnNlt: and his oldest son was named Abdon. Jeiel’s other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.textEnNasb: and his firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.textEn: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

verses.textZh: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。
verses.textEnNiv: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah and Mikloth.
verses.textEnEsv: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth;
verses.textEnNkjv: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.textEnNlt: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.textEnNasb: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.textEn: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah and Mikloth.

verses.textZh: 米基罗生示米暗。他们也和他们的亲族一同住在耶路撒冷，和他们的亲族为邻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米基罗生示米暗。他们也和他们的亲族一同住在耶路撒冷，和他们的亲族为邻。
verses.textZhCuv: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: and Mikloth was the father of Shimeam; and these also lived opposite their kinsmen in Jerusalem, with their kinsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Mikloth begot Shimeam. They also dwelt alongside their relatives in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. All these families lived near each other in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem opposite their other relatives.
verses.textEn: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 尼珥生基士，基士生扫罗，扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达和伊施．巴力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼珥生基士，基士生扫罗，扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达和伊施．巴力。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施‧巴力。
verses.textEnNiv: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.
verses.textEnEsv: Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul, Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ner begot Kish, Kish begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: Ner was the father of Kish. Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.textEnNasb: Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.textEn: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.

verses.textZh: 约拿单的儿子是米力．巴力；米力．巴力生米迦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单的儿子是米力．巴力；米力．巴力生米迦。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单的儿子是米力‧巴力 ；米力‧巴力生米迦。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal begot Micah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan was the father of Merib-baal. Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.textEn: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.

verses.textZh: 米迦的儿子是毘敦、米勒、他利亚和亚哈斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦的儿子是毘敦、米勒、他利亚和亚哈斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea and Ahaz.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.textEn: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea and Ahaz.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威和心利。心利生摩撒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威和心利。心利生摩撒；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz was the father of Jadah, Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahaz fathered Jarah, and Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahaz begot Jarah; Jarah begot Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz was the father of Jadah. Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaz fathered Jarah, Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.textEn: Ahaz was the father of Jadah, Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.

verses.textZh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是利法雅，利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨，以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是利法雅，利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨，以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚生利法雅；利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.textEnNiv: Moza was the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Moza fathered Binea, and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moza begot Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Moza was the father of Binea. Binea’s son was Rephaiah. Rephaiah’s son was Eleasah. Eleasah’s son was Azel.
verses.textEnNasb: Moza fathered Binea, and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.textEn: Moza was the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.

verses.textZh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难；这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难；这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnEsv: Azel had six sons and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Azel had six sons whose names were these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnNlt: Azel had six sons, whose names were Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEnNasb: Azel had six sons whose names were these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.textEn: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

verses.textZh: 非利士人攻打以色列人；以色列人从非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山上阵亡的人很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人攻打以色列人；以色列人从非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山上阵亡的人很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人与以色列人争战，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被杀仆倒的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them. Many were slaughtered on the slopes of Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from the Philistines but fell fatally wounded on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEn: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.

verses.textZh: 非利士人紧紧地追赶扫罗和他的儿子；非利士人杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达和麦基舒亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人紧紧地追赶扫罗和他的儿子；非利士人杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达和麦基舒亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达、麦基舒亚。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines overtook Saul and his sons, and the Philistines struck down Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons. And the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, Saul’s sons.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons, and they killed three of his sons—Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malkishua.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Philistines also overtook Saul and his sons, and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.textEn: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.

verses.textZh: 攻击扫罗的战役非常激烈；弓箭手发现了他，就把他射伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 攻击扫罗的战役非常激烈；弓箭手发现了他，就把他射伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，
verses.textEnNiv: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him.
verses.textEnEsv: The battle pressed hard against Saul, and the archers found him, and he was wounded by the archers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The battle became fierce against Saul. The archers hit him, and he was wounded by the archers.
verses.textEnNlt: The fighting grew very fierce around Saul, and the Philistine archers caught up with him and wounded him.
verses.textEnNasb: The battle became severe against Saul, and the archers found him; and he was wounded by the archers.
verses.textEn: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him.

verses.textZh: 扫罗对替他拿兵器的人说："拔出你的刀来，把我刺透，免得这些未受割礼的人来凌辱我。"但替他拿兵器的人不肯这样作，因为他非常害怕；于是扫罗拿出刀来，自己伏在刀上死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对替他拿兵器的人说："拔出你的刀来，把我刺透，免得这些未受割礼的人来凌辱我。"但替他拿兵器的人不肯这样作，因为他非常害怕；于是扫罗拿出刀来，自己伏在刀上死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说：「你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他；
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and abuse me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and mistreat me." But his armor-bearer would not, for he feared greatly. Therefore Saul took his own sword and fell upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to his armorbearer, "Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised men come and abuse me." But his armorbearer would not, for he was greatly afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword and fell on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul groaned to his armor bearer, "Take your sword and kill me before these pagan Philistines come to taunt and torture me." But his armor bearer was afraid and would not do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, "Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, otherwise these uncircumcised Philistines will come and abuse me." But his armor bearer would not, for he was very afraid. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
verses.textEn: Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and abuse me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

verses.textZh: 替他拿兵器的人看见扫罗死了，他也伏在刀上死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 替他拿兵器的人看见扫罗死了，他也伏在刀上死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died.
verses.textEnEsv: And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when his armorbearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword and died.
verses.textEnNlt: When his armor bearer realized that Saul was dead, he fell on his own sword and died.
verses.textEnNasb: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
verses.textEn: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died.

verses.textZh: 这样，扫罗和他的三个儿子，以及他的全家，都一同死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，扫罗和他的三个儿子，以及他的全家，都一同死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，并他的全家都一同死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Saul died; he and his three sons and all his house died together.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul and his three sons died there together, bringing his dynasty to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul died with his three sons, and all those of his house died together.
verses.textEn: So Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.

verses.textZh: 所有在山谷的以色列人，看见以色列军逃跑，扫罗和他的儿子都死了，他们就弃城逃跑，非利士人就来住在城中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有在山谷的以色列人，看见以色列军逃跑，扫罗和他的儿子都死了，他们就弃城逃跑，非利士人就来住在城中。
verses.textZhCuv: 住平原的以色列众人见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑，非利士人便来住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled, and the Philistines came and lived in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities and fled; then the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the Israelites in the Jezreel Valley saw that their army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. So the Philistines moved in and occupied their towns.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the people of Israel who were in the valley saw that they had fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
verses.textEn: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.

verses.textZh: 第二天，非利士人来剥那些被杀的人的衣物的时候，发现扫罗和他的儿子都倒毙在基利波山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，非利士人来剥那些被杀的人的衣物的时候，发现扫罗和他的儿子都倒毙在基利波山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他儿子仆倒在基利波山，
verses.textEnNiv: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it happened the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, when the Philistines went out to strip the dead, they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about the next day, when the Philistines came to strip those killed, that they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEn: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

verses.textZh: 他们就剥了他的衣服，拿了他的头和兵器，又派人到非利士地的各处，去向他们的偶像和人民报信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就剥了他的衣服，拿了他的头和兵器，又派人到非利士地的各处，去向他们的偶像和人民报信。
verses.textZhCuv: 就剥了他的军装，割下他的首级，打发人到 非利士地的四境报信与他们的偶像和众民，
verses.textEnNiv: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news among their idols and their people.
verses.textEnEsv: And they stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to carry the good news to their idols and to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent word throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news inthetemple of their idols and among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: So they stripped off Saul’s armor and cut off his head. Then they proclaimed the good news of Saul’s death before their idols and to the people throughout the land of Philistia.
verses.textEnNasb: So they stripped him and took his head and his armor and sent messengers around the land of the Philistines to carry the good news to their idols and to the people.
verses.textEn: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news among their idols and their people.

verses.textZh: 他们把扫罗的兵器放在他们的神庙里，把他的头挂在大衮庙中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把扫罗的兵器放在他们的神庙里，把他的头挂在大衮庙中。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将扫罗的军装放在他们神的庙里，将他的首级钉在大衮庙中。
verses.textEnNiv: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung up his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they put his armor in the temple of their gods and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they put his armor in the temple of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.textEnNlt: They placed his armor in the temple of their gods, and they fastened his head to the temple of Dagon.
verses.textEnNasb: They put his armor in the house of their gods and impaled his head in the house of Dagon.
verses.textEn: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung up his head in the temple of Dagon.

verses.textZh: 基列．雅比人听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列．雅比人听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 基列‧雅比人听见非利士人向扫罗所行的一切事，
verses.textEnNiv: When all the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnEsv: But when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnNlt: But when everyone in Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnNasb: When all Jabesh-gilead heard everything that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEn: When all the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.textZh: 所有的勇士就动身，把扫罗的尸体和他儿子的尸体收殓起来，带回雅比，把他们的骸骨埋葬在雅比的橡树下，并且禁食七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的勇士就动身，把扫罗的尸体和他儿子的尸体收殓起来，带回雅比，把他们的骸骨埋葬在雅比的橡树下，并且禁食七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身前去，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身送到雅比，将他们的尸骨葬在雅比的橡树下，就禁食七日。
verses.textEnNiv: all their valiant men went and took the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the valiant men arose and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons; and they brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: all their mighty warriors brought the bodies of Saul and his sons back to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones beneath the great tree at Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: all the valiant men got up and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh; and they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted for seven days.
verses.textEn: all their valiant men went and took the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

verses.textZh: 扫罗死了，因为他悖逆耶和华，没有听从他的话，也因为他去求问那交鬼的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗死了，因为他悖逆耶和华，没有听从他的话，也因为他去求问那交鬼的，
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，扫罗死了。因为他干犯耶和华，没有遵守耶和华的命；又因他求问交鬼的妇人，
verses.textEnNiv: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the Lord ; he did not keep the word of the Lord and even consulted a medium for guidance,
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul died for his breach of faith. He broke faith with the Lord in that he did not keep the command of the Lord , and also consulted a medium, seeking guidance.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness which he had committed against the Lord, because he did not keep the word of the Lord, and also because he consulted a medium for guidance.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul died because he was unfaithful to the Lord . He failed to obey the Lord ’s command, and he even consulted a medium
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness which he committed against the Lord, because of the word of the Lord which he did not keep; and also because he asked counsel of a medium, making inquiry of her,
verses.textEn: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the Lord ; he did not keep the word of the Lord and even consulted a medium for guidance,

verses.textZh: 没有求问耶和华，所以耶和华把他杀死了，把国位转给耶西的儿子大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有求问耶和华，所以耶和华把他杀死了，把国位转给耶西的儿子大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有求问耶和华，所以耶和华使他被杀，把国归于耶西的儿子大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: and did not inquire of the Lord . So the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
verses.textEnEsv: He did not seek guidance from the Lord . Therefore the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he did not inquire of the Lord; therefore He killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
verses.textEnNlt: instead of asking the Lord for guidance. So the Lord killed him and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
verses.textEnNasb: and did not inquire of the Lord. Therefore He killed him and turned the kingdom over to David, the son of Jesse.
verses.textEn: and did not inquire of the Lord . So the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列众人聚集到希伯仑去见大卫，说："看哪，我们原是你的骨肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列众人聚集到希伯仑去见大卫，说："看哪，我们原是你的骨肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人聚集到希伯仑见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。
verses.textEnNiv: All Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all Israel gathered together to David at Hebron and said, "Behold, we are your bone and flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, saying, "Indeed we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all Israel gathered before David at Hebron and told him, "We are your own flesh and blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all Israel gathered to David at Hebron and said, "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.textEn: All Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.

verses.textZh: 从前扫罗作王的时候，是你率领以色列人出入征战；耶和华你的神曾对你说过：‘你要牧养我的人民以色列，你要作我的人民以色列的领袖。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前扫罗作王的时候，是你率领以色列人出入征战；耶和华你的神曾对你说过：‘你要牧养我的人民以色列，你要作我的人民以色列的领袖。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前扫罗作王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华－你的神也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
verses.textEnNiv: In the past, even while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord your God said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. And the Lord your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, in time past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them in; and the Lord your God said to you, ‘You shall shepherd My people Israel, and be ruler over My people Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In the past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who really led the forces of Israel. And the Lord your God told you, ‘You will be the shepherd of my people Israel. You will be the leader of my people Israel.’"
verses.textEnNasb: In times past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who led out and brought in Israel; and the Lord your God said to you, ‘You shall shepherd My people Israel, and you shall be leader over My people Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: In the past, even while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord your God said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是以色列的众长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王，大卫就在希伯仑，在耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就按照耶和华借着撒母耳所说的话，膏立大卫作王治理以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列的众长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王，大卫就在希伯仑，在耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就按照耶和华借着撒母耳所说的话，膏立大卫作王治理以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王。大卫在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王，是照耶和华藉撒母耳所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, he made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel, as the Lord had promised through Samuel.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord . And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord. And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
verses.textEnNlt: So there at Hebron, David made a covenant before the Lord with all the elders of Israel. And they anointed him king of Israel, just as the Lord had promised through Samuel.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, in accordance with the word of the Lord through Samuel.
verses.textEn: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, he made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel, as the Lord had promised through Samuel.

verses.textZh: 大卫和以色列众人来到耶路撒冷，耶路撒冷就是耶布斯。那时，当地的居民耶布斯人住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和以色列众人来到耶路撒冷，耶路撒冷就是耶布斯。那时，当地的居民耶布斯人住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和以色列众人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那时耶布斯人住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus). The Jebusites who lived there
verses.textEnEsv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, that is, Jebus, where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (or Jebus, as it used to be called), where the Jebusites, the original inhabitants of the land, were living.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
verses.textEn: David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus). The Jebusites who lived there

verses.textZh: 耶布斯的居民对大卫说："你不能进这里来。"可是大卫占领了锡安的堡垒，锡安就是大卫城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶布斯的居民对大卫说："你不能进这里来。"可是大卫占领了锡安的堡垒，锡安就是大卫城。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶布斯人对大卫说：「你决不能进这地方。」然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
verses.textEnNiv: said to David, "You will not get in here." Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You will not come in here." Nevertheless, David took the stronghold of Zion, that is, the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You shall not come in here!" Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion (that is, the City of David).
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Jebus taunted David, saying, "You’ll never get in here!" But David captured the fortress of Zion, which is now called the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You shall not enter here." Nevertheless David took the mountain stronghold of Zion (that is, the city of David).
verses.textEn: said to David, "You will not get in here." Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.

verses.textZh: 大卫说："谁首先攻打耶布斯人，谁就必作首领和元帅。"洗鲁雅的儿子约押首先上去，就作了首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："谁首先攻打耶布斯人，谁就必作首领和元帅。"洗鲁雅的儿子约押首先上去，就作了首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「谁先攻打耶布斯人，必作首领元帅。」洗鲁雅的儿子约押先上去，就作了元帅。
verses.textEnNiv: David had said, "Whoever leads the attack on the Jebusites will become commander in chief." Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and so he received the command.
verses.textEnEsv: David said, "Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and commander." And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David said, "Whoever attacks the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain." And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and became chief.
verses.textEnNlt: David had said to his troops, "Whoever is first to attack the Jebusites will become the commander of my armies!" And Joab, the son of David’s sister Zeruiah, was first to attack, so he became the commander of David’s armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David had said, "Whoever is first to kill a Jebusite shall be chief and commander." Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief.
verses.textEn: David had said, "Whoever leads the attack on the Jebusites will become commander in chief." Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and so he received the command.

verses.textZh: 大卫住在堡垒中，因此人把那堡垒称为大卫城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫住在堡垒中，因此人把那堡垒称为大卫城。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫住在保障里，所以那保障叫作大卫城。
verses.textEnNiv: David then took up residence in the fortress, and so it was called the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And David lived in the stronghold; therefore it was called the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the City of David.
verses.textEnNlt: David made the fortress his home, and that is why it is called the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David lived in the stronghold; therefore it was called the city of David.
verses.textEn: David then took up residence in the fortress, and so it was called the City of David.

verses.textZh: 大卫又重建四周的城墙，从米罗起，以至城的周围；那城其余的部分由约押修建。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又重建四周的城墙，从米罗起，以至城的周围；那城其余的部分由约押修建。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又从米罗起，四围建筑城墙，其余的是约押修理。
verses.textEnNiv: He built up the city around it, from the terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: And he built the city all around from the Millo in complete circuit, and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built the city around it, from the Millo to the surrounding area. Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: He extended the city from the supporting terraces to the surrounding area, while Joab rebuilt the rest of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He built the city all around, from the Millo to the surrounding area; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.textEn: He built up the city around it, from the terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.

verses.textZh: 大卫日渐强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫日渐强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫日见强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: And David became more and more powerful, because the Lord Almighty was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went on and became great, and the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.textEnNlt: And David became more and more powerful, because the Lord of Heaven’s Armies was with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord of armies was with him.
verses.textEn: And David became more and more powerful, because the Lord Almighty was with him.

verses.textZh: 以下这些人是大卫众勇士的首领，就是全力帮助他得国的，又与以色列人照着耶和华对以色列人所说的话一同立他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些人是大卫众勇士的首领，就是全力帮助他得国的，又与以色列人照着耶和华对以色列人所说的话一同立他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下记录跟随大卫勇士的首领，就是奋勇帮助他得国、照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的话、与以色列人一同立他作王的。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the chiefs of David’s mighty warriors—they, together with all Israel, gave his kingship strong support to extend it over the whole land, as the Lord had promised—
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who gave him strong support in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were the heads of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the leaders of David’s mighty warriors. Together with all Israel, they decided to make David their king, just as the Lord had promised concerning Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the heads of the mighty men whom David had, who remained faithful to him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, in accordance with the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.textEn: These were the chiefs of David’s mighty warriors—they, together with all Israel, gave his kingship strong support to extend it over the whole land, as the Lord had promised—

verses.textZh: 这是大卫众勇士的数目：哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，是军官 "；《七十士译本》的一些抄本作"三 "）的首领；他挥舞矛枪，只一次就杀死了三百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是大卫众勇士的数目：哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，是军官 "；《七十士译本》的一些抄本作"三 "）的首领；他挥舞矛枪，只一次就杀死了三百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫勇士的数目记在下面：哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，他是军长的统领，一时举枪杀了三百人。
verses.textEnNiv: this is the list of David’s mighty warriors: Jashobeam, a Hakmonite, was chief of the officers ; he raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.
verses.textEnEsv: This is an account of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, was chief of the three. He wielded his spear against 300 whom he killed at one time.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam the son of a Hachmonite, chief of the captains; he had lifted up his spear against three hundred, killed byhim at one time.
verses.textEnNlt: Here is the record of David’s mightiest warriors: The first was Jashobeam the Hacmonite, who was leader of the Three—the mightiest warriors among David’s men. He once used his spear to kill 300 enemy warriors in a single battle.
verses.textEnNasb: These constitute the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he wielded his spear against three hundred whom he killed at one time.
verses.textEn: this is the list of David’s mighty warriors: Jashobeam, a Hakmonite, was chief of the officers ; he raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.

verses.textZh: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三勇士之一；
verses.textZhCnvs: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三勇士之一；
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三个勇士里的一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three mighty warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: And next to him among the three mighty men was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who wasone of the three mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Next in rank among the Three was Eleazar son of Dodai, a descendant of Ahoah.
verses.textEnNasb: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.textEn: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three mighty warriors.

verses.textZh: 他从前与大卫在巴斯．达闵，非利士人聚集在那里预备作战。那里有块长满大麦的田；众人从非利士人面前逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从前与大卫在巴斯．达闵，非利士人聚集在那里预备作战。那里有块长满大麦的田；众人从非利士人面前逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从前与大卫在巴斯‧达闵，非利士人聚集要打仗。那里有一块长满大麦的田，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑；
verses.textEnNiv: He was with David at Pas Dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place where there was a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines were gathered there for battle. There was a plot of ground full of barley, and the men fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was with David at Pasdammim. Now there the Philistines were gathered for battle, and there was a piece of ground full of barley. So the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: He was with David when the Philistines gathered for battle at Pas-dammim and attacked the Israelites in a field full of barley. The Israelite army fled,
verses.textEnNasb: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines were gathered together there to battle, and there was a plot of land full of barley; and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEn: He was with David at Pas Dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place where there was a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 他们却站在那块田中间，保护了那块田，击杀了非利士人；这样耶和华拯救了以色列人，使他们获得极大的胜利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却站在那块田中间，保护了那块田，击杀了非利士人；这样耶和华拯救了以色列人，使他们获得极大的胜利。
verses.textZhCuv: 这勇士便站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使以色列人大获全胜。
verses.textEnNiv: But they took their stand in the middle of the field. They defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.
verses.textEnEsv: But he took his stand in the midst of the plot and defended it and killed the Philistines. And the Lord saved them by a great victory.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they stationed themselves in the middle of that field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. So the Lord brought about a great victory.
verses.textEnNlt: but Eleazar and David held their ground in the middle of the field and beat back the Philistines. So the Lord saved them by giving them a great victory.
verses.textEnNasb: But they took their stand in the midst of the plot and defended it, and defeated the Philistines; and the Lord saved them with a great victory.
verses.textEn: But they took their stand in the middle of the field. They defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.

verses.textZh: 三十个首领中有三个，下到亚杜兰洞附近的盘石那里去见大卫；非利士人的军队在利乏音谷安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 三十个首领中有三个，下到亚杜兰洞附近的盘石那里去见大卫；非利士人的军队在利乏音谷安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 三十个勇士中的三个人下到磐石那里，进了亚杜兰洞见大卫；非利士的军队在利乏音谷安营。
verses.textEnNiv: Three of the thirty chiefs came down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnEsv: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David at the cave of Adullam, when the army of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNlt: Once when David was at the rock near the cave of Adullam, the Philistine army was camped in the valley of Rephaim. The Three (who were among the Thirty—an elite group among David’s fighting men) went down to meet him there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam, while the army of the Philistines was camping in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: Three of the thirty chiefs came down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.textZh: 那时大卫在山寨中，非利士人的驻军在伯利恒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时大卫在山寨中，非利士人的驻军在伯利恒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNkjv: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: David was staying in the stronghold at the time, and a Philistine detachment had occupied the town of Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: David was then in the stronghold, while the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 大卫渴望说："谁能把伯利恒城门旁边池中的水，拿来给我喝！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫渴望说："谁能把伯利恒城门旁边池中的水，拿来给我喝！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫渴想，说：「甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁井里的水打来给我喝！」
verses.textEnNiv: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said longingly, "Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is by the gate!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said with longing, "Oh, that someone would give me a drink of water from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!"
verses.textEnNlt: David remarked longingly to his men, "Oh, how I would love some of that good water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem."
verses.textEnNasb: And David had a craving and said, "Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!"
verses.textEn: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"

verses.textZh: 这三个勇士就冲过非利士人的军营，从伯利恒城门旁边的池里取水，带到大卫那里去，大卫却不肯喝，把水倾在耶和华面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这三个勇士就冲过非利士人的军营，从伯利恒城门旁边的池里取水，带到大卫那里去，大卫却不肯喝，把水倾在耶和华面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，
verses.textEnNiv: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the three mighty men broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David. But David would not drink it. He poured it out to the Lord
verses.textEnNkjv: So the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David. Nevertheless David would not drink it, but poured it out to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew some water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But David refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So the three broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water from the well of Bethlehem which was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David; however, David would not drink it, but poured it out to the Lord;
verses.textEn: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 说："在我的神面前，我绝对不可以这样作，我怎能喝这些冒生命危险的人的血呢？因为这是他们冒生命危险取回来的。"因此大卫不肯喝这水。这是三个勇士所行的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："在我的神面前，我绝对不可以这样作，我怎能喝这些冒生命危险的人的血呢？因为这是他们冒生命危险取回来的。"因此大卫不肯喝这水。这是三个勇士所行的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我的神啊，这三个人冒死去打水，这水好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝！」如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所做的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "God forbid that I should do this!" he said. "Should I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?" Because they risked their lives to bring it back, David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Far be it from me before my God that I should do this. Shall I drink the lifeblood of these men? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." Therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Far be it from me, O my God, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men whohaveput their lives injeopardy? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." Therefore he would not drink it. These things were done by the three mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: "God forbid that I should drink this!" he exclaimed. "This water is as precious as the blood of these men who risked their lives to bring it to me." So David did not drink it. These are examples of the exploits of the Three.
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "Far be it from me before my God that I would do this. Shall I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives? For they brought it at the risk of their lives." Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
verses.textEn: "God forbid that I should do this!" he said. "Should I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?" Because they risked their lives to bring it back, David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.

verses.textZh: 约押的兄弟亚比筛，是三个勇士的首领；他挥舞矛枪刺死了三百人，因此在三个勇士中赢得了名声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押的兄弟亚比筛，是三个勇士的首领；他挥舞矛枪刺死了三百人，因此在三个勇士中赢得了名声。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领；他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。
verses.textEnNiv: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the thirty. And he wielded his spear against 300 men and killed them and won a name beside the three.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of another three. He had lifted up his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name among these three.
verses.textEnNlt: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was the leader of the Thirty. He once used his spear to kill 300 enemy warriors in a single battle. It was by such feats that he became as famous as the Three.
verses.textEnNasb: As for Abshai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the thirty, and he wielded his spear against three hundred and killed them; and he had a name as well as the thirty.
verses.textEn: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

verses.textZh: 他在这三个勇士中，是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领；只是还不及前三个勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在这三个勇士中，是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领；只是还不及前三个勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领；只是不及前三个勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: He was doubly honored above the Three and became their commander, even though he was not included among them.
verses.textEnEsv: He was the most renowned of the thirty and became their commander, but he did not attain to the three.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the three he was more honored than the other two men. Therefore he became their captain. However he did not attain to the first three.
verses.textEnNlt: Abishai was the most famous of the Thirty and was their commander, though he was not one of the Three.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the three in the second rank he was the most honored, and he became their commander; however, he did not attain the reputation of the first three.
verses.textEn: He was doubly honored above the Three and became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，是甲薛族的勇士，曾有伟大的作为；他击杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的日子，下到坑中去击杀了一只狮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，是甲薛族的勇士，曾有伟大的作为；他击杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的日子，下到坑中去击杀了一只狮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事：他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的时候下坑里去杀了一个狮子，
verses.textEnNiv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.
verses.textEnEsv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a valiant man of Kabzeel, a doer of great deeds. He struck down two heroes of Moab. He also went down and struck down a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man from Kabzeel, who had done many deeds. He had killed two lion-like heroes of Moab. He also had gone down and killed a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.
verses.textEnNlt: There was also Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant warrior from Kabzeel. He did many heroic deeds, which included killing two champions of Moab. Another time, on a snowy day, he chased a lion down into a pit and killed it.
verses.textEnNasb: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a warrior of Kabzeel, mighty in deeds, struck and killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and struck and killed a lion inside a pit on a snowy day.
verses.textEn: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

verses.textZh: 他又杀死了一个身高两百多公分的埃及人。这埃及人手里拿着矛枪，好象织布机轴，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去会他，竟从那埃及人手中把矛枪夺了过来，再用他的矛枪把他杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又杀死了一个身高两百多公分的埃及人。这埃及人手里拿着矛枪，好象织布机轴，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去会他，竟从那埃及人手中把矛枪夺了过来，再用他的矛枪把他杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 又杀了一个埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手里拿着枪，枪杆粗如织布的机轴；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他刺死。
verses.textEnNiv: And he struck down an Egyptian who was five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s rod in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEnEsv: And he struck down an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits tall. The Egyptian had in his hand a spear like a weaver’s beam, but Benaiah went down to him with a staff and snatched the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of great height, five cubits tall. In the Egyptian’s hand therewas a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEnNlt: Once, armed only with a club, he killed an Egyptian warrior who was 7-1/2 feet tall and who was armed with a spear as thick as a weaver’s beam. Benaiah wrenched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with it.
verses.textEnNasb: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature five cubits tall. Now in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam, but he went down to him with a club and snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEn: And he struck down an Egyptian who was five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s rod in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.

verses.textZh: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，因此在三个勇士中赢得名声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，因此在三个勇士中赢得名声。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。
verses.textEnNiv: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada and won a name beside the three mighty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and won a name among three mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Deeds like these made Benaiah as famous as the three mightiest warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name as well as the three mighty men.
verses.textEn: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.

verses.textZh: 他比那三十个勇士更有声望，只是还不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作侍卫长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他比那三十个勇士更有声望，只是还不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作侍卫长。
verses.textZhCuv: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。
verses.textEnNiv: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
verses.textEnEsv: He was renowned among the thirty, but he did not attain to the three. And David set him over his bodyguard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed he was more honored than the thirty, but he did not attain to the first three. And David appointed him over his guard.
verses.textEnNlt: He was more honored than the other members of the Thirty, though he was not one of the Three. And David made him captain of his bodyguard.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, he was honored among the thirty, but he did not attain the reputation of the first three; and David appointed him over his bodyguard.
verses.textEn: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

verses.textZh: 军中勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑、伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难、
verses.textZhCnvs: 军中勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑、伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难、
verses.textZhCuv: 军中的勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑，伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难，
verses.textEnNiv: The mighty warriors were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,
verses.textEnEsv: The mighty men were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the mighty warriors were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.textEnNlt: David’s mighty warriors also included: Asahel, Joab’s brother; Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem;
verses.textEnNasb: Now the mighty men of the armies were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

verses.textEnNiv: These were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the warriors who helped him in battle;
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he could not move about freely because of Saul the son of Kish. And they were among the mighty men who helped him in war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag while he was still a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, helpers in the war,
verses.textEnNlt: The following men joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul son of Kish. They were among the warriors who fought beside David in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still restricted because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men who helped him in war.
verses.textEn: These were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the warriors who helped him in battle;

verses.textZh: 他们配备弓箭，能用左右两手开弓甩石射箭；他们都属便雅悯支派，是扫罗的亲族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们配备弓箭，能用左右两手开弓甩石射箭；他们都属便雅悯支派，是扫罗的亲族。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们善于拉弓，能用左右两手甩石射箭，都是便雅悯人扫罗的族弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):
verses.textEnEsv: They were bowmen and could shoot arrows and sling stones with either the right or the left hand; they were Benjaminites, Saul’s kinsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: armed with bows, using both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows with the bow. Theywere of Benjamin, Saul’s brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: All of them were expert archers, and they could shoot arrows or sling stones with their left hand as well as their right. They were all relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: They were equipped with bows, using both the right hand and the left to sling stones and shoot arrows with the bow; they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin.
verses.textEn: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):

verses.textEnNasb: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite,
verses.textEn: Ahiezer their chief and Joash the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Berakah, Jehu the Anathothite,

verses.textZh: 以及基遍人以实买雅，他在三十人中是个勇士，并且统领那三十人，又有耶利米、雅哈悉、约哈难和基得拉人约撒拔 、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及基遍人以实买雅，他在三十人中是个勇士，并且统领那三十人，又有耶利米、雅哈悉、约哈难和基得拉人约撒拔 、
verses.textZhCuv: 基遍人以实买雅（他在三十人中是勇士，管理他们），且有耶利米、雅哈悉、约哈难，和基得拉人约撒拔、
