verses.textEnNiv: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the Thirty, who was a leader of the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,
verses.textEnEsv: Ishmaiah of Gibeon, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader over the thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad of Gederah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
verses.textEnNlt: Ishmaiah from Gibeon, a famous warrior and leader among the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad from Gederah;
verses.textEnNasb: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and in charge of the thirty. Then Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,
verses.textEn: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the Thirty, who was a leader of the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,

verses.textZh: 伊利乌赛、耶利摩、比亚利雅、示玛利雅、哈律弗人示法提雅；
verses.textZhCnvs: 伊利乌赛、耶利摩、比亚利雅、示玛利雅、哈律弗人示法提雅；
verses.textZhCuv: 伊利乌赛、耶利摩、比亚利雅、示玛利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，
verses.textEnNiv: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
verses.textEnEsv: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah the Haruphite;
verses.textEnNkjv: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
verses.textEnNlt: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah from Haruph;
verses.textEnNasb: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.textEn: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

verses.textZh: 可拉人有以利加拿、耶西亚、亚萨列、约以谢和雅朔班、
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉人有以利加拿、耶西亚、亚萨列、约以谢和雅朔班、
verses.textZhCuv: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亚、亚萨列、约以谢、雅朔班，
verses.textEnNiv: Elkanah, Ishiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites;
verses.textEnEsv: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
verses.textEnNkjv: Elkanah, Jisshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
verses.textEnNlt: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;
verses.textEnNasb: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, Jashobeam, the Korahites,
verses.textEn: Elkanah, Ishiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites;

verses.textZh: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。
verses.textEnNiv: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.textEnNlt: Joelah and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
verses.textEnNasb: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.textEn: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

verses.textZh: 迦得支派中，有些人走到旷野的山寨去投奔大卫，他们都是英勇的战士，善于作战，能使用盾牌和长枪；他们的面貌好象狮子，他们敏捷得好象山上的羚羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得支派中，有些人走到旷野的山寨去投奔大卫，他们都是英勇的战士，善于作战，能使用盾牌和长枪；他们的面貌好象狮子，他们敏捷得好象山上的羚羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦得支派中有人到旷野的山寨投奔大卫，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和枪的战士。他们的面貌好像狮子，快跑如同山上的鹿。
verses.textEnNiv: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness. They were brave warriors, ready for battle and able to handle the shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles in the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: From the Gadites there went over to David at the stronghold in the wilderness mighty and experienced warriors, expert with shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were swift as gazelles upon the mountains:
verses.textEnNkjv: Some Gadites joined David at the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for battle, who could handle shield and spear, whose faces werelike the faces of lions, and were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:
verses.textEnNlt: Some brave and experienced warriors from the tribe of Gad also defected to David while he was at the stronghold in the wilderness. They were expert with both shield and spear, as fierce as lions and as swift as deer on the mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: From the Gadites valiant mighty men went over to David at the stronghold in the wilderness, men trained for war who could handle a large shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains.
verses.textEn: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness. They were brave warriors, ready for battle and able to handle the shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles in the mountains.

verses.textZh: 第一个是以薛，第二是俄巴底雅，第三是以利押，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一个是以薛，第二是俄巴底雅，第三是以利押，
verses.textZhCuv: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，
verses.textEnNiv: Ezer was the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
verses.textEnEsv: Ezer the chief, Obadiah second, Eliab third,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.textEnNlt: Ezer was their leader. Obadiah was second. Eliab was third.
verses.textEnNasb: Ezer was the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.textEn: Ezer was the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,

verses.textZh: 第四是弥施玛拿，第五是耶利米，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四是弥施玛拿，第五是耶利米，
verses.textZhCuv: 第四弥施玛拿，第五耶利米，
verses.textEnNiv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.textEnEsv: Mishmannah fourth, Jeremiah fifth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.textEnNlt: Mishmannah was fourth. Jeremiah was fifth.
verses.textEnNasb: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.textEn: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

verses.textZh: 第六是亚太，第七是以利业，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第六是亚太，第七是以利业，
verses.textZhCuv: 第六亚太，第七以利业，
verses.textEnNiv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.textEnEsv: Attai sixth, Eliel seventh,
verses.textEnNkjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.textEnNlt: Attai was sixth. Eliel was seventh.
verses.textEnNasb: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.textEn: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

verses.textZh: 第八是约哈难，第九是以利萨巴，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八是约哈难，第九是以利萨巴，
verses.textZhCuv: 第八约哈难，第九以利萨巴，
verses.textEnNiv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.textEnEsv: Johanan eighth, Elzabad ninth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.textEnNlt: Johanan was eighth. Elzabad was ninth.
verses.textEnNasb: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.textEn: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

verses.textZh: 第十是耶利米，第十一是末巴奈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第十是耶利米，第十一是末巴奈。
verses.textZhCuv: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah the tenth and Makbannai the eleventh.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah tenth, Machbannai eleventh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah was tenth. Macbannai was eleventh.
verses.textEnNasb: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai, the eleventh.
verses.textEn: Jeremiah the tenth and Makbannai the eleventh.

verses.textZh: 这些都是迦得支派中的军长，最小的一个能抵挡一百人，最大的一个能抵挡一千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些都是迦得支派中的军长，最小的一个能抵挡一百人，最大的一个能抵挡一千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是迦得人中的军长，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。
verses.textEnNiv: These Gadites were army commanders; the least was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: These Gadites were officers of the army; the least was a match for a hundred men and the greatest for a thousand.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were from the sons of Gad, captains of the army; the least was over a hundred, and the greatest was over a thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: These warriors from Gad were army commanders. The weakest among them could take on a hundred regular troops, and the strongest could take on a thousand!
verses.textEnNasb: These men from the sons of Gad were captains of the army; the one who was least was equal to a hundred, and the greatest, to a thousand.
verses.textEn: These Gadites were army commanders; the least was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.

verses.textZh: 在正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，这些人过了河，使全平原的人都东奔西逃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，这些人过了河，使全平原的人都东奔西逃。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，他们过河，使一切住平原的人东奔西逃。
verses.textEnNiv: It was they who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight everyone living in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the men who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks, and put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the men who crossed the Jordan River during its seasonal flooding at the beginning of the year and drove out all the people living in the lowlands on both the east and west banks.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
verses.textEn: It was they who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight everyone living in the valleys, to the east and to the west.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯支派和犹大支派中也有人来到山寨投奔大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯支派和犹大支派中也有人来到山寨投奔大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有便雅悯和犹大人到山寨大卫那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the men of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to David at the stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: Others from Benjamin and Judah came to David at the stronghold.
verses.textEnNasb: Then some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
verses.textEn: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.

verses.textZh: 大卫出去迎见他们，对他们说："你们若是存着和平的心到我这里来帮助我，我就与你们结盟，但你们若是把我这无辜的人出卖给我的敌人，就愿我们列祖的神鉴察和审判。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫出去迎见他们，对他们说："你们若是存着和平的心到我这里来帮助我，我就与你们结盟，但你们若是把我这无辜的人出卖给我的敌人，就愿我们列祖的神鉴察和审判。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫出去迎接他们，对他们说：「你们若是和和平平地来帮助我，我心就与你们相契；你们若是将我这无罪的人卖在敌人手里，愿我们列祖的神察看责罚。」
verses.textEnNiv: David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace to help me, I am ready for you to join me. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free from violence, may the God of our ancestors see it and judge you."
verses.textEnEsv: David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in friendship to help me, my heart will be joined to you; but if to betray me to my adversaries, although there is no wrong in my hands, then may the God of our fathers see and rebuke you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, "If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, since thereis no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers look and bring judgment."
verses.textEnNlt: David went out to meet them and said, "If you have come in peace to help me, we are friends. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when I am innocent, then may the God of our ancestors see it and punish you."
verses.textEnNasb: David went out to meet them, and said to them, "If you come peacefully to help me, my heart shall be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers look on it and decide."
verses.textEn: David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace to help me, I am ready for you to join me. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free from violence, may the God of our ancestors see it and judge you."

verses.textZh: 当时，神的灵降在那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒身上，他就说： "大卫啊，我们是来归从你； 耶西的儿子啊，我们是来跟随你； 愿你平平安安， 愿帮助你的人也都平安， 因为你的神帮助了你。" 于是大卫收留了他们，立他们作军长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，神的灵降在那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒身上，他就说： "大卫啊，我们是来归从你； 耶西的儿子啊，我们是来跟随你； 愿你平平安安， 愿帮助你的人也都平安， 因为你的神帮助了你。" 于是大卫收留了他们，立他们作军长。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时神的灵感动那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒，他就说： 大卫啊，我们是归于你的！ 耶西的儿子啊，我们是帮助你的！ 愿你平平安安， 愿帮助你的也都平安！ 因为你的神帮助你。 大卫就收留他们，立他们作军长。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty, and he said: "We are yours, David! We are with you, son of Jesse! Success, success to you, and success to those who help you, for your God will help you." So David received them and made them leaders of his raiding bands.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Spirit clothed Amasai, chief of the thirty, and he said, "We are yours, O David, and with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers! For your God helps you." Then David received them and made them officers of his troops.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, chief of the captains, andhesaid: "Weare yours, O David; We are on your side, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, And peace to your helpers! For your God helps you." So David received them, and made them captains of the troop.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the leader of the Thirty, and he said, "We are yours, David! We are on your side, son of Jesse. Peace and prosperity be with you, and success to all who help you, for your God is the one who helps you." So David let them join him, and he made them officers over his troops.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Spirit covered Amasai like clothing, the chief of the thirty; and he said, "We are yours, David, And are with you, son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, And peace to him who helps you; Indeed, your God helps you!" Then David received them and made them captains of the troops.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty, and he said: "We are yours, David! We are with you, son of Jesse! Success, success to you, and success to those who help you, for your God will help you." So David received them and made them leaders of his raiding bands.

verses.textZh: 大卫从前与非利士人一起，要去攻击扫罗的时候，有些玛拿西支派的人投奔大卫；但他们没有帮助非利士人，因为非利士人的领袖商议后把他遣回，说："恐怕大卫带着我们的首级归向他的主人扫罗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从前与非利士人一起，要去攻击扫罗的时候，有些玛拿西支派的人投奔大卫；但他们没有帮助非利士人，因为非利士人的领袖商议后把他遣回，说："恐怕大卫带着我们的首级归向他的主人扫罗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫从前与非利士人同去，要与扫罗争战，有些玛拿西人来投奔大卫，他们却没有帮助非利士人；因为非利士人的首领商议，打发他们回去，说：「恐怕大卫拿我们的首级，归降他的主人扫罗。」
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the tribe of Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (He and his men did not help the Philistines because, after consultation, their rulers sent him away. They said, "It will cost us our heads if he deserts to his master Saul.")
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the men of Manasseh deserted to David when he came with the Philistines for the battle against Saul. (Yet he did not help them, for the rulers of the Philistines took counsel and sent him away, saying, "At peril to our heads he will desert to his master Saul.")
verses.textEnNkjv: And some from Manasseh defected to David when he was going with the Philistines to battle against Saul; but they did not help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away by agreement, saying, "He may defect to his master Saul andendanger our heads."
verses.textEnNlt: Some men from Manasseh defected from the Israelite army and joined David when he set out with the Philistines to fight against Saul. But as it turned out, the Philistine rulers refused to let David and his men go with them. After much discussion, they sent them back, for they said, "It will cost us our heads if David switches loyalties to Saul and turns against us."
verses.textEnNasb: From Manasseh some also defected to David when he was about to go to battle with the Philistines against Saul. But they did not help them, because the governors of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, "At the cost of our heads he might defect to his master Saul."
verses.textEn: Some of the tribe of Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (He and his men did not help the Philistines because, after consultation, their rulers sent him away. They said, "It will cost us our heads if he deserts to his master Saul.")

verses.textZh: 大卫回到洗革拉的时候，玛拿西支派的押拿、约撒拔、耶叠、米迦勒、约撒拔、以利户、洗勒太来投奔他，他们都是玛拿西支派中的千夫长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回到洗革拉的时候，玛拿西支派的押拿、约撒拔、耶叠、米迦勒、约撒拔、以利户、洗勒太来投奔他，他们都是玛拿西支派中的千夫长。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫往洗革拉去的时候，有玛拿西人的千夫长押拿、约撒拔、耶叠、米迦勒、约撒拔、以利户、洗勒太都来投奔他。
verses.textEnNiv: When David went to Ziklag, these were the men of Manasseh who defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: As he went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh deserted to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he went to Ziklag, those of Manasseh who defected to him were Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of the thousands who were from Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: Here is a list of the men from Manasseh who defected to David as he was returning to Ziklag: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. Each commanded 1,000 troops from the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: As he was going to Ziklag, men from Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who belonged to Manasseh.
verses.textEn: When David went to Ziklag, these were the men of Manasseh who defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 他们帮助大卫，与他一同攻击贼匪；他们全是英勇的战士，是军队的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们帮助大卫，与他一同攻击贼匪；他们全是英勇的战士，是军队的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人帮助大卫攻击群贼；他们都是大能的勇士，且作军长。
verses.textEnNiv: They helped David against raiding bands, for all of them were brave warriors, and they were commanders in his army.
verses.textEnEsv: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were commanders in the army.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they helped David against the bands ofraiders, for they were all mighty men of valor, and they were captains in the army.
verses.textEnNlt: They helped David chase down bands of raiders, for they were all brave and able warriors who became commanders in his army.
verses.textEnNasb: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all valiant mighty men, and were captains in the army.
verses.textEn: They helped David against raiding bands, for all of them were brave warriors, and they were commanders in his army.

verses.textZh: 那时，天天都有人投奔大卫，要帮助他，以致成了一支大军，好象神的军兵一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，天天都有人投奔大卫，要帮助他，以致成了一支大军，好象神的军兵一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时天天有人来帮助大卫，以致成了大军，如神的军一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Day after day men came to help David, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like an army of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For at that time they came to David day by day to help him, until itwas a great army, like the army of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Day after day more men joined David until he had a great army, like the army of God.
verses.textEnNasb: For day by day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army like the army of God.
verses.textEn: Day after day men came to help David, until he had a great army, like the army of God.

verses.textZh: 预备作战的首领来到希伯仑见大卫，要照着耶和华的命令把扫罗的国位转归大卫，他们的数目如下：
verses.textZhCnvs: 预备作战的首领来到希伯仑见大卫，要照着耶和华的命令把扫罗的国位转归大卫，他们的数目如下：
verses.textZhCuv: 预备打仗的兵来到希伯仑见大卫，要照着耶和华的话将扫罗的国位归与大卫。他们的数目如下：
verses.textEnNiv: These are the numbers of the men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, as the Lord had said:
verses.textEnEsv: These are the numbers of the divisions of the armed troops who came to David in Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him, according to the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were the numbers of the divisions thatwere equipped for war, and came to David at Hebron to turn over the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the numbers of armed warriors who joined David at Hebron. They were all eager to see David become king instead of Saul, just as the Lord had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the numbers of the divisions equipped for war, who came to David at Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: These are the numbers of the men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, as the Lord had said:

verses.textZh: 犹大支派的子孙拿盾牌和长枪的，共有六千八百人，都预备好作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大支派的子孙拿盾牌和长枪的，共有六千八百人，都预备好作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大支派，拿盾牌和枪预备打仗的有六千八百人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Judah, carrying shield and spear—6,800 armed for battle;
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Judah bearing shield and spear were 6,800 armed troops.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Judah bearing shield and spear, six thousand eight hundred armed for war;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Judah, there were 6,800 warriors armed with shields and spears.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Judah who carried shield and spear numbered 6,800, equipped for war.
verses.textEn: from Judah, carrying shield and spear—6,800 armed for battle;

verses.textZh: 西缅支派的子孙能作战的英勇战士，共有七千一百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西缅支派的子孙能作战的英勇战士，共有七千一百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 西缅支派，能上阵大能的勇士有七千一百人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Simeon, warriors ready for battle—7,100;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Simeonites, mighty men of valor for war, 7,100.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valor fit for war, seven thousand one hundred;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Simeon, there were 7,100 brave warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Simeon, valiant mighty men of war, 7,100.
verses.textEn: from Simeon, warriors ready for battle—7,100;

verses.textZh: 利未支派的子孙中，共有四千六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未支派的子孙中，共有四千六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未支派有四千六百人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Levi—4,600,
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Levites 4,600.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Levi four thousand six hundred;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Levi, there were 4,600 warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Levi, 4,600.
verses.textEn: from Levi—4,600,

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大是亚伦家的领袖，跟随他的，共有三千七百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大是亚伦家的领袖，跟随他的，共有三千七百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大是亚伦家的首领，跟从他的有三千七百人。
verses.textEnNiv: including Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
verses.textEnEsv: The prince Jehoiada, of the house of Aaron, and with him 3,700.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoiada, the leader of the Aaronites, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
verses.textEnNlt: This included Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, who had 3,700 under his command.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jehoiada was the leader of the house of Aaron, and with him were 3,700,
verses.textEn: including Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, with 3,700 men,

verses.textZh: 还有一个年轻的英勇战士撒督和他家族的二十二个领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有一个年轻的英勇战士撒督和他家族的二十二个领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有少年大能的勇士撒督，同着他的有族长二十二人。
verses.textEnNiv: and Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 officers from his family;
verses.textEnEsv: Zadok, a young man mighty in valor, and twenty-two commanders from his own fathers’ house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zadok, a young man, a valiant warrior, and from his father’s house twenty-two captains;
verses.textEnNlt: This also included Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 members of his family who were all officers.
verses.textEnNasb: also Zadok, a young valiant mighty man, and from his father’s house, twenty-two captains.
verses.textEn: and Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 officers from his family;

verses.textZh: 便雅悯支派的子孙中，扫罗的亲族也有三千人，直到现在他们多半支持扫罗家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯支派的子孙中，扫罗的亲族也有三千人，直到现在他们多半支持扫罗家。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯支派，扫罗的族弟兄也有三千人，他们向来大半归顺扫罗家。
verses.textEnNiv: from Benjamin, Saul’s tribe—3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to Saul’s house until then;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Benjaminites, the kinsmen of Saul, 3,000, of whom the majority had to that point kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Benjamin, relatives of Saul, three thousand (until then the greatest part of them had remained loyal to the house of Saul);
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives, there were 3,000 warriors. Most of the men from Benjamin had remained loyal to Saul until this time.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Benjamin, Saul’s kinsmen, three thousand; for until now the majority of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
verses.textEn: from Benjamin, Saul’s tribe—3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to Saul’s house until then;

verses.textZh: 以法莲支派的子孙中，在自己家族中有名声的英勇的战士，共有二万零八百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲支派的子孙中，在自己家族中有名声的英勇的战士，共有二万零八百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲支派大能的勇士，在本族著名的有二万零八百人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Ephraim, brave warriors, famous in their own clans—20,800;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Ephraimites 20,800, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men throughout their father’s house;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Ephraim, there were 20,800 brave warriors, each highly respected in his own clan.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Ephraim 20,800, valiant mighty men, famous men in their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: from Ephraim, brave warriors, famous in their own clans—20,800;

verses.textZh: 玛拿西半个支派中有记名的，共一万八千人，都来拥立大卫为王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西半个支派中有记名的，共一万八千人，都来拥立大卫为王。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西半支派，册上有名的共一万八千人，都来立大卫作王。
verses.textEnNiv: from half the tribe of Manasseh, designated by name to come and make David king—18,000;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh 18,000, who were expressly named to come and make David king.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king;
verses.textEnNlt: From the half-tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan, 18,000 men were designated by name to help David become king.
verses.textEnNasb: From the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king.
verses.textEn: from half the tribe of Manasseh, designated by name to come and make David king—18,000;

verses.textZh: 以萨迦支派的子孙中，通晓时势和知道以色列当怎样行的，共有二百个首领；他们所有的亲族都听从他们的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦支派的子孙中，通晓时势和知道以色列当怎样行的，共有二百个首领；他们所有的亲族都听从他们的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦支派，有二百族长都通达时务，知道以色列人所当行的；他们族弟兄都听从他们的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: from Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do—200 chiefs, with all their relatives under their command;
verses.textEnEsv: Of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, 200 chiefs, and all their kinsmen under their command.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Issachar who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their chiefs were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their command;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Issachar, there were 200 leaders of the tribe with their relatives. All these men understood the signs of the times and knew the best course for Israel to take.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sons of Issachar, men who understood the times, with knowledge of what Israel should do, their chiefs were two hundred; and all their kinsmen were at their command.
verses.textEn: from Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do—200 chiefs, with all their relatives under their command;

verses.textZh: 西布伦支派的子孙中，能出去作战、可以使用各种兵器，行军整齐、不生二心的，共有五万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布伦支派的子孙中，能出去作战、可以使用各种兵器，行军整齐、不生二心的，共有五万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 西布伦支派，能上阵用各样兵器打仗、行伍整齐、不生二心的有五万人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Zebulun, experienced soldiers prepared for battle with every type of weapon, to help David with undivided loyalty—50,000;
verses.textEnEsv: Of Zebulun 50,000 seasoned troops, equipped for battle with all the weapons of war, to help David with singleness of purpose.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Zebulun there were fifty thousand who went out to battle, expert in war with all weapons of war, stouthearted men who could keep ranks;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Zebulun, there were 50,000 skilled warriors. They were fully armed and prepared for battle and completely loyal to David.
verses.textEnNasb: From Zebulun, there were fifty thousand who went out in the army, who could draw up in battle formation with all kinds of weapons of war and helped David with an undivided heart.
verses.textEn: from Zebulun, experienced soldiers prepared for battle with every type of weapon, to help David with undivided loyalty—50,000;

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利支派的子孙中，有一千个领袖；跟随他们拿着盾牌和矛枪的，共有三万七千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利支派的子孙中，有一千个领袖；跟随他们拿着盾牌和矛枪的，共有三万七千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弗他利支派，有一千军长；跟从他们、拿盾牌和枪的有三万七千人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Naphtali—1,000 officers, together with 37,000 men carrying shields and spears;
verses.textEnEsv: Of Naphtali 1,000 commanders with whom were 37,000 men armed with shield and spear.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Naphtali one thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Naphtali, there were 1,000 officers and 37,000 warriors armed with shields and spears.
verses.textEnNasb: From Naphtali there were a thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear.
verses.textEn: from Naphtali—1,000 officers, together with 37,000 men carrying shields and spears;

verses.textZh: 但支派的子孙中能作战的，共有二万八千六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但支派的子孙中能作战的，共有二万八千六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 但支派，能摆阵的有二万八千六百人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Dan, ready for battle—28,600;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Danites 28,600 men equipped for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the Danites who could keep battle formation, twenty-eight thousand six hundred;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Dan, there were 28,600 warriors, all prepared for battle.
verses.textEnNasb: From the Danites who could draw up in battle formation, there were 28,600.
verses.textEn: from Dan, ready for battle—28,600;

verses.textZh: 亚设支派的子孙中，能出去上阵作战的，共有四万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚设支派的子孙中，能出去上阵作战的，共有四万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚设支派，能上阵打仗的有四万人。
verses.textEnNiv: from Asher, experienced soldiers prepared for battle—40,000;
verses.textEnEsv: Of Asher 40,000 seasoned troops ready for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Asher, those who could go out to war, able to keep battle formation, forty thousand;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Asher, there were 40,000 trained warriors, all prepared for battle.
verses.textEnNasb: From Asher there were forty thousand who went out in the army to draw up in battle formation.
verses.textEn: from Asher, experienced soldiers prepared for battle—40,000;

verses.textZh: 在约旦河东岸，流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派的人中，能拿各种兵器作战的，共有十二万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约旦河东岸，流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派的人中，能拿各种兵器作战的，共有十二万。
verses.textZhCuv: 约旦河东的吕便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派，拿着各样兵器打仗的有十二万人。
verses.textEnNiv: and from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every type of weapon—120,000.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Reubenites and Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh from beyond the Jordan, 120,000 men armed with all the weapons of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, from the other side of the Jordan, one hundred and twenty thousand armed for battle with every kind of weapon of war.
verses.textEnNlt: From the east side of the Jordan River—where the tribes of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh lived—there were 120,000 troops armed with every kind of weapon.
verses.textEnNasb: From the other side of the Jordan, from the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, there were 120,000 with all kinds of weapons of war for the battle.
verses.textEn: and from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every type of weapon—120,000.

verses.textZh: 以上这些战士，行军齐整，一心一意来到希伯仑，要立大卫作以色列王；其余的以色列人也都一心一意要立大卫为王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些战士，行军齐整，一心一意来到希伯仑，要立大卫作以色列王；其余的以色列人也都一心一意要立大卫为王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上都是能守行伍的战士，他们都诚心来到希伯仑，要立大卫作以色列的王。以色列其余的人也都一心要立大卫作王。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were fighting men who volunteered to serve in the ranks. They came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. All the rest of the Israelites were also of one mind to make David king.
verses.textEnEsv: All these, men of war, arrayed in battle order, came to Hebron with a whole heart to make David king over all Israel. Likewise, all the rest of Israel were of a single mind to make David king.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these men of war, who could keep ranks, came to Hebron with a loyal heart, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel were of one mind to make David king.
verses.textEnNlt: All these men came in battle array to Hebron with the single purpose of making David the king over all Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel agreed that David should be their king.
verses.textEnNasb: All of these, being men of war who helped in battle formation, came to Hebron with a perfect heart to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel also were of one mind to make David king.
verses.textEn: All these were fighting men who volunteered to serve in the ranks. They came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. All the rest of the Israelites were also of one mind to make David king.

verses.textZh: 他们在那里三天，与大卫在一起吃喝，因为他们的亲族给他们预备好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那里三天，与大卫在一起吃喝，因为他们的亲族给他们预备好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在那里三日，与大卫一同吃喝，因为他们的族弟兄给他们预备了。
verses.textEnNiv: The men spent three days there with David, eating and drinking, for their families had supplied provisions for them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were there with David for three days, eating and drinking, for their brothers had made preparation for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.textEnNlt: They feasted and drank with David for three days, for preparations had been made by their relatives for their arrival.
verses.textEnNasb: They were there with David for three days, eating and drinking, for their kinsmen had prepared for them.
verses.textEn: The men spent three days there with David, eating and drinking, for their families had supplied provisions for them.

verses.textZh: 在他们附近的人，甚至以萨迦、西布伦和拿弗他利支派的人，都用驴、骆驼、骡子和牛，给他们带来了很多食物：面饼、无花果饼、葡萄饼干、酒、油和许多牛羊，以色列全境就充满欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们附近的人，甚至以萨迦、西布伦和拿弗他利支派的人，都用驴、骆驼、骡子和牛，给他们带来了很多食物：面饼、无花果饼、葡萄饼干、酒、油和许多牛羊，以色列全境就充满欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠近他们的人以及以萨迦、西布伦、拿弗他利人将许多面饼、无花果饼、干葡萄、酒、油，用驴、骆驼、骡子、牛驮来，又带了许多的牛和羊来，因为以色列人甚是欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen. There were plentiful supplies of flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, olive oil, cattle and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And also their relatives, from as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, came bringing food on donkeys and on camels and on mules and on oxen, abundant provisions of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, and wine and oil, oxen and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover those who were near to them, from as far away as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys and camels, on mules and oxen—provisions of flour and cakes of figs and cakes of raisins, wine and oil and oxen and sheep abundantly, for therewas joy in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And people from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen. Vast supplies of flour, fig cakes, clusters of raisins, wine, olive oil, cattle, sheep, and goats were brought to the celebration. There was great joy throughout the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought food on donkeys, camels, mules, and on oxen, great quantities of flour cakes, fig cakes and bunches of raisins, wine, oil, oxen, and sheep. There was joy indeed in Israel.
verses.textEn: Also, their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen. There were plentiful supplies of flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, olive oil, cattle and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫与千夫长、百夫长和所有的领袖商议。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫与千夫长、百夫长和所有的领袖商议。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫与千夫长、百夫长，就是一切首领商议。
verses.textEnNiv: David conferred with each of his officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
verses.textEnEsv: David consulted with the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.textEnNlt: David consulted with all his officials, including the generals and captains of his army.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David consulted with the captains of the thousands and the hundreds, with every leader.
verses.textEn: David conferred with each of his officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

verses.textZh: 然后大卫对以色列全体会众说："你们如果认为好，认为这事是出于耶和华我们的神，我们就差遣人走遍各地，去见留在以色列各地的兄弟，以及和他们在一起住在那些有草场的城的祭司和利未人，叫他们都聚集到我们这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后大卫对以色列全体会众说："你们如果认为好，认为这事是出于耶和华我们的神，我们就差遣人走遍各地，去见留在以色列各地的兄弟，以及和他们在一起住在那些有草场的城的祭司和利未人，叫他们都聚集到我们这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对以色列全会众说：「你们若以为美，见这事是出于耶和华－我们的神，我们就差遣人走遍以色列地，见我们未来的弟兄，又见住在有郊野之城的祭司利未人，使他们都到这里来聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: He then said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you and if it is the will of the Lord our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our people throughout the territories of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites who are with them in their towns and pasturelands, to come and join us.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you and from the Lord our God, let us send abroad to our brothers who remain in all the lands of Israel, as well as to the priests and Levites in the cities that have pasturelands, that they may be gathered to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If itseems good to you, and if it is of the Lord our God, let us send out to our brethren everywhere whoare left in all the land of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites whoare in their cities and their common-lands, that they may gather together to us;
verses.textEnNlt: Then he addressed the entire assembly of Israel as follows: "If you approve and if it is the will of the Lord our God, let us send messages to all the Israelites throughout the land, including the priests and Levites in their towns and pasturelands. Let us invite them to come and join us.
verses.textEnNasb: David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you, and if it is from the Lord our God, let us send word everywhere to our kinsmen who remain in all the land of Israel, and to the priests and Levites who are with them in their cities with pasture lands, that they meet with us;
verses.textEn: He then said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you and if it is the will of the Lord our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our people throughout the territories of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites who are with them in their towns and pasturelands, to come and join us.

verses.textZh: 我们可以把我们神的约柜运到我们这里来，因为在扫罗的日子，我们都没有在约柜前求问神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们可以把我们神的约柜运到我们这里来，因为在扫罗的日子，我们都没有在约柜前求问神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要把神的约柜运到我们这里来；因为在扫罗年间，我们没有在约柜前求问神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we did not inquire of it during the reign of Saul."
verses.textEnEsv: Then let us bring again the ark of our God to us, for we did not seek it in the days of Saul."
verses.textEnNkjv: and let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we have not inquired at it since the days of Saul."
verses.textEnNlt: It is time to bring back the Ark of our God, for we neglected it during the reign of Saul."
verses.textEnNasb: and let us bring back the ark of our God to us, since we did not seek it in the days of Saul."
verses.textEn: Let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we did not inquire of it during the reign of Saul."

verses.textZh: 全体会众都同意这样行，因为这事众人都认为对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众都同意这样行，因为这事众人都认为对。
verses.textZhCuv: 全会众都说可以如此行；这事在众民眼中都看为好。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole assembly agreed to do this, because it seemed right to all the people.
verses.textEnEsv: All the assembly agreed to do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole assembly agreed to this, for the people could see it was the right thing to do.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the assembly said that they would do so, for this was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.textEn: The whole assembly agreed to do this, because it seemed right to all the people.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫把以色列众人，从埃及的西曷河直到哈马口，都招聚来，要把神的约柜从基列．耶琳运来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫把以色列众人，从埃及的西曷河直到哈马口，都招聚来，要把神的约柜从基列．耶琳运来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，大卫将以色列人从埃及的西曷河直到哈马口都招聚了来，要从基列‧耶琳将神的约柜运来。
verses.textEnNiv: So David assembled all Israel, from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.
verses.textEnEsv: So David assembled all Israel from the Nile of Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor in Egypt to as far as the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath Jearim.
verses.textEnNlt: So David summoned all Israel, from the Shihor Brook of Egypt in the south all the way to the town of Lebo-hamath in the north, to join in bringing the Ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEnNasb: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor of Egypt to the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEn: So David assembled all Israel, from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.

verses.textZh: 大卫和以色列众人去到巴拉，就是属犹大的基列．耶琳，要从那里把神的约柜运回来；这约柜是以坐在二基路伯上面的耶和华而起名的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和以色列众人去到巴拉，就是属犹大的基列．耶琳，要从那里把神的约柜运回来；这约柜是以坐在二基路伯上面的耶和华而起名的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫率领以色列众人上到巴拉，就是属犹大的基列‧耶琳，要从那里将约柜运来。这约柜就是坐在二基路伯上耶和华神留名的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: David and all Israel went to Baalah of Judah (Kiriath Jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord , who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
verses.textEnEsv: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim that belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the name of the Lord who sits enthroned above the cherubim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kirjath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord, who dwells between the cherubim, where His name is proclaimed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David and all Israel went to Baalah of Judah (also called Kiriath-jearim) to bring back the Ark of God, which bears the name of the Lord who is enthroned between the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the Lord who is enthroned above the cherubim, where His name is called.
verses.textEn: David and all Israel went to Baalah of Judah (Kiriath Jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord , who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.

verses.textZh: 他们把神的约柜，从亚比拿达家里抬出来，放在一辆新车上，乌撒和亚希约负责赶车。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把神的约柜，从亚比拿达家里抬出来，放在一辆新车上，乌撒和亚希约负责赶车。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将神的约柜从亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上。乌撒和亚希约赶车。
verses.textEnNiv: They moved the ark of God from Abinadab’s house on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they carried the ark of God on a new cart, from the house of Abinadab, and Uzzah and Ahio were driving the cart.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they carried the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.textEnNlt: They placed the Ark of God on a new cart and brought it from Abinadab’s house. Uzzah and Ahio were guiding the cart.
verses.textEnNasb: And they carried the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.textEn: They moved the ark of God from Abinadab’s house on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding it.

verses.textZh: 大卫和以色列众人在神面前，用诗歌，以及弹琴鼓瑟、敲手鼓、响钹和吹号，尽情欢庆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和以色列众人在神面前，用诗歌，以及弹琴鼓瑟、敲手鼓、响钹和吹号，尽情欢庆。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和以色列众人在神前用琴、瑟、锣、鼓、号作乐，极力跳舞歌唱。
verses.textEnNiv: David and all the Israelites were celebrating with all their might before God, with songs and with harps, lyres, timbrels, cymbals and trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: And David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, with song and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David and all Israel played music before God with all their might, with singing, on harps, on stringed instruments, on tambourines, on cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, singing songs and playing all kinds of musical instruments—lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
verses.textEnNasb: David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and with lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
verses.textEn: David and all the Israelites were celebrating with all their might before God, with songs and with harps, lyres, timbrels, cymbals and trumpets.

verses.textZh: 他们到了基顿禾场的时候，因为牛失蹄绊倒，乌撒就伸手扶住约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了基顿禾场的时候，因为牛失蹄绊倒，乌撒就伸手扶住约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了基顿 的禾场；因为牛失前蹄 ，乌撒就伸手扶住约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to the threshing floor of Kidon, Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the ark, because the oxen stumbled.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah put out his hand to take hold of the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they arrived at the threshing floor of Nacon, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, because the oxen nearly overturned it.
verses.textEn: When they came to the threshing floor of Kidon, Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the ark, because the oxen stumbled.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华向乌撒发怒，因为乌撒伸手把约柜扶住，所以神把他击杀，他就在那里死在神面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华向乌撒发怒，因为乌撒伸手把约柜扶住，所以神把他击杀，他就在那里死在神面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向他发怒，因他伸手扶住约柜击杀他，他就死在神面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
verses.textEnEsv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he put out his hand to the ark, and he died there before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Uzza, and He struck him because he put his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord ’s anger was aroused against Uzzah, and he struck him dead because he had laid his hand on the Ark. So Uzzah died there in the presence of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But the anger of the Lord burned against Uzza, so He struck him because he had put out his hand toward the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.

verses.textZh: 大卫因耶和华忽然杀死乌撒，非常不悦，就称那地方为毘列斯．乌撒，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫因耶和华忽然杀死乌撒，非常不悦，就称那地方为毘列斯．乌撒，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫因耶和华击杀 乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯‧乌撒，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.
verses.textEnEsv: And David was angry because the Lord had broken out against Uzzah. And that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David became angry because of the Lord’s outbreak against Uzza; therefore that place is called Perez Uzza to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: David was angry because the Lord ’s anger had burst out against Uzzah. He named that place Perez-uzzah (which means "to burst out against Uzzah"), as it is still called today.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David became angry because of the Lord’s outburst against Uzza; and he called that place Perez-uzza as it is to this day.
verses.textEn: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

verses.textZh: 那天，大卫惧怕神，说："我怎可以把神的约柜运到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天，大卫惧怕神，说："我怎可以把神的约柜运到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，大卫惧怕神，说：「神的约柜怎可运到我这里来？」
verses.textEnNiv: David was afraid of God that day and asked, "How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David was afraid of God that day, and he said, "How can I bring the ark of God home to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: David was afraid of God that day, saying, "How can I bring the ark of God to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: David was now afraid of God, and he asked, "How can I ever bring the Ark of God back into my care?"
verses.textEnNasb: David was afraid of God that day, saying, "How can I bring the ark of God home to me?"
verses.textEn: David was afraid of God that day and asked, "How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?"

verses.textZh: 所以，大卫没有把约柜运到大卫城他自己那里去，却转运到迦特人俄别．以东的家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，大卫没有把约柜运到大卫城他自己那里去，却转运到迦特人俄别．以东的家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫不将约柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别‧以东的家中。
verses.textEnNiv: He did not take the ark to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
verses.textEnEsv: So David did not take the ark home into the city of David, but took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David would not move the ark with him into the City of David, but took it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
verses.textEnNlt: So David did not move the Ark into the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-edom of Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: So David did not take the ark with him to the city of David, but took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.textEn: He did not take the ark to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

verses.textZh: 神的约柜存放在俄别．以东的家里三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别．以东的家和他的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的约柜存放在俄别．以东的家里三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别．以东的家和他的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的约柜在俄别‧以东家中三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别‧以东的家和他一切所有的。
verses.textEnNiv: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house for three months, and the Lord blessed his household and everything he had.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that he had.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed-Edom and all that he had.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ark of God remained there in Obed-edom’s house for three months, and the Lord blessed the household of Obed-edom and everything he owned.
verses.textEnNasb: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months; and the Lord blessed the family of Obed-edom and all that he had.
verses.textEn: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house for three months, and the Lord blessed his household and everything he had.

verses.textZh: 推罗王希兰派使者来见大卫，给他送上香柏木、石匠和木匠，要为他建造宫殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗王希兰派使者来见大卫，给他送上香柏木、石匠和木匠，要为他建造宫殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠给大卫建造宫殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons and carpenters to build a palace for him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, also masons and carpenters to build a house for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar timber, and stonemasons and carpenters to build him a palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build a house for him.
verses.textEn: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons and carpenters to build a palace for him.

verses.textZh: 那时，大卫知道耶和华已经坚立他作王统治以色列，又为了以色列民的缘故，使他的国高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，大卫知道耶和华已经坚立他作王统治以色列，又为了以色列民的缘故，使他的国高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列，使他的国兴旺。
verses.textEnNiv: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and that his kingdom had been highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And David realized that the Lord had confirmed him as king over Israel and had greatly blessed his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And David realized that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingdom was highly exalted, for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.textEn: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and that his kingdom had been highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫在耶路撒冷又娶了多位妻子，并且生了很多儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在耶路撒冷又娶了多位妻子，并且生了很多儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: In Jerusalem David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David begot more sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David married more wives in Jerusalem, and they had more sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: In Jerusalem David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 以下这些就是他在耶路撒冷所生的孩子的名字：沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些就是他在耶路撒冷所生的孩子的名字：沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷所生的众子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the names of his children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of David’s sons who were born in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnNasb: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEn: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

verses.textZh: 益辖、以利书亚、以法列、
verses.textZhCnvs: 益辖、以利书亚、以法列、
verses.textZhCuv: 益辖、以利书亚、以法列、
verses.textEnNiv: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.textEnEsv: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.textEnNlt: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.textEnNasb: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.textEn: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

verses.textZh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textZhCuv: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textEnNiv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnEsv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNlt: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNasb: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEn: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.textZh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大和以利法列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙玛、以利雅大和以利法列。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙玛、比利雅大、以利法列。
verses.textEnNiv: Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnEsv: Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNlt: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNasb: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEn: Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.

verses.textZh: 非利士人听见了大卫受膏作王统治以色列人，就全体上来搜寻大卫；大卫听见了，就出来迎击他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人听见了大卫受膏作王统治以色列人，就全体上来搜寻大卫；大卫听见了，就出来迎击他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人听见大卫受膏作以色列众人的王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫。大卫听见，就出去迎敌。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went out to meet them.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. But David heard of it and went out against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. And David heard ofit and went out against them.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they mobilized all their forces to capture him. But David was told they were coming, so he marched out to meet them.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up in search of David; and David heard about it and went out against them.
verses.textEn: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went out to meet them.

verses.textZh: 非利士人来到，侵进了利乏音谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人来到，侵进了利乏音谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim;
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines went and made a raid on the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines arrived and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines had come and carried out a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim;

verses.textZh: 大卫求问神说："我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你把他们交在我手里吗？"耶和华对他说："你可以上去，我必把他们交在你的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫求问神说："我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你把他们交在我手里吗？"耶和华对他说："你可以上去，我必把他们交在你的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫求问神，说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将他们交在你手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: so David inquired of God: "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?" The Lord answered him, "Go, I will deliver them into your hands."
verses.textEnEsv: And David inquired of God, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you give them into my hand?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up, and I will give them into your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David inquired of God, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?" The Lord said to him, "Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: So David asked God, "Should I go out to fight the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The Lord replied, "Yes, go ahead. I will hand them over to you."
verses.textEnNasb: David inquired of God, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? And will You hand them over to me?" Then the Lord said to him, "Go up, for I will hand them over to you."
verses.textEn: so David inquired of God: "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?" The Lord answered him, "Go, I will deliver them into your hands."

verses.textZh: 非利士人上到巴力．毘拉心来，大卫在那里击败了他们。大卫说："神借着我击溃我的敌人，好象水冲破堤岸一般。"因此他们给那地方起名叫巴力．毘拉心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人上到巴力．毘拉心来，大卫在那里击败了他们。大卫说："神借着我击溃我的敌人，好象水冲破堤岸一般。"因此他们给那地方起名叫巴力．毘拉心。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人来到巴力‧毗拉心，大卫在那里杀败他们。大卫说：「神藉我的手冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般」；因此称那地方为巴力‧毗拉心。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies by my hand." So that place was called Baal Perazim.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went up to Baal-perazim, and David struck them down there. And David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand, like a bursting flood." Therefore the name of that place is called Baal-perazim.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. Then David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of water." Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and his troops went up to Baal-perazim and defeated the Philistines there. "God did it!" David exclaimed. "He used me to burst through my enemies like a raging flood!" So they named that place Baal-perazim (which means "the Lord who bursts through").
verses.textEnNasb: So they came up to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them there; and David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand, like the breakthrough of waters." Therefore they named that place Baal-perazim.
verses.textEn: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies by my hand." So that place was called Baal Perazim.

verses.textZh: 非利士人把他们的神像遗弃在那里，大卫吩咐人用火把它们烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人把他们的神像遗弃在那里，大卫吩咐人用火把它们烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人将神像撇在那里，大卫吩咐人用火焚烧了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines had abandoned their gods there, and David gave orders to burn them in the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And they left their gods there, and David gave command, and they were burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines had abandoned their gods there, so David gave orders to burn them.
verses.textEnNasb: They abandoned their gods there; so David gave the order and they were burned with fire.
verses.textEn: The Philistines had abandoned their gods there, and David gave orders to burn them in the fire.

verses.textZh: 非利士人又再入侵那山谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人又再入侵那山谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more the Philistines raided the valley;
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines once again made a raid on the valley.
verses.textEnNlt: But after a while the Philistines returned and raided the valley again.
verses.textEnNasb: The Philistines carried out yet another raid in the valley.
verses.textEn: Once more the Philistines raided the valley;

verses.textZh: 大卫又求问神，神对他说："不可在后面追赶他们，要绕过他们，从桑林对面攻打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又求问神，神对他说："不可在后面追赶他们，要绕过他们，从桑林对面攻打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又求问神。神说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。
verses.textEnNiv: so David inquired of God again, and God answered him, "Do not go directly after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.
verses.textEnEsv: And when David again inquired of God, God said to him, "You shall not go up after them; go around and come against them opposite the balsam trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "You shall not go up after them; circle around them, and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.
verses.textEnNlt: And once again David asked God what to do. "Do not attack them straight on," God replied. "Instead, circle around behind and attack them near the poplar trees.
verses.textEnNasb: David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "You shall not go up after them; circle around behind them and come at them in front of the baka-shrubs.
verses.textEn: so David inquired of God again, and God answered him, "Do not go directly after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.

verses.textZh: 你一听见桑林树梢上有脚步的声音，就要出战，因为神已经在你前面出去击杀非利士人的军队了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一听见桑林树梢上有脚步的声音，就要出战，因为神已经在你前面出去击杀非利士人的军队了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要出战，因为神已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move out to battle, because that will mean God has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."
verses.textEnEsv: And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then go out to battle, for God has gone out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, when you hear a sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you shall go out to battle, for God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: When you hear a sound like marching feet in the tops of the poplar trees, go out and attack! That will be the signal that God is moving ahead of you to strike down the Philistine army."
verses.textEnNasb: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baka-shrubs, then you shall go out to battle, for God will have gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines."
verses.textEn: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move out to battle, because that will mean God has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫照着神所吩咐他的去作，他们攻击非利士人的军队，从基遍起，一直攻打到基色。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫照着神所吩咐他的去作，他们攻击非利士人的军队，从基遍起，一直攻打到基色。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就遵着神所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的军队，从基遍直到基色。
verses.textEnNiv: So David did as God commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army, all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
verses.textEnEsv: And David did as God commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David did as God commanded him, and they drove back the army of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
verses.textEnNlt: So David did what God commanded, and they struck down the Philistine army all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
verses.textEnNasb: David did just as God had commanded him, and they defeated the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even as far as Gezer.
verses.textEn: So David did as God commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army, all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

verses.textZh: 因此大卫的名声传遍各地，耶和华使万国都惧怕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此大卫的名声传遍各地，耶和华使万国都惧怕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫的名传扬到列国，耶和华使列国都惧怕他。
verses.textEnNiv: So David’s fame spread throughout every land, and the Lord made all the nations fear him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the fame of David went out into all lands, and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the fame of David went out into all lands, and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.textEnNlt: So David’s fame spread everywhere, and the Lord caused all the nations to fear David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the fame of David spread in all the lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him on all the nations.
verses.textEn: So David’s fame spread throughout every land, and the Lord made all the nations fear him.

verses.textZh: 大卫在大卫城为自己建造宫殿，又为神的约柜预备地方，就是为它支搭帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在大卫城为自己建造宫殿，又为神的约柜预备地方，就是为它支搭帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在大卫城为自己建造宫殿，又为神的约柜预备地方，支搭帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: After David had constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
verses.textEnEsv: David built houses for himself in the city of David. And he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: David built houses for himself in the City of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.
verses.textEnNlt: David now built several buildings for himself in the City of David. He also prepared a place for the Ark of God and set up a special tent for it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David built houses for himself in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
verses.textEn: After David had constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.

verses.textZh: 那时大卫说："神的约柜，除了利未人以外，没有人可以抬，因为耶和华拣选了他们抬神的约柜，并且永远事奉他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时大卫说："神的约柜，除了利未人以外，没有人可以抬，因为耶和华拣选了他们抬神的约柜，并且永远事奉他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时大卫说：「除了利未人之外，无人可抬神的约柜；因为耶和华拣选他们抬神的约柜，且永远事奉他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said, "No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the Lord chose them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister before him forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said that no one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, for the Lord had chosen them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister to him forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "No one may carry the ark of God but the Levites, for the Lord has chosen them to carry the ark of God and to minister before Him forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he commanded, "No one except the Levites may carry the Ark of God. The Lord has chosen them to carry the Ark of the Lord and to serve him forever."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "No one is to carry the ark of God except the Levites; for the Lord chose them to carry the ark of the Lord and to serve Him forever."
verses.textEn: Then David said, "No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the Lord chose them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister before him forever."

verses.textZh: 于是，大卫把以色列人都招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜抬上来，到大卫给它预备好的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，大卫把以色列人都招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜抬上来，到大卫给它预备好的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫招聚以色列众人到耶路撒冷，要将耶和华的约柜抬到他所预备的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place he had prepared for it.
verses.textEnEsv: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David gathered all Israel together at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David summoned all Israel to Jerusalem to bring the Ark of the Lord to the place he had prepared for it.
verses.textEnNasb: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to its place which he had prepared for it.
verses.textEn: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place he had prepared for it.

verses.textZh: 大卫又聚集了亚伦的子孙和利未人：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又聚集了亚伦的子孙和利未人：
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又聚集亚伦的子孙和利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: He called together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.textEnEsv: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David assembled the children of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.textEnNlt: This is the number of the descendants of Aaron (the priests) and the Levites who were called together:
verses.textEnNasb: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.textEn: He called together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:

verses.textZh: 哥辖子孙中有作领袖的乌列和他的亲族一百二十人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖子孙中有作领袖的乌列和他的亲族一百二十人；
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖子孙中有族长乌列和他的弟兄一百二十人。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Kohath, Uriel the leader and 120 relatives;
verses.textEnEsv: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, with 120 of his brothers;
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and one hundred and twenty of his brethren;
verses.textEnNlt: From the clan of Kohath, 120, with Uriel as their leader.
verses.textEnNasb: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and 120 of his relatives;
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Kohath, Uriel the leader and 120 relatives;

verses.textZh: 米拉利子孙中有作领袖的亚帅雅和他的亲族二百二十人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利子孙中有作领袖的亚帅雅和他的亲族二百二十人；
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利子孙中有族长亚帅雅和他的弟兄二百二十人。
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Merari, Asaiah the leader and 220 relatives;
verses.textEnEsv: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, with 220 of his brothers;
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brethren;
verses.textEnNlt: From the clan of Merari, 220, with Asaiah as their leader.
verses.textEnNasb: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and 220 of his relatives;
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Merari, Asaiah the leader and 220 relatives;

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙中有作领袖的约珥和他的亲族一百三十人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的子孙中有作领袖的约珥和他的亲族一百三十人；
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺子孙中有族长约珥和他的弟兄一百三十人。
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;
verses.textEnEsv: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, with 130 of his brothers;
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brethren;
verses.textEnNlt: From the clan of Gershon, 130, with Joel as their leader.
verses.textEnNasb: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and 130 of his relatives;
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;

verses.textZh: 以利撒反的子孙中有作领袖的示玛雅和他的亲族二百人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利撒反的子孙中有作领袖的示玛雅和他的亲族二百人；
verses.textZhCuv: 以利撒反子孙中有族长示玛雅和他的弟兄二百人。
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the leader and 200 relatives;
verses.textEnEsv: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, with 200 of his brothers;
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and two hundred of his brethren;
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Elizaphan, 200, with Shemaiah as their leader.
verses.textEnNasb: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and two hundred of his relatives;
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the leader and 200 relatives;

verses.textZh: 希伯仑子孙中有作领袖的以列和他的亲族八十人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯仑子孙中有作领袖的以列和他的亲族八十人；
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯仑子孙中有族长以列和他的弟兄八十人。
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Hebron, Eliel the leader and 80 relatives;
verses.textEnEsv: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, with 80 of his brothers;
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and eighty of his brethren;
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Hebron, 80, with Eliel as their leader.
verses.textEnNasb: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and eighty of his relatives;
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Hebron, Eliel the leader and 80 relatives;

verses.textZh: 乌薛子孙中有作领袖的亚米拿达和他的亲族一百一十二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌薛子孙中有作领袖的亚米拿达和他的亲族一百一十二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌薛子孙中有族长亚米拿达和他的弟兄一百一十二人。
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.
verses.textEnEsv: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, with 112 of his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Uzziel, 112, with Amminadab as their leader.
verses.textEnNasb: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and 112 of his relatives.
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.

verses.textZh: 大卫把撒督和亚比亚他两位祭司，以及乌列、亚帅雅、约珥、示玛雅、以列和亚米拿达几位利未人，召了来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把撒督和亚比亚他两位祭司，以及乌列、亚帅雅、约珥、示玛雅、以列和亚米拿达几位利未人，召了来，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫将祭司撒督和亚比亚他，并利未人乌列、亚帅雅、约珥、示玛雅、以列、亚米拿达召来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.textEnNkjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David summoned the priests, Zadok and Abiathar, and these Levite leaders: Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David called for the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab;
verses.textEn: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab the Levites.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："你们是利未人各家族的首领，你们和你们的亲族都要自洁，好把以色列的神耶和华的约柜抬上来，到我为它预备的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："你们是利未人各家族的首领，你们和你们的亲族都要自洁，好把以色列的神耶和华的约柜抬上来，到我为它预备的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「你们是利未人的族长，你们和你们的弟兄应当自洁，好将耶和华－以色列神的约柜抬到我所预备的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "You are the heads of the Levitical families; you and your fellow Levites are to consecrate yourselves and bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites. Consecrate yourselves, you and your brothers, so that you may bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel to theplace I have prepared for it.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "You are the leaders of the Levite families. You must purify yourselves and all your fellow Levites, so you can bring the Ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
verses.textEnNasb: and he said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites; consecrate yourselves, you and your relatives, so that you may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel to the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.textEn: He said to them, "You are the heads of the Levitical families; you and your fellow Levites are to consecrate yourselves and bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.

verses.textZh: 先前没有你们，耶和华我们的神就击打我们，因为我们没有按照定例寻求他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 先前没有你们，耶和华我们的神就击打我们，因为我们没有按照定例寻求他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因你们先前没有抬这约柜，按定例求问耶和华－我们的神，所以他刑罚 我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: It was because you, the Levites, did not bring it up the first time that the Lord our God broke out in anger against us. We did not inquire of him about how to do it in the prescribed way."
verses.textEnEsv: Because you did not carry it the first time, the Lord our God broke out against us, because we did not seek him according to the rule."
verses.textEnNkjv: For because you did not doit the first time, the Lord our God broke out against us, because we did not consult Him about the proper order."
verses.textEnNlt: Because you Levites did not carry the Ark the first time, the anger of the Lord our God burst out against us. We failed to ask God how to move it properly."
verses.textEnNasb: Because you did not carry it at the first, the Lord our God made an outburst against us, since we did not seek Him according to the ordinance."
verses.textEn: It was because you, the Levites, did not bring it up the first time that the Lord our God broke out in anger against us. We did not inquire of him about how to do it in the prescribed way."

verses.textZh: 于是祭司和利未人自洁，好把以色列的神耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是祭司和利未人自洁，好把以色列的神耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是祭司利未人自洁，好将耶和华－以色列神的约柜抬上来。
verses.textEnNiv: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So the priests and the Levites purified themselves in order to bring the Ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
