verses.textEn: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 利未支派的子孙照着耶和华的话，就是摩西所吩咐的，用肩和杠来抬神的约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未支派的子孙照着耶和华的话，就是摩西所吩咐的，用肩和杠来抬神的约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未子孙就用杠，肩抬神的约柜，是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Levites carried the ark of God with the poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God on their shoulders, by its poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Levites carried the Ark of God on their shoulders with its carrying poles, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles on them, just as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And the Levites carried the ark of God with the poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫又吩咐利未支派的领袖，要指派他们的亲族负责歌唱，用琴瑟响钹各种乐器，欢欢喜喜高声歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又吩咐利未支派的领袖，要指派他们的亲族负责歌唱，用琴瑟响钹各种乐器，欢欢喜喜高声歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫吩咐利未人的族长，派他们歌唱的弟兄用琴瑟和钹作乐，欢欢喜喜地大声歌颂。
verses.textEnNiv: David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their fellow Levites as musicians to make a joyful sound with musical instruments: lyres, harps and cymbals.
verses.textEnEsv: David also commanded the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers as the singers who should play loudly on musical instruments, on harps and lyres and cymbals, to raise sounds of joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David spoke to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brethren tobe the singers accompanied by instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, by raising the voice with resounding joy.
verses.textEnNlt: David also ordered the Levite leaders to appoint a choir of Levites who were singers and musicians to sing joyful songs to the accompaniment of harps, lyres, and cymbals.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David spoke to the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their relatives as the singers, with musical instruments, harps, lyres, and cymbals, playing to raise sounds of joy.
verses.textEn: David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their fellow Levites as musicians to make a joyful sound with musical instruments: lyres, harps and cymbals.

verses.textZh: 于是利未人指派了约珥的儿子希幔和他的亲族中比利家的儿子亚萨，以及他们的亲族米拉利的子孙中古沙雅的儿子以探。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是利未人指派了约珥的儿子希幔和他的亲族中比利家的儿子亚萨，以及他们的亲族米拉利的子孙中古沙雅的儿子以探。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是利未人派约珥的儿子希幔和他弟兄中比利家的儿子亚萨，并他们族弟兄米拉利子孙里古沙雅的儿子以探。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his relatives, Asaph son of Berekiah; and from their relatives the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
verses.textEnEsv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of their brethren, the sons of Merari, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.textEnNlt: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel along with his fellow Levites: Asaph son of Berekiah, and Ethan son of Kushaiah from the clan of Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel, and from his relatives, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and from the sons of Merari their relatives, Ethan the son of Kushaiah,
verses.textEn: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his relatives, Asaph son of Berekiah; and from their relatives the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;

verses.textZh: 和他们一起的还有作第二班的，他们的亲族：撒迦利雅、便、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅，以及守门的俄别．以东和耶利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和他们一起的还有作第二班的，他们的亲族：撒迦利雅、便、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅，以及守门的俄别．以东和耶利。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次还有他们的弟兄撒迦利雅、便雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅，并守门的俄别‧以东和耶利。
verses.textEnNiv: and with them their relatives next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
verses.textEnEsv: and with them their brothers of the second order, Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
verses.textEnNkjv: and with them their brethren of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers;
verses.textEnNlt: The following men were chosen as their assistants: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers—Obed-edom and Jeiel.
verses.textEnNasb: and with them their relatives of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
verses.textEn: and with them their relatives next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

verses.textZh: 歌唱的希幔、亚萨和以探敲打铜钹，发出响亮的声音；
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌唱的希幔、亚萨和以探敲打铜钹，发出响亮的声音；
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，派歌唱的希幔、亚萨、以探敲铜钹，大发响声；
verses.textEnNiv: The musicians Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals;
verses.textEnEsv: The singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were to sound bronze cymbals;
verses.textEnNkjv: the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were to sound the cymbals of bronze;
verses.textEnNlt: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were chosen to sound the bronze cymbals.
verses.textEnNasb: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound aloud cymbals of bronze;
verses.textEn: The musicians Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals;

verses.textZh: 撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、玛西雅和比拿雅敲瑟，调用女高音；
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、玛西雅和比拿雅敲瑟，调用女高音；
verses.textZhCuv: 派撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、玛西雅、比拿雅鼓瑟，调用女音；
verses.textEnNiv: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play the lyres according to alamoth,
verses.textEnEsv: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth;
verses.textEnNkjv: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with strings according to Alamoth;
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were chosen to play the harps.
verses.textEnNasb: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with harps tuned to alamoth;
verses.textEn: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play the lyres according to alamoth,

verses.textZh: 玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅、俄别．以东、耶利和亚撒西雅弹琴领导，调用男低音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅、俄别．以东、耶利和亚撒西雅弹琴领导，调用男低音。
verses.textZhCuv: 又派玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅、俄别‧以东、耶利、亚撒西雅领首弹琴，调用第八。
verses.textEnNiv: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah were to play the harps, directing according to sheminith.
verses.textEnEsv: but Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, to direct with harps on the Sheminith;
verses.textEnNlt: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were chosen to play the lyres.
verses.textEnNasb: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, to lead with lyres tuned to the sheminith.
verses.textEn: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah were to play the harps, directing according to sheminith.

verses.textZh: 利未支派的领袖基拿尼雅专责音乐，又教人音乐，因为他精通音乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未支派的领袖基拿尼雅专责音乐，又教人音乐，因为他精通音乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人的族长基拿尼雅是歌唱人的首领，又教训人歌唱，因为他精通此事。
verses.textEnNiv: Kenaniah the head Levite was in charge of the singing; that was his responsibility because he was skillful at it.
verses.textEnEsv: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, should direct the music, for he understood it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites, was instructor inchargeof the music, because he was skillful;
verses.textEnNlt: Kenaniah, the head Levite, was chosen as the choir leader because of his skill.
verses.textEnNasb: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was in charge of the singing; he gave instruction in singing because he was skillful.
verses.textEn: Kenaniah the head Levite was in charge of the singing; that was his responsibility because he was skillful at it.

verses.textZh: 比利家、以利加拿作看守约柜的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比利家、以利加拿作看守约柜的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 比利家、以利加拿是约柜前守门的。
verses.textEnNiv: Berekiah and Elkanah were to be doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark;
verses.textEnNlt: Berekiah and Elkanah were chosen to guard the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.textEn: Berekiah and Elkanah were to be doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.textZh: 示巴尼、约沙法、拿坦业、亚玛赛、撒迦利雅、比拿亚和以利以谢几位祭司，在神的约柜前吹号；俄别．以东和耶希亚也作看守约柜的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴尼、约沙法、拿坦业、亚玛赛、撒迦利雅、比拿亚和以利以谢几位祭司，在神的约柜前吹号；俄别．以东和耶希亚也作看守约柜的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司示巴尼、约沙法、拿坦业、亚玛赛、撒迦利雅、比拿亚、以利以谢在神的约柜前吹号。俄别‧以东和耶希亚也是约柜前守门的。
verses.textEnNiv: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were to blow trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also to be doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, should blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah, doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer—all of whom were priests—were chosen to blow the trumpets as they marched in front of the Ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were chosen to guard the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah also were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.textEn: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were to blow trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also to be doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫和以色列的众长老，以及千夫长一起前去，从俄别．以东的家欢欢喜喜地把耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫和以色列的众长老，以及千夫长一起前去，从俄别．以东的家欢欢喜喜地把耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，大卫和以色列的长老，并千夫长都去从俄别‧以东的家欢欢喜喜地将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of units of a thousand went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom, with rejoicing.
verses.textEnEsv: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-edom with rejoicing.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David and the elders of Israel and the generals of the army went to the house of Obed-edom to bring the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant up to Jerusalem with a great celebration.
verses.textEnNasb: So it was David, with the elders of Israel and the captains of thousands, who went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.textEn: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of units of a thousand went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom, with rejoicing.

verses.textZh: 神帮助了那些抬耶和华约柜的利未人，他们就献上七头公牛和七只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神帮助了那些抬耶和华约柜的利未人，他们就献上七头公牛和七只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 神赐恩与抬耶和华约柜的利未人，他们就献上七只公牛，七只公羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Because God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.
verses.textEnEsv: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.textEnNlt: And because God was clearly helping the Levites as they carried the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.textEnNasb: Because God was helping the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.textEn: Because God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.

verses.textZh: 大卫和所有抬约柜的利未人，以及歌唱的人和歌唱的人的领袖基拿尼雅，都穿上细麻布的外袍；大卫另外穿上细麻布的以弗得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和所有抬约柜的利未人，以及歌唱的人和歌唱的人的领袖基拿尼雅，都穿上细麻布的外袍；大卫另外穿上细麻布的以弗得。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和抬约柜的利未人，并歌唱人的首领基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿着细麻布的外袍；大卫另外穿着细麻布的以弗得。
verses.textEnNiv: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and as were the musicians, and Kenaniah, who was in charge of the singing of the choirs. David also wore a linen ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as also were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers and Chenaniah the leader of the music of the singers. And David wore a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the music master with the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who carried the Ark, and also the singers, and Kenaniah the choir leader. David was also wearing a priestly garment.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David was clothed with a robe of fine linen with all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the leader of the singing with the singers. David also wore an ephod of linen.
verses.textEn: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and as were the musicians, and Kenaniah, who was in charge of the singing of the choirs. David also wore a linen ephod.

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列人欢呼、吹角、吹号、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，大声奏乐，把耶和华的约柜抬了上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列人欢呼、吹角、吹号、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，大声奏乐，把耶和华的约柜抬了上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以色列众人欢呼吹角、吹号、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，大发响声，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textEnNiv: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouts, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and of cymbals, and the playing of lyres and harps.
verses.textEnEsv: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, to the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, and made loud music on harps and lyres.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets and with cymbals, making music with stringed instruments and harps.
verses.textEnNlt: So all Israel brought up the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant with shouts of joy, the blowing of rams’ horns and trumpets, the crashing of cymbals, and loud playing on harps and lyres.
verses.textEnNasb: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets, with loud-sounding cymbals, with harps, and lyres.
verses.textEn: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouts, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and of cymbals, and the playing of lyres and harps.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户往下观看，看见大卫王跳跃嬉笑，心里就鄙视他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户往下观看，看见大卫王跳跃嬉笑，心里就鄙视他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。
verses.textEnNiv: As the ark of the covenant of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David dancing and celebrating, she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEnEsv: And as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the City of David, that Michal, Saul’s daughter, looked through a window and saw King David whirling and playing music; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEnNlt: But as the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant entered the City of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looked down from her window. When she saw King David skipping about and laughing with joy, she was filled with contempt for him.
verses.textEnNasb: When the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and celebrating; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEn: As the ark of the covenant of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David dancing and celebrating, she despised him in her heart.

verses.textZh: 他们把神的约柜抬了进去，安放在大卫为它所搭的会幕中间，然后在神面前献上了燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把神的约柜抬了进去，安放在大卫为它所搭的会幕中间，然后在神面前献上了燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人将神的约柜请进去，安放在大卫所搭的帐幕里，就在神面前献燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: They brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought in the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tabernacle that David had erected for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought the Ark of God and placed it inside the special tent David had prepared for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings to God.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought in the ark of God and placed it inside the tent which David had pitched for it, and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.textEn: They brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.

verses.textZh: 大卫献上了燔祭和平安祭以后，就奉耶和华的名给人民祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫献上了燔祭和平安祭以后，就奉耶和华的名给人民祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和华的名给民祝福，
verses.textEnNiv: After David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
verses.textEnNkjv: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When he had finished his sacrifices, David blessed the people in the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: After David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他又分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼、一块肉、一个葡萄饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼、一块肉、一个葡萄饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且分给以色列人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块肉，一个葡萄饼。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each Israelite man and woman.
verses.textEnEsv: and distributed to all Israel, both men and women, to each a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he distributed to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a piece ofmeat, and a cake of raisins.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gave to every man and woman in all Israel a loaf of bread, a cake of dates, and a cake of raisins.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he distributed to everyone of Israel, both men and women, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a raisin cake.
verses.textEn: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each Israelite man and woman.

verses.textZh: 大卫派了一部分利未人，在耶和华的约柜前事奉、颂扬、称谢和赞美耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫派了一部分利未人，在耶和华的约柜前事奉、颂扬、称谢和赞美耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫派几个利未人在耶和华的约柜前事奉，颂扬，称谢，赞美耶和华－以色列的神：
verses.textEnNiv: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord , to extol, thank, and praise the Lord , the God of Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: Then he appointed some of the Levites as ministers before the ark of the Lord , to invoke, to thank, and to praise the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the Lord God of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: David appointed the following Levites to lead the people in worship before the Ark of the Lord —to invoke his blessings, to give thanks, and to praise the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He appointed some of the Levites as ministers before the ark of the Lord, to celebrate and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:
verses.textEn: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord , to extol, thank, and praise the Lord , the God of Israel:

verses.textZh: 领导的人是亚萨，其次是撒迦利雅、耶利、示米拉末、耶歇、玛他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄别．以东和耶利，他们鼓瑟弹琴，亚萨敲打响钹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 领导的人是亚萨，其次是撒迦利雅、耶利、示米拉末、耶歇、玛他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄别．以东和耶利，他们鼓瑟弹琴，亚萨敲打响钹。
verses.textZhCuv: 为首的是亚萨，其次是撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、玛他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄别‧以东、耶利，鼓瑟弹琴；惟有亚萨敲钹，大发响声；
verses.textEnNiv: Asaph was the chief, and next to him in rank were Zechariah, then Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,
verses.textEnEsv: Asaph was the chief, and second to him were Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel, who were to play harps and lyres; Asaph was to sound the cymbals,
verses.textEnNkjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, and Obed-Edom: Jeiel with stringed instruments and harps, but Asaph made music with cymbals;
verses.textEnNlt: Asaph, the leader of this group, sounded the cymbals. Second to him was Zechariah, followed by Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They played the harps and lyres.
verses.textEnNasb: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel, with musical instruments, harps, and lyres; also Asaph played loud-sounding cymbals,
verses.textEn: Asaph was the chief, and next to him in rank were Zechariah, then Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,

verses.textZh: 比拿雅和雅哈悉两位祭司在神的约柜前不住地吹号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拿雅和雅哈悉两位祭司在神的约柜前不住地吹号。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在神的约柜前吹号。
verses.textEnNiv: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEnEsv: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests, Benaiah and Jahaziel, played the trumpets regularly before the Ark of God’s Covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEn: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.textZh: 那一天，大卫初次指定亚萨和他的亲族，以诗歌称谢耶和华，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，大卫初次指定亚萨和他的亲族，以诗歌称谢耶和华，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，大卫初次藉亚萨和他的弟兄以诗歌称颂耶和华，说：
verses.textEnNiv: That day David first appointed Asaph and his associates to give praise to the Lord in this manner:
verses.textEnEsv: Then on that day David first appointed that thanksgiving be sung to the Lord by Asaph and his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day David first delivered thispsalm into the hand of Asaph and his brethren, to thank the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: On that day David gave to Asaph and his fellow Levites this song of thanksgiving to the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then on that day David first assigned Asaph and his relatives to give thanks to the Lord.
verses.textEn: That day David first appointed Asaph and his associates to give praise to the Lord in this manner:

verses.textZh: "你们要称谢耶和华，呼求他的名， 在万民中宣扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要称谢耶和华，呼求他的名， 在万民中宣扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！
verses.textEnNiv: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh give thanks to the Lord ; call upon his name; make known his deeds among the peoples!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord! Call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples!
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord and proclaim his greatness. Let the whole world know what he has done.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, call upon His name; Make His deeds known among the peoples.
verses.textEn: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

verses.textZh: 要向他歌唱，向他颂扬， 述说他一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要向他歌唱，向他颂扬， 述说他一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 要向他唱诗、歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to him, sing praises to him; tell of all his wondrous works!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to him; yes, sing his praises. Tell everyone about his wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; Speak of all His wonders.
verses.textEn: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

verses.textZh: 要以他的圣名为荣， 愿寻求耶和华的人，心中喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要以他的圣名为荣， 愿寻求耶和华的人，心中喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 要以他的圣名夸耀； 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice!
verses.textEnNkjv: Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Exult in his holy name; rejoice, you who worship the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Boast in His holy name; Let the heart of those who seek the Lord be joyful.
verses.textEn: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

verses.textZh: 要寻求耶和华和他的能力， 常常寻求他的面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要寻求耶和华和他的能力， 常常寻求他的面。
verses.textZhCuv: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。
verses.textEnNiv: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.
verses.textEnEsv: Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence continually!
verses.textEnNkjv: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face evermore!
verses.textEnNlt: Search for the Lord and for his strength; continually seek him.
verses.textEnNasb: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face continually.
verses.textEn: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

verses.textZh: 他所拣选的雅各的子孙啊， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为、他的奇事和他口中的判语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所拣选的雅各的子孙啊， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为、他的奇事和他口中的判语。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember the wondrous works that he has done, his miracles and the judgments he uttered,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.textEnNlt: Remember the wonders he has performed, his miracles, and the rulings he has given,
verses.textEnNasb: Remember His wonderful deeds which He has done, His marvels and the judgments from His mouth,
verses.textEn: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

verses.textZh: 他是耶和华我们的神， 他的判语达到全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是耶和华我们的神， 他的判语达到全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是耶和华－我们的神， 全地都有他的判断。
verses.textEnNiv: you his servants, the descendants of Israel, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: O offspring of Israel his servant, children of Jacob, his chosen ones!
verses.textEnNkjv: O seed of Israel His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!
verses.textEnNlt: you children of his servant Israel, you descendants of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.textEnNasb: You descendants of Israel His servant, Sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!
verses.textEn: you his servants, the descendants of Israel, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 你们要记念他的约，直到永远； 不可忘记他吩咐的话，直到千代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要记念他的约，直到永远； 不可忘记他吩咐的话，直到千代。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代，
verses.textEnNiv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: He is the Lord our God. His justice is seen throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEn: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.textZh: 就是他与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 他向以撒所起的誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是他与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 他向以撒所起的誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。
verses.textEnNiv: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember his covenant forever, the word that he commanded, for a thousand generations,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember His covenant forever, The word which He commanded, for a thousand generations,
verses.textEnNlt: Remember his covenant forever— the commitment he made to a thousand generations.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember His covenant forever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.textEn: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,

verses.textZh: 他把这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永约，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永约，
verses.textZhCuv: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，
verses.textEnNiv: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
verses.textEnEsv: the covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to Isaac,
verses.textEnNkjv: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the covenant he made with Abraham and the oath he swore to Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac.
verses.textEn: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

verses.textZh: 说：‘我必把迦南地赐给你， 作你们的产业的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘我必把迦南地赐给你， 作你们的产业的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。
verses.textEnNiv: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
verses.textEnEsv: which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.textEnNlt: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, and to the people of Israel as a never-ending covenant:
verses.textEnNasb: He also confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.textEn: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

verses.textZh: 那时你们人丁单薄，数目很少， 又是在那地作寄居的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时你们人丁单薄，数目很少， 又是在那地作寄居的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 当时你们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的；
verses.textEnNiv: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, as your portion for an inheritance."
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,"
verses.textEnNlt: "I will give you the land of Canaan as your special possession."
verses.textEnNasb: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, As the portion of your inheritance."
verses.textEn: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

verses.textZh: 他们从这国走到那国， 从一族走到另一族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从这国走到那国， 从一族走到另一族。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。
verses.textEnNiv: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,
verses.textEnEsv: When you were few in number, of little account, and sojourners in it,
verses.textEnNkjv: When you were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.
verses.textEnNlt: He said this when you were few in number, a tiny group of strangers in Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: When they were only a few in number, Very few, and strangers in it,
verses.textEn: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

verses.textZh: 耶和华不容许任何人欺压他们， 曾为了他们的缘故责备君王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华不容许任何人欺压他们， 曾为了他们的缘故责备君王，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，
verses.textEnNiv: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
verses.textEnEsv: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they went from one nation to another, And from one kingdom to another people,
verses.textEnNlt: They wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
verses.textEnNasb: And they wandered from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people,
verses.textEn: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

verses.textZh: 说：‘不可伤害我所膏的人， 不可恶待我的先知。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘不可伤害我所膏的人， 不可恶待我的先知。’
verses.textZhCuv: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知！
verses.textEnNiv: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:
verses.textEnEsv: he allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account,
verses.textEnNkjv: He permitted no man to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet he did not let anyone oppress them. He warned kings on their behalf:
verses.textEnNasb: He allowed no one to oppress them, And He rebuked kings for their sakes, saying,
verses.textEn: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

verses.textZh: 全地都要向耶和华歌唱， 天天传扬他的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地都要向耶和华歌唱， 天天传扬他的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！ 天天传扬他的救恩，
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not touch my chosen people, and do not hurt my prophets."
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do not harm My prophets."
verses.textEn: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."

verses.textZh: 在列国中述说他的荣耀， 在万民中述说他奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在列国中述说他的荣耀， 在万民中述说他奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀， 在万民中述说他的奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord , all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to the Lord , all the earth! Tell of his salvation from day to day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the whole earth sing to the Lord ! Each day proclaim the good news that he saves.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; Proclaim good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord , all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华是伟大的，当受极大的赞美； 他当受敬畏，远在万神之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华是伟大的，当受极大的赞美； 他当受敬畏，远在万神之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美； 他在万神之上，当受敬畏。
verses.textEnNiv: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples!
verses.textEnNkjv: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: Publish his glorious deeds among the nations. Tell everyone about the amazing things he does.
verses.textEnNasb: Tell of His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all the peoples.
verses.textEn: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

verses.textZh: 万民的偶像算不得甚么， 唯独耶和华创造诸天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民的偶像算不得甚么， 唯独耶和华创造诸天。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦的神都属虚无， 惟独耶和华创造诸天。
verses.textEnNiv: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnEsv: For great is the Lord , and greatly to be praised, and he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lordis great and greatly to be praised; He is also to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Great is the Lord ! He is most worthy of praise! He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnNasb: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; He also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEn: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.textZh: 尊荣和威严在他面前， 能力和欢乐在他的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尊荣和威严在他面前， 能力和欢乐在他的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 有尊荣和威严在他面前， 有能力和喜乐在他圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: The gods of other nations are mere idols, but the Lord made the heavens!
verses.textEnNasb: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEn: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.textZh: 万族万民啊，你们要归给耶和华， 要把荣耀和能力归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万族万民啊，你们要归给耶和华， 要把荣耀和能力归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 民中的万族啊， 你们要将荣耀能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his dwelling place.
verses.textEnEsv: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Honor and majesty are before Him; Strength and gladness are in His place.
verses.textEnNlt: Honor and majesty surround him; strength and joy fill his dwelling.
verses.textEnNasb: Splendor and majesty are before Him, Strength and joy are in His place.
verses.textEn: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his dwelling place.

verses.textZh: 要把耶和华的名应得的荣耀归给他， 拿着礼物到他面前来， 要以圣洁的装饰敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把耶和华的名应得的荣耀归给他， 拿着礼物到他面前来， 要以圣洁的装饰敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 拿供物来奉到他面前； 当以圣洁的 妆饰敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe to the Lord , O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give to the Lord, O families of the peoples, Give to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnNlt: O nations of the world, recognize the Lord , recognize that the Lord is glorious and strong.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe to the Lord, you families of the peoples, Ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEn: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.textZh: 全地要在他面前战栗； 他使世界坚定，不致摇动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地要在他面前战栗； 他使世界坚定，不致摇动。
verses.textZhCuv: 全地要在他面前战抖， 世界也坚定不得动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come before him. Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come before him! Worship the Lord in the splendor of holiness;
verses.textEnNkjv: Give to the Lord the glory due His name; Bring an offering, and come before Him. Oh, worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
verses.textEnNlt: Give to the Lord the glory he deserves! Bring your offering and come into his presence. Worship the Lord in all his holy splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due His name; Bring an offering, and come before Him; Worship the Lord in holy attire.
verses.textEn: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come before him. Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

verses.textZh: 愿天欢喜，愿地欢呼， 愿人在万国中说：‘耶和华作王了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿天欢喜，愿地欢呼， 愿人在万国中说：‘耶和华作王了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐； 愿人在列邦中说： 耶和华作王了！
verses.textEnNiv: Tremble before him, all the earth! The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
verses.textEnEsv: tremble before him, all the earth; yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tremble before Him, all the earth. The world also is firmly established, It shall not be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Let all the earth tremble before him. The world stands firm and cannot be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: Tremble before Him, all the earth; Indeed, the world is firmly established, it will not be moved.
verses.textEn: Tremble before him, all the earth! The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

verses.textZh: 愿海和充满海中的都澎湃， 愿田和田中的一切都欢欣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿海和充满海中的都澎湃， 愿田和田中的一切都欢欣。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns!"
verses.textEnEsv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice, and let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; And let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns."
verses.textEnNlt: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice! Tell all the nations, "The Lord reigns!"
verses.textEnNasb: Let the heavens be joyful, and the earth rejoice; And let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns."
verses.textEn: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns!"

verses.textZh: 那时树林中的树木， 必在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来要审判全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时树林中的树木， 必在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来要审判全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来要审判全地。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the sea resound, and all that is in it; let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them!
verses.textEnEsv: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it; let the field exult, and everything in it!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the sea roar, and all its fullness; Let the field rejoice, and all that is in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the sea and everything in it shout his praise! Let the fields and their crops burst out with joy!
verses.textEnNasb: Let the sea roar, and everything it contains; Let the field rejoice, and everything that is in it.
verses.textEn: Let the sea resound, and all that is in it; let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them!

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他是良善的， 他的慈爱永远常存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他是良善的， 他的慈爱永远常存。
verses.textZhCuv: 应当称谢耶和华； 因他本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Let the trees of the forest sing, let them sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then shall the trees of the forest sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the trees of the woods shall rejoice before the Lord, For He is coming to judge the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the trees of the forest sing for joy before the Lord , for he is coming to judge the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy in the presence of the Lord; For He is coming to judge the earth.
verses.textEn: Let the trees of the forest sing, let them sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.

verses.textZh: 你们要说：‘拯救我们的神啊，求你拯救我们， 招聚我们，从万国中救我们出来， 好使我们称谢你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸耀。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要说：‘拯救我们的神啊，求你拯救我们， 招聚我们，从万国中救我们出来， 好使我们称谢你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸耀。’
verses.textZhCuv: 要说：拯救我们的神啊，求你救我们， 聚集我们，使我们脱离外邦， 我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从永远直到永远。" 全体人民都说阿们，并且赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从永远直到永远。" 全体人民都说阿们，并且赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神， 从亘古直到永远，是应当称颂的！ 众民都说：「阿们！」并且赞美耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Cry out, "Save us, God our Savior; gather us and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise."
verses.textEnEsv: Say also: "Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather and deliver us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And say, "Save us, O God of our salvation; Gather us together, and deliver us from the Gentiles, To give thanks to Your holy name, To triumph in Your praise."
verses.textEnNlt: Cry out, "Save us, O God of our salvation! Gather and rescue us from among the nations, so we can thank your holy name and rejoice and praise you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then say, "Save us, God of our salvation, And gather us and save us from the nations, To give thanks to Your holy name, And glory in Your praise."
verses.textEn: Cry out, "Save us, God our Savior; gather us and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise."

verses.textZh: 于是在那里，就是耶和华的约柜前，大卫留下亚萨和他的亲族，照着每日的本分，在约柜前不断地事奉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是在那里，就是耶和华的约柜前，大卫留下亚萨和他的亲族，照着每日的本分，在约柜前不断地事奉。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫派亚萨和他的弟兄在约柜前常常事奉耶和华，一日尽一日的职分；
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Then all the people said "Amen" and "Praise the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting!" Then all the people said, "Amen!" and praised the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! And all the people said, "Amen!" and praised the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who lives from everlasting to everlasting! And all the people shouted "Amen!" and praised the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting! Then all the people said, "Amen," and praised the Lord.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Then all the people said "Amen" and "Praise the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 又留下俄别．以东和他们的亲族六十八人，以及耶杜顿的儿子俄别．以东和何萨作守门的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又留下俄别．以东和他们的亲族六十八人，以及耶杜顿的儿子俄别．以东和何萨作守门的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又派俄别‧以东和他的弟兄六十八人，与耶杜顿的儿子俄别‧以东，并何萨作守门的；
verses.textEnNiv: David left Asaph and his associates before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister there regularly, according to each day’s requirements.
verses.textEnEsv: So David left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister regularly before the ark as each day required,
verses.textEnNkjv: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister before the ark regularly, as every day’s work required;
verses.textEnNlt: David arranged for Asaph and his fellow Levites to serve regularly before the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant, doing whatever needed to be done each day.
verses.textEnNasb: So he left Asaph and his relatives there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required,
verses.textEn: David left Asaph and his associates before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister there regularly, according to each day’s requirements.

verses.textZh: 又留下撒督祭司和他的亲族，都是作祭司的。在基遍的高地耶和华的帐幕前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又留下撒督祭司和他的亲族，都是作祭司的。在基遍的高地耶和华的帐幕前，
verses.textZhCuv: 与他们一同被派的有希幔、耶杜顿，和其余被选名字录在册上的，称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: He also left Obed-Edom and his sixty-eight associates to minister with them. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were gatekeepers.
verses.textEnEsv: and also Obed-edom and his sixty-eight brothers, while Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah were to be gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Obed-Edom with his sixty-eight brethren, including Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah, tobe gatekeepers;
verses.textEnNlt: This group included Obed-edom (son of Jeduthun), Hosah, and sixty-eight other Levites as gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNasb: and Obed-edom with his sixty-eight relatives; Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah as gatekeepers.
verses.textEn: He also left Obed-Edom and his sixty-eight associates to minister with them. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were gatekeepers.

verses.textZh: 每日早晚不住地在燔祭坛上，把燔祭献给耶和华，全是照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的律法书上所写的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每日早晚不住地在燔祭坛上，把燔祭献给耶和华，全是照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的律法书上所写的。
verses.textZhCuv: 希幔、耶杜顿同着他们吹号、敲钹，大发响声，并用别的乐器随着歌颂神。耶杜顿的子孙作守门的。
verses.textEnNiv: David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place in Gibeon
verses.textEnEsv: And he left Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon
verses.textEnNkjv: and Zadok the priest and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, David stationed Zadok the priest and his fellow priests at the Tabernacle of the Lord at the place of worship in Gibeon, where they continued to minister before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He left Zadok the priest and his relatives the priests before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place which was at Gibeon,
verses.textEn: David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place in Gibeon

verses.textZh: 和他们一起的有希幔、耶杜顿和其余被选出，有记名的人，都称谢耶和华，因为他的慈爱永远常存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和他们一起的有希幔、耶杜顿和其余被选出，有记名的人，都称谢耶和华，因为他的慈爱永远常存。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众民各归各家；大卫也回去为家眷祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: to present burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, in accordance with everything written in the Law of the Lord , which he had given Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly morning and evening, to do all that is written in the Law of the Lord that he commanded Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly morning and evening, and todo according to all that is written in the Law of the Lord which He commanded Israel;
verses.textEnNlt: They sacrificed the regular burnt offerings to the Lord each morning and evening on the altar set aside for that purpose, obeying everything written in the Law of the Lord , as he had commanded Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to everything that is written in the Law of the Lord, which He commanded Israel.
verses.textEn: to present burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, in accordance with everything written in the Law of the Lord , which he had given Israel.

verses.textZh: 希幔、耶杜顿和他们一起吹号敲钹，以及演奏各种乐器，大声歌颂神。耶杜顿的子孙负责守门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希幔、耶杜顿和他们一起吹号敲钹，以及演奏各种乐器，大声歌颂神。耶杜顿的子孙负责守门。
verses.textZhCuv: 希幔、耶杜顿和他们一起吹号敲钹，以及演奏各种乐器，大声歌颂神。耶杜顿的子孙负责守门。
verses.textEnNiv: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the Lord , "for his love endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and expressly named to give thanks to the Lord , for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were designated by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: David also appointed Heman, Jeduthun, and the others chosen by name to give thanks to the Lord , for "his faithful love endures forever."
verses.textEnNasb: With them were Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were designated by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because His kindness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the Lord , "for his love endures forever."

verses.textZh: 于是众民都回去，各人回自己的家；大卫也回去给自己的家人祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众民都回去，各人回自己的家；大卫也回去给自己的家人祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众民都回去，各人回自己的家；大卫也回去给自己的家人祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: Heman and Jeduthun were responsible for the sounding of the trumpets and cymbals and for the playing of the other instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Heman and Jeduthun had trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were appointed to the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, to sound aloud with trumpets and cymbals and the musical instruments of God. Now the sons of Jeduthun were gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNlt: They used their trumpets, cymbals, and other instruments to accompany their songs of praise to God. And the sons of Jeduthun were appointed as gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNasb: And with them were Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those who were to play them, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun for the gate.
verses.textEn: Heman and Jeduthun were responsible for the sounding of the trumpets and cymbals and for the playing of the other instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.

verses.textZh: 于是众民各自回自己的家去；大卫也回去给眷属祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the people left, each for their own home, and David returned home to bless his family.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people departed each to his house, and David went home to bless his household.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the people departed, every man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the people returned to their homes, and David turned and went home to bless his own family.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people departed, each to his house; and David returned to bless his household.
verses.textEn: Then all the people left, each for their own home, and David returned home to bless his family.
verses.textZhCn: 于是众民各自回自己的家去；大卫也回去给眷属祝福。

verses.textZh: 大卫住在自己宫中的时候，他对拿单先知说："看哪，我住在香柏木做的王宫，耶和华的约柜却在帐幕里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫住在自己宫中的时候，他对拿单先知说："看哪，我住在香柏木做的王宫，耶和华的约柜却在帐幕里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫住在自己宫中，对先知拿单说：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，耶和华的约柜反在幔子里。」
verses.textEnNiv: After David was settled in his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when David lived in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, "Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when David was dwelling in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lordis under tent curtains."
verses.textEnNlt: When David was settled in his palace, he summoned Nathan the prophet. "Look," David said, "I am living in a beautiful cedar palace, but the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant is out there under a tent!"
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when David lived in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "Look, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under tent curtains."
verses.textEn: After David was settled in his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent."

verses.textZh: 拿单对大卫说："你可以照你的心意去作，因为神与你同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单对大卫说："你可以照你的心意去作，因为神与你同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单对大卫说：「你可以照你的心意而行，因为神与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: Nathan replied to David, "Whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Nathan replied to David, "Do whatever you have in mind, for God is with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nathan said to David, "Do whatever is in your heart, for God is with you."
verses.textEn: Nathan replied to David, "Whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you."

verses.textZh: 当夜，神的话临到拿单，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 当夜，神的话临到拿单，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，神的话临到拿单，说：
verses.textEnNiv: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:
verses.textEnEsv: But that same night the word of the Lord came to Nathan,
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened that night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: But that same night God said to Nathan,
verses.textEnNasb: But it happened that same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.textEn: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:

verses.textZh: "你去对我的仆人大卫说：‘耶和华这样说：你不可建殿给我居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去对我的仆人大卫说：‘耶和华这样说：你不可建殿给我居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：『你不可建造殿宇给我居住。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: You are not the one to build me a house to dwell in.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord : It is not you who will build me a house to dwell in.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and tell My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord: "You shall not build Me a house to dwell in.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord has declared: You are not the one to build a house for me to live in.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and tell David My servant, ‘This is what the Lord says: "You shall not build a house for Me to dwell in;
verses.textEn: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: You are not the one to build me a house to dwell in.

verses.textZh: 因为自从我领以色列人上来那天起，直到今日，我都未曾住过殿宇，只是从这帐幕到那帐幕，从这帐棚到那帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为自从我领以色列人上来那天起，直到今日，我都未曾住过殿宇，只是从这帐幕到那帐幕，从这帐棚到那帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我领以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，乃从这会幕到那会幕，从这帐幕到那帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt to this day. I have moved from one tent site to another, from one dwelling place to another.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have not lived in a house since the day I brought up Israel to this day, but I have gone from tent to tent and from dwelling to dwelling.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought up Israel, even to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle toanother.
verses.textEnNlt: I have never lived in a house, from the day I brought the Israelites out of Egypt until this very day. My home has always been a tent, moving from one place to another in a Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but I have gone from tent to tent and from one dwelling place to another.
verses.textEn: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt to this day. I have moved from one tent site to another, from one dwelling place to another.

verses.textZh: 我和以色列众人，无论走到甚么地方，从没有向以色列的哪一个士师，就是我所吩咐牧养我的子民的，说：你们为甚么不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我和以色列众人，无论走到甚么地方，从没有向以色列的哪一个士师，就是我所吩咐牧养我的子民的，说：你们为甚么不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一个士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民的说：你为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their leaders whom I commanded to shepherd my people, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" ’
verses.textEnEsv: In all places where I have moved with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"’
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever I have moved about with all Israel, have I ever spoken a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar–’ " ’
verses.textEnNlt: Yet no matter where I have gone with the Israelites, I have never once complained to Israel’s leaders, the shepherds of my people. I have never asked them, "Why haven’t you built me a beautiful cedar house?"’
verses.textEnNasb: In all places where I have walked with all Israel, have I spoken a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?’ " ’
verses.textEn: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their leaders whom I commanded to shepherd my people, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" ’

verses.textZh: 现在你要对我的仆人大卫说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我把你从羊圈中选召出来，使你不再跟随羊群，使你作领袖管治我的子民以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要对我的仆人大卫说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我把你从羊圈中选召出来，使你不再跟随羊群，使你作领袖管治我的子民以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：『我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now, therefore, thus shall you say to my servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now go and say to my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has declared: I took you from tending sheep in the pasture and selected you to be the leader of my people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, therefore, this is what you shall say to My servant David: ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be leader over My people Israel.
verses.textEn: "Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.

verses.textZh: 无论你到哪里去，我总与你同在；在你面前消灭你所有的仇敌；我必使你获得名声，好象世上伟人的名声一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论你到哪里去，我总与你同在；在你面前消灭你所有的仇敌；我必使你获得名声，好象世上伟人的名声一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name like the names of the greatest men on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and I have been with you wherever you have gone and have cut off all your enemies from before you. And I will make for you a name, like the name of the great ones of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men who are on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have destroyed all your enemies before your eyes. Now I will make your name as famous as anyone who has ever lived on the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have eliminated all your enemies from you; and I will make for you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.
verses.textEn: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name like the names of the greatest men on earth.

verses.textZh: 我要为我的子民以色列人选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住在自己的地方，不再受搅扰，也不再像从前被恶徒苦害他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要为我的子民以色列人选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住在自己的地方，不再受搅扰，也不再像从前被恶徒苦害他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，
verses.textEnNiv: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning
verses.textEnEsv: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be disturbed no more. And violent men shall waste them no more, as formerly,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,
verses.textEnNlt: And I will provide a homeland for my people Israel, planting them in a secure place where they will never be disturbed. Evil nations won’t oppress them as they’ve done in the past,
verses.textEnNasb: And I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them there, so that they may live in their own place and not tremble with anxiety again; and the wicked will not make them waste away anymore as they did previously,
verses.textEn: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

verses.textZh: 好象我吩咐士师统治我的子民以色列人的日子一样。我必制伏你所有的仇敌，并且我告诉你，耶和华必为你建立家室。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好象我吩咐士师统治我的子民以色列人的日子一样。我必制伏你所有的仇敌，并且我告诉你，耶和华必为你建立家室。
verses.textZhCuv: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必治服你的一切仇敌，并且我－耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。
verses.textEnNiv: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. " ‘I declare to you that the Lord will build a house for you:
verses.textEnEsv: from the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the Lord will build you a house.
verses.textEnNkjv: since the time that I commanded judges tobe over My people Israel. Also I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I tell you that the Lord will build you a house.
verses.textEnNlt: starting from the time I appointed judges to rule my people Israel. And I will defeat all your enemies. "‘Furthermore, I declare that the Lord will build a house for you—a dynasty of kings!
verses.textEnNasb: even from the day that I commanded judges to be over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I tell you that the Lord will build a house for you.
verses.textEn: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. " ‘I declare to you that the Lord will build a house for you:

verses.textZh: 你的寿数满足，归你列祖那里的时候，我必兴起你的后裔接替你，他是你的众子中的一位；我必坚立他的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的寿数满足，归你列祖那里的时候，我必兴起你的后裔接替你，他是你的众子中的一位；我必坚立他的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 你寿数满足归你列祖的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位，我也必坚定他的国。
verses.textEnNiv: When your days are over and you go to be with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: When your days are fulfilled to walk with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled, when you must go tobe with your fathers, that I will set up your seed after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: For when you die and join your ancestors, I will raise up one of your descendants, one of your sons, and I will make his kingdom strong.
verses.textEnNasb: When your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, then I will set up one of your descendants after you, who will be from your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEn: When your days are over and you go to be with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.textZh: 他要为我建造殿宇，我必坚立他的王位，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要为我建造殿宇，我必坚立他的王位，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必为我建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the one who will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.textEnNlt: He is the one who will build a house—a temple—for me. And I will secure his throne forever.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall build for Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.textEn: He is the one who will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.

verses.textZh: 我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子；我的慈爱必不离开他，像离开在你以前的那位一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子；我的慈爱必不离开他，像离开在你以前的那位一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；并不使我的慈爱离开他，像离开在你以前的扫罗一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my love away from him, as I took it away from your predecessor.
verses.textEnEsv: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son. I will not take my steadfast love from him, as I took it from him who was before you,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son; and I will not take My mercy away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my favor from him as I took it from the one who ruled before you.
verses.textEnNasb: I will be his father and he shall be My son; and I will not take My favor away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.
verses.textEn: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my love away from him, as I took it away from your predecessor.

verses.textZh: 我却要把他坚立在我的家里和我的国里，直到永远；他的王位必永远坚立。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却要把他坚立在我的家里和我的国里，直到永远；他的王位必永远坚立。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要将他永远坚立在我家里和我国里；他的国位也必坚定，直到永远。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will set him over my house and my kingdom forever; his throne will be established forever.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but I will confirm him in my house and in my kingdom forever, and his throne shall be established forever.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will establish him in My house and in My kingdom forever; and his throne shall be established forever." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will confirm him as king over my house and my kingdom for all time, and his throne will be secure forever.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But I will settle him in My house and in My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will set him over my house and my kingdom forever; his throne will be established forever.’ "

verses.textZh: 拿单就按着这一切话和他所见的一切，告诉了大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单就按着这一切话和他所见的一切，告诉了大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示告诉大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
verses.textEnEsv: In accordance with all these words, and in accordance with all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.textEnNlt: So Nathan went back to David and told him everything the Lord had said in this vision.
verses.textEnNasb: According to all these words and according to all of this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.textEn: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说："耶和华神啊，我是甚么人？我的家算甚么，你竟带领我到这个地步？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说："耶和华神啊，我是甚么人？我的家算甚么，你竟带领我到这个地步？
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：「耶和华神啊，我是谁，我的家算什么，你竟使我到这地步呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
verses.textEnEsv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord and said, "Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord; and he said: "Who am I, O Lord God? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
verses.textEnNlt: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord and prayed, "Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
verses.textEnNasb: Then King David came in and sat before the Lord, and said, "Who am I, Lord God, and what is my house that You have brought me this far?
verses.textEn: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

verses.textZh: 神啊，这在你眼中看为小事，你对你仆人的家的未来发出应许！耶和华神啊，你看我好象一个高贵的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊，这在你眼中看为小事，你对你仆人的家的未来发出应许！耶和华神啊，你看我好象一个高贵的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。耶和华神啊，你看顾我好像看顾高贵的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And as if this were not enough in your sight, my God, you have spoken about the future of the house of your servant. You, Lord God, have looked on me as though I were the most exalted of men.
verses.textEnEsv: And this was a small thing in your eyes, O God. You have also spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have shown me future generations, O Lord God!
verses.textEnNkjv: And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O God; and You have also spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, O Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, O God, in addition to everything else, you speak of giving your servant a lasting dynasty! You speak as though I were someone very great, O Lord God!
verses.textEnNasb: This was a small thing in Your eyes, God; but You have spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have viewed me according to the standard of a person of high degree, Lord God.
verses.textEn: And as if this were not enough in your sight, my God, you have spoken about the future of the house of your servant. You, Lord God, have looked on me as though I were the most exalted of men.

verses.textZh: 你把荣耀加在你仆人身上，我还有甚么话可以对你说呢？你认识你的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把荣耀加在你仆人身上，我还有甚么话可以对你说呢？你认识你的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你加于仆人的尊荣，我还有何言可说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: "What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant,
verses.textEnEsv: And what more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: What more can David say to You for the honor of Your servant? For You know Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: "What more can I say to you about the way you have honored me? You know what your servant is really like.
verses.textEnNasb: What more can David still say to You concerning the honor bestowed on Your servant? For You know Your servant.
verses.textEn: "What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant,

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，为了你仆人的缘故，也是按着你的心意，你行了这一切大事，为要使人知道这一切大事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，为了你仆人的缘故，也是按着你的心意，你行了这一切大事，为要使人知道这一切大事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你行了这大事，并且显明出来，是因你仆人的缘故，也是照你的心意。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord . For the sake of your servant and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made known all these great promises.
verses.textEnEsv: For your servant’s sake, O Lord , and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, for Your servant’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.textEnNlt: For the sake of your servant, O Lord , and according to your will, you have done all these great things and have made them known.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, for Your servant’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
verses.textEn: Lord . For the sake of your servant and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made known all these great promises.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，照着我们耳中所听见的，没有谁能与你相比；除你以外，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，照着我们耳中所听见的，没有谁能与你相比；除你以外，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的，除你以外再无神。
verses.textEnNiv: "There is no one like you, Lord , and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
verses.textEnEsv: There is none like you, O Lord , and there is no God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, thereis none like You, nor isthereany God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord , there is no one like you. We have never even heard of another God like you!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, there is none like You, nor is there any God besides You, according to everything that we have heard with our ears.
verses.textEn: "There is no one like you, Lord , and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

verses.textZh: 世上有哪一个国能比得上你的子民以色列呢？神亲自把他们救赎出来，作自己的子民，又在你从埃及所救赎出来的子民面前驱逐列国，以大而可畏的事建立自己的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上有哪一个国能比得上你的子民以色列呢？神亲自把他们救赎出来，作自己的子民，又在你从埃及所救赎出来的子民面前驱逐列国，以大而可畏的事建立自己的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你神从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人，显出你的大名。
verses.textEnNiv: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?
verses.textEnEsv: And who is like your people Israel, the one nation on earth whom God went to redeem to be his people, making for yourself a name for great and awesome things, in driving out nations before your people whom you redeemed from Egypt?
verses.textEnNkjv: And who is like Your people Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people—to make for Yourself a name by great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt?
verses.textEnNlt: What other nation on earth is like your people Israel? What other nation, O God, have you redeemed from slavery to be your own people? You made a great name for yourself when you redeemed your people from Egypt. You performed awesome miracles and drove out the nations that stood in their way.
verses.textEnNasb: And what one nation on the earth is like Your people Israel, whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for You a name by great and awesome things, by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt?
verses.textEn: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

verses.textZh: 你使你的子民以色列永远作你的子民；耶和华啊，你也作了他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使你的子民以色列永远作你的子民；耶和华啊，你也作了他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永远；你－耶和华也作他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And you made your people Israel to be your people forever, and you, O Lord , became their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, Lord, have become their God.
verses.textEnNlt: You chose Israel to be your very own people forever, and you, O Lord , became their God.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have made Your people Israel Your own people forever, and You, Lord, became their God.
