verses.textEn: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，现在求你永远坚立你应许你仆人和他的家的话，照着你所说的实行吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，现在求你永远坚立你应许你仆人和他的家的话，照着你所说的实行吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远，照你所说的而行。
verses.textEnNiv: "And now, Lord , let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O Lord , let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do as you have spoken,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now, O Lord, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, letit be established forever, and do as You have said.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, O Lord , I am your servant; do as you have promised concerning me and my family. May it be a promise that will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, Lord, let the word that You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do just as You have spoken.
verses.textEn: "And now, Lord , let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,

verses.textZh: 愿你的名永远坚立、尊大，以致人人都说：‘万军之耶和华以色列的神，实在是以色列人的神。’这样，你仆人大卫的家就在你面前得到坚立了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的名永远坚立、尊大，以致人人都说：‘万军之耶和华以色列的神，实在是以色列人的神。’这样，你仆人大卫的家就在你面前得到坚立了。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的名永远坚立，被尊为大，说：『万军之耶和华是以色列的神，是治理以色列的神。』这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: so that it will be established and that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty, the God over Israel, is Israel’s God!’ And the house of your servant David will be established before you.
verses.textEnEsv: and your name will be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel’s God,’ and the house of your servant David will be established before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So let it be established, that Your name may be magnified forever, saying, ‘The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel’s God.’ And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.
verses.textEnNlt: And may your name be established and honored forever so that everyone will say, ‘The Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, is Israel’s God!’ And may the house of your servant David continue before you forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Let Your name be established and be great forever, saying, ‘The Lord of armies is the God of Israel, a God to Israel; and the house of Your servant David is established before You.’
verses.textEn: so that it will be established and that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty, the God over Israel, is Israel’s God!’ And the house of your servant David will be established before you.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊，因为你启示了你的仆人，要你的仆人为你建造殿宇，所以你仆人才敢在你面前这样祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊，因为你启示了你的仆人，要你的仆人为你建造殿宇，所以你仆人才敢在你面前这样祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，因你启示仆人说，我必为你建立家室，所以仆人大胆在你面前祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: "You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, O my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house. Therefore Your servant has found it inhisheart to pray before You.
verses.textEnNlt: "O my God, I have been bold enough to pray to you because you have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him—a dynasty of kings!
verses.textEnNasb: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house; therefore Your servant has found courage to pray before You.
verses.textEn: "You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，唯有你是神，你曾应许把这福气赐给你的仆人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，唯有你是神，你曾应许把这福气赐给你的仆人；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，惟有你是神，你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , are God! You have promised these good things to your servant.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O Lord , you are God, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, Lord, You are God, and have promised this goodness to Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are God, O Lord . And you have promised these good things to your servant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, Lord, You are God, and have promised this good thing to Your servant.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , are God! You have promised these good things to your servant.

verses.textZh: 现在请你赐福你仆人的家，使它在你面前永远存留。耶和华啊，因为你已经赐福了你仆人的家，它必永远蒙福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你赐福你仆人的家，使它在你面前永远存留。耶和华啊，因为你已经赐福了你仆人的家，它必永远蒙福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你喜悦赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和华啊，你已经赐福，还要赐福到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Lord , have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you, for it is you, O Lord , who have blessed, and it is blessed forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You have blessed it, O Lord, and itshallbe blessed forever."
verses.textEnNlt: And now, it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, so that it will continue forever before you. For when you grant a blessing, O Lord , it is an eternal blessing!"
verses.textEnNasb: And now You have decided to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You; for You, Lord, have blessed, and it is blessed forever."
verses.textEn: Now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Lord , have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever."

verses.textZh: 这事以后，大卫攻打非利士人，征服了他们，从非利士人手中夺了迦特和属于迦特的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，大卫攻打非利士人，征服了他们，从非利士人手中夺了迦特和属于迦特的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了迦特和属迦特的村庄；
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its surrounding villages from the control of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: After this David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its villages out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this it came to pass that David attacked the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, David defeated and subdued the Philistines by conquering Gath and its surrounding towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after this it came about that David defeated the Philistines and subdued them and took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its surrounding villages from the control of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
verses.textZhCuv: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
verses.textEnNiv: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought him tribute.
verses.textEnEsv: And he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought tribute.
verses.textEnNlt: David also conquered the land of Moab, and the Moabites who were spared became David’s subjects and paid him tribute money.
verses.textEnNasb: And he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David, bringing tribute.
verses.textEn: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought him tribute.

verses.textZh: 琐巴王哈大底谢到幼发拉底河去，要建立自己的势力的时候，大卫就攻打他，直到哈马。
verses.textZhCnvs: 琐巴王哈大底谢到幼发拉底河去，要建立自己的势力的时候，大卫就攻打他，直到哈马。
verses.textZhCuv: 琐巴王哈大利谢 往 幼发拉底河去，要坚定自己的国权，大卫就攻打他，直到哈马，
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, in the vicinity of Hamath, when he went to set up his monument at the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnEsv: David also defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah-Hamath, as he went to set up his monument at the river Euphrates.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah asfaras Hamath, as he went to establish his power by the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: David also destroyed the forces of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, as far as Hamath, when Hadadezer marched out to strengthen his control along the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: David also defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah as far as Hamath, as he went to establish his rule to the river Euphrates.
verses.textEn: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, in the vicinity of Hamath, when he went to set up his monument at the Euphrates River.

verses.textZh: 大卫掳获了他的战车一千辆，马兵七千人，步兵二万名。大卫把所有战车的马的蹄筋都砍断，只留下一百辆车的马。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫掳获了他的战车一千辆，马兵七千人，步兵二万名。大卫把所有战车的马的蹄筋都砍断，只留下一百辆车的马。
verses.textZhCuv: 夺了他的战车一千，马兵七千，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。
verses.textEnNiv: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took from him 1,000 chariots, 7,000 horsemen, and 20,000 foot soldiers. And David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough for 100 chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Also David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: David captured 1,000 chariots, 7,000 charioteers, and 20,000 foot soldiers. He crippled all the chariot horses except enough for 100 chariots.
verses.textEnNasb: David took from him a thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and David hamstrung almost all the chariot horses, but left enough of them for a hundred chariots.
verses.textEn: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

verses.textZh: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢的时候，大卫就杀了二万二千名亚兰人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢的时候，大卫就杀了二万二千名亚兰人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大利谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 men of the Syrians.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.
verses.textEnNlt: When Arameans from Damascus arrived to help King Hadadezer, David killed 22,000 of them.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand men of the Arameans.
verses.textEn: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地驻军，亚兰人就臣服大卫，给他进贡。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地驻军，亚兰人就臣服大卫，给他进贡。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought him tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus, and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. And the Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought tribute. So the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he placed several army garrisons in Damascus, the Aramean capital, and the Arameans became David’s subjects and paid him tribute money. So the Lord made David victorious wherever he went.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David put garrisons among the Arameans of Damascus; and the Arameans became servants to David, bringing tribute. And the Lord helped David wherever he went.
verses.textEn: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought him tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

verses.textZh: 大卫夺取了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带回耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫夺取了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带回耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他夺了哈大利谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌带到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took the shields of gold that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: David brought the gold shields of Hadadezer’s officers to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: And David took the shields of gold which were carried by the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 大卫又从属于哈大底谢的提巴和均二城中，夺取了大量的铜；后来所罗门用这些铜来制造铜海、铜柱和一切铜器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又从属于哈大底谢的提巴和均二城中，夺取了大量的铜；后来所罗门用这些铜来制造铜海、铜柱和一切铜器。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又从属哈大利谢的提巴 和均二城中夺取了许多的铜。后来所罗门用此制造铜海、铜柱，和一切的铜器。
verses.textEnNiv: From Tebah and Kun, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze Sea, the pillars and various bronze articles.
verses.textEnEsv: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a large amount of bronze. With it Solomon made the bronze sea and the pillars and the vessels of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also from Tibhath and from Chun, cities of Hadadezer, David brought a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the articles of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: along with a large amount of bronze from Hadadezer’s towns of Tebah and Cun. Later Solomon melted the bronze and molded it into the great bronze basin called the Sea, the pillars, and the various bronze articles used at the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Also from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a very large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea and the pillars and the bronze utensils.
verses.textEn: From Tebah and Kun, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze Sea, the pillars and various bronze articles.

verses.textZh: 哈马王陀乌听见大卫击败了琐巴王哈大底谢的全军，
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈马王陀乌听见大卫击败了琐巴王哈大底谢的全军，
verses.textZhCuv: 哈马王陀乌听见大卫杀败琐巴王哈大利谢的全军，
verses.textEnNiv: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.textEnEsv: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer, king of Zobah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.textEnNlt: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had destroyed the entire army of King Hadadezer of Zobah,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.textEn: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

verses.textZh: 就差派自己的儿子哈多兰去见大卫王，给他问安，祝贺他，因为他与哈大底谢交战，击败了哈大底谢。原来陀乌与哈大底谢常有争战。哈多兰送来了各样金、银、铜制的器皿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就差派自己的儿子哈多兰去见大卫王，给他问安，祝贺他，因为他与哈大底谢交战，击败了哈大底谢。原来陀乌与哈大底谢常有争战。哈多兰送来了各样金、银、铜制的器皿。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发他儿子哈多兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大利谢（原来陀乌与哈大利谢常常争战）。哈多兰带了金银铜的各样器皿来。
verses.textEnNiv: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold, of silver and of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: he sent his son Hadoram to King David, to ask about his health and to bless him because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him; for Hadadezer had often been at war with Tou. And he sent all sorts of articles of gold, of silver, and of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: he sent Hadoram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him (for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou); and Hadorambroughtwithhim all kinds of articles of gold, silver, and bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: he sent his son Joram to congratulate King David for his successful campaign. Hadadezer and Toi had been enemies and were often at war. Joram presented David with many gifts of gold, silver, and bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and had defeated him; for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou. And Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze.
verses.textEn: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold, of silver and of bronze.

verses.textZh: 大卫王把这些器皿，连同从各国夺取的金银，就是从以东、摩押、亚扪人、非利士人和亚玛力人夺取的，都分别为圣献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王把这些器皿，连同从各国夺取的金银，就是从以东、摩押、亚扪人、非利士人和亚玛力人夺取的，都分别为圣献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王将这些器皿，并从各国夺来的金银，就是从以东、摩押、亚扪、非利士、亚玛力人所夺来的，都分别为圣献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.
verses.textEnEsv: These also King David dedicated to the Lord , together with the silver and gold that he had carried off from all the nations, from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek.
verses.textEnNkjv: King David also dedicated these to the Lord, along with the silver and gold that he had brought from all these nations—from Edom, from Moab, from the people of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.textEnNlt: King David dedicated all these gifts to the Lord , along with the silver and gold he had taken from the other nations—from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
verses.textEnNasb: King David also dedicated these to the Lord, with the silver and the gold which he had carried away from all the nations: from Edom, Moab, the sons of Ammon, the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.textEn: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛在盐谷击杀了以东人一万八千名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛在盐谷击杀了以东人一万八千名。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛在盐谷击杀了以东一万八千人。
verses.textEnNiv: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, killed 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnNlt: Abishai son of Zeruiah destroyed 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEn: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

verses.textZh: 大卫在以东设立驻防营，所有以东人就都臣服大卫。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在以东设立驻防营，所有以东人就都臣服大卫。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在以东地设立防营，以东人就都归服他。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: He put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNlt: He placed army garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became David’s subjects. In fact, the Lord made David victorious wherever he went.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord helped David wherever he went.
verses.textEn: He put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

verses.textZh: 大卫作王统治全以色列，以公平和正义对待所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫作王统治全以色列，以公平和正义对待所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。
verses.textEnNiv: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.
verses.textEnEsv: So David reigned over all Israel, and he administered justice and equity to all his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and administered judgment and justice to all his people.
verses.textEnNlt: So David reigned over all Israel and did what was just and right for all his people.
verses.textEnNasb: So David reigned over all Israel; and he administered justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.textEn: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作军队的元帅，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作军队的元帅，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textEnNiv: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnNkjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnNlt: Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the royal historian.
verses.textEnNasb: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was secretary;
verses.textEn: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.textZh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长，沙威沙作书记；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长，沙威沙作书记；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长；沙威沙作书记；
verses.textEnNiv: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;
verses.textEnEsv: and Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; and Shavsha was secretary;
verses.textEnNkjv: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests; Shavsha was the scribe;
verses.textEnNlt: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were the priests. Seraiah was the court secretary.
verses.textEnNasb: and Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, and Shavsha was secretary;
verses.textEn: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统管基利提人和比利提人；大卫的众子都在王的左右作领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统管基利提人和比利提人；大卫的众子都在王的左右作领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都在王的左右作领袖。
verses.textEnNiv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.
verses.textEnEsv: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were the chief officials in the service of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers at the king’s side.
verses.textEnNlt: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was captain of the king’s bodyguard. And David’s sons served as the king’s chief assistants.
verses.textEnNasb: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and the sons of David were chiefs at the king’s side.
verses.textEn: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.

verses.textZh: 后来，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他的儿子接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他的儿子接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他儿子接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Now after this Nahash the king of the Ammonites died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened after this that Nahash the king of the people of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time after this, King Nahash of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun became king.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after this, that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son became king in his place.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 大卫说："我要恩待拿辖的儿子哈嫩，因为他的父亲曾恩待我。"于是大卫差派使者去为了他丧父的事安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人境内，去见哈嫩要安慰他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："我要恩待拿辖的儿子哈嫩，因为他的父亲曾恩待我。"于是大卫差派使者去为了他丧父的事安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人境内，去见哈嫩要安慰他。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣使者为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内见哈嫩，要安慰他，
verses.textEnNiv: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s envoys came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to express sympathy to him,
verses.textEnEsv: And David said, "I will deal kindly with Hanun the son of Nahash, for his father dealt kindly with me." So David sent messengers to console him concerning his father. And David’s servants came to the land of the Ammonites to Hanun to console him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came to Hanun in the land of the people of Ammon to comfort him.
verses.textEnNlt: David said, "I am going to show loyalty to Hanun because his father, Nahash, was always loyal to me." So David sent messengers to express sympathy to Hanun about his father’s death. But when David’s ambassadors arrived in the land of Ammon,
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent messengers to console him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the sons of Ammon to Hanun to console him.
verses.textEn: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s envoys came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to express sympathy to him,

verses.textZh: 但亚扪人的众领袖对哈嫩说："大卫差派这些慰问的人到你这里来，你以为他是尊敬你父亲吗？他的臣仆来见你，不是为了窥探、倾覆、侦察这地吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但亚扪人的众领袖对哈嫩说："大卫差派这些慰问的人到你这里来，你以为他是尊敬你父亲吗？他的臣仆来见你，不是为了窥探、倾覆、侦察这地吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 但亚扪人的首领对哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他的臣仆来见你不是为详察窥探、倾覆这地吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Haven’t his envoys come to you only to explore and spy out the country and overthrow it?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun, "Do you think, because David has sent comforters to you, that he is honoring your father? Have not his servants come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the princes of the people of Ammon said to Hanun, "Do you think that David really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Did his servants not come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?"
verses.textEnNlt: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, "Do you really think these men are coming here to honor your father? No! David has sent them to spy out the land so they can come in and conquer it!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the commanders among the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, " Do you think that David is honoring your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Have his servants not come to you to search, to demolish, and to spy out the land?"
verses.textEn: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Haven’t his envoys come to you only to explore and spy out the country and overthrow it?"

verses.textZh: 于是，哈嫩拿住大卫的臣仆，剃去他们的胡须，又把他们的衣服，从臀部以下割去半截，然后才放他们走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，哈嫩拿住大卫的臣仆，剃去他们的胡须，又把他们的衣服，从臀部以下割去半截，然后才放他们走。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved them, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.textEnEsv: So Hanun took David’s servants and shaved them and cut off their garments in the middle, at their hips, and sent them away;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, at their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hanun seized David’s ambassadors and shaved them, cut off their robes at the buttocks, and sent them back to David in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hanun took David’s servants and shaved them, and cut off their robes in the middle as far as their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.textEn: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved them, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.textZh: 有人去把这些人遭遇的事告诉大卫，他就派人去迎接他们；因为他们非常羞耻，王就说："你们可以住在耶利哥，等到你们的胡须长长了才回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人去把这些人遭遇的事告诉大卫，他就派人去迎接他们；因为他们非常羞耻，王就说："你们可以住在耶利哥，等到你们的胡须长长了才回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人将臣仆所遇的事告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，因为他们甚觉羞耻；告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」
verses.textEnNiv: When someone came and told David about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."
verses.textEnEsv: and they departed. When David was told concerning the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Remain at Jericho until your beards have grown and then return."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some went and told David about the men; and he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard what had happened to the men, he sent messengers to tell them, "Stay at Jericho until your beards grow out, and then come back." For they felt deep shame because of their appearance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then certain people went and told David about the men. And he sent messengers to meet them, because the men were very humiliated. And the king said, "Stay at Jericho until your beards grow back, then return."
verses.textEn: When someone came and told David about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."

verses.textZh: 亚扪人看见自己与大卫结了仇恨，哈嫩和亚扪人就派人用三万公斤银子，从米所波大米、亚兰玛迦和琐巴去雇战车和马兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人看见自己与大卫结了仇恨，哈嫩和亚扪人就派人用三万公斤银子，从米所波大米、亚兰玛迦和琐巴去雇战车和马兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，哈嫩和亚扪人就打发人拿一千他连得银子，从美索不达米亚、亚兰、玛迦、琐巴雇战车和马兵，
verses.textEnNiv: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram Naharaim, Aram Maakah and Zobah.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Ammonites saw that they had become a stench to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent 1,000 talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Aram-maacah, and from Zobah.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, Hanun and the people of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Syrian Maacah, and from Zobah.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people of Ammon realized how seriously they had angered David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent 75,000 pounds of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, Hanun and the sons of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.
verses.textEn: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram Naharaim, Aram Maakah and Zobah.

verses.textZh: 他们雇了三万二千辆战车，以及玛迦王和他的军队；他们都来在米底巴前面安营。亚扪人也从他们的各城聚集起来，出来作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们雇了三万二千辆战车，以及玛迦王和他的军队；他们都来在米底巴前面安营。亚扪人也从他们的各城聚集起来，出来作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是雇了三万二千辆战车和玛迦王并他的军兵；他们来安营在米底巴前。亚扪人也从他们的城里出来，聚集交战。
verses.textEnNiv: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots and charioteers, as well as the king of Maakah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba, while the Ammonites were mustered from their towns and moved out for battle.
verses.textEnEsv: They hired 32,000 chariots and the king of Maacah with his army, who came and encamped before Medeba. And the Ammonites were mustered from their cities and came to battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, with the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. Also the people of Ammon gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.textEnNlt: They also hired 32,000 chariots and secured the support of the king of Maacah and his army. These forces camped at Medeba, where they were joined by the Ammonite troops that Hanun had recruited from his own towns.
verses.textEnNasb: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people, who came and camped opposite Medeba. And the sons of Ammon gathered together from their cities and came to the battle.
verses.textEn: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots and charioteers, as well as the king of Maakah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba, while the Ammonites were mustered from their towns and moved out for battle.

verses.textZh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押和全体勇士出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫听见了，就差派约押和全体勇士出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when David heard ofit, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard about this, he sent Joab and all his warriors to fight them.
verses.textEnNasb: When David heard about it, he sent Joab and all the army, the mighty men.
verses.textEn: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；前来助阵的列王，也在田野摆阵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；前来助阵的列王，也在田野摆阵。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人出来在城门前摆阵，所来的诸王另在郊野摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Ammonites came out and drew up in battle array at the entrance of the city, and the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people of Ammon came out and put themselves in battle array before the gate of the city, and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ammonite troops came out and drew up their battle lines at the entrance of the city, while the other kings positioned themselves to fight in the open fields.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ammon came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
verses.textEn: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.

verses.textZh: 约押看见自己前后受敌，就从以色列所有的精兵中，挑选一部分出来，使他们摆阵去迎战亚兰人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押看见自己前后受敌，就从以色列所有的精兵中，挑选一部分出来，使他们摆阵去迎战亚兰人，
verses.textZhCuv: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵；
verses.textEnNiv: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joab saw that the battle was set against him both in front and in the rear, he chose some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Syrians.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Joab saw that the battle line was against him before and behind, he chose some of Israel’s best and put them in battle array against the Syrians.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab saw that he would have to fight on both the front and the rear, he chose some of Israel’s elite troops and placed them under his personal command to fight the Arameans in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him at the front and at the rear, he selected warriors from all the choice men in Israel and lined them up against the Arameans.
verses.textEn: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

verses.textZh: 他把其余的人交在他兄弟亚比筛手下，使他们摆阵去迎战亚扪人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把其余的人交在他兄弟亚比筛手下，使他们摆阵去迎战亚扪人。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother, and they were deployed against the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of his men he put in the charge of Abishai his brother, and they were arrayed against the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of the people he put under the command of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in battle array against the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: He left the rest of the army under the command of his brother Abishai, who was to attack the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: But the remainder of the people he placed under the command of Abshai his brother; and they lined up against the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother, and they were deployed against the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 约押对亚比筛说："如果亚兰人比我强，你就来帮助我；如果亚扪人比你强，我就去帮助你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押对亚比筛说："如果亚兰人比我强，你就来帮助我；如果亚扪人比你强，我就去帮助你。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to rescue me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me, but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will help you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the people of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then come over and help me," Joab told his brother. "And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will help you.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
verses.textEn: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to rescue me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.

verses.textZh: 你当刚强；为了我们的人民和我们神的众城镇，我们要刚强；愿耶和华成全他看为美的行事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你当刚强；为了我们的人民和我们神的众城镇，我们要刚强；愿耶和华成全他看为美的行事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和神的城邑作大丈夫，愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."
verses.textEnEsv: Be strong, and let us use our strength for our people and for the cities of our God, and may the Lord do what seems good to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the Lord do whatis good in His sight."
verses.textEnNlt: Be courageous! Let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. May the Lord ’s will be done."
verses.textEnNasb: Be strong, and let’s show ourselves courageous for the benefit of our people and the cities of our God; and may the Lord do what is good in His sight."
verses.textEn: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."

verses.textZh: 于是约押和他的军队前进，预备作战攻打亚兰人；亚兰人却在约押面前逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约押和他的军队前进，预备作战攻打亚兰人；亚兰人却在约押面前逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near before the Syrians for battle, and they fled before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near for the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab and his troops attacked, the Arameans began to run away.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joab and the people who were with him advanced to battle against the Arameans, and they fled from him.
verses.textEn: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人看见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑，退回城里。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人看见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑，退回城里。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they too fled before his brother Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Ammonites saw that the Syrians fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, Joab’s brother, and entered the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai his brother, and entered the city. So Joab went to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the Ammonites saw the Arameans running, they also ran from Abishai and retreated into the city. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Ammon saw that the Arameans had fled, they also fled from his brother Abshai and entered the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they too fled before his brother Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人看见自己在以色列人面前被打败，就差派使者去把大河那边的亚兰人调过来，有哈大底谢的元帅朔法率领他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人看见自己在以色列人面前被打败，就差派使者去把大河那边的亚兰人调过来，有哈大底谢的元帅朔法率领他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就打发使者将大河那边的亚兰人调来，哈大利谢的将军朔法率领他们。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River, with Shophak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the Euphrates, with Shophach the commander of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought the Syrians who were beyond the River, and Shophach the commander of Hadadezer’s army went before them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Arameans now realized that they were no match for Israel, so they sent messengers and summoned additional Aramean troops from the other side of the Euphrates River. These troops were under the command of Shobach, the commander of Hadadezer’s forces.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Arameans who were beyond the Euphrates River, with Shophach the commander of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
verses.textEn: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River, with Shophak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.

verses.textZh: 大卫得到报告，就招聚以色列众人，渡过约旦河，来到亚兰人那里，向他们摆阵。大卫摆好阵迎战亚兰人，亚兰人就与他交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫得到报告，就招聚以色列众人，渡过约旦河，来到亚兰人那里，向他们摆阵。大卫摆好阵迎战亚兰人，亚兰人就与他交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人过约旦河，来到亚兰人那里，迎着他们摆阵。大卫既摆阵攻击亚兰人，亚兰人就与他打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan; he advanced against them and formed his battle lines opposite them. David formed his lines to meet the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was told to David, he gathered all Israel together and crossed the Jordan and came to them and drew up his forces against them. And when David set the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel, crossed over the Jordan and came upon them, and set up in battle array against them. So when David had set up in battle array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard what was happening, he mobilized all Israel, crossed the Jordan River, and positioned his troops in battle formation. Then David engaged the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.
verses.textEnNasb: When it was reported to David, he gathered all Israel together and crossed the Jordan, and came upon them and drew up in formation against them. And when David drew up in battle formation against the Arameans, they fought against him.
verses.textEn: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan; he advanced against them and formed his battle lines opposite them. David formed his lines to meet the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰人七千辆战车上的军兵和四万步兵。又杀了亚兰人的元帅朔法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰人七千辆战车上的军兵和四万步兵。又杀了亚兰人的元帅朔法。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七千辆战车的人，四万步兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。
verses.textEnNiv: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also killed Shophak the commander of their army.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Syrians fled before Israel, and David killed of the Syrians the men of 7,000 chariots and 40,000 foot soldiers, and put to death also Shophach the commander of their army.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers of the Syrians, and killed Shophach the commander of the army.
verses.textEnNlt: But again the Arameans fled from the Israelites. This time David’s forces killed 7,000 charioteers and 40,000 foot soldiers, including Shobach, the commander of their army.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Arameans fled from Israel, and David killed of the Arameans seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers; and he put Shophach the commander of the army to death.
verses.textEn: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also killed Shophak the commander of their army.

verses.textZh: 哈大底谢的臣仆看见自己在以色列人面前被打败了，就与大卫议和，臣服了他；于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈大底谢的臣仆看见自己在以色列人面前被打败了，就与大卫议和，臣服了他；于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人。
verses.textZhCuv: 属哈大利谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与大卫和好，归服他。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Syrians were not willing to save the Ammonites anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants. So the Syrians were not willing to help the people of Ammon anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: When Hadadezer’s allies saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they surrendered to David and became his subjects. After that, the Arameans were no longer willing to help the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: So when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the sons of Ammon anymore.
verses.textEn: When the vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.

verses.textZh: 过了年，在列王出征的时候，约押带领军兵，毁坏了亚扪人的地方，然后去围困拉巴。那时大卫住在耶路撒冷。约押攻打拉巴，把城摧毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了年，在列王出征的时候，约押带领军兵，毁坏了亚扪人的地方，然后去围困拉巴。那时大卫住在耶路撒冷。约押攻打拉巴，把城摧毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，约押率领军兵毁坏亚扪人的地，围攻拉巴；大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。约押攻打拉巴，将城倾覆。
verses.textEnNiv: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, Joab led out the armed forces. He laid waste the land of the Ammonites and went to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and left it in ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: In the spring of the year, the time when kings go out to battle, Joab led out the army and ravaged the country of the Ammonites and came and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem. And Joab struck down Rabbah and overthrew it.
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened in the spring of the year, at the time kings go out tobattle, that Joab led out the armed forces and ravaged the country of the people of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. And Joab defeated Rabbah and overthrew it.
verses.textEnNlt: In the spring of the year, when kings normally go out to war, Joab led the Israelite army in successful attacks against the land of the Ammonites. In the process he laid siege to the city of Rabbah, attacking and destroying it. However, David stayed behind in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened in the spring, at the time when kings go out to battle, that Joab led out the army and ravaged the land of the sons of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed in Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and overthrew it.
verses.textEn: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, Joab led out the armed forces. He laid waste the land of the Ammonites and went to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and left it in ruins.

verses.textZh: 大卫从米勒公神像的头上取下金冠，发现金子重三十公斤，又有一块宝石嵌在上面；有人把这冠冕戴在大卫的头上；大卫从城里夺走了大批战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从米勒公神像的头上取下金冠，发现金子重三十公斤，又有一块宝石嵌在上面；有人把这冠冕戴在大卫的头上；大卫从城里夺走了大批战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕 ，其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌着宝石；人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，
verses.textEnNiv: David took the crown from the head of their king —its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones—and it was placed on David’s head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city
verses.textEnEsv: And David took the crown of their king from his head. He found that it weighed a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone. And it was placed on David’s head. And he brought out the spoil of the city, a very great amount.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David took their king’s crown from his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and therewere precious stones in it. And it was set on David’s head. Also he brought out the spoil of the city in great abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David went to Rabbah and removed the crown from the king’s head, and it was placed on his own head. The crown was made of gold and set with gems, and he found that it weighed seventy-five pounds. David took a vast amount of plunder from the city.
verses.textEnNasb: David took the crown of their king from his head, and he found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there was a precious stone in it; and it was placed on David’s head. And he brought out the spoils of the city, a very great amount.
verses.textEn: David took the crown from the head of their king —its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones—and it was placed on David’s head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city

verses.textZh: 又把城里的众民拉出来，要他们用锯子、铁铲和斧子作工；大卫待亚扪各城的人都是这样。后来大卫和众民都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把城里的众民拉出来，要他们用锯子、铁铲和斧子作工；大卫待亚扪各城的人都是这样。后来大卫和众民都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或铁斧下 ，大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought out the people who were in it and set them to labor with saws and iron picks and axes. And thus David did to all the cities of the Ammonites. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. So David did to all the cities of the people of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made slaves of the people of Rabbah and forced them to labor with saws, iron picks, and iron axes. That is how David dealt with the people of all the Ammonite towns. Then David and all the army returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work at saws, iron picks, and axes. And David did the same to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，以色列人在基色与非利士人交战；那时户沙人西比该击杀了巨人的一个儿子细派，非利士人就被制伏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，以色列人在基色与非利士人交战；那时户沙人西比该击杀了巨人的一个儿子细派，非利士人就被制伏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，以色列人在基色与非利士人打仗。户沙人西比该杀了伟人的一个儿子细派，非利士人就被制伏了。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, war broke out with the Philistines, at Gezer. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaites, and the Philistines were subjugated.
verses.textEnEsv: And after this there arose war with the Philistines at Gezer. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, who was one of the descendants of the giants, and the Philistines were subdued.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened afterward that war broke out at Gezer with the Philistines, at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Sippai, whowasone of the sons of the giant. And they were subdued.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. As they fought, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Saph, a descendant of the giants, and so the Philistines were subdued.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after this, that war broke out at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the giants, and they were subdued.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, war broke out with the Philistines, at Gezer. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaites, and the Philistines were subjugated.

verses.textZh: 后来，以色列人与非利士人再次交战，睚珥的儿子伊勒哈难，击杀了迦特人歌利亚的兄弟拉哈米；这人的枪杆好象织布机轴一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，以色列人与非利士人再次交战，睚珥的儿子伊勒哈难，击杀了迦特人歌利亚的兄弟拉哈米；这人的枪杆好象织布机轴一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 又与非利士人打仗。睚珥的儿子伊勒哈难杀了迦特人歌利亚的兄弟拉哈米；这人的枪杆粗如织布的机轴。
verses.textEnNiv: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was again war with the Philistines, and Elhanan the son of Jair struck down Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again there was war with the Philistines, and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textEnNlt: During another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath of Gath. The handle of Lahmi’s spear was as thick as a weaver’s beam!
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war with the Philistines again, and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textEn: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.

verses.textZh: 后来，在迦特又有战事；那里有一个身材高大的人，手脚各有六指，共有二十四根指头；他也是巨人的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，在迦特又有战事；那里有一个身材高大的人，手脚各有六指，共有二十四根指头；他也是巨人的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在迦特打仗。那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都是六指，共有二十四个指头，他也是伟人的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was descended from the giants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, with twenty-four fingers and toes, six oneachhand and six oneachfoot; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.textEnNlt: In another battle with the Philistines at Gath, they encountered a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in all, who was also a descendant of the giants.
verses.textEnNasb: Again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot; and he also was descended from the giants.
verses.textEn: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

verses.textZh: 这人侮辱以色列人，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就把他击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人侮辱以色列人，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就把他击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就杀了他。
verses.textEnNiv: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, struck him down.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: But when he defied and taunted Israel, he was killed by Jonathan, the son of David’s brother Shimea.
verses.textEnNasb: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.textEn: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

verses.textZh: 这些人是迦特巨人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人是迦特巨人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
verses.textZhCuv: 这三个人是迦特伟人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
verses.textEnNiv: These were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
verses.textEnEsv: These were descended from the giants in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were born to the giant in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: These Philistines were descendants of the giants of Gath, but David and his warriors killed them.
verses.textEnNasb: These were descended from the giants in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.textEn: These were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

verses.textZh: 撒但起来攻击以色列人，引诱大卫去数点以色列人的数目。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒但起来攻击以色列人，引诱大卫去数点以色列人的数目。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒但起来攻击以色列人，激动大卫数点他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Satan stood against Israel and incited David to number Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Satan rose up against Israel and caused David to take a census of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Satan stood up against Israel and incited David to count Israel.
verses.textEn: Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫对约押和民众的领袖说："你们去数点以色列人，从别是巴直到但，然后回来见我，让我知道他们的数目。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫对约押和民众的领袖说："你们去数点以色列人，从别是巴直到但，然后回来见我，让我知道他们的数目。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就吩咐约押和民中的首领说：「你们去数点以色列人，从别是巴直到但，回来告诉我，我好知道他们的数目。」
verses.textEnNiv: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, "Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan. Then report back to me so that I may know how many there are."
verses.textEnEsv: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the army, "Go, number Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, and bring me a report, that I may know their number."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, "Go, number Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring the number of them to me that I may know it."
verses.textEnNlt: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the army, "Take a census of all the people of Israel—from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north—and bring me a report so I may know how many there are."
verses.textEnNasb: So David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, "Go, count Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring me word so that I may know their number."
verses.textEn: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, "Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan. Then report back to me so that I may know how many there are."

verses.textZh: 约押说："愿耶和华使他的子民比现在增加百倍。我主我王啊，他们不都是我主的仆人吗？我主为甚么要作这事呢？为甚么使以色列人陷在罪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押说："愿耶和华使他的子民比现在增加百倍。我主我王啊，他们不都是我主的仆人吗？我主为甚么要作这事呢？为甚么使以色列人陷在罪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约押说：「愿耶和华使他的百姓比现在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他们不都是你的仆人吗？我主为何吩咐行这事，为何使以色列人陷在罪里呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Joab replied, "May the Lord multiply his troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all my lord’s subjects? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Joab said, "May the Lord add to his people a hundred times as many as they are! Are they not, my lord the king, all of them my lord’s servants? Why then should my lord require this? Why should it be a cause of guilt for Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab answered, "May the Lord make His people a hundred times more than they are. But, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? Why then does my lord require this thing? Why should he be a cause of guilt in Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Joab replied, "May the Lord increase the number of his people a hundred times over! But why, my lord the king, do you want to do this? Are they not all your servants? Why must you cause Israel to sin?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Joab said, "May the Lord add to His people a hundred times as many as they are! My lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord seek this thing? Why should he be a cause of guilt to Israel?"
verses.textEn: But Joab replied, "May the Lord multiply his troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all my lord’s subjects? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?"

verses.textZh: 但王坚持他的命令，约押不敢违抗；约押就出去，走遍以色列各地，然后回到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但王坚持他的命令，约押不敢违抗；约押就出去，走遍以色列各地，然后回到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 但王的命令胜过约押。约押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，
verses.textEnNiv: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab; so Joab left and went throughout Israel and then came back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king’s word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and went throughout all Israel and came back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king insisted that they take the census, so Joab traveled throughout all Israel to count the people. Then he returned to Jerusalem
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore, Joab departed and went throughout Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab; so Joab left and went throughout Israel and then came back to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 约押把数点人民的数目呈报大卫：全以色列能拿刀的人，共有一百一十万；犹大能拿刀的人，共有四十七万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押把数点人民的数目呈报大卫：全以色列能拿刀的人，共有一百一十万；犹大能拿刀的人，共有四十七万。
verses.textZhCuv: 将百姓的总数奏告大卫：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十万；犹大人拿刀的有四十七万。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab gave the sum of the numbering of the people to David. In all Israel there were 1,100,000 men who drew the sword, and in Judah 470,000 who drew the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. All Israel had one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and Judah had four hundred and seventy thousand men who drew the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: and reported the number of people to David. There were 1,100,000 warriors in all Israel who could handle a sword, and 470,000 in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab gave the number of the census of the people to David. Israel was 1,100,000 men in all who drew the sword; and Judah was 470,000 men who drew the sword.
verses.textEn: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.

verses.textZh: 唯有利未人和便雅悯人，他没有数点在内，因为约押厌恶王这个命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有利未人和便雅悯人，他没有数点在内，因为约押厌恶王这个命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有利未人和便雅悯人没有数在其中，因为约押厌恶王的这命令。
verses.textEnNiv: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the king’s command was repulsive to him.
verses.textEnEsv: But he did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, for the king’s command was abhorrent to Joab.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he did not count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
verses.textEnNlt: But Joab did not include the tribes of Levi and Benjamin in the census because he was so distressed at what the king had made him do.
verses.textEnNasb: But he did not count Levi and Benjamin among them, because the king’s command was abhorrent to Joab.
verses.textEn: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the king’s command was repulsive to him.

verses.textZh: 神不喜悦这事，所以他击打以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不喜悦这事，所以他击打以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神不喜悦这数点百姓的事，便降灾给以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But God was displeased with this thing, and he struck Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore He struck Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: God was very displeased with the census, and he punished Israel for it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now God was displeased with this thing, so He struck Israel.
verses.textEn: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫对神说："我犯了重罪，因为我行了这事；现在求你除去你仆人的罪孽，因我作了十分愚昧的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对神说："我犯了重罪，因为我行了这事；现在求你除去你仆人的罪孽，因我作了十分愚昧的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫祷告神说：「我行这事大有罪了！现在求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to God, "I have sinned greatly in that I have done this thing. But now, please take away the iniquity of your servant, for I have acted very foolishly."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to God, "I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing; but now, I pray, take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have done very foolishly."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by taking this census. Please forgive my guilt for doing this foolish thing."
verses.textEnNasb: David said to God, "I have sinned greatly, by doing this thing. But now, please overlook Your servant’s guilt, for I have behaved very foolishly."
verses.textEn: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉大卫的先见迦得，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉大卫的先见迦得，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐大卫的先见迦得说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Gad, David’s seer,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer. This was the message:
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Gad, David’s seer,

verses.textZh: "你去告诉大卫，说：‘耶和华这样说：我给你提出三件事，你可以选择一件，我好向你施行。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去告诉大卫，说：‘耶和华这样说：我给你提出三件事，你可以选择一件，我好向你施行。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉大卫说，耶和华如此说：我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and say to David, ‘Thus says the Lord , Three things I offer you; choose one of them, that I may do it to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and tell David, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I offer you three things; choose one of them for yourself, that I may do it to you." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and say to David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I will give you three choices. Choose one of these punishments, and I will inflict it on you.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and speak to David, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says: "I extend to you three choices; choose for yourself one of them, which I will do to you." ’ "
verses.textEn: "Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是迦得来见大卫，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你可以选择：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是迦得来见大卫，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你可以选择：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，迦得来见大卫，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你可以随意选择：
verses.textEnNiv: So Gad went to David and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Take your choice:
verses.textEnEsv: So Gad came to David and said to him, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Choose what you will:
verses.textEnNkjv: So Gad came to David and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Choose for yourself,
verses.textEnNlt: So Gad came to David and said, "These are the choices the Lord has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: So Gad came to David and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Take for yourself
verses.textEn: So Gad went to David and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Take your choice:

verses.textZh: 或是三年的饥荒；或是在你敌人面前逃亡，被你仇敌的刀剑追杀三个月；或是耶和华的刀攻击三天，就是在国中发生瘟疫三日，耶和华的使者在以色列的四境施行毁灭。’现在你考虑一下，我该用甚么话回复那差派我来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是三年的饥荒；或是在你敌人面前逃亡，被你仇敌的刀剑追杀三个月；或是耶和华的刀攻击三天，就是在国中发生瘟疫三日，耶和华的使者在以色列的四境施行毁灭。’现在你考虑一下，我该用甚么话回复那差派我来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 或三年的饥荒；或败在你敌人面前，被敌人的刀追杀三个月；或在你国中有耶和华的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和华的使者在以色列的四境施行毁灭。』现在你要想一想，我好回复那差我来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies, with their swords overtaking you, or three days of the sword of the Lord —days of plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should answer the one who sent me."
verses.textEnEsv: either three years of famine, or three months of devastation by your foes while the sword of your enemies overtakes you, or else three days of the sword of the Lord , pestilence on the land, with the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the territory of Israel.’ Now decide what answer I shall return to him who sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: either three years of famine, or three months to be defeated by your foes with the sword of your enemies overtaking you, or else for three days the sword of the Lord—the plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the territory of Israel.’ Now consider what answer I should take back to Him who sent me."
verses.textEnNlt: You may choose three years of famine, three months of destruction by the sword of your enemies, or three days of severe plague as the angel of the Lord brings devastation throughout the land of Israel. Decide what answer I should give the Lord who sent me."
verses.textEnNasb: three years of famine, or three months to be swept away before your foes while the sword of your enemies overtakes you, or else three days of the sword of the Lord: a plague in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout the territory of Israel.’ Now, therefore, consider what answer I shall bring back to Him who sent me."
verses.textEn: three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies, with their swords overtaking you, or three days of the sword of the Lord —days of plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should answer the one who sent me."

verses.textZh: 大卫对迦得说："我十分作难，我情愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有极丰盛的怜悯，我不愿落在人的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对迦得说："我十分作难，我情愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有极丰盛的怜悯，我不愿落在人的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对迦得说：「我甚为难。我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯；我不愿落在人的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let me fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is very great; but do not let me fall into human hands."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Let me fall into the hand of the Lord , for his mercy is very great, but do not let me fall into the hand of man."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Please let me fall into the hand of the Lord, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hand of man."
verses.textEnNlt: "I’m in a desperate situation!" David replied to Gad. "But let me fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is very great. Do not let me fall into human hands."
verses.textEnNasb: David said to Gad, "I am in great distress; please let me fall into the hand of the Lord, for His mercies are very great. But do not let me fall into human hands."
verses.textEn: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let me fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is very great; but do not let me fall into human hands."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华使瘟疫降在以色列人身上；以色列人死了七万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华使瘟疫降在以色列人身上；以色列人死了七万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，以色列人就死了七万。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord sent a pestilence on Israel, and 70,000 men of Israel fell.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel, and 70,000 people died as a result.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel; seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
verses.textEn: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.

verses.textZh: 神差派一位使者到耶路撒冷去，要毁灭那城；正要施行毁灭的时候，耶和华看见了，就后悔所要降的这灾，于是对施行毁灭的天使说："够了！住手吧！"那时，耶和华的使者正站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场附近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神差派一位使者到耶路撒冷去，要毁灭那城；正要施行毁灭的时候，耶和华看见了，就后悔所要降的这灾，于是对施行毁灭的天使说："够了！住手吧！"那时，耶和华的使者正站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场附近。
verses.textZhCuv: 神差遣使者去灭耶路撒冷，刚要灭的时候，耶和华看见后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭城的天使说：「够了，住手吧！」那时，耶和华的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场那里。
verses.textEnNiv: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But as the angel was doing so, the Lord saw it and relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnEsv: And God sent the angel to Jerusalem to destroy it, but as he was about to destroy it, the Lord saw, and he relented from the calamity. And he said to the angel who was working destruction, "It is enough; now stay your hand." And the angel of the Lord was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was destroying, the Lord looked and relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who was destroying, "It is enough; now restrain your hand." And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNlt: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But just as the angel was preparing to destroy it, the Lord relented and said to the death angel, "Stop! That is enough!" At that moment the angel of the Lord was standing by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNasb: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it; but as he was about to destroy it, the Lord saw and was sorry about the catastrophe, and said to the destroying angel, "It is enough; now relax your hand." And the angel of the Lord was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEn: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But as the angel was doing so, the Lord saw it and relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.textZh: 大卫举目看见耶和华的使者站在天地之间，手里拿着出了鞘的刀，指向耶路撒冷。大卫和众长老都穿上麻布，脸伏于地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫举目看见耶和华的使者站在天地之间，手里拿着出了鞘的刀，指向耶路撒冷。大卫和众长老都穿上麻布，脸伏于地。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫举目，看见耶和华的使者站在天地间，手里有拔出来的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大卫和长老都身穿麻衣，面伏于地。
verses.textEnNiv: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: And David lifted his eyes and saw the angel of the Lord standing between earth and heaven, and in his hand a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David lifted his eyes and saw the angel of the Lord standing between earth and heaven, having in his hand a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem. So David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
verses.textEnNlt: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth with his sword drawn, reaching out over Jerusalem. So David and the leaders of Israel put on burlap to show their deep distress and fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David raised his eyes and saw the angel of the Lord standing between earth and heaven, with his drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, covered with sackcloth, fell on their faces.
verses.textEn: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 大卫对神说："吩咐统计这人民的不是我吗？是我犯了罪，行了这大恶；但这羊群作了甚么呢？耶和华我的神啊，愿你的手攻击我和我的家族，不可把瘟疫降在你子民的身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对神说："吩咐统计这人民的不是我吗？是我犯了罪，行了这大恶；但这羊群作了甚么呢？耶和华我的神啊，愿你的手攻击我和我的家族，不可把瘟疫降在你子民的身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫祷告神说：「吩咐数点百姓的不是我吗？我犯了罪，行了恶，但这群羊做了什么呢？愿耶和华－我神的手攻击我和我的父家，不要攻击你的民，降瘟疫与他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to God, "Was it not I who ordered the fighting men to be counted? I, the shepherd, have sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Lord my God, let your hand fall on me and my family, but do not let this plague remain on your people."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to God, "Was it not I who gave command to number the people? It is I who have sinned and done great evil. But these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Lord my God, be against me and against my father’s house. But do not let the plague be on your people."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to God, "Was it not I who commanded the people to be numbered? I am the one who has sinned and done evil indeed; but these sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand, I pray, O Lord my God, be against me and my father’s house, but not against Your people that they should be plagued."
