verses.textEnNlt: And David said to God, "I am the one who called for the census! I am the one who has sinned and done wrong! But these people are as innocent as sheep—what have they done? O Lord my God, let your anger fall against me and my family, but do not destroy your people."
verses.textEnNasb: And David said to God, "Is it not I who commanded to count the people? Indeed, I am the one who has sinned and acted very wickedly, but these sheep, what have they done? Lord, my God, just let Your hand be against me and my father’s household, and not against Your people as a plague."
verses.textEn: David said to God, "Was it not I who ordered the fighting men to be counted? I, the shepherd, have sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Lord my God, let your hand fall on me and my family, but do not let this plague remain on your people."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者吩咐迦得去告诉大卫，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上，为耶和华筑一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者吩咐迦得去告诉大卫，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上，为耶和华筑一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者吩咐迦得去告诉大卫，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of the Lord ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the angel of the Lord had commanded Gad to say to David that David should go up and raise an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David that David should go and erect an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of the Lord told Gad to instruct David to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David was to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEn: Then the angel of the Lord ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.textZh: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华的名所说的话上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华的名所说的话上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So David went up at Gad’s word, which he had spoken in the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went up at the word of Gad, which he had spoken in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So David went up to do what the Lord had commanded him through Gad.
verses.textEnNasb: So David went up at the word of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: So David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 那时阿珥楠正在打麦子；阿珥楠转过身来看见了天使，就和他的四个儿子一起躲藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时阿珥楠正在打麦子；阿珥楠转过身来看见了天使，就和他的四个儿子一起躲藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时阿珥楠正打麦子，回头看见天使，就和他四个儿子都藏起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: While Araunah was threshing wheat, he turned and saw the angel; his four sons who were with him hid themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Ornan was threshing wheat. He turned and saw the angel, and his four sons who were with him hid themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ornan turned and saw the angel; and his four sons whowere with him hid themselves, but Ornan continued threshing wheat.
verses.textEnNlt: Araunah, who was busy threshing wheat at the time, turned and saw the angel there. His four sons, who were with him, ran away and hid.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ornan turned back and saw the angel, and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. And Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.textEn: While Araunah was threshing wheat, he turned and saw the angel; his four sons who were with him hid themselves.

verses.textZh: 大卫来到阿珥楠那里，阿珥楠看见大卫，就从禾场上出来，脸伏于地，向大卫下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫来到阿珥楠那里，阿珥楠看见大卫，就从禾场上出来，脸伏于地，向大卫下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了阿珥楠那里，阿珥楠看见大卫，就从禾场上出去，脸伏于地，向他下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David approached, and when Araunah looked and saw him, he left the threshing floor and bowed down before David with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David and went out from the threshing floor and paid homage to David with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David came to Ornan, and Ornan looked and saw David. And he went out from the threshing floor, and bowed before David with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: When Araunah saw David approaching, he left his threshing floor and bowed before David with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out from the threshing floor and prostrated himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.textEn: Then David approached, and when Araunah looked and saw him, he left the threshing floor and bowed down before David with his face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 大卫对阿珥楠说："请把这块禾场的地让给我，我要在这里为耶和华筑一座祭坛，请你算足价银让给我，使民间的瘟疫可以止息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对阿珥楠说："请把这块禾场的地让给我，我要在这里为耶和华筑一座祭坛，请你算足价银让给我，使民间的瘟疫可以止息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对阿珥楠说：「你将这禾场与相连之地卖给我，我必给你足价，我好在其上为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to him, "Let me have the site of your threshing floor so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped. Sell it to me at the full price."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Ornan, "Give me the site of the threshing floor that I may build on it an altar to the Lord —give it to me at its full price—that the plague may be averted from the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Ornan, "Grant me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar on it to the Lord. You shall grant it to me at the full price, that the plague may be withdrawn from the people."
verses.textEnNlt: David said to Araunah, "Let me buy this threshing floor from you at its full price. Then I will build an altar to the Lord there, so that he will stop the plague."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Ornan, "Give me the site of this threshing floor, so that I may build on it an altar to the Lord; you shall give it to me for the full price, so that the plague may be brought to a halt from the people."
verses.textEn: David said to him, "Let me have the site of your threshing floor so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped. Sell it to me at the full price."

verses.textZh: 阿珥楠对大卫说："只管拿去吧，我主我王看怎样好就怎样行吧；你看，我把牛给你作燔祭，把打禾的用具当柴烧，拿麦子作素祭；这一切我都送给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿珥楠对大卫说："只管拿去吧，我主我王看怎样好就怎样行吧；你看，我把牛给你作燔祭，把打禾的用具当柴烧，拿麦子作素祭；这一切我都送给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 阿珥楠对大卫说：「你可以用这禾场，愿我主我王照你所喜悦的去行。我也将牛给你作燔祭，把打粮的器具当柴烧，拿麦子作素祭。这些我都送给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Araunah said to David, "Take it! Let my lord the king do whatever pleases him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give all this."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ornan said to David, "Take it, and let my lord the king do what seems good to him. See, I give the oxen for burnt offerings and the threshing sledges for the wood and the wheat for a grain offering; I give it all."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Ornan said to David, "Take it to yourself, and let my lord the king do whatis good in his eyes. Look, I also give you the oxen for burnt offerings, the threshing implements for wood, and the wheat for the grain offering; I give it all."
verses.textEnNlt: "Take it, my lord the king, and use it as you wish," Araunah said to David. "I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, and the threshing boards for wood to build a fire on the altar, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give it all to you."
verses.textEnNasb: But Ornan said to David, "Take it for yourself, and may my lord the king do what is good in his sight. See, I am giving the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing sledges for wood and the wheat for the grain offering; I am giving it all."
verses.textEn: Araunah said to David, "Take it! Let my lord the king do whatever pleases him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give all this."

verses.textZh: 大卫王对阿珥楠说："不，我必照足价银向你买；我不能拿你的东西献给耶和华，也不能把没有付代价的东西献上作燔祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王对阿珥楠说："不，我必照足价银向你买；我不能拿你的东西献给耶和华，也不能把没有付代价的东西献上作燔祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王对阿珥楠说：「不然！我必要用足价向你买。我不用你的物献给耶和华，也不用白得之物献为燔祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or sacrifice a burnt offering that costs me nothing."
verses.textEnEsv: But King David said to Ornan, "No, but I will buy them for the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, nor offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King David said to Ornan, "No, but I will surely buy it for the full price, for I will not take what is yours for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings with thatwhich costs me nothing."
verses.textEnNlt: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on buying it for the full price. I will not take what is yours and give it to the Lord . I will not present burnt offerings that have cost me nothing!"
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, King David said to Ornan, "No, but I will certainly buy it for the full price; for I will not take what is yours for the Lord, nor offer a burnt offering which costs me nothing."
verses.textEn: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or sacrifice a burnt offering that costs me nothing."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫称了六千八百四十克金子给阿珥楠，买了那块地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫称了六千八百四十克金子给阿珥楠，买了那块地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫为那块地平了六百舍客勒金子给阿珥楠。
verses.textEnNiv: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.
verses.textEnEsv: So David paid Ornan 600 shekels of gold by weight for the site.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
verses.textEnNlt: So David gave Araunah 600 pieces of gold in payment for the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNasb: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the site.
verses.textEn: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.

verses.textZh: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座祭坛，献上燔祭和平安祭；他呼求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，从天上降火在燔祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座祭坛，献上燔祭和平安祭；他呼求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，从天上降火在燔祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和华。耶和华就应允他，使火从天降在燔祭坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He called on the Lord , and the Lord answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And David built there an altar to the Lord and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings and called on the Lord , and the Lord answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the Lord; and He answered him from heaven by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: David built an altar there to the Lord and sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings. And when David prayed, the Lord answered him by sending fire from heaven to burn up the offering on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David built an altar there to the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. And he called to the Lord, and He answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEn: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He called on the Lord , and the Lord answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord commanded the angel, and he returned his sword to its sheath.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, who put the sword back into its sheath.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord commanded the angel, and he returned his sword to its sheath.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

verses.textZh: 那时，大卫见耶和华在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上应允了他，就在那里献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，大卫见耶和华在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上应允了他，就在那里献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，大卫见耶和华在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上应允了他，就在那里献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
verses.textEnNlt: When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered sacrifices there at Araunah’s threshing floor.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifice there.
verses.textEn: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.

verses.textZh: 摩西在旷野所做耶和华的帐幕和燔祭坛，那时都在基遍的高地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在旷野所做耶和华的帐幕和燔祭坛，那时都在基遍的高地，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在旷野所造之耶和华的帐幕和燔祭坛都在基遍的高处；
verses.textEnNiv: The tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: For the tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time in the high place at Gibeon,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the tabernacle of the Lord and the altar of the burnt offering, which Moses had made in the wilderness, were at that time at the high place in Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Tabernacle of the Lord and the altar of burnt offering that Moses had made in the wilderness were located at the place of worship in Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were on the high place at Gibeon at that time.
verses.textEn: The tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 只是大卫不敢上去求问神，因为惧怕耶和华使者的刀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是大卫不敢上去求问神，因为惧怕耶和华使者的刀。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是大卫不敢前去求问神，因为惧怕耶和华使者的刀。
verses.textEnNiv: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But David was not able to go there to inquire of God, because he was terrified by the drawn sword of the angel of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, for he was terrified by the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.textEn: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是大卫说："这就是耶和华神的殿，这就是给以色列人献燔祭的坛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫说："这就是耶和华神的殿，这就是给以色列人献燔祭的坛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫说："这就是耶和华神的殿，这就是给以色列人献燔祭的坛。"
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said, "The house of the LORD God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said, "Here shall be the house of the LORD God and here the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said, "This will be the location for the Temple of the LORD God and the place of the altar for Israel’s burnt offerings!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEn: Then David said, "The house of the LORD God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."

verses.textZh: 大卫吩咐人召集住在以色列地的外族人，又派石匠开凿石头，要建造神的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫吩咐人召集住在以色列地的外族人，又派石匠开凿石头，要建造神的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「这就是耶和华神的殿，为以色列人献燔祭的坛。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said, "The house of the Lord God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said, "Here shall be the house of the Lord God and here the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said, "This will be the location for the Temple of the Lord God and the place of the altar for Israel’s burnt offerings!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
verses.textEn: Then David said, "The house of the Lord God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."

verses.textZh: 大卫预备了大量的铁，做门扇上的钉子和钩子；又预备了大量的铜，多得无法可称；
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫预备了大量的铁，做门扇上的钉子和钩子；又预备了大量的铜，多得无法可称；
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，从其中派石匠凿石头，要建造神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: So David gave orders to assemble the foreigners residing in Israel, and from among them he appointed stonecutters to prepare dressed stone for building the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: David commanded to gather together the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel, and he set stonecutters to prepare dressed stones for building the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David commanded to gather the aliens who were in the land of Israel; and he appointed masons to cut hewn stones to build the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So David gave orders to call together the foreigners living in Israel, and he assigned them the task of preparing finished stone for building the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So David gave orders to gather the strangers who were in the land of Israel, and he set stonecutters to cut out stones to build the house of God.
verses.textEn: So David gave orders to assemble the foreigners residing in Israel, and from among them he appointed stonecutters to prepare dressed stone for building the house of God.

verses.textZh: 又预备了无数的香柏木，因为西顿人和推罗人给大卫运来了很多香柏木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又预备了无数的香柏木，因为西顿人和推罗人给大卫运来了很多香柏木。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫预备许多铁做门上的钉子和钩子，又预备许多铜，多得无法可称；
verses.textEnNiv: He provided a large amount of iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, and more bronze than could be weighed.
verses.textEnEsv: David also provided great quantities of iron for nails for the doors of the gates and for clamps, as well as bronze in quantities beyond weighing,
verses.textEnNkjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails of the doors of the gates and for the joints, and bronze in abundance beyond measure,
verses.textEnNlt: David provided large amounts of iron for the nails that would be needed for the doors in the gates and for the clamps, and he gave more bronze than could be weighed.
verses.textEnNasb: And David prepared large quantities of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gates and for the clamps, and more bronze than could be weighed;
verses.textEn: He provided a large amount of iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, and more bronze than could be weighed.

verses.textZh: 大卫心里说："我的儿子所罗门年幼识浅，要为耶和华建造的殿宇，必须宏伟辉煌，名声荣耀传遍各地，因此我必须为这殿预备材料。"于是大卫在未死以前，预备了很多材料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫心里说："我的儿子所罗门年幼识浅，要为耶和华建造的殿宇，必须宏伟辉煌，名声荣耀传遍各地，因此我必须为这殿预备材料。"于是大卫在未死以前，预备了很多材料。
verses.textZhCuv: 又预备无数的香柏木，因为西顿人和泰尔人给大卫运了许多香柏木来。
verses.textEnNiv: He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought large numbers of them to David.
verses.textEnEsv: and cedar timbers without number, for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought great quantities of cedar to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: and cedar trees in abundance; for the Sidonians and those from Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.textEnNlt: He also provided innumerable cedar logs, for the men of Tyre and Sidon had brought vast amounts of cedar to David.
verses.textEnNasb: and timbers of cedar beyond number, for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought large quantities of cedar timber to David.
verses.textEn: He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought large numbers of them to David.

verses.textZh: 大卫把他的儿子所罗门召了来，吩咐他要为耶和华以色列的神建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把他的儿子所罗门召了来，吩咐他要为耶和华以色列的神建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「我儿子所罗门还年幼娇嫩，要为耶和华建造的殿宇必须高大辉煌，使名誉荣耀传遍万国；所以我要为殿预备材料。」于是，大卫在未死之先预备的材料甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lord should be of great magnificence and fame and splendor in the sight of all the nations. Therefore I will make preparations for it." So David made extensive preparations before his death.
verses.textEnEsv: For David said, "Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for the Lord must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and glory throughout all lands. I will therefore make preparation for it." So David provided materials in great quantity before his death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David said, "Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lordmustbe exceedingly magnificent, famous and glorious throughout all countries. I will now make preparation for it." So David made abundant preparations before his death.
verses.textEnNlt: David said, "My son Solomon is still young and inexperienced. And since the Temple to be built for the Lord must be a magnificent structure, famous and glorious throughout the world, I will begin making preparations for it now." So David collected vast amounts of building materials before his death.
verses.textEnNasb: David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for the Lord shall be exceedingly magnificent, famous, and glorious throughout the lands. Therefore I now will make preparations for it." So David made ample preparations before his death.
verses.textEn: David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lord should be of great magnificence and fame and splendor in the sight of all the nations. Therefore I will make preparations for it." So David made extensive preparations before his death.

verses.textZh: 大卫对所罗门说："我儿啊，我心里原想为耶和华我的神的名建造殿宇，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对所罗门说："我儿啊，我心里原想为耶和华我的神的名建造殿宇，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫召了他儿子所罗门来，嘱咐他给耶和华－以色列的神建造殿宇，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he called for Solomon his son and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he called for his son Solomon, and charged him to build a house for the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David sent for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a Temple for the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he called for his son Solomon, and commanded him to build a house for the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 只是耶和华的话临到我说：‘你流了许多人的血，打了很多大仗；你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我面前流了许多人的血在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是耶和华的话临到我说：‘你流了许多人的血，打了很多大仗；你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我面前流了许多人的血在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 对所罗门说：「我儿啊，我心里本想为耶和华－我神的名建造殿宇，
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Solomon: "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house for the Name of the Lord my God.
verses.textEnEsv: David said to Solomon, "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house to the name of the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Solomon: "My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house to the name of the Lord my God;
verses.textEnNlt: "My son, I wanted to build a Temple to honor the name of the Lord my God," David told him.
verses.textEnNasb: David said to Solomon, "My son, I had intended to build a house for the name of the Lord my God.
verses.textEn: David said to Solomon: "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house for the Name of the Lord my God.

verses.textZh: 看哪，你必生一个儿子；他是个和平的人，我必使他得享太平，不被四围所有的仇敌骚扰；他的名字要叫所罗门，他在位的日子，我必把太平和安宁赐给以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，你必生一个儿子；他是个和平的人，我必使他得享太平，不被四围所有的仇敌骚扰；他的名字要叫所罗门，他在位的日子，我必把太平和安宁赐给以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是耶和华的话临到我说：『你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: But this word of the Lord came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and have fought many wars. You are not to build a house for my Name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
verses.textEnEsv: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have waged great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed so much blood before me on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the word of the Lord came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have made great wars; you shall not build a house for My name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in My sight.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the Lord said to me, ‘You have killed many men in the battles you have fought. And since you have shed so much blood in my sight, you will not be the one to build a Temple to honor my name.
verses.textEnNasb: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have waged great wars; you shall not build a house to My name, because you have shed so much blood on the earth before Me.
verses.textEn: But this word of the Lord came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and have fought many wars. You are not to build a house for my Name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

verses.textZh: 他要为我的名建造殿宇；他要作我的儿子，我要作他的父亲；我必坚立他的国位，永远统治以色列。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要为我的名建造殿宇；他要作我的儿子，我要作他的父亲；我必坚立他的国位，永远统治以色列。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你要生一个儿子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安静，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。他的名要叫所罗门 。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。
verses.textEnNiv: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace and rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side. His name will be Solomon, and I will grant Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, a son shall be born to you who shall be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his surrounding enemies. For his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies all around. His name shall be Solomon, for I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
verses.textEnNlt: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace. I will give him peace with his enemies in all the surrounding lands. His name will be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel during his reign.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, a son will be born to you, who shall be a man of rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.
verses.textEn: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace and rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side. His name will be Solomon, and I will grant Israel peace and quiet during his reign.

verses.textZh: 我儿啊，现在愿耶和华与你同在，使你亨通，照着他应许你，建造耶和华你的神的殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿啊，现在愿耶和华与你同在，使你亨通，照着他应许你，建造耶和华你的神的殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必为我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。』
verses.textEnNiv: He is the one who will build a house for my Name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
verses.textEnEsv: He shall build a house for my name. He shall be my son, and I will be his father, and I will establish his royal throne in Israel forever.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall build a house for My name, and he shall be My son, and I willbe his Father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
verses.textEnNlt: He is the one who will build a Temple to honor my name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will secure the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
verses.textEnNasb: He shall build a house for My name, and he shall be My son and I will be his Father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
verses.textEn: He is the one who will build a house for my Name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

verses.textZh: 深愿耶和华赐你聪明和智慧，使你治理以色列的时候，谨守耶和华你的神的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 深愿耶和华赐你聪明和智慧，使你治理以色列的时候，谨守耶和华你的神的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿啊，现今愿耶和华与你同在，使你亨通，照他指着你说的话，建造耶和华－你神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, my son, the Lord be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the Lord your God, as he said you would.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now, my son, the Lord be with you, so that you may succeed in building the house of the Lord your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, my son, may the Lord be with you; and may you prosper, and build the house of the Lord your God, as He has said to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, my son, may the Lord be with you and give you success as you follow his directions in building the Temple of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, my son, the Lord be with you that you may be successful, and build the house of the Lord your God just as He has spoken concerning you.
verses.textEn: "Now, my son, the Lord be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the Lord your God, as he said you would.

verses.textZh: 如果你谨守遵行耶和华吩咐摩西向以色列人颁布的律例和典章，这样你就必亨通。你要坚强勇敢，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你谨守遵行耶和华吩咐摩西向以色列人颁布的律例和典章，这样你就必亨通。你要坚强勇敢，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿耶和华赐你聪明智慧，好治理以色列国，遵行耶和华－你神的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord give you discretion and understanding when he puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Only, may the Lord grant you discretion and understanding, that when he gives you charge over Israel you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only may the Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and give you charge concerning Israel, that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord give you wisdom and understanding, that you may obey the Law of the Lord your God as you rule over Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Only the Lord give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: May the Lord give you discretion and understanding when he puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我辛辛苦苦为耶和华的殿预备了金子三千四百公吨，银子三万四千公吨，铜和铁多得无法可称；我又预备了木材和石头；你还可以增添。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我辛辛苦苦为耶和华的殿预备了金子三千四百公吨，银子三万四千公吨，铜和铁多得无法可称；我又预备了木材和石头；你还可以增添。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若谨守遵行耶和华藉摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will have success if you are careful to observe the decrees and laws that the Lord gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will prosper if you are careful to observe the statutes and the rules that the Lord commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Fear not; do not be dismayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will prosper, if you take care to fulfill the statutes and judgments with which the Lord charged Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and of good courage; do not fear nor be dismayed.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will be successful if you carefully obey the decrees and regulations that the Lord gave to Israel through Moses. Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or lose heart!
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will prosper, if you are careful to follow the statutes and the ordinances which the Lord commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous, do not fear nor be dismayed.
verses.textEn: Then you will have success if you are careful to observe the decrees and laws that the Lord gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

verses.textZh: 此外，你也有很多匠人：凿石的人、石匠、木匠和能作各样工作的巧手工人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，你也有很多匠人：凿石的人、石匠、木匠和能作各样工作的巧手工人，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在困难之中为耶和华的殿预备了金子十万他连得，银子一百万他连得，铜和铁多得无法可称；我也预备了木头、石头，你还可以增添。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, quantities of bronze and iron too great to be weighed, and wood and stone. And you may add to them.
verses.textEnEsv: With great pains I have provided for the house of the Lord 100,000 talents of gold, a million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond weighing, for there is so much of it; timber and stone, too, I have provided. To these you must add.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed I have taken much trouble to prepare for the house of the Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold and one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond measure, for it is so abundant. I have prepared timber and stone also, and you may add to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have worked hard to provide materials for building the Temple of the Lord —nearly 4,000 tons of gold, 40,000 tons of silver, and so much iron and bronze that it cannot be weighed. I have also gathered timber and stone for the walls, though you may need to add more.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, with great pains I have prepared for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond measure, for they are in great quantity; I have also prepared timber and stone, and you may add to that.
verses.textEn: "I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, quantities of bronze and iron too great to be weighed, and wood and stone. And you may add to them.

verses.textZh: 以及金匠、银匠、铜匠、铁匠，多得无法可数；你当起来作工，愿耶和华与你同在！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及金匠、银匠、铜匠、铁匠，多得无法可数；你当起来作工，愿耶和华与你同在！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你有许多匠人，就是石匠、木匠，和一切能做各样工的巧匠，
verses.textEnNiv: You have many workers: stonecutters, masons and carpenters, as well as those skilled in every kind of work
verses.textEnEsv: You have an abundance of workmen: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and all kinds of craftsmen without number, skilled in working
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover thereare workmen with you in abundance: woodsmen and stonecutters, and all types of skillful men for every kind of work.
verses.textEnNlt: You have a large number of skilled stonemasons and carpenters and craftsmen of every kind.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover there are many workmen with you, stonecutters, masons of stone, and carpenters; and all of them are skillful in every kind of work.
verses.textEn: You have many workers: stonecutters, masons and carpenters, as well as those skilled in every kind of work

verses.textZh: 大卫又吩咐以色列的众领袖帮助他的儿子所罗门，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又吩咐以色列的众领袖帮助他的儿子所罗门，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 并有无数的金银铜铁。你当起来办事，愿耶和华与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the Lord be with you."
verses.textEnEsv: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. Arise and work! The Lord be with you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Of gold and silver and bronze and iron thereis no limit. Arise and begin working, and the Lord be with you."
verses.textEnNlt: You have expert goldsmiths and silversmiths and workers of bronze and iron. Now begin the work, and may the Lord be with you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Of the gold, silver, bronze, and iron there is no limit. Arise and work, and may the Lord be with you."
verses.textEn: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the Lord be with you."

verses.textZh: "耶和华你们的神不是与你们同在吗？不是使你们四境都安宁吗？因为他已经把这地的居民交在我手中；这地在耶和华和他的子民面前被治服了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你们的神不是与你们同在吗？不是使你们四境都安宁吗？因为他已经把这地的居民交在我手中；这地在耶和华和他的子民面前被治服了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又吩咐以色列的众首领帮助他儿子所罗门，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to assist Solomon in this project.
verses.textEnNasb: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon, saying,
verses.textEn: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要立定心意，寻求耶和华你们的神；你们当起来，建造耶和华神的圣所，好把耶和华的约柜和神的神圣器皿，都搬进为耶和华的名所建造的殿宇中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要立定心意，寻求耶和华你们的神；你们当起来，建造耶和华神的圣所，好把耶和华的约柜和神的神圣器皿，都搬进为耶和华的名所建造的殿宇中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你们的神不是与你们同在吗？不是叫你们四围都平安吗？因他已将这地的居民交在我手中，这地就在耶和华与他百姓面前制伏了。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has he not granted you rest on every side? For he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hands, and the land is subject to the Lord and to his people.
verses.textEnEsv: "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has he not given you peace on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land is subdued before the Lord and his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land is subdued before the Lord and before His people.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord your God is with you," he declared. "He has given you peace with the surrounding nations. He has handed them over to me, and they are now subject to the Lord and his people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is the Lord your God not with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has handed over to me the inhabitants of the land, and the land is subdued before the Lord and before His people.
verses.textEn: He said to them, "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has he not granted you rest on every side? For he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hands, and the land is subject to the Lord and to his people.

verses.textZh: 现在你们应当立定心意，寻求耶和华－你们的神；也当起来建造耶和华神的圣所，好将耶和华的约柜和供奉神的圣器皿都搬进为耶和华名建造的殿里。」
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们应当立定心意，寻求耶和华－你们的神；也当起来建造耶和华神的圣所，好将耶和华的约柜和供奉神的圣器皿都搬进为耶和华名建造的殿里。」
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们应当立定心意，寻求耶和华－你们的神；也当起来建造耶和华神的圣所，好将耶和华的约柜和供奉神的圣器皿都搬进为耶和华名建造的殿里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now devote your heart and soul to seeking the Lord your God. Begin to build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the sacred articles belonging to God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Now set your mind and heart to seek the Lord your God. Arise and build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God may be brought into a house built for the name of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God. Therefore arise and build the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy articles of God into the house that is to be built for the name of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Now seek the Lord your God with all your heart and soul. Build the sanctuary of the Lord God so that you can bring the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant and the holy vessels of God into the Temple built to honor the Lord ’s name."
verses.textEnNasb: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; then arise, and build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the name of the Lord."
verses.textEn: Now devote your heart and soul to seeking the Lord your God. Begin to build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the sacred articles belonging to God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 大卫年老，寿数将尽的时候，就立他的儿子所罗门作王统治以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫年老，寿数将尽的时候，就立他的儿子所罗门作王统治以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫年纪老迈，日子满足，就立他儿子所罗门作以色列的王。
verses.textEnNiv: When David was old and full of years, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: When David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When David was an old man, he appointed his son Solomon to be king over Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when David reached old age, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
verses.textEn: When David was old and full of years, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫召集了以色列的众领袖、祭司和利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫召集了以色列的众领袖、祭司和利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫招聚以色列的众首领和祭司利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: He also gathered together all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: David assembled all the leaders of Israel and the priests and the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he gathered together all the leaders of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: David summoned all the leaders of Israel, together with the priests and Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: And he gathered together all the leaders of Israel with the priests and the Levites.
verses.textEn: He also gathered together all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.

verses.textZh: 利未人自三十岁及以上的都被数点；按统计，他们男丁的数目，共有三万八千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人自三十岁及以上的都被数点；按统计，他们男丁的数目，共有三万八千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人从三十岁以外的都被数点，他们男丁的数目共有三万八千；
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites thirty years old or more were counted, and the total number of men was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: The Levites, thirty years old and upward, were numbered, and the total was 38,000 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and above; and the number of individual males was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: All the Levites who were thirty years old or older were counted, and the total came to 38,000.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward, and their number by head count of men was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.textEn: The Levites thirty years old or more were counted, and the total number of men was thirty-eight thousand.

verses.textZh: 其中有二万四千人，监管耶和华殿宇的工作；有六千人作官长和审判官；
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中有二万四千人，监管耶和华殿宇的工作；有六千人作官长和审判官；
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有二万四千人管理耶和华殿的事，有六千人作官长和士师，
verses.textEnNiv: David said, "Of these, twenty-four thousand are to be in charge of the work of the temple of the Lord and six thousand are to be officials and judges.
verses.textEnEsv: "Twenty-four thousand of these," David said, "shall have charge of the work in the house of the Lord , 6,000 shall be officers and judges,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to look after the work of the house of the Lord, six thousand were officers and judges,
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said, "From all the Levites, 24,000 will supervise the work at the Temple of the Lord . Another 6,000 will serve as officials and judges.
verses.textEnNasb: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges,
verses.textEn: David said, "Of these, twenty-four thousand are to be in charge of the work of the temple of the Lord and six thousand are to be officials and judges.

verses.textZh: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做 的乐器赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做 的乐器赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做的乐器颂赞耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Four thousand are to be gatekeepers and four thousand are to praise the Lord with the musical instruments I have provided for that purpose."
verses.textEnEsv: 4,000 gatekeepers, and 4,000 shall offer praises to the Lord with the instruments that I have made for praise."
verses.textEnNkjv: four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the Lord with musical instruments, "which I made," saidDavid, "for giving praise."
verses.textEnNlt: Another 4,000 will work as gatekeepers, and 4,000 will praise the Lord with the musical instruments I have made."
verses.textEnNasb: and four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand were praising the Lord with the instruments which David made for giving praise.
verses.textEn: Four thousand are to be gatekeepers and four thousand are to praise the Lord with the musical instruments I have provided for that purpose."

verses.textZh: 大卫把利未的儿子革顺、哥辖和米拉利的子孙，分成班次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把利未的儿子革顺、哥辖和米拉利的子孙，分成班次。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫将利未人革顺、哥辖、米拉利的子孙分了班次。
verses.textEnNiv: David separated the Levites into divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
verses.textEnEsv: And David organized them in divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also David separated them into divisions among the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David divided the Levites into divisions named after the clans descended from the three sons of Levi—Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEn: David separated the Levites into divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙 有拉但和示每。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的子孙 有拉但和示每。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的子孙有拉但和示每。
verses.textEnNiv: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Gershon were Ladan and Shimei.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Gershonites: Laadan and Shimei.
verses.textEnNlt: The Gershonite family units were defined by their lines of descent from Libni and Shimei, the sons of Gershon.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the Gershonites there were Ladan and Shimei.
verses.textEn: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

verses.textZh: 拉但的儿子是：长子耶歇，还有西坦和约珥，共三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉但的儿子是：长子耶歇，还有西坦和约珥，共三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉但的长子是耶歇，还有细坦和约珥，共三人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham and Joel—three in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Laadan: the first Jehiel, then Zetham and Joel—three inall.
verses.textEnNlt: Three of the descendants of Libni were Jehiel (the family leader), Zetham, and Joel.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ladan were Jehiel the first, and Zetham and Joel, three.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham and Joel—three in all.

verses.textZh: 示每的儿子有示罗密、哈薛和哈兰，共三人。以上这些人是拉但家族的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示每的儿子有示罗密、哈薛和哈兰，共三人。以上这些人是拉但家族的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 示每的儿子是示罗密、哈薛、哈兰三人。这是拉但族的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ houses of Ladan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran—three inall. These were the heads of the fathers’ houses of Laadan.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the leaders of the family of Libni. Three of the descendants of Shimei were Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shimei were Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.

verses.textZh: 示每的儿子是雅哈、细拿、耶乌施和比利亚；这四人都是示每的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示每的儿子是雅哈、细拿、耶乌施和比利亚；这四人都是示每的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 示每的儿子是雅哈、细拿、耶乌施、比利亚共四人。
verses.textEnNiv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the four sons of Shimei.
verses.textEnNlt: Four other descendants of Shimei were Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shimei were Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.textEn: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.

verses.textZh: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子；耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以合为一个家族，同归一个班次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子；耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以合为一个家族，同归一个班次。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子。但耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以算为一族。
verses.textEnNiv: Jahath was the first and Ziza the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; so they were counted as one family with one assignment.
verses.textEnEsv: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, therefore they became counted as a single father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jahath was the first and Zizah the second. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; therefore they were assigned as one father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Jahath was the family leader, and Ziza was next. Jeush and Beriah were counted as a single family because neither had many sons.
verses.textEnNasb: Jahath was the first and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they became a father’s household, one group for duty.
verses.textEn: Jahath was the first and Ziza the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; so they were counted as one family with one assignment.

verses.textZh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦和乌薛，共四人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦和乌薛，共四人。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛共四人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel—four in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four inall.
verses.textEnNlt: Four of the descendants of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Kohath were four in number: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel—four in all.

verses.textZh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦和摩西。亚伦和他的子孙永远被分别出来，献上至圣之物；在耶和华面前烧香，服事他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦和摩西。亚伦和他的子孙永远被分别出来，献上至圣之物；在耶和华面前烧香，服事他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西。亚伦和他的子孙分出来，好分别至圣的物，在耶和华面前烧香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his descendants forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices before the Lord , to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart to dedicate the most holy things, that he and his sons forever should make offerings before the Lord and minister to him and pronounce blessings in his name forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was set apart, he and his sons forever, that he should sanctify the most holy things, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister to Him, and to give the blessing in His name forever.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Amram were Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart to dedicate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices in the Lord ’s presence, to serve the Lord , and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Amram were Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was set apart to sanctify him as most holy, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the Lord, to serve Him and bless in His name forever.
verses.textEn: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his descendants forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices before the Lord , to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.

verses.textZh: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙记在利未支派的册上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙记在利未支派的册上。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙名字记在利未支派的册上。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Moses the man of God were counted as part of the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnEsv: But the sons of Moses the man of God were named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sons of Moses the man of God were reckoned to the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnNlt: As for Moses, the man of God, his sons were included with the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for Moses, the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEn: The sons of Moses the man of God were counted as part of the tribe of Levi.

verses.textZh: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Moses were Gershon and Eliezer.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Moses were Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Moses were Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.textEn: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.textZh: 革舜的长子是细布业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革舜的长子是细布业。
verses.textZhCuv: 革舜的长子是细布业；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Gershom: Shubael was the first.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Gershon, Shebuel was the first.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershom included Shebuel, the family leader.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Gershom was Shebuel the chief.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Gershom: Shubael was the first.

verses.textZh: 以利以谢的第一个儿子是利哈比雅；以利以谢没有别的儿子，利哈比雅却有很多儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利以谢的第一个儿子是利哈比雅；以利以谢没有别的儿子，利哈比雅却有很多儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅。以利以谢没有别的儿子，但利哈比雅的子孙甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the descendants of Eliezer, Rehabiah was the first. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.textEnNlt: Eliezer had only one son, Rehabiah, the family leader. Rehabiah had numerous descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.

verses.textZh: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Izhar, Shelomith was the first.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Izhar included Shelomith, the family leader.
verses.textEnNasb: The son of Izhar was Shelomith the chief.
verses.textEn: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.

verses.textZh: 希伯伦的儿子是：长子耶利雅、次子亚玛利亚、三子雅哈悉、四子耶加面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯伦的儿子是：长子耶利雅、次子亚玛利亚、三子雅哈悉、四子耶加面。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯伦的长子是耶利雅，次子是亚玛利亚，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Hebron included Jeriah (the family leader), Amariah (the second), Jahaziel (the third), and Jekameam (the fourth).
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Hebron were Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEn: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.textZh: 乌薛的儿子是：长子米迦、次子耶西雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌薛的儿子是：长子米迦、次子耶西雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌薛的长子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first and Ishiah the second.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief and Isshiah the second.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah was the first and Jesshiah the second.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Uzziel included Micah (the family leader) and Isshiah (the second).
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Uzziel were Micah the first and Isshiah the second.
verses.textEn: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first and Ishiah the second.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示；抹利的儿子是以利亚撒和基士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示；抹利的儿子是以利亚撒和基士。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。抹利的儿子是以利亚撒、基士。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Merari included Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.
verses.textEn: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

verses.textZh: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿；基士的儿子们，就是他们的亲族，娶了她们为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿；基士的儿子们，就是他们的亲族，娶了她们为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿，他们本族基士的儿子娶了她们为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Eleazar died without having sons: he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
verses.textEnEsv: Eleazar died having no sons, but only daughters; their kinsmen, the sons of Kish, married them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but only daughters; and their brethren, the sons of Kish, took them aswives.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar died with no sons, only daughters. His daughters married their cousins, the sons of Kish.
verses.textEnNasb: Eleazar died and had no sons, but only daughters; so their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
verses.textEn: Eleazar died without having sons: he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.

verses.textZh: 母示的儿子是末力、以得和耶利摩，共三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 母示的儿子是末力、以得和耶利摩，共三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth—three in all.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three inall.
verses.textEnNlt: Three of the descendants of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Mushi were three: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
verses.textEn: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth—three in all.

verses.textZh: 以上这些是利未的子孙，按着他们的家族，各家的首领，照着男丁名字的数目被数点，二十岁及以上的，都是办理耶和华殿的事务的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些是利未的子孙，按着他们的家族，各家的首领，照着男丁名字的数目被数点，二十岁及以上的，都是办理耶和华殿的事务的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上利未子孙作族长的，照着男丁的数目，从二十岁以外，都办耶和华殿的事务。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families as they were registered under their names and counted individually, that is, the workers twenty years old or more who served in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: These were the sons of Levi by their fathers’ houses, the heads of fathers’ houses as they were listed according to the number of the names of the individuals from twenty years old and upward who were to do the work for the service of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Levi by their fathers’ houses—the heads of the fathers’ houses as they were counted individually by the number of their names, who did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and above.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the descendants of Levi by clans, the leaders of their family groups, registered carefully by name. Each had to be twenty years old or older to qualify for service in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: These were the sons of Levi according to their fathers’ households, the heads of the fathers’ households of those among them who were counted, in the number of names by their head count, doing the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.textEn: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families as they were registered under their names and counted individually, that is, the workers twenty years old or more who served in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因为大卫曾说："耶和华以色列的神已经使他的子民得享安宁，他自己永远住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为大卫曾说："耶和华以色列的神已经使他的子民得享安宁，他自己永远住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「耶和华－以色列的神已经使他的百姓平安，他永远住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: For David had said, "Since the Lord , the God of Israel, has granted rest to his people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever,
verses.textEnEsv: For David said, "The Lord , the God of Israel, has given rest to his people, and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: For David said, "The Lord God of Israel has given rest to His people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever";
verses.textEnNlt: For David said, "The Lord , the God of Israel, has given us peace, and he will always live in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For David said, "The Lord God of Israel has given rest to His people, and He dwells in Jerusalem forever.
verses.textEn: For David had said, "Since the Lord , the God of Israel, has granted rest to his people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever,

verses.textZh: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所使用的一切器皿了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所使用的一切器皿了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」
verses.textEnNiv: the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles used in its service."
verses.textEnEsv: And so the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the things for its service."
verses.textEnNkjv: and also to the Levites, "They shall no longer carry the tabernacle, or any of the articles for its service."
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Levites will no longer need to carry the Tabernacle and its furnishings from place to place."
verses.textEnNasb: Also, the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its utensils for its service."
verses.textEn: the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles used in its service."

verses.textZh: 按着大卫临终所吩咐的话，利未人从二十岁起的都被数点了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着大卫临终所吩咐的话，利未人从二十岁起的都被数点了。
verses.textZhCuv: 照着大卫临终所吩咐的，利未人从二十岁以外的都被数点。
verses.textEnNiv: According to the last instructions of David, the Levites were counted from those twenty years old or more.
verses.textEnEsv: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered from twenty years old and upward.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above;
verses.textEnNlt: In accordance with David’s final instructions, all the Levites twenty years old or older were registered for service.
verses.textEnNasb: For by the last words of David, the sons of Levi were counted from twenty years old and upward.
verses.textEn: According to the last instructions of David, the Levites were counted from those twenty years old or more.

verses.textZh: 他们的职任是协助亚伦的子孙，办理耶和华殿的事务，管理院子、厢房和洁净一切圣物，以及办理神殿的事务；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的职任是协助亚伦的子孙，办理耶和华殿的事务，管理院子、厢房和洁净一切圣物，以及办理神殿的事务；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的职任是服事亚伦的子孙，在耶和华的殿和院子，并屋中办事，洁净一切圣物，就是办神殿的事务，
verses.textEnNiv: The duty of the Levites was to help Aaron’s descendants in the service of the temple of the Lord : to be in charge of the courtyards, the side rooms, the purification of all sacred things and the performance of other duties at the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For their duty was to assist the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord , having the care of the courts and the chambers, the cleansing of all that is holy, and any work for the service of the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: because their duty was to help the sons of Aaron in the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts and in the chambers, in the purifying of all holy things and the work of the service of the house of God,
verses.textEnNlt: The work of the Levites was to assist the priests, the descendants of Aaron, as they served at the house of the Lord . They also took care of the courtyards and side rooms, helped perform the ceremonies of purification, and served in many other ways in the house of God.
verses.textEnNasb: For their office is to assist the sons of Aaron with the service of the house of the Lord, in the courtyards and in the chambers, and in the purification of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God,
verses.textEn: The duty of the Levites was to help Aaron’s descendants in the service of the temple of the Lord : to be in charge of the courtyards, the side rooms, the purification of all sacred things and the performance of other duties at the house of God.

verses.textZh: 又管 理陈设饼、素祭细面，或无酵薄饼，或是煎盘烤的，或是用油调和的，以及管理各种量度的器具。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又管 理陈设饼、素祭细面，或无酵薄饼，或是煎盘烤的，或是用油调和的，以及管理各种量度的器具。
verses.textZhCuv: 并管理陈设饼，素祭的细面，或无酵薄饼，或用盘烤，或用油调和的物，又管理各样的升斗尺度；
verses.textEnNiv: They were in charge of the bread set out on the table, the special flour for the grain offerings, the thin loaves made without yeast, the baking and the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
verses.textEnEsv: Their duty was also to assist with the showbread, the flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil, and all measures of quantity or size.
verses.textEnNkjv: both with the showbread and the fine flour for the grain offering, with the unleavened cakes and whatisbakedin the pan, with what is mixed and with all kinds of measures and sizes;
verses.textEnNlt: They were in charge of the sacred bread that was set out on the table, the choice flour for the grain offerings, the wafers made without yeast, the cakes cooked in olive oil, and the other mixed breads. They were also responsible to check all the weights and measures.
verses.textEnNasb: and with the showbread, and the fine flour for a grain offering, and unleavened wafers, or what is baked in the pan or what is well-mixed, and all measures of volume and size.
verses.textEn: They were in charge of the bread set out on the table, the special flour for the grain offerings, the thin loaves made without yeast, the baking and the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.

verses.textZh: 每天早晨要侍立称谢和赞美耶和华，每天晚上也要这样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 每天早晨要侍立称谢和赞美耶和华，每天晚上也要这样；
verses.textZhCuv: 每日早晚，站立称谢赞美耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: They were also to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord . They were to do the same in the evening
verses.textEnEsv: And they were to stand every morning, thanking and praising the Lord , and likewise at evening,
verses.textEnNkjv: to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at evening;
verses.textEnNlt: And each morning and evening they stood before the Lord to sing songs of thanks and praise to him.
verses.textEnNasb: They are to stand every morning to thank and to praise the Lord, and likewise at evening,
verses.textEn: They were also to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord . They were to do the same in the evening

verses.textZh: 又要在安息日，每月初一日和指定的节日，按着数目照着规例，把燔祭不住地献在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要在安息日，每月初一日和指定的节日，按着数目照着规例，把燔祭不住地献在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在安息日、月朔，并节期，按数照例，将燔祭常常献给耶和华；
verses.textEnNiv: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the Lord on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals. They were to serve before the Lord regularly in the proper number and in the way prescribed for them.
verses.textEnEsv: and whenever burnt offerings were offered to the Lord on Sabbaths, new moons, and feast days, according to the number required of them, regularly before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and at every presentation of a burnt offering to the Lord on the Sabbaths and on the New Moons and on the set feasts, by number according to the ordinance governing them, regularly before the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: They assisted with the burnt offerings that were presented to the Lord on Sabbath days, at new moon celebrations, and at all the appointed festivals. The required number of Levites served in the Lord ’s presence at all times, following all the procedures they had been given.
verses.textEnNasb: and to offer all burnt offerings to the Lord, on the Sabbaths, the new moons and the appointed festivals, in the number determined by the ordinance concerning them, continually before the Lord.
verses.textEn: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the Lord on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals. They were to serve before the Lord regularly in the proper number and in the way prescribed for them.

verses.textZh: 他们要看守会幕和圣所，以及看管他们在耶和华殿里办事的亲族，亚伦的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要看守会幕和圣所，以及看管他们在耶和华殿里办事的亲族，亚伦的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 又看守会幕和圣所，并守耶和华吩咐他们弟兄亚伦子孙的，办耶和华殿的事。
verses.textEnNiv: And so the Levites carried out their responsibilities for the tent of meeting, for the Holy Place and, under their relatives the descendants of Aaron, for the service of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Thus they were to keep charge of the tent of meeting and the sanctuary, and to attend the sons of Aaron, their brothers, for the service of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and that they should attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, the needs of the holy place, and the needs of the sons of Aaron their brethren in the work of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And so, under the supervision of the priests, the Levites watched over the Tabernacle and the Temple and faithfully carried out their duties of service at the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So they are to perform the duties of the tent of meeting, the holy place, and of assisting the sons of Aaron their relatives, for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And so the Levites carried out their responsibilities for the tent of meeting, for the Holy Place and, under their relatives the descendants of Aaron, for the service of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伦子孙的班次如下：亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒和以他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦子孙的班次如下：亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒和以他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦子孙的班次记在下面：亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron: The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: The divisions of the sons of Aaron were these. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now theseare the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: This is how Aaron’s descendants, the priests, were divided into groups for service. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the divisions of the descendants of Aaron were these: the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEn: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron: The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.textZh: 拿答和亚比户比他们的父亲早死，又没有儿子；所以以利亚撒和以他玛作了祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿答和亚比户比他们的父亲早死，又没有儿子；所以以利亚撒和以他玛作了祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿答、亚比户死在他们父亲之先，没有留下儿子；故此，以利亚撒、以他玛供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.
verses.textEnEsv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar became the priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and they had no sons. So only Eleazar and Ithamar were left to carry on as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
verses.textEn: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.

verses.textZh: 大卫和以利亚撒的子孙撒督，以及以他玛的子孙亚希米勒，把他们的亲族分开班次，按着他们的职责服事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和以利亚撒的子孙撒督，以及以他玛的子孙亚希米勒，把他们的亲族分开班次，按着他们的职责服事。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚撒的子孙撒督和以他玛的子孙亚希米勒，同着大卫将他们的族弟兄分成班次。
verses.textEnNiv: With the help of Zadok a descendant of Eleazar and Ahimelek a descendant of Ithamar, David separated them into divisions for their appointed order of ministering.
verses.textEnEsv: With the help of Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, David organized them according to the appointed duties in their service.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to the schedule of their service.
verses.textEnNlt: With the help of Zadok, who was a descendant of Eleazar, and of Ahimelech, who was a descendant of Ithamar, David divided Aaron’s descendants into groups according to their various duties.
verses.textEnNasb: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their offices for their ministry.
verses.textEn: With the help of Zadok a descendant of Eleazar and Ahimelek a descendant of Ithamar, David separated them into divisions for their appointed order of ministering.

verses.textZh: 后来发现以利亚撒的子孙中，比以他玛的子孙有更多作首领的，就把他们分开班次；以利亚撒子孙中作首领的，按着他们的家族有十六人；以他玛子孙中作首领的，按着他们的家族有八人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来发现以利亚撒的子孙中，比以他玛的子孙有更多作首领的，就把他们分开班次；以利亚撒子孙中作首领的，按着他们的家族有十六人；以他玛子孙中作首领的，按着他们的家族有八人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚撒子孙中为首的比以他玛子孙中为首的更多，分班如下：以利亚撒的子孙中有十六个族长，以他玛的子孙中有八个族长；
verses.textEnNiv: A larger number of leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than among Ithamar’s, and they were divided accordingly: sixteen heads of families from Eleazar’s descendants and eight heads of families from Ithamar’s descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: Since more chief men were found among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar, they organized them under sixteen heads of fathers’ houses of the sons of Eleazar, and eight of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were more leaders found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar were sixteen heads of their fathers’ houses, and eight heads of their fathers’ houses among the sons of Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar’s descendants were divided into sixteen groups and Ithamar’s into eight, for there were more family leaders among the descendants of Eleazar.
verses.textEnNasb: Since more chief men were found from the descendants of Eleazar than the descendants of Ithamar, they divided them this way: there were sixteen heads of fathers’ households of the descendants of Eleazar, and eight of the descendants of Ithamar according to their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: A larger number of leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than among Ithamar’s, and they were divided accordingly: sixteen heads of families from Eleazar’s descendants and eight heads of families from Ithamar’s descendants.

verses.textZh: 以抽签的方式平均地把他们分开，因为在以利亚撒的子孙中和以他玛的子孙中都有人在圣所作领袖，以及在神面前作领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以抽签的方式平均地把他们分开，因为在以利亚撒的子孙中和以他玛的子孙中都有人在圣所作领袖，以及在神面前作领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 都掣签分立，彼此一样。在圣所和神面前作首领的有以利亚撒的子孙，也有以他玛的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: They divided them impartially by casting lots, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: They divided them by lot, all alike, for there were sacred officers and officers of God among both the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they were divided by lot, one group as another, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials ofthehouse of God, from the sons of Eleazar and from the sons of Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: All tasks were assigned to the various groups by means of sacred lots so that no preference would be shown, for there were many qualified officials serving God in the sanctuary from among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNasb: So they were divided by lot, the one as the other; for they were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God, both from the descendants of Eleazar and the descendants of Ithamar.
verses.textEn: They divided them impartially by casting lots, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.textZh: 作书记的利未人拿坦业的儿子示玛雅，在君王、领袖、撒督祭司、亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒，以及众祭司家族和利未家族的首领面前，把他们的名字记录下来。在以利亚撒的子孙中，有一家族被选取了；在以他玛的子孙中，也有一家族被选取了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作书记的利未人拿坦业的儿子示玛雅，在君王、领袖、撒督祭司、亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒，以及众祭司家族和利未家族的首领面前，把他们的名字记录下来。在以利亚撒的子孙中，有一家族被选取了；在以他玛的子孙中，也有一家族被选取了。
verses.textZhCuv: 作书记的利未人拿坦业的儿子示玛雅在王和首领，与祭司撒督、亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒，并祭司利未人的族长面前记录他们的名字。在以利亚撒的子孙中取一族，在以他玛的子孙中取一族。
verses.textEnNiv: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officials: Zadok the priest, Ahimelek son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar and then one from Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the scribe Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded them in the presence of the king and the princes and Zadok the priest and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and of the Levites, one father’s house being chosen for Eleazar and one chosen for Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the scribe, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel, oneof the Levites, wrote them down before the king, the leaders, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and Levites, one father’s house taken for Eleazar and one for Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, acted as secretary and wrote down the names and assignments in the presence of the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites. The descendants of Eleazar and Ithamar took turns casting lots.
verses.textEnNasb: Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, from the Levites, recorded them in the presence of the king, the leaders, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and the Levites; one father’s household taken for Eleazar and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.textEn: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officials: Zadok the priest, Ahimelek son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar and then one from Ithamar.
