verses.textZh: 这就是他们的班次，是照着耶和华以色列的神借着他们的祖宗亚伦所吩咐的条例，进入耶和华的殿，办理事务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是他们的班次，是照着耶和华以色列的神借着他们的祖宗亚伦所吩咐的条例，进入耶和华的殿，办理事务。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是他们的班次，要照耶和华－以色列的神藉他们祖宗亚伦所吩咐的条例进入耶和华的殿办理事务。
verses.textEnNiv: This was their appointed order of ministering when they entered the temple of the Lord , according to the regulations prescribed for them by their ancestor Aaron, as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: These had as their appointed duty in their service to come into the house of the Lord according to the procedure established for them by Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the schedule of their service for coming into the house of the Lord according to their ordinance by the hand of Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: Each group carried out its appointed duties in the house of the Lord according to the procedures established by their ancestor Aaron in obedience to the commands of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: These were their offices for their ministry when they entered the house of the Lord according to the ordinance given to them through their father Aaron, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.textEn: This was their appointed order of ministering when they entered the temple of the Lord , according to the regulations prescribed for them by their ancestor Aaron, as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded him.

verses.textZh: 利未还有其他子孙：暗兰的子孙中有书巴业；书巴业的子孙中有耶希底亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未还有其他子孙：暗兰的子孙中有书巴业；书巴业的子孙中有耶希底亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未其余的子孙如下：暗兰的子孙里有书巴业；书巴业的子孙里有耶希底亚。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the rest of the descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
verses.textEnEsv: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the other family leaders descended from Levi: From the descendants of Amram, the leader was Shebuel. From the descendants of Shebuel, the leader was Jehdeiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now for the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.textEn: As for the rest of the descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.

verses.textZh: 至于利哈比雅：利哈比雅的众子中，长子是伊示雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于利哈比雅：利哈比雅的众子中，长子是伊示雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 利哈比雅的子孙里有长子伊示雅。
verses.textEnNiv: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: Ishiah was the first.
verses.textEnEsv: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
verses.textEnNkjv: Concerning Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Rehabiah, the leader was Isshiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah, the first.
verses.textEn: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: Ishiah was the first.

verses.textZh: 以斯哈的众子中有示罗摩；示罗摩的众子中有雅哈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯哈的众子中有示罗摩；示罗摩的众子中有雅哈。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯哈的子孙里有示罗摩；示罗摩的子孙里有雅哈。
verses.textEnNiv: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Izhar, the leader was Shelomith. From the descendants of Shelomith, the leader was Jahath.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.textEn: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.

verses.textZh: 希伯伦的儿子是：长子耶利雅 、次子亚玛利亚、三子雅哈悉、四子耶加面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯伦的儿子是：长子耶利雅 、次子亚玛利亚、三子雅哈悉、四子耶加面。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯伦的子孙里有长子耶利雅，次子亚玛利亚，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah wasthefirst, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Hebron, Jeriah was the leader, Amariah was second, Jahaziel was third, and Jekameam was fourth.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.textEn: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.textZh: 乌薛的众子中有米迦；米迦的众子中有沙密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌薛的众子中有米迦；米迦的众子中有沙密。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌薛的子孙里有米迦；米迦的子孙里有沙密。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah; of the sons of Michah, Shamir.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Uzziel, the leader was Micah. From the descendants of Micah, the leader was Shamir,
verses.textEnNasb: Of the sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.textEn: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.

verses.textZh: 米迦的兄弟是耶西雅；耶西雅的众子中有撒迦利雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦的兄弟是耶西雅；耶西雅的众子中有撒迦利雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孙里有撒迦利雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The brother of Micah: Ishiah; from the sons of Ishiah: Zechariah.
verses.textEnEsv: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The brother of Michah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.textEnNlt: along with Isshiah, the brother of Micah. From the descendants of Isshiah, the leader was Zechariah.
verses.textEnNasb: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.textEn: The brother of Micah: Ishiah; from the sons of Ishiah: Zechariah.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示、雅西雅；雅西雅的儿子是比挪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示、雅西雅；雅西雅的儿子是比挪。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示、雅西雅；雅西雅的儿子有比挪；
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziah: Beno.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi; the son of Jaaziah, Beno.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Merari, the leaders were Mahli and Mushi. From the descendants of Jaaziah, the leader was Beno.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Merari, Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, Beno.
verses.textEn: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的众子中有雅西雅的儿子比挪、朔含、撒刻和伊比利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的众子中有雅西雅的儿子比挪、朔含、撒刻和伊比利。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的子孙里有雅西雅的儿子比挪、朔含、撒刻、伊比利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Merari: from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zakkur and Ibri.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Merari through Jaaziah, the leaders were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Merari: by Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.textEn: The sons of Merari: from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zakkur and Ibri.

verses.textZh: 抹利的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒没有儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抹利的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒没有儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 抹利的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒没有儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.textEnEsv: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Mahli, the leader was Eleazar, though he had no sons.
verses.textEnNasb: By Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.textEn: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.textZh: 至于基士：基士的众子中有耶拉篾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于基士：基士的众子中有耶拉篾。
verses.textZhCuv: 基士的子孙里有耶拉篾。
verses.textEnNiv: From Kish: the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnEsv: Of Kish, the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Kish: the son of Kish, Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Kish, the leader was Jerahmeel.
verses.textEnNasb: By Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
verses.textEn: From Kish: the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

verses.textZh: 母示的儿子是末力、以得和耶利摩；以上这些都是利未的子孙，按着他们的家族记录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 母示的儿子是末力、以得和耶利摩；以上这些都是利未的子孙，按着他们的家族记录。
verses.textZhCuv: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩。按着宗族这都是利未的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. These were the Levites, according to their families.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: From the descendants of Mushi, the leaders were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi in their various families.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. These were the Levites, according to their families.

verses.textZh: 他们在大卫王、撒督、亚希米勒，以及祭司和利未人的家族首领面前也抽了签，好象他们的亲族亚伦的子孙一样；各家族首领和他们年幼的兄弟都一样抽了签。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在大卫王、撒督、亚希米勒，以及祭司和利未人的家族首领面前也抽了签，好象他们的亲族亚伦的子孙一样；各家族首领和他们年幼的兄弟都一样抽了签。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在大卫王和撒督，并亚希米勒与祭司利未人的族长面前掣签，正如他们弟兄亚伦的子孙一般。各族的长者与兄弟没有分别。
verses.textEnNiv: They also cast lots, just as their relatives the descendants of Aaron did, in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelek, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.
verses.textEnEsv: These also, the head of each father’s house and his younger brother alike, cast lots, just as their brothers the sons of Aaron, in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of fathers’ houses of the priests and of the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: These also cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aaron did, in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and Levites. The chief fathers did just as their younger brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Like the descendants of Aaron, they were assigned to their duties by means of sacred lots, without regard to age or rank. Lots were drawn in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: These also cast lots just as their relatives, the sons of Aaron did in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites—the head of fathers’ households as well as those of his younger brother.
verses.textEn: They also cast lots, just as their relatives the descendants of Aaron did, in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelek, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.

verses.textZh: 大卫和军队的领袖，也给亚萨、希幔和耶杜顿的子孙分派了任务，叫他们用琴瑟响钹说预言。他们任职的人数如下：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和军队的领袖，也给亚萨、希幔和耶杜顿的子孙分派了任务，叫他们用琴瑟响钹说预言。他们任职的人数如下：
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和众首领分派亚萨、希幔，并耶杜顿的子孙弹琴、鼓瑟、敲钹、唱歌 。他们供职的人数记在下面：
verses.textEnNiv: David, together with the commanders of the army, set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophesying, accompanied by harps, lyres and cymbals. Here is the list of the men who performed this service:
verses.textEnEsv: David and the chiefs of the service also set apart for the service the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who prophesied with lyres, with harps, and with cymbals. The list of those who did the work and of their duties was:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover David and the captains of the army separated for the service some of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, stringed instruments, and cymbals. And the number of the skilled men performing their service was:
verses.textEnNlt: David and the army commanders then appointed men from the families of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to proclaim God’s messages to the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. Here is a list of their names and their work:
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, David and the commanders of the army set apart for the service some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals; and the number of those who performed this service was:
verses.textEn: David, together with the commanders of the army, set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophesying, accompanied by harps, lyres and cymbals. Here is the list of the men who performed this service:

verses.textZh: 亚萨的儿子有撒刻、约瑟、尼探雅和亚萨利拉；亚萨的儿子都归亚萨指挥，遵照王的旨意说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的儿子有撒刻、约瑟、尼探雅和亚萨利拉；亚萨的儿子都归亚萨指挥，遵照王的旨意说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚萨的儿子撒刻、约瑟、尼探雅、亚萨利拉都归亚萨指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。
verses.textEnNiv: From the sons of Asaph: Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. The sons of Asaph were under the supervision of Asaph, who prophesied under the king’s supervision.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah, sons of Asaph, under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah; the sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: From the sons of Asaph, there were Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. They worked under the direction of their father, Asaph, who proclaimed God’s messages by the king’s orders.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah; the sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.
verses.textEn: From the sons of Asaph: Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. The sons of Asaph were under the supervision of Asaph, who prophesied under the king’s supervision.

verses.textZh: 至于耶杜顿，他的儿子有基大利、西利、耶筛亚、示每、哈沙比雅和玛他提雅，共六人，都归他们 的父亲耶杜顿指挥。耶杜顿用琴说预言，称谢和赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于耶杜顿，他的儿子有基大利、西利、耶筛亚、示每、哈沙比雅和玛他提雅，共六人，都归他们 的父亲耶杜顿指挥。耶杜顿用琴说预言，称谢和赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶杜顿的儿子基大利、西利、耶筛亚、哈沙比雅、玛他提雅、示每共六人，都归他们父亲耶杜顿指教，弹琴，唱歌，称谢，颂赞耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: As for Jeduthun, from his sons: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all, under the supervision of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied, using the harp in thanking and praising the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre in thanksgiving and praise to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: From the sons of Jeduthun, there were Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six in all. They worked under the direction of their father, Jeduthun, who proclaimed God’s messages to the accompaniment of the lyre, offering thanks and praise to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six in all, under the direction of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the Lord.
verses.textEn: As for Jeduthun, from his sons: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all, under the supervision of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied, using the harp in thanking and praising the Lord .

verses.textZh: 至于希幔，他的儿子有布基雅、玛探雅、乌薛、细布业、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亚他、基大利提、罗幔提．以谢、约施比加沙、玛罗提、何提和玛哈秀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于希幔，他的儿子有布基雅、玛探雅、乌薛、细布业、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亚他、基大利提、罗幔提．以谢、约施比加沙、玛罗提、何提和玛哈秀。
verses.textZhCuv: 希幔的儿子布基雅、玛探雅、乌薛、细布业、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亚他、基大利提、罗幔提‧以谢、约施比加沙、玛罗提、何提、玛哈秀；
verses.textEnNiv: As for Heman, from his sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.
verses.textEnEsv: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
verses.textEnNlt: From the sons of Heman, there were Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
verses.textEn: As for Heman, from his sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.

verses.textZh: 这些人都是希幔的儿子；希幔是王的先见，照着神的话高举他 。神赐给希幔十四个儿子，三个女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都是希幔的儿子；希幔是王的先见，照着神的话高举他 。神赐给希幔十四个儿子，三个女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是希幔的儿子，吹角颂赞。希幔奉神之命作王的先见。神赐给希幔十四个儿子，三个女儿，
verses.textEnNiv: (All these were sons of Heman the king’s seer. They were given him through the promises of God to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.)
verses.textEnEsv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer, according to the promise of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to exalt his horn. For God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: All these were the sons of Heman, the king’s seer, for God had honored him with fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer to exalt him according to the words of God, for God gave fourteen sons and three daughters to Heman.
verses.textEn: (All these were sons of Heman the king’s seer. They were given him through the promises of God to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.)

verses.textZh: 这些人都归他们的父亲指挥，在耶和华的殿里歌颂，用响钹和琴瑟在神的殿事奉。亚萨、耶杜顿和希幔都是由王指挥的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都归他们的父亲指挥，在耶和华的殿里歌颂，用响钹和琴瑟在神的殿事奉。亚萨、耶杜顿和希幔都是由王指挥的。
verses.textZhCuv: 都归他们父亲指教，在耶和华的殿唱歌、敲钹、弹琴、鼓瑟，办神殿的事务。亚萨、耶杜顿、希幔都是王所命定的。
verses.textEnNiv: All these men were under the supervision of their father for the music of the temple of the Lord , with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman were under the supervision of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: They were all under the direction of their father in the music in the house of the Lord with cymbals, harps, and lyres for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the order of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these were under the direction of their father for the music in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the authority of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: All these men were under the direction of their fathers as they made music at the house of the Lord . Their responsibilities included the playing of cymbals, harps, and lyres at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman reported directly to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: All of these were under the direction of their father to sing in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the direction of the king.
verses.textEn: All these men were under the supervision of their father for the music of the temple of the Lord , with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman were under the supervision of the king.

verses.textZh: 他们和他们的亲族，在歌颂耶和华的事上受过特别训练，精于歌唱的，人数共有二百八十八人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们和他们的亲族，在歌颂耶和华的事上受过特别训练，精于歌唱的，人数共有二百八十八人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们和他们的弟兄学习颂赞耶和华；善于歌唱的共有二百八十八人。
verses.textEnNiv: Along with their relatives—all of them trained and skilled in music for the Lord —they numbered 288.
verses.textEnEsv: The number of them along with their brothers, who were trained in singing to the Lord , all who were skillful, was 288.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the number of them, with their brethren who were instructed in the songs of the Lord, all who were skillful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
verses.textEnNlt: They and their families were all trained in making music before the Lord , and each of them—288 in all—was an accomplished musician.
verses.textEnNasb: Their number who were trained in singing to the Lord, with their relatives, all who were skillful, was 288.
verses.textEn: Along with their relatives—all of them trained and skilled in music for the Lord —they numbered 288.

verses.textZh: 这些人，无论大小，不分师生，都一同抽签分班次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人，无论大小，不分师生，都一同抽签分班次。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人无论大小，为师的、为徒的，都一同掣签分了班次。
verses.textEnNiv: Young and old alike, teacher as well as student, cast lots for their duties.
verses.textEnEsv: And they cast lots for their duties, small and great, teacher and pupil alike.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they cast lots for their duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher with the student.
verses.textEnNlt: The musicians were appointed to their term of service by means of sacred lots, without regard to whether they were young or old, teacher or student.
verses.textEnNasb: They cast lots for their duties, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the pupil.
verses.textEn: Young and old alike, teacher as well as student, cast lots for their duties.

verses.textZh: 守门的人的班次如下：可拉家族，亚萨的子孙中，有可利的儿子米施利米雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守门的人的班次如下：可拉家族，亚萨的子孙中，有可利的儿子米施利米雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 守门的班次记在下面：可拉族亚萨的子孙中，有可利的儿子米施利米雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.textEnNkjv: Concerning the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites, there was Meshelemiah son of Kore, of the family of Abiasaph.
verses.textEnNasb: For the divisions of the gatekeepers there were of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.textEn: The divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.

verses.textZh: 米施利米雅有几个儿子：长子是撒迦利雅、次子是耶叠、三子是西巴弟雅、四子是耶提聂、
verses.textZhCnvs: 米施利米雅有几个儿子：长子是撒迦利雅、次子是耶叠、三子是西巴弟雅、四子是耶提聂、
verses.textZhCuv: 米施利米雅的长子是撒迦利亚，次子是耶叠，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聂，
verses.textEnNiv: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.textEnEsv: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Meshelemiah were Zechariah (the oldest), Jediael (the second), Zebadiah (the third), Jathniel (the fourth),
verses.textEnNasb: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.textEn: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

verses.textZh: 五子是以拦、六子是约哈难、七子是以利约乃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 五子是以拦、六子是约哈难、七子是以利约乃。
verses.textZhCuv: 五子是以拦，六子是约哈难，七子是以利约乃。
verses.textEnNiv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.textEnEsv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.textEnNlt: Elam (the fifth), Jehohanan (the sixth), and Eliehoenai (the seventh).
verses.textEnNasb: Elam the fifth, Johanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.textEn: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh.

verses.textZh: 俄别．以东有几个儿子：长子是示玛雅、次子是约萨拔、三子是约亚，四子是沙甲、五子是拿坦业、
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄别．以东有几个儿子：长子是示玛雅、次子是约萨拔、三子是约亚，四子是沙甲、五子是拿坦业、
verses.textZhCuv: 俄别‧以东的长子是示玛雅，次子是约萨拔，三子是约亚，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦业，
verses.textEnNiv: Obed-Edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sakar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
verses.textEnEsv: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the sons of Obed-Edom were Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Obed-edom, also gatekeepers, were Shemaiah (the oldest), Jehozabad (the second), Joah (the third), Sacar (the fourth), Nethanel (the fifth),
verses.textEnNasb: Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
verses.textEn: Obed-Edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sakar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

verses.textZh: 六子是亚米利、七子是以萨迦、八子是毘乌利太；神实在赐福给俄别．以东。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六子是亚米利、七子是以萨迦、八子是毘乌利太；神实在赐福给俄别．以东。
verses.textZhCuv: 六子是亚米利，七子是以萨迦，八子是毗乌利太，因为神赐福与俄别‧以东。
verses.textEnNiv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth. (For God had blessed Obed-Edom.)
verses.textEnEsv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth, for God blessed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth; for God blessed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Ammiel (the sixth), Issachar (the seventh), and Peullethai (the eighth). God had richly blessed Obed-edom.
verses.textEnNasb: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; God had indeed blessed him.
verses.textEn: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth. (For God had blessed Obed-Edom.)

verses.textZh: 他的儿子示玛雅也生了几个儿子，都是管治他们的家族的，因为他们都是英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿子示玛雅也生了几个儿子，都是管治他们的家族的，因为他们都是英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的儿子示玛雅有几个儿子，都是大能的壮士，掌管父亲的家。
verses.textEnNiv: Obed-Edom’s son Shemaiah also had sons, who were leaders in their father’s family because they were very capable men.
verses.textEnEsv: Also to his son Shemaiah were sons born who were rulers in their fathers’ houses, for they were men of great ability.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born who governed their fathers’ houses, because they were men of great ability.
verses.textEnNlt: Obed-edom’s son Shemaiah had sons with great ability who earned positions of great authority in the clan.
verses.textEnNasb: Also to his son Shemaiah sons were born who ruled over the house of their father, for they were valiant mighty men.
verses.textEn: Obed-Edom’s son Shemaiah also had sons, who were leaders in their father’s family because they were very capable men.

verses.textZh: 示玛雅的儿子是俄得尼、利法益、俄备得和以利萨巴。以利萨巴的兄弟以利户和西玛迦都是勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示玛雅的儿子是俄得尼、利法益、俄备得和以利萨巴。以利萨巴的兄弟以利户和西玛迦都是勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 示玛雅的儿子是俄得尼、利法益、俄备得、以利萨巴。以利萨巴的弟兄是壮士，还有以利户和西玛迦。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad; his relatives Elihu and Semakiah were also able men.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad, whose brothers were able men, Elihu and Semachiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Shemaiah were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers Elihu and Semachiah were able men.
verses.textEnNlt: Their names were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad. Their relatives, Elihu and Semakiah, were also very capable men.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shemaiah were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers, Elihu and Semachiah, were valiant men.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad; his relatives Elihu and Semakiah were also able men.

verses.textZh: 这些人都是俄别．以东的子孙，他们和他们的儿子、兄弟，都是有能力办事的人。俄别．以东的子孙，共有六十二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都是俄别．以东的子孙，他们和他们的儿子、兄弟，都是有能力办事的人。俄别．以东的子孙，共有六十二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是俄别‧以东的子孙，他们和他们的儿子并弟兄，都是善于办事的壮士。俄别‧以东的子孙共六十二人。
verses.textEnNiv: All these were descendants of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their relatives were capable men with the strength to do the work—descendants of Obed-Edom, 62 in all.
verses.textEnEsv: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom with their sons and brothers, able men qualified for the service; sixty-two of Obed-edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom, they and their sons and their brethren, able men with strength for the work: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: All of these descendants of Obed-edom, including their sons and grandsons—sixty-two of them in all—were very capable men, well qualified for their work.
verses.textEnNasb: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom; they and their sons and relatives were able men with strength for the service, sixty-two from Obed-edom.
verses.textEn: All these were descendants of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their relatives were capable men with the strength to do the work—descendants of Obed-Edom, 62 in all.

verses.textZh: 米施利米雅有儿子和兄弟，都是勇士，共十八人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米施利米雅有儿子和兄弟，都是勇士，共十八人。
verses.textZhCuv: 米施利米雅的儿子和弟兄都是壮士，共十八人。
verses.textEnNiv: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, who were able men—18 in all.
verses.textEnEsv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, able men, eighteen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, eighteen able men.
verses.textEnNlt: Meshelemiah’s eighteen sons and relatives were also very capable men.
verses.textEnNasb: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, eighteen valiant men.
verses.textEn: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, who were able men—18 in all.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的子孙何萨有几个儿子，长子是申利 、
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的子孙何萨有几个儿子，长子是申利 、
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利子孙何萨有几个儿子：长子是申利，他原不是长子，是他父亲立他作长子。
verses.textEnNiv: Hosah the Merarite had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him the first),
verses.textEnEsv: And Hosah, of the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him chief),
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the first (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him the first),
verses.textEnNlt: Hosah, of the Merari clan, appointed Shimri as the leader among his sons, though he was not the oldest.
verses.textEnNasb: Also Hosah, one of the sons of Merari had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father made him first),
verses.textEn: Hosah the Merarite had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him the first),

verses.textZh: 次子是希勒家、三子是底巴利雅、四子是撒迦利亚。何萨所有的儿子和兄弟共十三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次子是希勒家、三子是底巴利雅、四子是撒迦利亚。何萨所有的儿子和兄弟共十三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亚。何萨的儿子并弟兄共十三人。
verses.textEnNiv: Hilkiah the second, Tabaliah the third and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and relatives of Hosah were 13 in all.
verses.textEnEsv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.textEnNlt: His other sons included Hilkiah (the second), Tebaliah (the third), and Zechariah (the fourth). Hosah’s sons and relatives, who served as gatekeepers, numbered thirteen in all.
verses.textEnNasb: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth; the sons and relatives of Hosah were thirteen in all.
verses.textEn: Hilkiah the second, Tabaliah the third and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and relatives of Hosah were 13 in all.

verses.textZh: 以上这些都是守门人的班次；无论是首领或是他们的亲族，都在耶和华的殿里按班供职。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些都是守门人的班次；无论是首领或是他们的亲族，都在耶和华的殿里按班供职。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人都是守门的班长，与他们的弟兄一同在耶和华殿里按班供职。
verses.textEnNiv: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their leaders, had duties for ministering in the temple of the Lord , just as their relatives had.
verses.textEnEsv: These divisions of the gatekeepers, corresponding to their chief men, had duties, just as their brothers did, ministering in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Among these were the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having duties just like their brethren, to serve in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: These divisions of the gatekeepers were named for their family leaders, and like the other Levites, they served at the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: To these divisions of the gatekeepers, to the chief men, were given duties like their relatives, to serve in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their leaders, had duties for ministering in the temple of the Lord , just as their relatives had.

verses.textZh: 他们无论大小，都按着他们的家族抽签，看守各门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们无论大小，都按着他们的家族抽签，看守各门。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们无论大小，都按着宗族掣签分守各门。
verses.textEnNiv: Lots were cast for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
verses.textEnEsv: And they cast lots by fathers’ houses, small and great alike, for their gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they cast lots for each gate, the small as well as the great, according to their father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: They were assigned by families for guard duty at the various gates, without regard to age or training, for it was all decided by means of sacred lots.
verses.textEnNasb: They cast lots, the small and the great alike, according to their fathers’ households, for every gate.
verses.textEn: Lots were cast for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.

verses.textZh: 抽出守东门的签的是示利米雅。他的儿子撒迦利亚是个聪明的谋士，他们为他抽出了守北面的签。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抽出守东门的签的是示利米雅。他的儿子撒迦利亚是个聪明的谋士，他们为他抽出了守北面的签。
verses.textZhCuv: 掣签守东门的是示利米雅；他的儿子撒迦利亚是精明的谋士，掣签守北门。
verses.textEnNiv: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
verses.textEnEsv: The lot for the east fell to Shelemiah. They cast lots also for his son Zechariah, a shrewd counselor, and his lot came out for the north.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then they cast lots for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and his lot came out for the North Gate;
verses.textEnNlt: The responsibility for the east gate went to Meshelemiah and his group. The north gate was assigned to his son Zechariah, a man of unusual wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: The lot to the east fell to Shelemiah. Then they cast lots for his son Zechariah, a counselor with insight, and his lot came out to the north.
verses.textEn: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.

verses.textZh: 俄别．以东守南门；他的儿子守库房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄别．以东守南门；他的儿子守库房。
verses.textZhCuv: 俄别‧以东守南门，他的儿子守库房。
verses.textEnNiv: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-Edom, and the lot for the storehouse fell to his sons.
verses.textEnEsv: Obed-edom’s came out for the south, and to his sons was allotted the gatehouse.
verses.textEnNkjv: to Obed-Edom the South Gate, and to his sons the storehouse.
verses.textEnNlt: The south gate went to Obed-edom, and his sons were put in charge of the storehouse.
verses.textEnNasb: For Obed-edom it fell to the south, and to his sons went the storehouse.
verses.textEn: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-Edom, and the lot for the storehouse fell to his sons.

verses.textZh: 书聘和何萨守西门，以及在斜路上的沙利基门；守卫的人相对而立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 书聘和何萨守西门，以及在斜路上的沙利基门；守卫的人相对而立。
verses.textZhCuv: 书聘与何萨守西门，在靠近沙利基门、通着往上去的街道上，班与班相对。
verses.textEnNiv: The lots for the West Gate and the Shalleketh Gate on the upper road fell to Shuppim and Hosah. Guard was alongside of guard:
verses.textEnEsv: For Shuppim and Hosah it came out for the west, at the gate of Shallecheth on the road that goes up. Watch corresponded to watch.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Shuppim and Hosah thelotcameout for the West Gate, with the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway—watchman opposite watchman.
verses.textEnNlt: Shuppim and Hosah were assigned the west gate and the gateway leading up to the Temple. Guard duties were divided evenly.
verses.textEnNasb: For Shuppim and Hosah it was to the west, by the gate of Shallecheth, on the ascending highway. Guard corresponded to guard.
verses.textEn: The lots for the West Gate and the Shalleketh Gate on the upper road fell to Shuppim and Hosah. Guard was alongside of guard:

verses.textZh: 守东门的有六个利未人，守北门的每日有四人，守南门的每日有四人，守库房的两人一组。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守东门的有六个利未人，守北门的每日有四人，守南门的每日有四人，守库房的两人一组。
verses.textZhCuv: 每日东门有六个利未人，北门有四个，南门有四个，库房有两个，又有两个轮班替换。
verses.textEnNiv: There were six Levites a day on the east, four a day on the north, four a day on the south and two at a time at the storehouse.
verses.textEnEsv: On the east there were six each day, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, as well as two and two at the gatehouse.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the east were six Levites, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, and for the storehouse two by two.
verses.textEnNlt: Six Levites were assigned each day to the east gate, four to the north gate, four to the south gate, and two pairs at the storehouse.
verses.textEnNasb: On the east there were six Levites, on the north four daily, on the south four daily, and at the storehouse two by two.
verses.textEn: There were six Levites a day on the east, four a day on the north, four a day on the south and two at a time at the storehouse.

verses.textZh: 在西面的前廊有四人在大路上，在前廊那里有两个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在西面的前廊有四人在大路上，在前廊那里有两个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在西面街道上有四个，在游廊上有两个。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the court to the west, there were four at the road and two at the court itself.
verses.textEnEsv: And for the colonnade on the west there were four at the road and two at the colonnade.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the Parbar on the west, therewere four on the highway and two at the Parbar.
verses.textEnNlt: Six were assigned each day to the west gate, four to the gateway leading up to the Temple, and two to the courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: At the annex on the west there were four at the highway and two at the annex.
verses.textEn: As for the court to the west, there were four at the road and two at the court itself.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人是可拉子孙和米拉利子孙守门的人的班次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人是可拉子孙和米拉利子孙守门的人的班次。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上是可拉子孙和米拉利子孙守门的班次。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the Korahites and the sons of Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Korah and among the sons of Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers from the clans of Korah and Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers of the sons of Korah and of the sons of Merari.
verses.textEn: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.

verses.textZh: 他们其他的利未亲族，就管理神殿里的库房和圣物的库房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们其他的利未亲族，就管理神殿里的库房和圣物的库房。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未子孙中有亚希雅掌管神殿的府库和圣物的府库。
verses.textEnNiv: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries for the dedicated things.
verses.textEnEsv: And of the Levites, Ahijah had charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated gifts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasuries of the house of God and over the treasuries of the dedicated things.
verses.textEnNlt: Other Levites, led by Ahijah, were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the gifts dedicated to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites, their relatives, were in charge of the treasures of the house of God and of the treasures of the dedicated gifts.
verses.textEn: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries for the dedicated things.

verses.textZh: 革顺家族拉但的子孙中作首领的，有革顺家族拉但的子孙耶希伊利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺家族拉但的子孙中作首领的，有革顺家族拉但的子孙耶希伊利。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺族、拉但子孙里，作族长的是革顺族拉但的子孙耶希伊利。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and who were heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Laadan, the descendants of the Gershonites of Laadan, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Libni in the clan of Gershon, Jehiel was the leader.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, namely, the Jehielites, were the heads of the fathers’ households, belonging to Ladan the Gershonite.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and who were heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,

verses.textZh: 耶希伊利的儿子西坦和他的兄弟约珥，掌管耶和华殿里的库房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶希伊利的儿子西坦和他的兄弟约珥，掌管耶和华殿里的库房。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶希伊利的儿子西坦和他兄弟约珥掌管耶和华殿里的府库。
verses.textEnNiv: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and Joel his brother, were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham and Joel his brother, were over the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Jehiel, Zetham and his brother Joel, were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel, were in charge of the treasures of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 至于暗兰家族、以斯哈家族、希伯伦家族和乌薛家族，也各有职守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于暗兰家族、以斯哈家族、希伯伦家族和乌薛家族，也各有职守。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗兰族、以斯哈族、希伯伦族、乌泄族也有职分。
verses.textEnNiv: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites and the Uzzielites:
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites—
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the leaders that descended from Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel:
verses.textEnNasb: As for the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
verses.textEn: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites and the Uzzielites:

verses.textZh: 摩西的孙子、革顺的儿子细布业作库房的总管。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的孙子、革顺的儿子细布业作库房的总管。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子细布业掌管府库。
verses.textEnNiv: Shubael, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the official in charge of the treasuries.
verses.textEnEsv: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, son of Moses, was chief officer in charge of the treasuries.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was overseer of the treasuries.
verses.textEnNlt: From the clan of Amram, Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom son of Moses. He was the chief officer of the treasuries.
verses.textEnNasb: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was officer over the treasures.
verses.textEn: Shubael, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the official in charge of the treasuries.

verses.textZh: 细布业的兄弟是以利以谢；以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅，利哈比雅的儿子是耶筛亚，耶筛亚的儿子是约兰，约兰的儿子是细基利，细基利的儿子是示罗密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 细布业的兄弟是以利以谢；以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅，利哈比雅的儿子是耶筛亚，耶筛亚的儿子是约兰，约兰的儿子是细基利，细基利的儿子是示罗密。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有他的弟兄以利以谢。以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的儿子是耶筛亚；耶筛亚的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是细基利；细基利的儿子是示罗密。
verses.textEnNiv: His relatives through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zikri his son and Shelomith his son.
verses.textEnEsv: His brothers: from Eliezer were his son Rehabiah, and his son Jeshaiah, and his son Joram, and his son Zichri, and his son Shelomoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his brethren by Eliezer were Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.textEnNlt: His relatives through Eliezer were Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zicri, and Shelomoth.
verses.textEnNasb: His relatives by Eliezer were Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
verses.textEn: His relatives through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zikri his son and Shelomith his son.

verses.textZh: 这示罗密和他的兄弟掌管库房里的一切圣物，就是大卫王、众家族首领、千夫长、百夫长和军长所献的圣物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这示罗密和他的兄弟掌管库房里的一切圣物，就是大卫王、众家族首领、千夫长、百夫长和军长所献的圣物。
verses.textZhCuv: 这示罗密和他的弟兄掌管府库的圣物，就是大卫王和众族长、千夫长、百夫长，并军长所分别为圣的物。
verses.textEnNiv: Shelomith and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and by the other army commanders.
verses.textEnEsv: This Shelomoth and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries of the dedicated gifts that David the king and the heads of the fathers’ houses and the officers of the thousands and the hundreds and the commanders of the army had dedicated.
verses.textEnNkjv: This Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things which King David and the heads of fathers’ houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
verses.textEnNlt: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of the treasuries containing the gifts that King David, the family leaders, and the generals and captains and other officers of the army had dedicated to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: This Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the treasures of the dedicated gifts which King David and the heads of the fathers’ households, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had dedicated.
verses.textEn: Shelomith and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and by the other army commanders.

verses.textZh: 他们把在战场上掠夺的财物献上，用作修建耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把在战场上掠夺的财物献上，用作修建耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将争战时所夺的财物分别为圣，以备修造耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the plunder taken in battle they dedicated for the repair of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: From spoil won in battles they dedicated gifts for the maintenance of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Some of the spoils won in battles they dedicated to maintain the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: These men dedicated some of the plunder they had gained in battle to maintain the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They dedicated part of the spoils won in battles to repair the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Some of the plunder taken in battle they dedicated for the repair of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 撒母耳先见、基士的儿子扫罗、尼珥的儿子押尼珥和洗鲁雅的儿子约押所分别为圣的一切，以及一切分别为圣的物，都归示罗密和他的众兄弟掌管。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳先见、基士的儿子扫罗、尼珥的儿子押尼珥和洗鲁雅的儿子约押所分别为圣的一切，以及一切分别为圣的物，都归示罗密和他的众兄弟掌管。
verses.textZhCuv: 先见撒母耳、基士的儿子扫罗、尼珥的儿子押尼珥、洗鲁雅的儿子约押所分别为圣的物都归示罗密和他的弟兄掌管。
verses.textEnNiv: And everything dedicated by Samuel the seer and by Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah, and all the other dedicated things were in the care of Shelomith and his relatives.
verses.textEnEsv: Also all that Samuel the seer and Saul the son of Kish and Abner the son of Ner and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated—all dedicated gifts were in the care of Shelomoth and his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, every dedicated thing, was under the hand of Shelomith and his brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Shelomoth and his relatives also cared for the gifts dedicated to the Lord by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah. All the other dedicated gifts were in their care, too.
verses.textEnNasb: And all that Samuel the seer had dedicated, and Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, everyone who had dedicated anything, all of this was under the care of Shelomoth and his relatives.
verses.textEn: And everything dedicated by Samuel the seer and by Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah, and all the other dedicated things were in the care of Shelomith and his relatives.

verses.textZh: 以斯哈家族有基拿尼雅和他的众子在圣殿外作官长和审判官，治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯哈家族有基拿尼雅和他的众子在圣殿外作官长和审判官，治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他众子作官长和士师，管理以色列的外事。
verses.textEnNiv: From the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons were assigned duties away from the temple, as officials and judges over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to external duties for Israel, as officers and judges.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons performed duties as officials and judges over Israel outside Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: From the clan of Izhar came Kenaniah. He and his sons were given administrative responsibilities over Israel as officials and judges.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were assigned to outside duties for Israel, as officers and judges.
verses.textEn: From the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons were assigned duties away from the temple, as officials and judges over Israel.

verses.textZh: 希伯伦家族有哈沙比雅和他的亲族，共一千七百人，都是勇士，主管约旦河西以色列地耶和华的一切职事和王的任务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯伦家族有哈沙比雅和他的亲族，共一千七百人，都是勇士，主管约旦河西以色列地耶和华的一切职事和王的任务。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯伦族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壮士，在约旦河西、以色列地办理耶和华与王的事。
verses.textEnNiv: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives—seventeen hundred able men—were responsible in Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the king’s service.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, 1,700 men of ability, had the oversight of Israel westward of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the service of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, one thousand seven hundred able men, had the oversight of Israel on the west side of the Jordan for all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: From the clan of Hebron came Hashabiah. He and his relatives—1,700 capable men—were put in charge of the Israelite lands west of the Jordan River. They were responsible for all matters related to the things of the Lord and the service of the king in that area.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, were responsible for the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan, for all the work of the Lord and the service of the king.
verses.textEn: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives—seventeen hundred able men—were responsible in Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the king’s service.

verses.textZh: 希伯伦家族中有作首领的耶利雅，是按着他们家族的族谱作希伯伦家族的首领的。大卫在位第四十年，经过调查，在基列的雅谢从这家族中找到英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯伦家族中有作首领的耶利雅，是按着他们家族的族谱作希伯伦家族的首领的。大卫在位第四十年，经过调查，在基列的雅谢从这家族中找到英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯伦族中有耶利雅作族长。大卫作王第四十年，在基列的雅谢，从这族中寻得大能的勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the Hebronites, Jeriah was their chief according to the genealogical records of their families. In the fortieth year of David’s reign a search was made in the records, and capable men among the Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was chief of the Hebronites of whatever genealogy or fathers’ houses. (In the fortieth year of David’s reign search was made and men of great ability among them were found at Jazer in Gilead.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Among the Hebronites, Jerijah was head of the Hebronites according to his genealogy of the fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought, and there were found among them capable men at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: Also from the clan of Hebron came Jeriah, who was the leader of the Hebronites according to the genealogical records. (In the fortieth year of David’s reign, a search was made in the records, and capable men from the clan of Hebron were found at Jazer in the land of Gilead.)
verses.textEnNasb: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah the chief (these Hebronites were sought out according to their genealogies and fathers’ households, in the fortieth year of David’s reign, and men of outstanding capability were found among them at Jazer of Gilead)
verses.textEn: As for the Hebronites, Jeriah was their chief according to the genealogical records of their families. In the fortieth year of David’s reign a search was made in the records, and capable men among the Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.

verses.textZh: 耶利雅的亲族有二千七百人，都是勇士，各家族的首领；大卫王派他们管理流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派一切有关神和王的事务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利雅的亲族有二千七百人，都是勇士，各家族的首领；大卫王派他们管理流本支派、迦得支派和玛拿西半个支派一切有关神和王的事务。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壮士，且作族长；大卫王派他们在吕便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派中办理神和王的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeriah had twenty-seven hundred relatives, who were able men and heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: King David appointed him and his brothers, 2,700 men of ability, heads of fathers’ houses, to have the oversight of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of the Manassites for everything pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his brethren were two thousand seven hundred able men, heads of fathers’ houses, whom King David made officials over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God and the affairs of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 2,700 capable men among the relatives of Jeriah. King David sent them to the east side of the Jordan River and put them in charge of the tribes of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh. They were responsible for all matters related to God and to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: and his relatives, capable men, numbered 2,700, heads of fathers’ households. And King David appointed them as overseers of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites concerning all the affairs of God and of the king.
verses.textEn: Jeriah had twenty-seven hundred relatives, who were able men and heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

verses.textZh: 以色列人各家族的首领、千夫长、百夫长和服事王的所有官长，都按着他们的数目分定班次，每年按月轮班，每班有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人各家族的首领、千夫长、百夫长和服事王的所有官长，都按着他们的数目分定班次，每年按月轮班，每班有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人的族长、千夫长、百夫长，和官长都分定班次，每班是二万四千人，周年按月轮流，替换出入服事王。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the list of the Israelites—heads of families, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and their officers, who served the king in all that concerned the army divisions that were on duty month by month throughout the year. Each division consisted of 24,000 men.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the number of the people of Israel, the heads of fathers’ houses, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and their officers who served the king in all matters concerning the divisions that came and went, month after month throughout the year, each division numbering 24,000:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel, according to their number, the heads of fathers’ houses, the captains of thousands and hundreds and their officers, served the king in every matter of the military divisions. Thesedivisions came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, each division having twenty-four thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the list of Israelite generals and captains, and their officers, who served the king by supervising the army divisions that were on duty each month of the year. Each division served for one month and had 24,000 troops.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this is the number of the sons of Israel, the heads of fathers’ households, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in all the affairs of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout the months of the year, each division numbering twenty-four thousand:
verses.textEn: This is the list of the Israelites—heads of families, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and their officers, who served the king in all that concerned the army divisions that were on duty month by month throughout the year. Each division consisted of 24,000 men.

verses.textZh: 负责正月第一班的，是撒巴第业的儿子雅朔班，他那一班有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 负责正月第一班的，是撒巴第业的儿子雅朔班，他那一班有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月第一班的班长是撒巴第业的儿子雅朔班；他班内有二万四千人。
verses.textEnNiv: In charge of the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
verses.textEnEsv: Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division in the first month; in his division were 24,000.
verses.textEnNkjv: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel, and in his division were twenty-four thousand;
verses.textEnNlt: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was commander of the first division of 24,000 troops, which was on duty during the first month.
verses.textEnNasb: Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division for the first month; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.textEn: In charge of the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

verses.textZh: 他是法勒斯子孙中的首领，统管正月那一班所有的军长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是法勒斯子孙中的首领，统管正月那一班所有的军长。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是法勒斯的子孙，统管正月班的一切军长。
verses.textEnNiv: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army officers for the first month.
verses.textEnEsv: He was a descendant of Perez and was chief of all the commanders. He served for the first month.
verses.textEnNkjv: hewas of the children of Perez, and the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
verses.textEnNlt: He was a descendant of Perez and was in charge of all the army officers for the first month.
verses.textEnNasb: He was from the sons of Perez, and was chief of all the commanders of the army for the first month.
verses.textEn: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army officers for the first month.

verses.textZh: 负责二月那一班的是亚哈希人朵代，他那一班还有副官密基罗，他那一班有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 负责二月那一班的是亚哈希人朵代，他那一班还有副官密基罗，他那一班有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 二月的班长是亚哈希人朵代，还有副官密基罗；他班内有二万四千人。
verses.textEnNiv: In charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; Mikloth was the leader of his division. There were 24,000 men in his division.
verses.textEnEsv: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division of the second month; in his division were 24,000.
verses.textEnNkjv: Over the division of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his division Mikloth also was the leader; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: Dodai, a descendant of Ahoah, was commander of the second division of 24,000 troops, which was on duty during the second month. Mikloth was his chief officer.
verses.textEnNasb: Dodai the Ahohite and his division was in charge of the division for the second month, Mikloth being the chief officer; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.textEn: over Dan: Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人二十岁以下的，大卫都没有登记他们的数目，因为耶和华曾经说过要增添以色列人的数目，好象天上的星那样多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人二十岁以下的，大卫都没有登记他们的数目，因为耶和华曾经说过要增添以色列人的数目，好象天上的星那样多。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人二十岁以内的，大卫没有记其数目；因耶和华曾应许说，必加增以色列人如天上的星那样多。
verses.textEnNiv: David did not take the number of the men twenty years old or less, because the Lord had promised to make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: David did not count those below twenty years of age, for the Lord had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: But David did not take the number of those twenty years old and under, because the Lord had said He would multiply Israel like the stars of the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: When David took his census, he did not count those who were younger than twenty years of age, because the Lord had promised to make the Israelites as numerous as the stars in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: But David did not count those twenty years of age and under, because the Lord had said He would multiply Israel as the stars of heaven.
verses.textEn: David did not take the number of the men twenty years old or less, because the Lord had promised to make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押开始数点，但还没有完成，为了这事耶和华的忿怒就临到以色列人身上，所以以色列的人数没有记在大卫王的年录上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押开始数点，但还没有完成，为了这事耶和华的忿怒就临到以色列人身上，所以以色列的人数没有记在大卫王的年录上。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押动手数点，当时耶和华的烈怒临到以色列人；因此，没有点完，数目也没有写在大卫王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. God’s wrath came on Israel on account of this numbering, and the number was not entered in the book of the annals of King David.
verses.textEnEsv: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to count, but did not finish. Yet wrath came upon Israel for this, and the number was not entered in the chronicles of King David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah began a census, but he did not finish, for wrath came upon Israel because of this census; nor was the number recorded in the account of the chronicles of King David.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab son of Zeruiah began the census but never finished it because the anger of God fell on Israel. The total number was never recorded in King David’s official records.
verses.textEnNasb: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count them, but did not finish; and because of this, wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not included in the account of the chronicles of King David.
verses.textEn: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. God’s wrath came on Israel on account of this numbering, and the number was not entered in the book of the annals of King David.

verses.textZh: 管理王的库房的，是亚叠的儿子押斯马威；管理郊野、城市、乡村和望楼的仓库的，是乌西雅的儿子约拿单；
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理王的库房的，是亚叠的儿子押斯马威；管理郊野、城市、乡村和望楼的仓库的，是乌西雅的儿子约拿单；
verses.textZhCuv: 掌管王府库的是亚叠的儿子押斯马威。掌管田野城邑村庄保障之仓库的是乌西雅的儿子约拿单。
verses.textEnNiv: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the outlying districts, in the towns, the villages and the watchtowers.
verses.textEnEsv: Over the king’s treasuries was Azmaveth the son of Adiel; and over the treasuries in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
verses.textEnNkjv: And Azmaveth the son of Adiel was over the king’s treasuries; and Jehonathan the son of Uzziah was over the storehouses in the field, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
verses.textEnNlt: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the palace treasuries. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the regional treasuries throughout the towns, villages, and fortresses of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Azmaveth the son of Adiel was responsible for the king’s storehouses. And Jonathan the son of Uzziah was responsible for the storehouses in the country, the cities, the villages, and the towers.
verses.textEn: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the outlying districts, in the towns, the villages and the watchtowers.

verses.textZh: 管理耕田种地的，是基绿的儿子以斯利；
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理耕田种地的，是基绿的儿子以斯利；
verses.textZhCuv: 掌管耕田种地的是基绿的儿子以斯利。
verses.textEnNiv: Ezri son of Kelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the land.
verses.textEnEsv: and over those who did the work of the field for tilling the soil was Ezri the son of Chelub;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ezri the son of Chelub was over those who did the work of the field for tilling the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Ezri son of Kelub was in charge of the field workers who farmed the king’s lands.
verses.textEnNasb: Ezri the son of Chelub was responsible for the agricultural workers who tilled the soil.
verses.textEn: Ezri son of Kelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the land.

verses.textZh: 管理葡萄园的，是拉玛人示每；管理园里酒库的，是实弗米人撒巴底；
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理葡萄园的，是拉玛人示每；管理园里酒库的，是实弗米人撒巴底；
verses.textZhCuv: 掌管葡萄园的是拉玛人示每。掌管葡萄园酒窖的是实弗米人撒巴底。
verses.textEnNiv: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
verses.textEnEsv: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; and over the produce of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Shimei the Ramathite was over the vineyards, and Zabdi the Shiphmite was over the produce of the vineyards for the supply of wine.
verses.textEnNlt: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the king’s vineyards. Zabdi from Shepham was responsible for the grapes and the supplies of wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Shimei the Ramathite was responsible for the vineyards; and Zabdi the Shiphmite was responsible for the produce of the vineyards stored in the wine cellars.
verses.textEn: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.

verses.textZh: 管理高原橄榄树和桑树的，是基第利人巴力．哈南；管理油库的，是约阿施；
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理高原橄榄树和桑树的，是基第利人巴力．哈南；管理油库的，是约阿施；
verses.textZhCuv: 掌管高原橄榄树和桑树的是基第利人巴勒‧哈南。掌管油库的是约阿施。
verses.textEnNiv: Baal-Hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore-fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of the supplies of olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: Over the olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah was Baal-hanan the Gederite; and over the stores of oil was Joash.
verses.textEnNkjv: Baal-Hanan the Gederite was over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowlands, and Joash was over the store of oil.
verses.textEnNlt: Baal-hanan from Geder was in charge of the king’s olive groves and sycamore-fig trees in the foothills of Judah. Joash was responsible for the supplies of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: Baal-hanan the Gederite was responsible for the olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah; and Joash was responsible for the stores of oil.
verses.textEn: Baal-Hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore-fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of the supplies of olive oil.

verses.textZh: 管理在沙仑牧放的牛群的，是沙仑人施提赉；管理在山谷的牛群的，是亚第赉的儿子沙法；
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理在沙仑牧放的牛群的，是沙仑人施提赉；管理在山谷的牛群的，是亚第赉的儿子沙法；
verses.textZhCuv: 掌管沙仑牧放牛群的是沙仑人施提赉。掌管山谷牧养牛群的是亚第赉的儿子沙法。
verses.textEnNiv: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
verses.textEnEsv: Over the herds that pastured in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; over the herds in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Shitrai the Sharonite was over the herds that fed in Sharon, and Shaphat the son of Adlai was over the herds thatwere in the valleys.
verses.textEnNlt: Shitrai from Sharon was in charge of the cattle on the Sharon Plain. Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for the cattle in the valleys.
verses.textEnNasb: Shitrai the Sharonite was responsible for the cattle which were grazing in Sharon; and Shaphat the son of Adlai was responsible for the cattle in the valleys.
verses.textEn: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.

verses.textZh: 管理骆驼的，是以实玛利人阿比勒；管理驴群的，是米仑人耶希底亚；
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理骆驼的，是以实玛利人阿比勒；管理驴群的，是米仑人耶希底亚；
verses.textZhCuv: 掌管驼群的是以实玛利人阿比勒。掌管驴群的是米仑人耶希底亚。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。
verses.textEnNiv: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Obil the Ishmaelite was over the camels, Jehdeiah the Meronothite was over the donkeys,
verses.textEnNlt: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: Obil the Ishmaelite was responsible for the camels; and Jehdeiah the Meronothite was responsible for the donkeys.
verses.textEn: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.

verses.textZh: 管理羊群的，是夏甲人雅悉。以上这些人都是给大卫王管理产业的官员。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理羊群的，是夏甲人雅悉。以上这些人都是给大卫王管理产业的官员。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是给大卫王掌管产业的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these were the officials in charge of King David’s property.
verses.textEnEsv: Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite. All these were stewards of King David’s property.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Jaziz the Hagrite was over the flocks. All these were the officials over King David’s property.
verses.textEnNlt: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the king’s flocks of sheep and goats. All these officials were overseers of King David’s property.
verses.textEnNasb: Jaziz the Hagrite was responsible for the flocks. All these were overseers of the property which belonged to King David.
verses.textEn: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these were the officials in charge of King David’s property.

verses.textZh: 大卫的叔父约拿单是一个谋士；这人很有智慧，又是一个经学家；哈摩尼的儿子耶歇是王众子的老师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的叔父约拿单是一个谋士；这人很有智慧，又是一个经学家；哈摩尼的儿子耶歇是王众子的老师。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的叔叔约拿单作谋士；这人有智慧，又作书记。哈摩尼的儿子耶歇作王众子的师傅。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hakmoni took care of the king’s sons.
verses.textEnEsv: Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, being a man of understanding and a scribe. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni attended the king’s sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jehonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a wise man, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a wise counselor to the king, a man of great insight, and a scribe. Jehiel the Hacmonite was responsible for teaching the king’s sons.
verses.textEnNasb: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni tutored the king’s sons.
verses.textEn: Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hakmoni took care of the king’s sons.

verses.textZh: 亚希多弗也是王的谋士；亚基人户筛是王的朋友；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希多弗也是王的谋士；亚基人户筛是王的朋友；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希多弗也作王的谋士。亚基人户筛作王的陪伴。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Arkite was the king’s confidant.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor, and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor, and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahithophel was the royal adviser. Hushai the Arkite was the king’s friend.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahithophel was counselor to the king; and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
verses.textEn: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Arkite was the king’s confidant.

verses.textZh: 亚希多弗以后，有比拿雅的儿子耶何耶大和亚比亚他，接续他作谋士；约押作王的元帅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希多弗以后，有比拿雅的儿子耶何耶大和亚比亚他，接续他作谋士；约押作王的元帅。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希多弗之后，有比拿雅的儿子耶何耶大和亚比亚他接续他作谋士。约押作王的元帅。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah and by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the royal army.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was commander of the king’s army.
verses.textEnNkjv: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, then Abiathar. And the general of the king’s army was Joab.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah and by Abiathar. Joab was commander of the king’s army.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar succeeded Ahithophel; and Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
verses.textEn: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah and by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the royal army.

verses.textZh: 大卫把以色列的众领袖：各支派的领袖、轮班服事王的领袖、千夫长、百夫长、掌管王和王子们一切财产与牲畜的领袖，以及太监、显贵和所有英勇的战士，都召集到耶路撒冷来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把以色列的众领袖：各支派的领袖、轮班服事王的领袖、千夫长、百夫长、掌管王和王子们一切财产与牲畜的领袖，以及太监、显贵和所有英勇的战士，都召集到耶路撒冷来。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫招聚以色列各支派的首领和轮班服事王的军长，与千夫长、百夫长，掌管王和王子产业牲畜的，并太监，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷来。
verses.textEnNiv: David summoned all the officials of Israel to assemble at Jerusalem: the officers over the tribes, the commanders of the divisions in the service of the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the warriors and all the brave fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: David assembled at Jerusalem all the officials of Israel, the officials of the tribes, the officers of the divisions that served the king, the commanders of thousands, the commanders of hundreds, the stewards of all the property and livestock of the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the mighty men and all the seasoned warriors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David assembled at Jerusalem all the leaders of Israel: the officers of the tribes and the captains of the divisions who served the king, the captains over thousands and captains over hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officials, the valiant men, and all the mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: David summoned all the officials of Israel to Jerusalem—the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of the army divisions, the other generals and captains, the overseers of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, the mighty men, and all the other brave warriors in the kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David assembled at Jerusalem all the officials of Israel, the leaders of the tribes, and the commanders of the divisions that served the king, the commanders of thousands, and the commanders of hundreds, and the overseers of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, with the officials and the mighty men, all the valiant warriors.
verses.textEn: David summoned all the officials of Israel to assemble at Jerusalem: the officers over the tribes, the commanders of the divisions in the service of the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the warriors and all the brave fighting men.

verses.textZh: 大卫王站起来，说："我的兄弟，我的人民哪，你们要听我的话；我心里有意要建造一所安放耶和华的约柜的殿宇，作我们的神的脚凳，并且我已经准备好要建造。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王站起来，说："我的兄弟，我的人民哪，你们要听我的话；我心里有意要建造一所安放耶和华的约柜的殿宇，作我们的神的脚凳，并且我已经准备好要建造。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王就站起来，说：「我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你们当听我言，我心里本想建造殿宇，安放耶和华的约柜，作为我神的脚凳；我已经预备建造的材料。
verses.textEnNiv: King David rose to his feet and said: "Listen to me, my fellow Israelites, my people. I had it in my heart to build a house as a place of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord , for the footstool of our God, and I made plans to build it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King David rose to his feet and said: "Hear me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord and for the footstool of our God, and I made preparations for building.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King David rose to his feet and said, "Hear me, my brethren and my people: I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made preparations to build it.
verses.textEnNlt: David rose to his feet and said: "My brothers and my people! It was my desire to build a Temple where the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant, God’s footstool, could rest permanently. I made the necessary preparations for building it,
verses.textEnNasb: Then King David rose to his feet and said, "Listen to me, my brothers and my people; I had intended to build a permanent home for the ark of the covenant of the Lord and for the footstool of our God. So I had made preparations to build it.
verses.textEn: King David rose to his feet and said: "Listen to me, my fellow Israelites, my people. I had it in my heart to build a house as a place of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord , for the footstool of our God, and I made plans to build it.

verses.textZh: 可是神对我说：‘你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你是个战士，曾杀人流血。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是神对我说：‘你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你是个战士，曾杀人流血。’
verses.textZhCuv: 只是神对我说：『你不可为我的名建造殿宇；因你是战士，流了人的血。』
verses.textEnNiv: But God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for my Name, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.’
verses.textEnEsv: But God said to me, ‘You may not build a house for my name, for you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for My name, because you havebeen a man of war and have shed blood.’
verses.textEnNlt: but God said to me, ‘You must not build a Temple to honor my name, for you are a warrior and have shed much blood.’
verses.textEnNasb: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for My name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
verses.textEn: But God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for my Name, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.’

verses.textZh: 然而耶和华以色列的神，在我父的全家拣选了我作以色列人的王，直到永远；因为他拣选了犹大作领袖；在犹大家中拣选了我的父家；在我父亲的众子中，他喜悦我，立我作全以色列的王；
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而耶和华以色列的神，在我父的全家拣选了我作以色列人的王，直到永远；因为他拣选了犹大作领袖；在犹大家中拣选了我的父家；在我父亲的众子中，他喜悦我，立我作全以色列的王；
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，耶和华－以色列的神在我父的全家拣选我作以色列的王，直到永远。因他拣选犹大为首领；在犹大支派中拣选我父家，在我父的众子里喜悦我，立我作以色列众人的王。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet the Lord , the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as leader, and from the tribe of Judah he chose my family, and from my father’s sons he was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the Lord God of Israel chose me from all my father’s house to be king over Israel forever. For he chose Judah as leader, and in the house of Judah my father’s house, and among my father’s sons he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: However the Lord God of Israel chose me above all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever, for He has chosen Judah tobe the ruler. And of the house of Judah, the house of my father, and among the sons of my father, He was pleased with me to make me king over all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet the Lord , the God of Israel, has chosen me from among all my father’s family to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen the tribe of Judah to rule, and from among the families of Judah he chose my father’s family. And from among my father’s sons the Lord was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet, the Lord, the God of Israel, chose me from all the household of my father to be king over Israel forever. For He has chosen Judah to be a leader; and in the house of Judah, my father’s house, and among the sons of my father He took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
