verses.textEn: "Yet the Lord , the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as leader, and from the tribe of Judah he chose my family, and from my father’s sons he was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

verses.textZh: 在我的众子中 ，他拣选了我的儿子所罗门，坐耶和华的国位，统治以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我的众子中 ，他拣选了我的儿子所罗门，坐耶和华的国位，统治以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华赐我许多儿子，在我儿子中拣选所罗门坐耶和华的国位，治理以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Of all my sons—and the Lord has given me many—he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And of all my sons (for the Lord has given me many sons) he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of all my sons (for the Lord has given me many sons) He has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And from among my sons—for the Lord has given me many—he chose Solomon to succeed me on the throne of Israel and to rule over the Lord ’s kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: Of all my sons (for the Lord has given me many sons), He has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.textEn: Of all my sons—and the Lord has given me many—he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘你的儿子所罗门要建造我的殿宇和庭院；因为我已经拣选他作我的儿子，我也要作他的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘你的儿子所罗门要建造我的殿宇和庭院；因为我已经拣选他作我的儿子，我也要作他的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：『你儿子所罗门必建造我的殿和院宇；因为我拣选他作我的子，我也必作他的父。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me: ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to me, ‘It is Solomon your son who shall build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He said to me, ‘It is your son Solomon who shall build My house and My courts; for I have chosen him tobe My son, and I will be his Father.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to me, ‘Your son Solomon will build my Temple and its courtyards, for I have chosen him as my son, and I will be his father.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to me, ‘Your son Solomon is the one who shall build My house and My courtyards; for I have chosen him to be a son to Me, and I will be a Father to him.
verses.textEn: He said to me: ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

verses.textZh: 如果他坚心遵行我的诫命和典章，像今日一样，我必坚立他的国，直到永远。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他坚心遵行我的诫命和典章，像今日一样，我必坚立他的国，直到永远。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他若恒久遵行我的诫命典章如今日一样，我就必坚定他的国位，直到永远。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will establish his kingdom forever if he is unswerving in carrying out my commands and laws, as is being done at this time.’
verses.textEnEsv: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues strong in keeping my commandments and my rules, as he is today.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will establish his kingdom forever, if he is steadfast to observe My commandments and My judgments, as it is this day.’
verses.textEnNlt: And if he continues to obey my commands and regulations as he does now, I will make his kingdom last forever.’
verses.textEnNasb: I will establish his kingdom forever if he resolutely performs My commandments and My ordinances, as is done now.’
verses.textEn: I will establish his kingdom forever if he is unswerving in carrying out my commands and laws, as is being done at this time.’

verses.textZh: 所以现今在耶和华的会众，全体以色列人面前，我们的神也在垂听，你们务要谨守和寻求耶和华你们神的一切诫命，使你们可以承受那美地，并且遗留给你们以后的子孙，永远作为产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以现今在耶和华的会众，全体以色列人面前，我们的神也在垂听，你们务要谨守和寻求耶和华你们神的一切诫命，使你们可以承受那美地，并且遗留给你们以后的子孙，永远作为产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 现今在耶和华的会中，以色列众人眼前所说的，我们的神也听见了。你们应当寻求耶和华－你们神的一切诫命，谨守遵行，如此你们可以承受这美地，遗留给你们的子孙，永远为业。
verses.textEnNiv: "So now I charge you in the sight of all Israel and of the assembly of the Lord , and in the hearing of our God: Be careful to follow all the commands of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the Lord , and in the hearing of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the Lord, and in the hearing of our God, be careful to seek out all the commandments of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it as an inheritance for your children after you forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "So now, with God as our witness, and in the sight of all Israel—the Lord ’s assembly—I give you this charge. Be careful to obey all the commands of the Lord your God, so that you may continue to possess this good land and leave it to your children as a permanent inheritance.
verses.textEnNasb: So now, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the Lord, and in the presence of our God, keep and seek after all the commandments of the Lord your God so that you may possess the good land and leave it as an inheritance to your sons after you forever.
verses.textEn: "So now I charge you in the sight of all Israel and of the assembly of the Lord , and in the hearing of our God: Be careful to follow all the commands of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your descendants forever.

verses.textZh: "至于你，我儿所罗门哪，你要认识耶和华你父亲的神，一心乐意事奉他，因为耶和华鉴察万人的心，知道人的一切心思意念。你若是寻求他，就必寻见；你若是离弃他，他必永远丢弃你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于你，我儿所罗门哪，你要认识耶和华你父亲的神，一心乐意事奉他，因为耶和华鉴察万人的心，知道人的一切心思意念。你若是寻求他，就必寻见；你若是离弃他，他必永远丢弃你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我儿所罗门哪，你当认识耶和华－你父的神，诚心乐意地事奉他；因为他鉴察众人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若寻求他，他必使你寻见；你若离弃他，他必永远丢弃你。
verses.textEnNiv: "And you, my son Solomon, acknowledge the God of your father, and serve him with wholehearted devotion and with a willing mind, for the Lord searches every heart and understands every desire and every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve him with a whole heart and with a willing mind, for the Lord searches all hearts and understands every plan and thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for you, my son Solomon, know the God of your father, and serve Him with a loyal heart and with a willing mind; for the Lord searches all hearts and understands all the intent of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will cast you off forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "And Solomon, my son, learn to know the God of your ancestors intimately. Worship and serve him with your whole heart and a willing mind. For the Lord sees every heart and knows every plan and thought. If you seek him, you will find him. But if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, my son Solomon, know the God of your father, and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind; for the Lord searches all hearts, and understands every intent of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will let you find Him; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
verses.textEn: "And you, my son Solomon, acknowledge the God of your father, and serve him with wholehearted devotion and with a willing mind, for the Lord searches every heart and understands every desire and every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.

verses.textZh: 现在你当谨慎，因为耶和华拣选了你建造殿宇，作为圣所；你要勇敢地去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你当谨慎，因为耶和华拣选了你建造殿宇，作为圣所；你要勇敢地去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你当谨慎，因耶和华拣选你建造殿宇作为圣所。你当刚强去行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house as the sanctuary. Be strong and do the work."
verses.textEnEsv: Be careful now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong and do it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong, and do it."
verses.textEnNlt: So take this seriously. The Lord has chosen you to build a Temple as his sanctuary. Be strong, and do the work."
verses.textEnNasb: Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be courageous and act."
verses.textEn: Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house as the sanctuary. Be strong and do the work."

verses.textZh: 大卫把殿的走廊、房屋、库房、阁楼、内殿和安放施恩座的圣所的图样，都交给他的儿子所罗门；
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把殿的走廊、房屋、库房、阁楼、内殿和安放施恩座的圣所的图样，都交给他的儿子所罗门；
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫将殿的游廊、旁屋、府库、楼房、内殿，和施恩所的样式指示他儿子所罗门，
verses.textEnNiv: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper parts, its inner rooms and the place of atonement.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David gave Solomon his son the plan of the vestibule of the temple, and of its houses, its treasuries, its upper rooms, and its inner chambers, and of the room for the mercy seat;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the vestibule, its houses, its treasuries, its upper chambers, its inner chambers, and the place of the mercy seat;
verses.textEnNlt: Then David gave Solomon the plans for the Temple and its surroundings, including the entry room, the storerooms, the upstairs rooms, the inner rooms, and the inner sanctuary—which was the place of atonement.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David gave to his son Solomon the plan of the porch of the temple, its buildings, its storehouses, its upper rooms, its inner rooms, and the room for the atoning cover;
verses.textEn: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper parts, its inner rooms and the place of atonement.

verses.textZh: 又把他心中所想的图样，就是耶和华殿的院子、四周所有的房屋、神殿里的库房和圣物库房的图样，都指示了他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把他心中所想的图样，就是耶和华殿的院子、四周所有的房屋、神殿里的库房和圣物库房的图样，都指示了他；
verses.textZhCuv: 又将被灵感动所得的样式，就是耶和华神殿的院子、周围的房屋、殿的府库，和圣物府库的一切样式都指示他；
verses.textEnNiv: He gave him the plans of all that the Spirit had put in his mind for the courts of the temple of the Lord and all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the temple of God and for the treasuries for the dedicated things.
verses.textEnEsv: and the plan of all that he had in mind for the courts of the house of the Lord , all the surrounding chambers, the treasuries of the house of God, and the treasuries for dedicated gifts;
verses.textEnNkjv: and the plans for all that he had by the Spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, of all the chambers all around, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries for the dedicated things;
verses.textEnNlt: David also gave Solomon all the plans he had in mind for the courtyards of the Lord ’s Temple, the outside rooms, the treasuries, and the rooms for the gifts dedicated to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and the plan of all that he had in mind, for the courtyards of the house of the Lord, and for all the surrounding rooms, for the storehouses of the house of God and for the storehouses of the dedicated things;
verses.textEn: He gave him the plans of all that the Spirit had put in his mind for the courts of the temple of the Lord and all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the temple of God and for the treasuries for the dedicated things.

verses.textZh: 又把祭司和利未人的班次，耶和华殿里各样的职事和耶和华殿里一切需用的器皿，都指示了他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把祭司和利未人的班次，耶和华殿里各样的职事和耶和华殿里一切需用的器皿，都指示了他；
verses.textZhCuv: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次与耶和华殿里各样的工作，并耶和华殿里一切器皿的样式，
verses.textEnNiv: He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of serving in the temple of the Lord , as well as for all the articles to be used in its service.
verses.textEnEsv: for the divisions of the priests and of the Levites, and all the work of the service in the house of the Lord ; for all the vessels for the service in the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: also for the division of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the articles of service in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The king also gave Solomon the instructions concerning the work of the various divisions of priests and Levites in the Temple of the Lord . And he gave specifications for the items in the Temple that were to be used for worship.
verses.textEnNasb: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord and for all the utensils of service in the house of the Lord;
verses.textEn: He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of serving in the temple of the Lord , as well as for all the articles to be used in its service.

verses.textZh: 大卫又指示了他用多少金子做各样需用的金器；用多少银子做各样需用的银器；
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又指示了他用多少金子做各样需用的金器；用多少银子做各样需用的银器；
verses.textZhCuv: 以及各样应用金器的分两和各样应用银器的分两，
verses.textEnNiv: He designated the weight of gold for all the gold articles to be used in various kinds of service, and the weight of silver for all the silver articles to be used in various kinds of service:
verses.textEnEsv: the weight of gold for all golden vessels for each service, the weight of silver vessels for each service,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hegave gold by weight for things of gold, for all articles used in every kind of service; also silver for all articles of silver by weight, for all articles used in every kind of service;
verses.textEnNlt: David gave instructions regarding how much gold and silver should be used to make the items needed for service.
verses.textEnNasb: for the golden utensils, by weight of gold for all utensils for every service; for all the silver utensils, by weight of silver for all utensils for every service;
verses.textEn: He designated the weight of gold for all the gold articles to be used in various kinds of service, and the weight of silver for all the silver articles to be used in various kinds of service:

verses.textZh: 用多少金子做金灯台和台上的金灯；用多少金子做每盏金灯台和台上的金灯；用多少银子做银灯台和台上的银灯。每盏银灯台和台上的银灯用多少银子，都按照每盏灯台的用途；
verses.textZhCnvs: 用多少金子做金灯台和台上的金灯；用多少金子做每盏金灯台和台上的金灯；用多少银子做银灯台和台上的银灯。每盏银灯台和台上的银灯用多少银子，都按照每盏灯台的用途；
verses.textZhCuv: 金灯台和金灯的分两，银灯台和银灯的分两，轻重各都合宜；
verses.textEnNiv: the weight of gold for the gold lampstands and their lamps, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;
verses.textEnEsv: the weight of the golden lampstands and their lamps, the weight of gold for each lampstand and its lamps, the weight of silver for a lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand in the service,
verses.textEnNkjv: the weight for the lampstands of gold, and their lamps of gold, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps; for the lampstands of silver by weight, for the lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand.
verses.textEnNlt: He told Solomon the amount of gold needed for the gold lampstands and lamps, and the amount of silver for the silver lampstands and lamps, depending on how each would be used.
verses.textEnNasb: and the weight of gold for the golden lampstands and their golden lamps, with the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for the silver lampstands, with the weight of each lampstand and its lamps according to the use of each lampstand;
verses.textEn: the weight of gold for the gold lampstands and their lamps, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

verses.textZh: 用多少金子做陈设饼的桌子；用多少银子做银桌子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 用多少金子做陈设饼的桌子；用多少银子做银桌子；
verses.textZhCuv: 陈设饼金桌子的分两，银桌子的分两，
verses.textEnNiv: the weight of gold for each table for consecrated bread; the weight of silver for the silver tables;
verses.textEnEsv: the weight of gold for each table for the showbread, the silver for the silver tables,
verses.textEnNkjv: And by weight hegave gold for the tables of the showbread, for each table, and silver for the tables of silver;
verses.textEnNlt: He designated the amount of gold for the table on which the Bread of the Presence would be placed and the amount of silver for other tables.
verses.textEnNasb: and the gold by weight for the tables of the showbread, for each table; and silver for the silver tables;
verses.textEn: the weight of gold for each table for consecrated bread; the weight of silver for the silver tables;

verses.textZh: 用多少纯金做叉、盘和壶；用多少金子做金碗，每只碗重量多少；用多少银子做银碗，每只碗重量多少；
verses.textZhCnvs: 用多少纯金做叉、盘和壶；用多少金子做金碗，每只碗重量多少；用多少银子做银碗，每只碗重量多少；
verses.textZhCuv: 精金的肉叉子、盘子，和爵的分两，各金碗与各银碗的分两，
verses.textEnNiv: the weight of pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls and pitchers; the weight of gold for each gold dish; the weight of silver for each silver dish;
verses.textEnEsv: and pure gold for the forks, the basins and the cups; for the golden bowls and the weight of each; for the silver bowls and the weight of each;
verses.textEnNkjv: also pure gold for the forks, the basins, the pitchers of pure gold, and the golden bowls—he gave gold by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls, silver by weight for every bowl;
verses.textEnNlt: David also designated the amount of gold for the solid gold meat hooks used to handle the sacrificial meat and for the basins, pitchers, and dishes, as well as the amount of silver for every dish.
verses.textEnNasb: and the forks, the basins, and the pitchers of pure gold; and for the golden bowls with the weight for each bowl; and for the silver bowls with the weight for each bowl;
verses.textEn: the weight of pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls and pitchers; the weight of gold for each gold dish; the weight of silver for each silver dish;

verses.textZh: 用多少精金做香坛；又用金子做基路伯，像车的样子；基路伯展开翅膀，遮盖着耶和华的约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用多少精金做香坛；又用金子做基路伯，像车的样子；基路伯展开翅膀，遮盖着耶和华的约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 精金香坛的分两，并用金子做基路伯 ；基路伯张开翅膀，遮掩耶和华的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: and the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense. He also gave him the plan for the chariot, that is, the cherubim of gold that spread their wings and overshadow the ark of the covenant of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: for the altar of incense made of refined gold, and its weight; also his plan for the golden chariot of the cherubim that spread their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and refined gold by weight for the altar of incense, and for the construction of the chariot, that is, the gold cherubim that spread theirwings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He designated the amount of refined gold for the altar of incense. Finally, he gave him a plan for the Lord ’s "chariot"—the gold cherubim whose wings were stretched out over the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the model of the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.textEn: and the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense. He also gave him the plan for the chariot, that is, the cherubim of gold that spread their wings and overshadow the ark of the covenant of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫说："以上这一切，就是一切工作的样式，都是耶和华用手写给我，使我明白的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："以上这一切，就是一切工作的样式，都是耶和华用手写给我，使我明白的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「这一切工作的样式都是耶和华用手划出来使我明白的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "All this," David said, "I have in writing as a result of the Lord ’s hand on me, and he enabled me to understand all the details of the plan."
verses.textEnEsv: "All this he made clear to me in writing from the hand of the Lord , all the work to be done according to the plan."
verses.textEnNkjv: "All this," saidDavid, "the Lord made me understand in writing, by His hand upon me, all the works of these plans."
verses.textEnNlt: "Every part of this plan," David told Solomon, "was given to me in writing from the hand of the Lord . "
verses.textEnNasb: "All this," said David, "the Lord made me understand in writing by His hand upon me, all the details of this pattern."
verses.textEn: "All this," David said, "I have in writing as a result of the Lord ’s hand on me, and he enabled me to understand all the details of the plan."

verses.textZh: 大卫又对他的儿子所罗门说："你要坚强勇敢地去作，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为耶和华神，就是我的神，与你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你，直到耶和华殿的一切工作都完成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又对他的儿子所罗门说："你要坚强勇敢地去作，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为耶和华神，就是我的神，与你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你，直到耶和华殿的一切工作都完成。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又对他儿子所罗门说：「你当刚强壮胆去行！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。因为耶和华神就是我的神，与你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你，直到耶和华殿的工作都完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: David also said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the temple of the Lord is finished.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous and do it. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed, for the Lord God, even my God, is with you. He will not leave you or forsake you, until all the work for the service of the house of the Lord is finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to his son Solomon, "Be strong and of good courage, and do it; do not fear nor be dismayed, for the Lord God—my God—willbe with you. He will not leave you nor forsake you, until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David continued, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Don’t be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you. He will see to it that all the work related to the Temple of the Lord is finished correctly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to his son Solomon, "Be strong and courageous, and act; do not fear nor be dismayed, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you until all the work for the service of the house of the Lord is finished.
verses.textEn: David also said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the temple of the Lord is finished.

verses.textZh: 你看，有祭司和利未人的各班次，办理神殿里的一切事务；又有各种的巧匠，在各样的工作上，乐意帮助你，并且众领袖和所有的人民，都听从你的一切命令。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，有祭司和利未人的各班次，办理神殿里的一切事务；又有各种的巧匠，在各样的工作上，乐意帮助你，并且众领袖和所有的人民，都听从你的一切命令。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有祭司和利未人的各班，为要办理神殿各样的事，又有灵巧的人在各样的工作上乐意帮助你；并有众首领和众民一心听从你的命令。」
verses.textEnNiv: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the work on the temple of God, and every willing person skilled in any craft will help you in all the work. The officials and all the people will obey your every command."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of the house of God; and with you in all the work will be every willing man who has skill for any kind of service; also the officers and all the people will be wholly at your command."
verses.textEnNkjv: Hereare the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of the house of God; and every willing craftsman willbe with you for all manner of workmanship, for every kind of service; also the leaders and all the people willbe completely at your command."
verses.textEnNlt: The various divisions of priests and Levites will serve in the Temple of God. Others with skills of every kind will volunteer, and the officials and the entire nation are at your command."
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of any skill will be with you in all the work for all kinds of service. The officials also and all the people will be entirely at your command."
verses.textEn: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the work on the temple of God, and every willing person skilled in any craft will help you in all the work. The officials and all the people will obey your every command."

verses.textZh: 大卫王对全体会众说："我的儿子所罗门，是神所拣选的，现在还年幼识浅，而这工程非常浩大；因为这殿宇不是为人建造，而是为耶和华神建造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王对全体会众说："我的儿子所罗门，是神所拣选的，现在还年幼识浅，而这工程非常浩大；因为这殿宇不是为人建造，而是为耶和华神建造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王对会众说：「我儿子所罗门是神特选的，还年幼娇嫩；这工程甚大，因这殿不是为人，乃是为耶和华神建造的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King David said to the whole assembly: "My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great, because this palatial structure is not for man but for the Lord God.
verses.textEnEsv: And David the king said to all the assembly, "Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and the work is great, for the palace will not be for man but for the Lord God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore King David said to all the assembly: "My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is young and inexperienced; and the work is great, because the temple is not for man but for the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King David turned to the entire assembly and said, "My son Solomon, whom God has clearly chosen as the next king of Israel, is still young and inexperienced. The work ahead of him is enormous, for the Temple he will build is not for mere mortals—it is for the Lord God himself!
verses.textEnNasb: Then King David said to the entire assembly, "My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is still young and inexperienced, and the work is great; for the temple is not for mankind, but for the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Then King David said to the whole assembly: "My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great, because this palatial structure is not for man but for the Lord God.

verses.textZh: 我为我神的殿已经尽了我的力量，预备了金子做金器，银子做银器，铜做铜器，铁做铁器，木做木器；还有红玛瑙、用作镶嵌的宝石、彩石和各样的宝石，以及很多大理石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为我神的殿已经尽了我的力量，预备了金子做金器，银子做银器，铜做铜器，铁做铁器，木做木器；还有红玛瑙、用作镶嵌的宝石、彩石和各样的宝石，以及很多大理石。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为我神的殿已经尽力，预备金子做金器，银子做银器，铜做铜器，铁做铁器，木做木器，还有红玛瑙可镶嵌的宝石，彩石和一切的宝石，并许多汉白玉。
verses.textEnNiv: With all my resources I have provided for the temple of my God—gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, and all kinds of fine stone and marble—all of these in large quantities.
verses.textEnEsv: So I have provided for the house of my God, so far as I was able, the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, and the bronze for the things of bronze, the iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, besides great quantities of onyx and stones for setting, antimony, colored stones, all sorts of precious stones and marble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now for the house of my God I have prepared with all my might: gold for thingstobemadeof gold, silver for thingsof silver, bronze for thingsof bronze, iron for thingsof iron, wood for thingsof wood, onyx stones, stones to be set, glistening stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble slabs in abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: Using every resource at my command, I have gathered as much as I could for building the Temple of my God. Now there is enough gold, silver, bronze, iron, and wood, as well as great quantities of onyx, other precious stones, costly jewels, and all kinds of fine stone and marble.
verses.textEnNasb: Now with all my ability I have provided for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, the iron for the things of iron, wood for the things of wood, onyx stones and inlaid stones, stones of antimony and stones of various colors, and all kinds of precious stones and alabaster in abundance.
verses.textEn: With all my resources I have provided for the temple of my God—gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, and all kinds of fine stone and marble—all of these in large quantities.

verses.textZh: 不但这样，因我爱慕我神的殿，就在我为建造圣殿预备的一切以外，又把我自己积蓄的金银献给我神的殿：
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但这样，因我爱慕我神的殿，就在我为建造圣殿预备的一切以外，又把我自己积蓄的金银献给我神的殿：
verses.textZhCuv: 且因我心中爱慕我神的殿，就在预备建造圣殿的材料之外，又将我自己积蓄的金银献上，建造我神的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: Besides, in my devotion to the temple of my God I now give my personal treasures of gold and silver for the temple of my God, over and above everything I have provided for this holy temple:
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, in addition to all that I have provided for the holy house, I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, and because of my devotion to the house of my God I give it to the house of my God:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, because of my devotion to the Temple of my God, I am giving all of my own private treasures of gold and silver to help in the construction. This is in addition to the building materials I have already collected for his holy Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: In addition, in my delight in the house of my God, the treasure I have of gold and silver, I give to the house of my God, over and above all that I have already provided for the holy temple,
verses.textEn: Besides, in my devotion to the temple of my God I now give my personal treasures of gold and silver for the temple of my God, over and above everything I have provided for this holy temple:

verses.textZh: 就是俄斐金一百多公吨，精炼的银子约两百四十公吨，用来贴殿里的墙壁；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是俄斐金一百多公吨，精炼的银子约两百四十公吨，用来贴殿里的墙壁；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是俄斐金三千他连得、精炼的银子七千他连得，以贴殿墙。
verses.textEnNiv: three thousand talents of gold (gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the buildings,
verses.textEnEsv: 3,000 talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and 7,000 talents of refined silver, for overlaying the walls of the house,
verses.textEnNkjv: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses;
verses.textEnNlt: I am donating more than 112 tons of gold from Ophir and 262 tons of refined silver to be used for overlaying the walls of the buildings
verses.textEnNasb: namely, three thousand talents of gold, from the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings;
verses.textEn: three thousand talents of gold (gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the buildings,

verses.textZh: 金子做金器，银子做银器，以及匠人手所作的各样巧工。今日有谁愿意奉献给耶和华呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 金子做金器，银子做银器，以及匠人手所作的各样巧工。今日有谁愿意奉献给耶和华呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 金子做金器，银子做银器，并藉匠人的手制造一切。今日有谁乐意将自己献给耶和华呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate themselves to the Lord today?"
verses.textEnEsv: and for all the work to be done by craftsmen, gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver. Who then will offer willingly, consecrating himself today to the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: the gold for thingsof gold and the silver for thingsof silver, and for all kinds of work tobedone by the hands of craftsmen. Who then is willing to consecrate himself this day to the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: and for the other gold and silver work to be done by the craftsmen. Now then, who will follow my example and give offerings to the Lord today?"
verses.textEnNasb: gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver, that is, for all the work done by the craftsmen. Who then is willing to consecrate himself this day to the Lord?"
verses.textEn: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate themselves to the Lord today?"

verses.textZh: 于是各家族的领袖、以色列各支派的领袖、千夫长、百夫长和管理王的事务的领袖，都乐意奉献。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是各家族的领袖、以色列各支派的领袖、千夫长、百夫长和管理王的事务的领袖，都乐意奉献。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，众族长和以色列各支派的首领、千夫长、百夫长，并监管王工的官长，都乐意献上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the leaders of families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the leaders of fathers’ houses made their freewill offerings, as did also the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officers over the king’s work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the leaders of the fathers’ houses, leaders of the tribes of Israel, the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the officers over the king’s work, offered willingly.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the family leaders, the leaders of the tribes of Israel, the generals and captains of the army, and the king’s administrative officers all gave willingly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the rulers of the fathers’ households, the leaders of the tribes of Israel, and the commanders of thousands and hundreds, with the supervisors of the king’s work, offered willingly;
verses.textEn: Then the leaders of families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.

verses.textZh: 为了神殿里的需用，他们奉献了金子一百七十多公吨，银子三百四十多公吨，铜约六百二十公吨和铁三千四百公吨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了神殿里的需用，他们奉献了金子一百七十多公吨，银子三百四十多公吨，铜约六百二十公吨和铁三千四百公吨。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们为神殿的使用献上金子五千他连得零一万达利克，银子一万他连得，铜一万八千他连得，铁十万他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: They gave toward the work on the temple of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.textEnEsv: They gave for the service of the house of God 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze and 100,000 talents of iron.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gave for the work of the house of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.textEnNlt: For the construction of the Temple of God, they gave about 188 tons of gold, 10,000 gold coins, 375 tons of silver, 675 tons of bronze, and 3,750 tons of iron.
verses.textEnNasb: and for the service of the house of God they gave five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of brass, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.textEn: They gave toward the work on the temple of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.textZh: 有宝石的，都交到耶和华殿这库房，由革顺人耶歇经办。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有宝石的，都交到耶和华殿这库房，由革顺人耶歇经办。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有宝石的都交给革顺人耶歇，送入耶和华殿的府库。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the temple of the Lord in the custody of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the Lord , in the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the Lord, into the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.textEnNlt: They also contributed numerous precious stones, which were deposited in the treasury of the house of the Lord under the care of Jehiel, a descendant of Gershon.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever possessed precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the Lord, in care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.textEn: Anyone who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the temple of the Lord in the custody of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.textZh: 人民因这些人自愿奉献而欢喜，因为他们一心乐意奉献给耶和华，大卫王也非常欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民因这些人自愿奉献而欢喜，因为他们一心乐意奉献给耶和华，大卫王也非常欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 因这些人诚心乐意献给耶和华，百姓就欢喜，大卫王也大大欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: The people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the Lord . David the king also rejoiced greatly.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people rejoiced because they had given willingly, for with a whole heart they had offered freely to the Lord . David the king also rejoiced greatly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people rejoiced, for they had offered willingly, because with a loyal heart they had offered willingly to the Lord; and King David also rejoiced greatly.
verses.textEnNlt: The people rejoiced over the offerings, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the Lord , and King David was filled with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people rejoiced because they had offered so willingly, for they made their offering to the Lord wholeheartedly, and King David also rejoiced greatly.
verses.textEn: The people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the Lord . David the king also rejoiced greatly.

verses.textZh: 所以大卫在全体会众面前称颂耶和华，说："耶和华我们的祖先以色列的神，是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以大卫在全体会众面前称颂耶和华，说："耶和华我们的祖先以色列的神，是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，大卫在会众面前称颂耶和华说：「耶和华－我们的父，以色列的神是应当称颂，直到永永远远的！
verses.textEnNiv: David praised the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, "Praise be to you, Lord , the God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore David blessed the Lord in the presence of all the assembly. And David said: "Blessed are you, O Lord , the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David blessed the Lord before all the assembly; and David said: "Blessed are You, Lord God of Israel, our Father, forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David praised the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly: "O Lord , the God of our ancestor Israel, may you be praised forever and ever!
verses.textEnNasb: So David blessed the Lord in the sight of all the assembly; and David said, "Blessed are You, Lord God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
verses.textEn: David praised the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, "Praise be to you, Lord , the God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，尊大、能力、荣耀、胜利和威严，都是你的；因为天上地下的万有都是你的；耶和华啊，国度是你的，你是至高的，是万有之首。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，尊大、能力、荣耀、胜利和威严，都是你的；因为天上地下的万有都是你的；耶和华啊，国度是你的，你是至高的，是万有之首。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，尊大、能力、荣耀、强胜、威严都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；国度也是你的，并且你为至高，为万有之首。
verses.textEnNiv: Yours, Lord , is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, Lord , is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.
verses.textEnEsv: Yours, O Lord , is the greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty, for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, O Lord , and you are exalted as head above all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yours, O Lord, is the greatness, The power and the glory, The victory and the majesty; For all thatis in heaven and in earth isYours; Yours is the kingdom, O Lord, And You are exalted as head over all.
verses.textEnNlt: Yours, O Lord , is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty. Everything in the heavens and on earth is yours, O Lord , and this is your kingdom. We adore you as the one who is over all things.
verses.textEnNasb: Yours, Lord, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty, indeed everything that is in the heavens and on the earth; Yours is the dominion, Lord, and You exalt Yourself as head over all.
verses.textEn: Yours, Lord , is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, Lord , is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.

verses.textZh: 富足和尊荣都从你而来，你也统治万有。在你的手里有力量和权能；人的尊大、强盛都是出于你的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 富足和尊荣都从你而来，你也统治万有。在你的手里有力量和权能；人的尊大、强盛都是出于你的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 丰富尊荣都从你而来，你也治理万物。在你手里有大能大力，使人尊大强盛都出于你。
verses.textEnNiv: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.
verses.textEnEsv: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all. In your hand are power and might, and in your hand it is to make great and to give strength to all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand itis to make great And to give strength to all.
verses.textEnNlt: Wealth and honor come from you alone, for you rule over everything. Power and might are in your hand, and at your discretion people are made great and given strength.
verses.textEnNasb: Both riches and honor come from You, and You rule over all, and in Your hand is power and might; and it lies in Your hand to make great and to strengthen everyone.
verses.textEn: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.

verses.textZh: 我们的神啊，现在我们要称颂你，赞美你荣耀的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神啊，现在我们要称颂你，赞美你荣耀的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的神啊，现在我们称谢你，赞美你荣耀之名！
verses.textEnNiv: Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name.
verses.textEnEsv: And now we thank you, our God, and praise your glorious name.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, our God, We thank You And praise Your glorious name.
verses.textEnNlt: "O our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name!
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, our God, we thank You, and praise Your glorious name.
verses.textEn: Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name.

verses.textZh: 我算甚么？我的人民又算甚么？竟有力量这样乐意奉献？因为万物都是从你而来，我们只是把从你手里得来的，奉献给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我算甚么？我的人民又算甚么？竟有力量这样乐意奉献？因为万物都是从你而来，我们只是把从你手里得来的，奉献给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我算什么，我的民算什么，竟能如此乐意奉献？因为万物都从你而来，我们把从你而得的献给你。
verses.textEnNiv: "But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: "But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able thus to offer willingly? For all things come from you, and of your own have we given you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But who am I, and who are my people, That we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You.
verses.textEnNlt: But who am I, and who are my people, that we could give anything to you? Everything we have has come from you, and we give you only what you first gave us!
verses.textEnNasb: "But who am I and who are my people that we should be able to offer as generously as this? For all things come from You, and from Your hand we have given to You.
verses.textEn: "But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.

verses.textZh: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我们的列祖一样；我们在世上的日子好象影儿，没有指望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我们的列祖一样；我们在世上的日子好象影儿，没有指望。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，与我们列祖一样。我们在世的日子如影儿，不能长存 。
verses.textEnNiv: We are foreigners and strangers in your sight, as were all our ancestors. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are strangers before you and sojourners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are like a shadow, and there is no abiding.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are aliens and pilgrims before You, As were all our fathers; Our days on earth are as a shadow, And without hope.
verses.textEnNlt: We are here for only a moment, visitors and strangers in the land as our ancestors were before us. Our days on earth are like a passing shadow, gone so soon without a trace.
verses.textEnNasb: For we are strangers before You, and temporary residents, as all our fathers were; our days on the earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.
verses.textEn: We are foreigners and strangers in your sight, as were all our ancestors. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神啊，我们预备的这一切财物，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来的，也都是属于你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神啊，我们预备的这一切财物，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来的，也都是属于你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神啊，我们预备这许多材料，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来，都是属你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a temple for your Holy Name comes from your hand, and all of it belongs to you.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a house for your holy name comes from your hand and is all your own.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name is from Your hand, and is all Your own.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord our God, even this material we have gathered to build a Temple to honor your holy name comes from you! It all belongs to you!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord our God, all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy name, it is from Your hand, and everything is Yours.
verses.textEn: Lord our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a temple for your Holy Name comes from your hand, and all of it belongs to you.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直；至于我，我以正直的心甘愿奉献这一切；现在我也非常欢喜看见你在这里的人民，都甘愿奉献给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直；至于我，我以正直的心甘愿奉献这一切；现在我也非常欢喜看见你在这里的人民，都甘愿奉献给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直；我以正直的心乐意献上这一切物。现在我喜欢见你的民在这里都乐意奉献与你。
verses.textEnNiv: I know, my God, that you test the heart and are pleased with integrity. All these things I have given willingly and with honest intent. And now I have seen with joy how willingly your people who are here have given to you.
verses.textEnEsv: I know, my God, that you test the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart I have freely offered all these things, and now I have seen your people, who are present here, offering freely and joyously to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I know also, my God, that You test the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here to offer willingly to You.
verses.textEnNlt: I know, my God, that you examine our hearts and rejoice when you find integrity there. You know I have done all this with good motives, and I have watched your people offer their gifts willingly and joyously.
verses.textEnNasb: Since I know, my God, that You put the heart to the test and delight in uprightness, I, in the integrity of my heart, have willingly offered all these things; so now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here, make their offerings willingly to You.
verses.textEn: I know, my God, that you test the heart and are pleased with integrity. All these things I have given willingly and with honest intent. And now I have seen with joy how willingly your people who are here have given to you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神啊，求你永远保守这一件事，就是使你的子民常存这心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神啊，求你永远保守这一件事，就是使你的子民常存这心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神啊，求你使你的民常存这样的心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你，
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , the God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Israel, keep these desires and thoughts in the hearts of your people forever, and keep their hearts loyal to you.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep forever such purposes and thoughts in the hearts of your people, and direct their hearts toward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep this forever in the intent of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and fix their heart toward You.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord , the God of our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, make your people always want to obey you. See to it that their love for you never changes.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep this forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts to You;
verses.textEn: Lord , the God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Israel, keep these desires and thoughts in the hearts of your people forever, and keep their hearts loyal to you.

verses.textZh: 求你赐给我的儿子所罗门专一的心，谨守你的诫命、法度和律例，作成这一切事，用我所预备的一切来建造殿宇。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你赐给我的儿子所罗门专一的心，谨守你的诫命、法度和律例，作成这一切事，用我所预备的一切来建造殿宇。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又求你赐我儿子所罗门诚实的心，遵守你的命令、法度、律例，成就这一切的事，用我所预备的建造殿宇。」
verses.textEnNiv: And give my son Solomon the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, statutes and decrees and to do everything to build the palatial structure for which I have provided."
verses.textEnEsv: Grant to Solomon my son a whole heart that he may keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, performing all, and that he may build the palace for which I have made provision."
verses.textEnNkjv: And give my son Solomon a loyal heart to keep Your commandments and Your testimonies and Your statutes, to do all thesethings, and to build the temple for which I have made provision."
verses.textEnNlt: Give my son Solomon the wholehearted desire to obey all your commands, laws, and decrees, and to do everything necessary to build this Temple, for which I have made these preparations."
verses.textEnNasb: and give my son Solomon a perfect heart to keep Your commandments, Your testimonies, and Your statutes, and to do them all, and to build the temple for which I have made provision."
verses.textEn: And give my son Solomon the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, statutes and decrees and to do everything to build the palatial structure for which I have provided."

verses.textZh: 大卫对全体会众说："你们应当称颂耶和华你们的神。"于是全体会众就称颂耶和华他们列祖的神，俯伏敬拜耶和华和王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对全体会众说："你们应当称颂耶和华你们的神。"于是全体会众就称颂耶和华他们列祖的神，俯伏敬拜耶和华和王。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对全会众说：「你们应当称颂耶和华－你们的神。」于是会众称颂耶和华－他们列祖的神，低头拜耶和华与王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to the whole assembly, "Praise the Lord your God." So they all praised the Lord , the God of their fathers; they bowed down, prostrating themselves before the Lord and the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to all the assembly, "Bless the Lord your God." And all the assembly blessed the Lord , the God of their fathers, and bowed their heads and paid homage to the Lord and to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to all the assembly, "Now bless the Lord your God." So all the assembly blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed their heads and prostrated themselves before the Lord and the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to the whole assembly, "Give praise to the Lord your God!" And the entire assembly praised the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and they bowed low and knelt before the Lord and the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to all the assembly, "Now bless the Lord your God." And all the assembly blessed the Lord, the God of their fathers, and bowed down and paid homage to the Lord and the king.
verses.textEn: Then David said to the whole assembly, "Praise the Lord your God." So they all praised the Lord , the God of their fathers; they bowed down, prostrating themselves before the Lord and the king.

verses.textZh: 第二天，他们向耶和华献祭，他们向耶和华献上燔祭；那一天他们献了公牛一千头、公绵羊一千只、羊羔一千只，以及同献的奠祭，又为以色列众人献了许多祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，他们向耶和华献祭，他们向耶和华献上燔祭；那一天他们献了公牛一千头、公绵羊一千只、羊羔一千只，以及同献的奠祭，又为以色列众人献了许多祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，他们向耶和华献平安祭和燔祭，就是献公牛一千只，公绵羊一千只，羊羔一千只，并同献的奠祭；又为以色列众人献许多的祭。那日，他们在耶和华面前吃喝，大大欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day they made sacrifices to the Lord and presented burnt offerings to him: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams and a thousand male lambs, together with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And they offered sacrifices to the Lord , and on the next day offered burnt offerings to the Lord , 1,000 bulls, 1,000 rams, and 1,000 lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made sacrifices to the Lord and offered burnt offerings to the Lord on the next day: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day they brought 1,000 bulls, 1,000 rams, and 1,000 male lambs as burnt offerings to the Lord . They also brought liquid offerings and many other sacrifices on behalf of all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: On the next day they made sacrifices to the Lord and offered burnt offerings to the Lord, a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.textEn: The next day they made sacrifices to the Lord and presented burnt offerings to him: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams and a thousand male lambs, together with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

verses.textZh: 那一天，他们十分喜乐地在耶和华面前吃喝。他们再次表示拥立大卫的儿子所罗门作王，膏他为耶和华作君王，又膏撒督作祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，他们十分喜乐地在耶和华面前吃喝。他们再次表示拥立大卫的儿子所罗门作王，膏他为耶和华作君王，又膏撒督作祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们奉耶和华的命再膏大卫的儿子所罗门作王，又膏撒督作祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: They ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the Lord that day. Then they acknowledged Solomon son of David as king a second time, anointing him before the Lord to be ruler and Zadok to be priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And they ate and drank before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and they anointed him as prince for the Lord , and Zadok as priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they ate and drank before the Lord with great gladness on that day. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the Lordtobe the leader, and Zadok tobe priest.
verses.textEnNlt: They feasted and drank in the Lord ’s presence with great joy that day. And again they crowned David’s son Solomon as their new king. They anointed him before the Lord as their leader, and they anointed Zadok as priest.
verses.textEnNasb: So they ate and drank that day before the Lord with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king a second time, and they anointed him as ruler for the Lord and Zadok as priest.
verses.textEn: They ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the Lord that day. Then they acknowledged Solomon son of David as king a second time, anointing him before the Lord to be ruler and Zadok to be priest.

verses.textZh: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王；他凡事亨通，以色列众人都听从他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王；他凡事亨通，以色列众人都听从他。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王，万事亨通；以色列众人也都听从他。
verses.textEnNiv: So Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king in place of his father David. He prospered and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king in place of David his father. And he prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon took the throne of the Lord in place of his father, David, and he succeeded in everything, and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of his father David; and he prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.textEn: So Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king in place of his father David. He prospered and all Israel obeyed him.

verses.textZh: 众领袖和勇士，以及大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众领袖和勇士，以及大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。
verses.textZhCuv: 众首领和勇士，并大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。
verses.textEnNiv: All the officers and warriors, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their submission to King Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: All the leaders and the mighty men, and also all the sons of King David, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the leaders and the mighty men, and also all the sons of King David, submitted themselves to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: All the officials, the warriors, and the sons of King David pledged their loyalty to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the officials, the mighty men, and also all the sons of King David pledged allegiance to King Solomon.
verses.textEn: All the officers and warriors, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their submission to King Solomon.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人面前非常尊大，又赐给他君王的威严，胜过在他以前所有的以色列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人面前非常尊大，又赐给他君王的威严，胜过在他以前所有的以色列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人眼前甚为尊大，极其威严，胜过在他以前的以色列王。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal splendor such as no king over Israel ever had before.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord made Solomon very great in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord exalted Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed on him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel, and he gave Solomon greater royal splendor than any king in Israel before him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord highly honored Solomon in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed on him royal majesty which had not been bestowed on any king before him in Israel.
verses.textEn: The Lord highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal splendor such as no king over Israel ever had before.

verses.textZh: 耶西的儿子大卫作全以色列的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西的儿子大卫作全以色列的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，
verses.textEnNiv: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So David son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.textEn: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫作王统治以色列的日子共四十年；他在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫作王统治以色列的日子共四十年；他在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.textZhCuv: 作王共四十年：在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.textEnNiv: He ruled over Israel forty years—seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years. He reigned seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the period that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years he reigned in Hebron, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He reigned over Israel for forty years, seven of them in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: The period which he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned in Hebron seven years and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
verses.textEn: He ruled over Israel forty years—seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 大卫年纪老迈，寿数满足，享尽富足和尊荣才去世；他的儿子所罗门接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫年纪老迈，寿数满足，享尽富足和尊荣才去世；他的儿子所罗门接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 他年纪老迈，日子满足，享受丰富、尊荣，就死了。他儿子所罗门接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth and honor. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he died at a good age, full of days, riches, and honor. And Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he died in a good old age, full of days and riches and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: He died at a ripe old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth, and honor. Then his son Solomon ruled in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and his son Solomon reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth and honor. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 大卫王一生始末的事迹，都记在撒母耳先见的书上、拿单先知的书上和迦得先见的书上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王一生始末的事迹，都记在撒母耳先见的书上、拿单先知的书上和迦得先见的书上。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王始终的事都写在先见撒母耳的书上和先知拿单并先见迦得的书上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the events of King David’s reign, from beginning to end, they are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet and the records of Gad the seer,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are written in the Chronicles of Samuel the seer, and in the Chronicles of Nathan the prophet, and in the Chronicles of Gad the seer,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the acts of King David, first and last, indeed they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
verses.textEnNlt: All the events of King David’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in The Record of Samuel the Seer, The Record of Nathan the Prophet, and The Record of Gad the Seer.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the acts of King David, from the first to the last, are written in the chronicles of Samuel the seer, in the chronicles of Nathan the prophet, and in the chronicles of Gad the seer,
verses.textEn: As for the events of King David’s reign, from beginning to end, they are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet and the records of Gad the seer,

verses.textZh: 还有他治理的一切国事，他的英勇事迹，以及在他身上和以色列并各地列国发生的事迹，都记在这些书上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有他治理的一切国事，他的英勇事迹，以及在他身上和以色列并各地列国发生的事迹，都记在这些书上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的国事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列并列国所经过的事都写在这书上。
verses.textEnNiv: together with the details of his reign and power, and the circumstances that surrounded him and Israel and the kingdoms of all the other lands.
verses.textEnEsv: with accounts of all his rule and his might and of the circumstances that came upon him and upon Israel and upon all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.textEnNkjv: with all his reign and his might, and the events that happened to him, to Israel, and to all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.textEnNlt: These accounts include the mighty deeds of his reign and everything that happened to him and to Israel and to all the surrounding kingdoms.
verses.textEnNasb: with all of his reign, his power, and the circumstances which came upon him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.textEn: together with the details of his reign and power, and the circumstances that surrounded him and Israel and the kingdoms of all the other lands.
